Create Or Replace Force view Ias_V_soqty as
SELECT Order_detail.ORDER_NO, Order_detail.i_code, Sum(i_qty) i_qty
FROM Order_detail
GROUP BY Order_detail.Order_no, Order_detail.i_code
Create or replace force view Ias_V_bsoqty as
SELECT so_no, IAS_BILL_DTL.i_code, sum(i_qty ) i_qty
From IAS_BILL_DTL
WHERE so_no Is Not Null
GROUP BY so_no, IAS_BILL_DTL.i_code
Create or replace force view Ias_V_so_bill_qty as
SELECT a.order_no, a.i_code,
nvl(a.i_qty,0)-nvl(b.i_qty,0) net_qty
FROM ias_v_soqty a ,ias_v_bsoqty b
where a.order_no= b.so_no(+)
and a.i_code= b.i_code(+)
and nvl(a.i_qty,0)-nvl(b.i_qty,0) >0

AD_U_ID, UP_DATE, UP_U_ID)AS
Select Inv_Type , TYPE_NO , Type_L_Nm , Type_F_Nm ,AD_DATE, AD_U_ID, UP_DATE, UP_U_ID
From
SELECT 1 Inv_Type , REQ_TYPE TYPE_NO ,REQ_NAME Type_L_Nm , REQ_E_NAME Type_F_Nm ,AD_DATE, AD_U_ID, UP_DATE, UP_U_ID FROM REQUEST_TYPES
Union All
SELECT 2 Inv_Type , INCOM_TYPE TYPE_NO ,INCOM_NAME Type_L_Nm , INCOM_E_NAME Type_F_Nm ,AD_DATE, AD_U_ID, UP_DATE, UP_U_ID FROM INCOM_TYPES
SELECT 3 Inv_Type , OUT_TYPE TYPE_NO ,OUT_NAME Type_L_Nm , OUT_E_NAME Type_F_Nm ,AD_DATE, AD_U_ID, UP_DATE, UP_U_ID FROM OUT_TYPES
SELECT 4 Inv_Type , TR_TYPE TYPE_NO ,TR_NAME Type_L_Nm , TR_E_NAME Type_F_Nm ,AD_DATE, AD_U_ID, UP_DATE, UP_U_ID FROM TRANSFER_TYPES
SELECT 5 Inv_Type , STK_TYPE TYPE_NO ,STK_NAME Type_L_Nm , STK_E_NAME Type_F_Nm ,AD_DATE, AD_U_ID, UP_DATE, UP_U_ID FROM IAS_STK_ADJST_TYPES
SELECT 6 Inv_Type , INV_TYPE TYPE_NO ,INV_NAME Type_L_Nm , INV_E_NAME Type_F_Nm ,AD_DATE, AD_U_ID, UP_DATE, UP_U_ID FROM IAS_INV_TYPES)
Create Or Replace View Ias_V_Ap_Types
(Ap_Type , TYPE_No, Type_L_Nm , Type_F_Nm ,AD_DATE, AD_U_ID, UP_DATE, UP_U_ID)
Select Ap_Type , TYPE_No , Type_L_Nm , Type_F_Nm ,AD_DATE, AD_U_ID, UP_DATE, UP_U_ID
SELECT 1 Ap_Type , Pr_TYPE TYPE_No ,Pr_A_NAME Type_L_Nm , Pr_E_NAME Type_F_Nm ,AD_DATE, AD_U_ID, UP_DATE, UP_U_ID FROM Ias_Preq_Types
SELECT 2 Ap_Type , Po_TYPE TYPE_No ,Po_A_NAME Type_L_Nm , Po_E_NAME Type_F_Nm ,AD_DATE, AD_U_ID, UP_DATE, UP_U_ID FROM Ias_Porder_Types
SELECT 3 Ap_Type , GRN_TYPE TYPE_No ,GRN_A_NAME Type_L_Nm , GRN_E_NAME Type_F_Nm ,AD_DATE, AD_U_ID, UP_DATE, UP_U_ID FROM IAS_GRN_TYPES
SELECT 4 Ap_Type , Bill_TYPE_No TYPE_No ,Type_L_NAME Type_L_Nm , Type_F_NAME Type_F_Nm ,AD_DATE, AD_U_ID, UP_DATE, UP_U_ID FROM ia
s_Ap_Bill_Types
Create Or Replace View Ias_V_Ar_Types
(Ar_Type , TYPE_No, Type_L_Nm , Type_F_Nm ,AD_DATE, AD_U_ID, UP_DATE, UP_U_ID)
Select Ar_Type , TYPE_No , Type_L_Nm , Type_F_Nm ,AD_DATE, AD_U_ID, UP_DATE, UP_U_ID
SELECT 1 Ar_Type , Qt_TYPE TYPE_No ,Qt_A_NAME Type_L_Nm , Qt_E_NAME Type_F_Nm ,AD_DATE, AD_U_ID, UP_DATE, UP_U_ID FROM IAS_QUOT_TYPES
SELECT 2 Ar_Type , So_TYPE TYPE_No ,So_A_NAME Type_L_Nm , So_E_NAME Type_F_Nm ,AD_DATE, AD_U_ID, UP_DATE, UP_U_ID FROM IAS_SORDER_TYPES
SELECT 3 Ar_Type , Si_TYPE TYPE_No ,Si_A_NAME Type_L_Nm , Si_E_NAME Type_F_Nm ,AD_DATE, AD_U_ID, UP_DATE, UP_U_ID FROM Ias_Sales_Types
SELECT 4 Ar_Type , Sr_Type TYPE_No ,Sr_A_NAME TypeL_Nm , Sr_E_NAME Type_F_Nm ,AD_DATE, AD_U_ID, UP_DATE, UP_U_ID FROM Ias_Rt_Sales_Types
SELECT 5 Ar_Type , Rcpt_TYPE_No TYPE_No ,Rcpt_A_NAME Type_L_Nm , Rcpt_E_NAME Type_F_Nm ,AD_DATE, AD_U_ID, UP_DATE, UP_U_ID FROM Ias_Rcpt_Doc_Types
SELECT 6 Ar_Type , Wo_TYPE_No TYPE_No ,Wo_A_NAME Type_L_Nm , Wo_E_NAME Type_F_Nm ,AD_DATE, AD_U_ID, UP_DATE, UP_U_ID FROM Ias_Work_Order_Types
SELECT 7 Ar_Type , TYP_No TYPE_No ,Typ_L_Nm Type_L_Nm , Typ_F_NM Type_F_Nm ,AD_DATE, AD_U_ID, UP_DATE, UP_U_ID FROM Ias_Ar_Typs Where Ar_Type_No = 7
SELECT 8 Ar_Type , TYP_No TYPE_No ,Typ_L_Nm Type_L_Nm , Typ_F_NM Type_F_Nm ,AD_DATE, AD_U_ID, UP_DATE, UP_U_ID FROM Ias_Ar_T
yps Where Ar_Type_No = 8
SELECT 9 Ar_Type , TYP_No TYPE_No ,Typ_L_Nm Type_L_Nm , Typ_F_NM Type_F_Nm ,AD_DATE, AD_U_ID, UP_DATE, UP_U_ID FROM Ias_Ar_Typs Where Ar_Type_No = 9
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW IAS_V_USR_WC_PRV (
U_ID,
USR_NaMe,
W_CODE,
W_NM,
ADD_FLAG,
VIEW_FLAG,
AD_U_ID,
AD_DATE,
UP_U_ID,
UP_DATE,
REC_SRC )
SELECT A.U_Id,
Decode ( Ias_Prmtr_Pkg.Getpval(P_Prmtr =>'LANG_NO') ,1,NVL (B.U_A_Name, B.U_E_Name),NVL (B.U_E_Name, B.U_A_Name)) Usr_Nm,
A.W_Code,
Decode ( Ias_Prmtr_Pkg.Getpval(P_Prmtr =>'LANG_NO') ,1,NVL (C.W_Name, C.W_E_Name),NVL (C.W_E_Name, C.W_Name)) Wc_Nm,
A.Add_Flag,
A.View_Flag,
A.Ad_U_Id,
A.Ad_Date,
A.Up_U_Id,
A.Up_Date,
1 Rec_Src
FROM Privilege_Wh A, User_R B, Warehouse_Details C
WHERE A.U_Id = B.U_Id
AND A.W_Code = C.W_Code
--AND (Add_Flag = 1 OR View_Flag = 1)
UNION
SELECT B.U_Id,
C.W_Code,
0 Add_Flag,
0 View_Flag,
NULL Ad_U_Id,
NULL Ad_Date,
NULL Up_U_Id,
NULL Up_Date,
0 Rec_Src
FROM User_R B, Warehouse_Details C
WHERE NOT EXISTS
(SELECT 1
FROM Privilege_Wh
WHERE W_Code = C.W_Code AND U_Id = B.U_Id AND ROWNUM <= 1)

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW ias_v_usr_sales_man_prv (u_id,
usr_name,
rep_code,
sales_man_nm,
add_flag,
view_flag,
ad_u_id,
ad_date,
up_u_id,
up_date,
rec_src
SELECT a.u_id,
DECODE (ias_prmtr_pkg.getpval (p_prmtr => 'LANG_NO'),
1, NVL (b.u_a_name, b.u_e_name),
NVL (b.u_e_name, b.u_a_name)
) usr_nm,
c.reprs_code,
1, NVL (c.reprs_a_name, c.reprs_e_name),
NVL (c.reprs_e_name, c.reprs_a_name)
) stk_nm,
a.add_flag, a.view_flag, a.ad_u_id, a.ad_date, a.up_u_id, a.up_date,
1 rec_src
FROM ias_priv_sman a, user_r b, sales_man c
WHERE a.u_id = b.u_id
AND a.rep_code = c.reprs_code
--AND (add_flag = 1 OR view_flag = 1)
SELECT b.u_id,
0 add_flag, 0 view_flag, NULL ad_u_id, NULL ad_date, NULL up_u_id,
NULL up_date, 0 rec_src
FROM user_r b, sales_man c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
SELECT 1
FROM ias_priv_sman
WHERE rep_code = c.reprs_code AND u_id = b.u_id
AND ROWNUM <= 1)

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW IAS_SYS.YS_V_TBLSP_ST (TABLESPACE_NAME, TABLESPACE_SIZE, USED_SPACE,
TABLESPACE_FREE, COLLECTION_DATE,USED_PERCENT, T_LARGEST, T_MAX_SIZE, T_PCT_MAX_USED, T_EXTENT_MAN,T_SEGEMENT) AS
SELECT (SELECT tablespace_name
FROM dba_tablespaces
WHERE tablespace_name = b.tablespace_name)
TABLESPACE_NAME,
ROUND (kbytes_alloc / 1024, 2) TABLESPACE_SIZE,
ROUND ( (kbytes_alloc - NVL (kbytes_free, 0)) / 1024, 2) US
ED_SPACE,
ROUND (NVL (kbytes_free, 0) / 1024, 2) TABLESPACE_FREE,
SYSDATE COLLECTION_DATE,
ROUND (
( (kbytes_alloc - NVL (kbytes_free, 0)) / kbytes_alloc) * 100,
USED_PERCENT,
ROUND (NVL (largest, 0) / 1024, 2) T_LARGEST,
ROUND (NVL (kbytes_max, kbytes_alloc) / 1024, 2) T_MAX_SIZE,
DECODE (
kbytes_max,
( (kbytes_alloc - NVL (kbytes_free, 0)) / kbytes_max) * 100),
T_PCT_MAX_USED,
(SELECT extent_management
T_EXTENT_MAN,
(SELECT segment_space_management
T_SEGEMENT
FROM ( SELECT SUM (bytes) / 1024 Kbytes_free,
MAX (bytes) / 1024 largest,
tablespace_name
FROM sys.dba_free_space
GROUP BY tablespace_name) a,
( SELECT SUM (bytes) / 1024 Kbytes_alloc,
SUM (maxbytes) / 1024 Kbytes_max,
FROM sys.dba_data_files
GROUP BY tablespace_name
UNION ALL
SELECT SUM (bytes) / 1024 Kbytes_alloc,
FROM sys.dba_temp_files
GROUP BY tablespace_name) b
WHERE a.tablespace_name = b.tablespace_name
SELECT TABLESPACE_NAME,
ROUND (BYTES / 1024 / 1024, 2),
NULL,
NULL
ORDER BY 2
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW IAS_SYS.YS_V_DATA_FILES (FILE_NAME, FILE_ID, TABLESPACE_NAME, BYTES, BLOCKS,
STATUS, RELATIVE_FNO, AUTOEXTENSIBLE, MAXBYTES, MAXBLOCKS, INCREMENT_BY, USER_BYTES, USER_BLOCKS, ONLINE_STATUS, FREE_BYTES) AS
select a.FILE_NAME FILE_NAME,
a.FILE_ID FILE_ID ,
a.TABLESPACE_NAME TABLESPACE_NAME,
a.BYTES BYTES,
a.BLOCKS BLOCKS,
a.STATUS STATUS,
a.RELATIVE_FNO RELATIVE_FNO,
a.AUTOEXTENSIBLE AUTOEXTENSIBLE,
a.MAXBYTES MAXBYTES,
a.MAXBLOCKS MAXBLOCKS,
a.INCREMENT_BY INCREMENT_BY,
a.USER_BYTES USER_BYTES,
a.USER_BLOCKS USER_BLOCKS,
a.ONLINE_STATUS ONLINE_STATUS,
sum(b.bytes) FREE_BYTES from sys.dba_data_files a , SYS.DBA_FREE_SPACE b
where a.file_id=b.file_id
group by a.FILE_NAME,
a.FILE_ID,
a.TABLESPACE_NAME,
a.BYTES,
a.BLOCKS,
a.STATUS ,
a.RELATIVE_FNO,
a.AUTOEXTENSIBLE,
a.MAXBYTES,
a.MAXBLOCKS,
a.INCREMENT_BY,
a.USER_BYTES,
a.USER_BLOCKS,
a.ONLINE_STATUS
SELECT FILE_NAME,NULL,TABLESPACE_NAME,BYTES,NULL,'TEMP FILE',
NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL FROM dba_temp_files

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW IAS_V_NY_OUT_REQUEST_DTL AS
Select Q.Out_Req_Type, Q.Out_Req_No, Q.Out_Req_Ser,
Q.I_Code, Mov_Data.I_Qty, Q.Itm_Unt,
Q.P_Size, (Mov_Data.I_Qty*Q.P_Size) P_Qty,
Q.W_Code,
Q.Rcrd_No, Q.Barcode, Q.Use_Attch,
Q.Rec_Attch, Q.
I_Length,
Q.I_Width, Q.I_Height, Q.I_Number,
Q.Item_Desc, Q.External_Post, Q.Cmp_No,
Q.Brn_No, Q.Brn_Year,
Q.Brn_Usr
From Ias_Out_Request_Dtl Q,(Select Doc_Ser,I_Code,Itm_Unt,Sum(Nvl(I_Qty,0)) I_Qty
From( Select Out_Req_Ser Doc_Ser,I_Code,Itm_Unt,Nvl(I_Qty,0) I_Qty
From Ias_Out_Request_Dtl
Select M.Out_Req_Ser Doc_Ser,D.I_Code,D.Itm_Unt,Sum(Nvl(D.I_Qty,0))*-1 I_Qty
From Ias_Out_Request_Mst M,Ias_Out_Request_Dtl D
Where M.Out_Req_Ser = D.Out_Req_Ser
And M.Out_Req_Ser Is Not Null
Group By M.Out_Req_Ser,D.I_Code,D.Itm_Unt)
Group By Doc_Ser,I_Code,Itm_Unt
Having Sum(Nvl(I_Qty,0))>0) Mov_Data
Where Q.Out_Req_Ser = Mov_Data.Doc_Ser
And Q.I_Code=Mov_Data.I_Code
And Q.Itm_Unt=Mov_Data.Itm_Unt
And Nvl(Mov_Data.I_Qty,0)>=0
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW IAS_V_NY_OUT_REQUEST_MST AS

From( Select Inc_Ser Doc_Ser,I_Code,Itm_Unt,Nvl(I_Qty,0) I_Qty

Select O.SO_TYPE, O.ORDER_NO, O.ORDER_SER,
O.I_CODE, Mov_Data.I_Qty, Mov_Data.Free_Qty,
O.P_Size, (Mov_Data.I_Qty*O.P_Size) P_Qty, O.I_Price,
O.RES_DATE, O.RES_QTY, O.W_CODE,
O.RESERVED, O.RCRD_NO, O.BARCODE,
O.USE_ATTCH, O.REC_ATTCH, O.ITEM_DESC,
O.EXTERNAL_POST, O.CANCELED, O.EXPIRE_DATE,
O.BATCH_NO, O.VAT_PER, O.VAT_AMT,
O.I_LENGTH, O.I_WIDTH, O.I_HEIGHT,
O.I_NUMBER, O.FIELD_DTL1, O.FIELD_DTL2,
O.FIELD_DTL3, O.CMP_NO, O.BRN_NO,
O.BRN_YEAR, O.BRN_USR, O.UP_CNT,
O.ITM_UNT, O.WT_QTY, O.WT_UNT,
O.DIS_PER, O.DIS_AMT_DTL, O.DIS_PER2,
O.DIS_AMT_DTL2, O.DIS_PER3, O.DIS_AMT_DTL3,
O.DIS_AMT, O.DIS_AMT_MST, O.EMP_NO,
O.SUB_C_CODE
From Order_Detail O,(Select Doc_Ser,I_Code,Rcrd_No,Sum(Nvl(I_Qty,0)) I_Qty,Sum(Nvl(Free_Qty,0)) Free_Qty
From( Select Order_Ser Doc_Ser,I_Code,Rcrd_No,Nvl(I_Qty,0) I_Qty,Nvl(Free_Qty,0) Free_Qty
From Order_Detail
Select Doc_Ser_Ref Doc_Ser,I_Code,Rcrd_No_Ref,Sum(Nvl(I_Qty,0))*-1 I_Qty,Sum(Nvl(Free_Qty,0))*-1 Free_Qty
From Ias_Bill_Dtl
Where Doc_Type_Ref=53
And Doc_Ser_Ref Is Not Null
And Rcrd_No_Ref Is Not Null
Group By Doc_Ser_Ref,I_Code,Rcrd_No_Ref)
Group By Doc_Ser,I_Code,Rcrd_No
Having Sum(Nvl(I_Qty,0))+Sum(Nvl(Free_Qty,0))>0) Mov_Data
Where O.Order_Ser=Mov_Data.Doc_Ser
And O.I_Code=Mov_Data.I_Code
And O.Rcrd_No=Mov_Data.Rcrd_No
And Nvl(Canceled,0)=0
And Nvl(Mov_Data.Free_Qty,0)>=0

CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER IAS_DECR_AVLQTY_STRGE_Tgr
BEFORE DELETE ON ITEM_MOVEMENT FOR EACH ROW
--## For Incoming
If :OLD.IN_OUT = 1 Then
Update Ias_Itm_Wcode Set Avl_Qty = nvl(Avl_Qty,0) - ((nvl(:OLD.I_qty,0)+ nvl(:OLD.FREE_Qty,0))*:OLD.P_SIZE)
Where I_Code = :Old.I_Code
--And Itm_Unt = :Old.Itm_Unt
And w_code = :Old.W_CODE;
Update Ias_Itm_Sales_Age
Set Doc_Ser_Inc = Null ,
Doc_Seq_Inc = Null ,
First_Inc_Date = Null
And Itm_Unt = :Old.Itm_Unt
And W_Code = :Old.W_Code
And Brn_Year = :Old.Brn_Year
And Doc_Ser_Inc = :Old.Doc_Ser
And Doc_Seq_Inc = :Old.Doc_Sequence ;
Exception
When Others Then
Null ;
--## For Outgoing
Else
Update Ias_Itm_Wcode Set Avl_Qty = nvl(Avl_Qty,0) + ((nvl(:OLD.I_qty,0)+ nvl(:OLD.FREE_Qty
,0))*:OLD.P_SIZE)
And w_code = :Old.W_Code;
Delete From Ias_Itm_Sales_Age
And Doc_Ser_Out = :Old.Doc_Ser
And Doc_Seq_out = :Old.Doc_Sequence ;
End If;
Exception When Others Then
Raise_Application_Error (-20301,'Error In DecrTrg. When Update Ias_Itm_Wcode AvlQty ='||SqlErrm);
End;

CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER IAS_VD_INSTALLMNT_Tgr
BEFORE DELETE OR INSERT OR UPDATE
OF A_CY
,AC_AMT
,AC_AMTF
,C_CODE
,V_CODE
,BILL_NO
,BILL_SER
,I_NO
ON VOUCHER_DETAIL
REFERENCING NEW AS NEW OLD AS OLD
EGIN
If DELETING Then --(1)
If :OLD.VOUCHER_TYPE = 1 AND :OLD.BILL_SER Is Not Null AND :OLD.I_NO Is Not Null AND :OLD.C_CODE Is Not Null Then --(2)
UPDATE INSTALLMENT SET PAID_AMT=NVL(PAID_AMT,0)- DECODE(NVL(:OLD.AC_AMTF,0),0,ABS(:OLD.AC_AMT),ABS(:OLD.AC_AMTF))
WHERE C_CODE=:OLD.C_CODE
AND A_CY =:OLD.A_CY
AND BILL_SER =:OLD.BILL_SER
AND I_NO =:OLD.I_NO;
ELSIf :OLD.VOUCHER_TYPE = 2 AND :OLD.BILL_SER Is Not Null AND :OLD.I_NO Is Not Null AND :OLD.V_CODE Is Not Null Then --(2)
UPDATE IAS_INSTALLMENT_PI SET PAID_AMT=NVL(PAID_AMT,0)- DECODE(NVL(:OLD.AC_AMTF,0),0,ABS(:OLD.AC_AMT),ABS(:OLD.AC_AMTF))
WHERE V_CODE=:OLD.V_CODE
ElsIf INSERTING Then --(1)
If :NEW.VOUCHER_TYPE = 1 AND :NEW.BILL_SER Is Not Null AND :NEW.I_NO Is Not Null AND :NEW.C_CODE Is Not Null Then --(3)
UPDATE INSTALLMENT SET PAID_AMT=NVL(PAID_AMT,0) + DECODE(NVL(:NEW.AC_AMTF,0),0,ABS(:NEW.AC_AMT),ABS(:NEW.AC_AMTF))
WHERE C_CODE=:NEW.C_CODE
AND A_CY =:NEW.A_CY
AND BILL_SER =:NEW.BILL_SER
AND I_NO =:NEW.I_NO;
ELSIf :NEW.VOUCHER_TYPE = 2 AND :NEW.BILL_SER Is Not Null AND :NEW.I_NO Is Not Null AND :NEW.V_CODE Is Not Null Then --(3)
UPDATE IAS_INSTALLMENT_PI SET PAID_AMT=NVL(PAID_AMT,0) + DECODE(NVL(:NEW.AC_AMTF,0),0,ABS(:NEW.AC_AMT),ABS(:NEW.AC_AMTF))
WHERE V_CODE=:NEW.V_CODE
End If;--(3)
ElsIf UPDATING Then --(1)
If :OLD.VOUCHER_TYPE = 1 AND :OLD.BILL_SER Is Not Null AND :OLD.I_NO Is Not Null AND :OLD.C_CODE Is Not Null Then
UPDATE INSTALLMENT SET PAID_AMT=NVL(PAID_AMT,0)- DECODE(nvl(:OLD.AC_AMTF,0),0,
ABS(nvl(:OLD.AC_AMT,0)),ABS(nvl(:OLD.AC_AMTF,0)))
WHERE C_CODE =:OLD.C_CODE
If :NEW.VOUCHER_TYPE = 1 AND :NEW.BILL_SER Is Not Null AND :NEW.I_NO Is Not Null AND :NEW.C_CODE Is Not Null Then
UPDATE INSTALLMENT SET PAID_AMT=NVL(PAID_AMT,0) + DECODE(nvl(:NEW.AC_AMTF,0),0,ABS(nvl(:NEW.AC_AMT,0)),ABS(nvl(:NEW.AC_AMTF,0)))
If :OLD.VOUCHER_TYPE = 2 AND :OLD.BILL_SER Is Not Null AND :OLD.I_NO Is Not Null AND :OLD.V_CODE Is Not Null Then
UPDATE IAS_INSTALLMENT_PI SET PAID_AMT=NVL(PAID_AMT,0)- DECODE (nvl(:OLD.AC_AMTF,0),0,ABS(nvl(:OLD.AC_AMT,0)),ABS(nvl(:OLD.AC_AMTF,0)))
WHERE V_CODE =:OLD.V_CODE
If :NEW.VOUCHER_TYPE = 2 AND :NEW.BILL_SER Is Not Null AND :NEW.I_NO Is Not Null AND :NEW.V_CODE Is Not Null Then
UPDATE IAS_INSTALLMENT_PI SET PAID_AMT=NVL(PAID_AMT,0) + DECODE(nvl(:NEW.AC_AMTF,0),0,ABS(nvl(:NEW.AC_AMT,0)),ABS(nvl(:NEW.AC_AMTF,0)))
End If;--(1)
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
Raise_Application_Error(-20303,' Error When Installment Trans. '||SqlErrm);

CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER UPD_MOV_BDGT_BLNC_MST_TGR
BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON GLS_MOV_BDGT_MST
IF INSERTING THEN
UPDATE IAS_BDGT_BLNC_DTL
SET AMT_L_DISC_MOV=NVL(AMT_L_DISC_MOV,0)+NVL(:NEW.AMT_L,0)
, AMT_F_DISC_MOV=NVL(AMT_F_DISC_MOV,0)+NVL(:NEW.AMT_F,0)
Where doc_ser=:NEW.DOC_SER_REF
AND A_CODE= :NEW.A_CODE
AND PRD_NO= :NEW.PRD_NO
AND Bdgt_Prd_Type= :NEW.Bdgt_Prd_Type
And Nvl(A_CY,'0')= :NEW.A_Cy
And nvl(cc_code,'0') = Decode(nvl(cc_code,'0'),'0',nvl(cc_code,'0'),:NEW.cc_code)
And nvl(pj_no,'0') = Decode(nvl(pj_no,'0'),'0',nvl(pj_no,'0'),:NEW.PJ_NO)
And nvl(actv_no,'0') = Decode(nvl(actv_no,'0'),'0',nvl(actv_no,'0'),:NEW.ACTV_NO) ;
NULL;
END ;
ELSIF UPDATING THEN
SET AMT_L_DISC_MOV=NVL(AMT_L_DISC_MOV,0)+NVL(:NEW.AMT_L,0)-NVL(:OLD.AMT_L,0)
, AMT_F_DISC_MOV=NVL(AMT_F_DISC_MOV,0)+NVL(:NEW.AMT_F,0)-NVL(:OLD.AMT_F,0)
ELSIF DELETING THEN
SET AMT_L_DISC_MOV=NVL(AMT_L_DISC_MOV,0)-NVL(:OLD.AMT_L,0)
, AMT_F_DISC_MOV=NVL(AMT_F_DISC_MOV,0)-NVL(:OLD.AMT_F,0)
Where doc_ser=:OLD.DOC_SER_REF
AND A_CODE= :OLD.A_CODE
AND PRD_NO= :OLD.PRD_NO
AND Bdgt_Prd_Type= :OLD.Bdgt_Prd_Type
And Nvl(A_CY,'0')= :OLD.A_Cy
And nvl(cc_code,'0') = Decode(nvl(cc_code,'0'),'0',nvl(cc_code,'0'),:OLD.cc_code)
And nvl(pj_no,'0') = Decode(nvl(pj_no,'0'),'0',nvl(pj_no,'0'),:OLD.PJ_NO)
And nvl(actv_no,'0') = Decode(nvl(actv_no,'0'),'0',nvl(actv_no,'0'),:OLD.ACTV_NO) ;
End UPD_MOV_BDGT_BLNC_MST_TGR ;

, AMT_F_DISC=NVL(AMT_F_DISC,0)+NVL(:NEW.AMT_F_DISC,0)-NVL(:OLD.AMT_F_DISC,0)
AND PRD_NO= :NEW.PRD_
SET AMT_L_ADD=NVL(AMT_L_ADD,0)-NVL(:OLD.AMT_L_ADD,0)
, AMT_F_ADD=NVL(AMT_F_ADD,0)-NVL(:OLD.AMT_F_ADD,0)
, AMT_L_DISC=NVL(AMT_L_DISC,0)-NVL(:OLD.AMT_L_DISC,0)
, AMT_F_DISC=NVL(AMT_F_DISC,0)-NVL(:OLD.AMT_F_DISC,0)
END UPD_EDIT_BDGT_BLNC_DTL_TGR ;

ON IAS_RT_BILL_DTL
Select 1 InTo V_Cnt From Item_Movement Where Doc_Ser=:Old.RT_Bill_Ser And i_Code=:Old.I_Code And Doc_Sequence=:old.Doc_Sequence And RowNum<=1;
Raise_application_error(-20804,'Error When Delete Item From Ias_Rt_Bill_Dtl Table '||SqlErrm) ;
END chk_del_rt_bill_dtl;

OR REPLACE PROCEDURE Ias_Last_Sale_Price_Prc( P_Icode In Ias_Itm_Mst.I_CODE%TYPE ,
P_c_code In CUSTOMER.C_CODE%TYPE DEFAULT NULL,
P_Acy In VARCHAR2,
P_Lst_Sale_Price Out Number,
P_Bill_Date Out Date) IS
Max_Doc_Seq Number ;
If P_Icode Is Not Null and P_Acy Is Not Null Then
Select Max(a.Bill_Date),Max(b.Doc_Sequence)
Into P_Bill_date,Max_Doc_Seq
From Ias_Bill_Mst a,Ias_Bill_Dtl b
Where a.bill_ser=b.bill_ser
and a.Bill_currency=P_Acy
and nvl(a.c_code,'0')= Decode(P_c_code,Null,nvl(a.c_code,'0'),P_c_code)
and b.I_Code= P_Icode;
P_bill_date:=null;
SELECT MAX (ROUND ((NVL (D.I_PRICE, 0) - NVL (D.DIS_AMT_DTL, 0)), 2))
Into P_Lst_Sale_Price
From Ias_Bill_Mst M,Ias_Bill_Dtl D
Where M.Bill_Ser = D.Bill_Ser
and I_Code=P_Icode
and bill_date =P_Bill_date
and d.Doc_Sequence =Max_Doc_Seq
and nvl(M.c_code,'0')= Decode(P_c_code,Null,nvl(M.c_code,'0'),P_c_code);
P_Lst_Sale_Price:=0;
End Ias_Last_Sale_Price_Prc;

CLMN_DOC_NO
VarChar2(50);
CLMN_DOC_DATE
CLMN_JV_TYPE
CLMN_Doc_Ser

TABLE_NAME

-- and nvl(DOC_POST,0)= 1

' Update Ias_Post_Dtl Set Doc_post=0 ,Unpost_date=Sysdate ,Unpost_u_id='||P_User_no||'

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE Ias_Unclosing_Period_Prc ( P_Brn_No In Number ,
P_User_No In Number ,
P_mnth In Number ,
P_Fd In Date ,
P_Td In Date ,
P_Cls_Type In Number ) Is
If P_Cls_Type = 1 Then -- Daily
--1)Remove Curr Diff
Delete From Ias_Post_Dtl Where Brn_No = P_Brn_No And doc_type=50 and doc_date between P_Fd and P_Td;
Delete From Ias_Post_Mst Where Brn_No = P_Brn_No And doc_type=50 and doc_date between P_Fd and P_Td;
when others then
Null;
--3)Remove From IAS_CLOSE_DAY_PERIODS
Delete From Ias_Close_Day_Periods Where ( F_DATE Between P_Fd and P_Td )
And (T_DATE Between P_Fd And P_Td );
--4)Update final status
Update S_PRD_BRN_CLS Set INACTV=0,
PRD_CLS=0,
PRD_UNCLS_U_ID=P_User_No,
PRD_UNCLS_DATE=Sysdate
Where Brn_No = P_Brn_No And ( F_DATE Between P_Fd and P_Td ) Or (T_DATE Between P_Fd And P_Td );
Raise_Application_Error(-20207,'Error In Update S_PRD_BRN_CLS , '||SqlErrm) ;
--##--------------------------------------------------------------------------##--
Else -- mnthly
Delete From Ias_Post_Dtl Where Brn_No = P_Brn_No And doc_no=P_mnth and doc_type=50;
Delete From Ias_Post_Mst Where Brn_No = P_Brn_No And doc_no=P_mnth and doc_type=50;
--2)Remove From period_ex_rate
Delete From Ias_Period_Ex_Rate Where Prd_no=P_mnth;
--3)Remove Revers Journal
Delete From Ias_Post_Dtl Where Brn_No = P_Brn_No And jv_type=0 and doc_no=P_mnth and doc_type=30;
Delete From Ias_Post_Mst Where Brn_No = P_Brn_No And jv_type=0 and doc_no=P_mnth and doc_type=30;
Where Brn_No = P_Brn_No
And prd_no = P_mnth;
End Ias_Unclosing_Period_Prc;
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE IAS_CheckData_AR_Prc (P_Bill_Type In Number Default 1) IS
V_Disc_Per_Items_Ar Number;
V_Disc_count Number;
V_Frc_No Number;
Select nvl(SHOW_DISC_PER_ITEMS_AR,0),nvl(Disc_count,1),nvl(NO_OF_DECIMAL_AR,2)
Into V_Disc_Per_Items_Ar,V_Disc_count,V_Frc_No
From Ias_Para_AR;
V_Disc_Per_Items_Ar:=0;
If P_Bill_Type = 1 Then -- Sales Invoice (1)
--##---------------------------------------------------------------------------##--
Select 1 Into cnt From IAS_BILL_DTL bd
Where nvl(dis_amt,0) <> ( nvl(dis_amt_mst,0)+nvl(dis_amt_dtl,0)+nvl(dis_amt_dtl2,0)+nvl(dis_amt_dtl3,0)+nvl(add_dis_amt_mst,0)+nvl(add_dis_amt_dtl,0) )
and Exists( select 1 From ias_bill_mst
where bill_ser=bd.bill_ser
and nvl(bill_post,0) = 0
and RowNum<=1)
and RowNum<=1;
Cnt:=0;
If Cnt > 0 Then
Update IAS_BILL_DTL bd Set dis_amt = ( nvl(dis_amt_mst,0)+nvl(dis_amt_dtl,0)+nvl(dis_amt_dtl2,0)+nvl(dis_amt_dtl3,0)+nvl(add_dis_amt_mst,0)+nvl(add_dis_amt_dtl,0) )
Where nvl(dis_amt,0) <> ( nvl(dis_amt_mst,0)+nvl(dis_amt_dtl,0)+nvl(dis_amt_dtl2,0)+nvl(dis_amt_dtl3,0) )
and Exists( Select 1 From ias_bill_mst
and RowNum<=1) ;
Commit;
Select 1 Into cnt From IAS_V_BILL_AMT_ERR Where RowNum<=1;
If Cnt > 0 Then --(2)
--====================================================================================
INSERT INTO IAS_LOGS( F_SYS, DOC_TYPE, LOG_DATE, LOG_DESC )
Values ('ARS', 4 ,Sysdate ,'Use IAS_CheckData_AR_Prc Check Error In Bills');
Update Ias_Bill_Mst a Set bill_amt = (Select Round(nvl(Sum(nvl(i_qty,0)*nvl(i_price,0)),0),V_Frc_No) From Ias_Bill_Dtl
Where bill_ser=a.bill_ser)
Where Exists (Select 1 From IAS_V_BILL_AMT_ERR
Where Bill_Ser=a.Bill_Ser);
-- Where a.bill_ser in ( Select bill_ser From IAS_V_BILL_AMT_ERR );
--## End check bill_amt
--=====================================================================================
---## Check disc_amt
If V_Disc_Per_Items_Ar = 1 Then -- Disc In Detail --(3)
Update Ias_Bill_Dtl a Set dis_amt_mst=(Select (nvl(disc_amt_mst,0)/nvl(bill_amt,0))*nvl(a.i_price,0) From Ias_Bill_Mst
-- Where a.bill_ser in (select bill_ser From IAS_V_BILL_AMT_ERR);
Update Ias_Bill_Dtl Set dis_amt_dtl = nvl(i_price,0)*nvl(dis_per,0)/100 ,
dis_amt = nvl(i_price,0)*nvl(dis_per,0)/100 + nvl(dis_amt_mst,0)+ nvl(add_dis_amt_mst,0)+nvl(add_dis_amt_dtl,0)
Where Bill_Ser=Ias_Bill_Dtl.Bill_Ser);
-- where bill_ser in (select bill_ser From IAS_V_BILL_AMT_ERR);
If V_Disc_count > 1 Then
Update Ias_Bill_Dtl Set dis_amt_dtl2 = (nvl(i_price,0) - (nvl(dis_amt_dtl,0)) )*nvl(dis_per2,0)/100 ,
dis_amt = (nvl(i_price,0) - (nvl(dis_amt_dtl,0)) )*nvl(dis_per2,0)/100 + nvl(dis_amt_mst,0)+ nvl(dis_amt_dtl,0)+ nvl(add_dis_amt_mst,0)+nvl(add_dis_amt_dtl,0)
where bill_ser in (select bill_ser From IAS_V_BILL_AMT_ERR);
If V_Disc_count > 2 Then
Update Ias_Bill_Dtl Set dis_amt_dtl3 = (nvl(i_price,0) - (nvl(dis_amt_dtl,0)+ nvl(dis_amt_dtl2,0)) )*nvl(dis_per3,0)/100 ,
dis_amt = (nvl(i_price,0) - (nvl(dis_amt_dtl,0)+ nvl(dis_amt_dtl2,0)) )*nvl(dis_per3,0)/100 + nvl(dis_amt_mst,0)+ nvl(dis_amt_dtl,0)+ nvl(dis_amt_dtl2,0)+ nvl(add_dis_amt_mst,0)+nvl(add_dis_amt_dtl,0)
Update Ias_Bill_Mst a Set disc_amt_dtl=( Select nvl(sum((nvl(dis_amt_dtl,0) + nvl(dis_amt_dtl2,0) + nvl(dis_amt_dtl3,0)) * nvl(i_qty,0)),0) From Ias_Bill_Dtl
-- Where a.bill_ser In ( Select bill_ser From IAS_V_BILL_AMT_ERR );
Update Ias_Bill_Mst a Set disc_amt=( Select nvl(sum(nvl(dis_amt,0)*nvl(i_qty,0)),0) From Ias_Bill_Dtl
Else -- Disc In Master
Update Ias_Bill_Mst Set disc_amt = nvl(disc_amt_mst,0) + nvl(add_disc_amt_mst,0)
Where (nvl(disc_amt_mst,0)+ nvl(add_disc_amt_mst,0))<>nvl(disc_amt,0);
Update Ias_Bill_Dtl a Set dis_amt=(Select (nvl(disc_amt,0)/nvl(bill_amt,0))*nvl(a.i_price,0) From Ias_Bill_Mst
ere Bill_Ser=a.Bill_Ser);
Exception when zero_divide then
Update Ias_Bill_Dtl Set dis_amt= 0
where bill_ser In (select bill_ser From IAS_BILL_MST where nvl(bill_amt,0) =0 )
And Exists (Select 1 From IAS_V_BILL_AMT_ERR
-- and bill_ser In (select bill_ser From IAS_V_BILL_AMT_ERR);
Where a.bill_ser in (select bill_ser From IAS_V_BILL_AMT_ERR);
Update Ias_Bill_Dtl Set dis_amt_mst= 0
and bill_ser In (select bill_ser From IAS_V_BILL_AMT_ERR);
--## End check Disc_amt
--##--------------------------------------------------------------##--
---## Check Othe_amt
Select 1 Into cnt From (
Select Round(Sum(nvl(amt,0)),V_Frc_No) From Other_Charges
where bill_type=1
Select Round(Sum(nvl(othr_amt,0)),V_Frc_No) From ias_bill_mst)
Where RowNum<=1;
If cnt > 0 Then
Update ias_bill_mst a set othr_amt = ( Select Round(Sum(nvl(amt,0)),V_Frc_No) From Other_Charges
and bill_ser= a.bill_ser)
Where nvl(bill_post,0) = 0;
Select 1 into cnt From (
Select Round(Sum(nvl(othr_amt,0)),V_Frc_No) From ias_bill_mst
Select Round(Sum(nvl(othr_amt,0)* nvl(i_qty,0)),V_Frc_No) From ias_bill_dtl)
Update Ias_Bill_Dtl a Set Othr_Amt = 0
Where nvl(Othr_amt,0) <> 0
and Exists ( Select 1 From Ias_Bill_Mst
Where Bill_Ser = a.Bill_Ser
And Nvl(Bill_Post,0) = 0

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE IAS_CheckData_Inv_Prc ( P_Doc_Type In Number Default 1 ) IS
v_frc Number;
--============================================================
Select nvl(No_Of_Decimal_Inv,0)
Into v_frc
From Ias_Para_Inv;
v_frc:=2;
-============================================================
If P_Doc_Type = 9 Then -- Outgoing --(1)
---## Check out_amt
Select 1 Into cnt From IAS_V_OUTGOING_AMT_ERR Where RowNum<=1;
--===========================================================================
Update Ias_Outgoing_Mst M Set out_amt = (Select Round(nvl(Sum(nvl(i_qty,0)*nvl(i_price,0)),0),v_frc) From Ias_Outgoing_Dtl
Where out_ser=M.out_ser)
Where Exists (Select 1 From IAS_V_OUTGOING_AMT_ERR
Where Out_Ser=M.Out_Ser);
--Where M.out_ser in ( Select out_ser From IAS_V_OUTGOING_AMT_ERR );
---## Check Exp_amt
Update Ias_Outgoing_Dtl D Set exp_amt =(Select (nvl(M.exp_amt,0)/nvl(M.out_amt,0))*nvl(D.i_price,0) From Ias_Outgoing_Mst M
Where M.out_ser=D.out_ser)
Where Out_Ser=D.Out_Ser);
Where D.out_ser in (select out_ser From IAS_V_OUTGOING_AMT_ERR);
--==============================================================================
Insert Into IAS_LOGS( F_SYS, DOC_TYPE, LOG_DATE, LOG_DESC )
Values ('INV' , 9 ,Sysdate ,'Use IAS_CheckData_INV_Prc Check Error In OUTGOING');
END IAS_CheckData_Inv_Prc;
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE Ias_Get_Qut_Prm_Price_Prc ( P_Date In Date,
P_Icode In Varchar2,
P_Rate In Number,
P_Nof In Number,
P_Q_No Out Number,
P_Price Out Number) IS
Q_Cur Varchar2(9);
Rate Number;
Prc Number;
Select Ias_Qut_Prm_Mst.Quot_No,Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.I_Price InTo P_Q_No,P_Price
From Ias_Qut_Prm_Mst,Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl
Where Ias_Qut_Prm_Mst.Quot_No = Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.Quot_No
And Nvl(Ias_Qut_Prm_Mst.Inactive,0)=0
And P_date Between F_Date And T_Date
And To_Char(To_Date(P_date),'D') In (Fld_Day1,Fld_Day2,Fld_Day3,Fld_Day4,Fld_Day5,Fld_Day6,Fld_Day7)
And To_Char(Ias_gen_Pkg.Get_Curdate,'HH24:MI:SS') Between Nvl(F_Time,To_Char(Ias_gen_Pkg.Get_Curdate,'HH24:MI:SS')) And Nvl(T_Time,To_Char(Ias_gen_Pkg.Get_Curdate,'HH24:MI:SS'))
And I_Code = P_Icode
And RowNum <=1 ;
If P_Q_No Is Not Null Then
Select Quot_Cur InTo Q_Cur
From Ias_Qut_Prm_Mst
Where Quot_No = P_Q_No
Rate := Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Cur_rate(Q_cur);
P_Price := (Nvl(P_Price,0) * Nvl(round((Rate/P_Rate),P_Nof),0));
WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
NULL; --RAISE;
END Ias_Get_Qut_Prm_Price_Prc;

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE IAS_Get_SalesDisc_Prc ( P_DiscType In NUMBER,
P_Sales_Disc_Wcode In NUMBER,
P_Iprice In NUMBER Default 0,
P_Bill_Doc_Type In Number,
P_bill_i_qty In Number Default 0,
P_Icode In Ias_Itm_Mst.I_CODE%TYPE,

P_Brn_No In S_Brn.Brn_No%Type) IS
-- amt_type 0= Per , 1= amt
If ( P_DiscType Between 1 And 9 ) Or ( P_DiscType = 12 ) Then
Select Decode(amt_type,0,amt),
Decode(amt_type,0,(amt*P_Iprice)/100,Decode(a_cy,P_billcur,amt,(ac_rate*1/P_billrate)))
Into P_dis_per,P_dis_amt
From Sales_Disc
Where Nvl(G_Code,'0')=Decode(Nvl(G_Code,'0'),'0','0',P_Gcode)
and Nvl(I_Code,'0')=Decode(Nvl(I_code,'0'),'0','0',P_Icode)
and Nvl(Itm_Unt,'0')=Decode(Nvl(Itm_Unt,'0'),'0','0',P_Itm_Unt)
and Nvl(C_Code,'0')=Decode(Nvl(C_Code,'0'),'0','0',P_C_Code)
and Nvl(C_Class,0)=Decode(Nvl(C_Class,0),0,0,P_Cst_Class)
and Nvl(Lev_No,0)=Decode(Nvl(Lev_No,0),0,0,P_LevNo)
And Nvl(Batch_No,'0')=Decode(Nvl(Batch_No,'0'),'0','0',P_Batch_No)
and Decode(P_Sales_Disc_Wcode,2,w_code,3,whg_code,0)=Decode(P_Sales_Disc_Wcode,2,P_Wcode,3,P_whgcode,0)
and P_BillDate Between F_Date and T_Date;
ElsIf P_DiscType In (10,11) Then
Where I_Code = P_Icode
and Itm_Unt =P_Itm_Unt
and Nvl(P_Bill_I_Qty,0) Between NVL(F_Qty,0) And NVL(T_Qty,0)
and Nvl(Bill_Doc_Type,0)=Decode(Nvl(Bill_Doc_Type,0),0,0,P_Bill_Doc_Type)
ElsIf P_DiscType In (13,14 ) Then
and Brn_No = P_Brn_No
and Nvl(Lev_No,0) = Decode(Nvl(Lev_No,0),0,0,P_LevNo)
Exception when others then
P_dis_per:=0;
P_dis_amt:=0;
END IAS_Get_SalesDisc_Prc;
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE IAS_Get_SalesFreeQty_Prc ( P_Sales_Free_Qty_Type In Number,
P_Sales_FreeQty_Wcode In Number,
P_Cst_Class In Number Default 0,
P_whP_Gcode In Number,
P_Free_qty Out Number)
-- Per_Qty 0 =Percent , 1- Qty
If P_Sales_Free_Qty_Type Between 1 And 9 Then
Select Decode( Sign(nvl(P_bill_i_qty,0)-(nvl(Low_qty,0))),
Decode(nvl(Pay_Type,0),0,Floor(Per_qty*P_bill_i_qty/100),1,nvl(Per_Qty,0),2,Trunc(P_bill_i_qty/Low_Qty)*Per_Qty),
Decode(nvl(Pay_Type,0),0,Floor(Per_qty*P_bill_i_qty/100),1,nvl(Per_Qty,0),2,Trunc(P_bill_i_qty/Low_Qty)*Per_Qty))
Into P_Free_qty
From Sales_Free_qty
and Decode(P_Sales_FreeQty_Wcode,2,w_code,3,whg_code,0)=Decode(P_Sales_FreeQty_Wcode,2,P_Wcode,3,P_whP_Gcode,0)
ElsIf P_Sales_Free_Qty_Type In (10,11) Then
Select Decode(nvl(Pay_Type,0),0,Floor(Per_qty*P_bill_i_qty/100),nvl(Per_Qty,0))
Where Nvl(I_Code,'0')=Decode(Nvl(I_code,'0'),'0','0',P_Icode)
P_Free_qty:=0;
END IAS_Get_SalesFreeQty_Prc;
Create Or Replace Procedure Recalc_Sales_Ages ( P_I_Code In Ias_Itm_Mst.I_Code%Type ,
P_W_Code In Warehouse_Details.W_Code%Type ) Is
Cursor C_Itm Is Select I_Code,Itm_Unt,W_Code,Expire_Date,Batch_No,
In_Out,Serial,Doc_Sequence,
Nvl(I_Qty,0) I_Qty,Nvl(P_Qty,0) P_Qty,P_Size,
Nvl(Free_Qty,0) Free_Qty,Nvl(Pf_Qty,0) Pf_Qty,
Doc_Type,Doc_Ser,I_Date,
Ad_Date,Up_Date,Cmp_No ,Brn_No ,Brn_Year,Brn_Usr
From Item_Movement
Where I_Code = P_I_Code
And W_Code = P_W_Code
Order By W_Code,I_Code,Serial ;
V_Avl_Qty Number := 0 ;
For I_Itm In C_Itm Loop
If I_Itm.In_Out = -1 Then
Select Nvl(Sum(In_Out*(Nvl(P_Qty,0)+Nvl(Pf_Qty,0)) ),0)
Into V_Avl_Qty
And I_Code = I_Itm.I_Code
And W_Co
de = I_Itm.W_Code
And Brn_Year = I_Itm.Brn_Year
--And Expire_Date = I_Itm.Expire_Date
--And Batch_No = I_Itm.Batch_No
And I_Date <= I_Itm.I_Date
And Serial <= I_Itm.Serial ;
V_Avl_Qty := 0 ;
If Nvl(V_Avl_Qty,0) = 0 Then
Values ( I_Itm.I_Code ,
I_Itm.Itm_Unt ,
I_Itm.W_Code ,
Decode(I_Itm.Doc_Type,1,I_Itm.I_Date,Null) ,
I_Itm.I_Date ,
I_Itm.Doc_Ser ,
I_Itm.Doc_Sequence ,
Decode(I_Itm.Doc_Type,1,I_Itm.Doc_Ser,Null) ,
Decode(I_Itm.Doc_Type,1,I_Itm.Doc_Sequence,Null) ,
I_Itm.Ad_Date ,
I_Itm.Up_Date ,
I_Itm.Cmp_No ,
I_Itm.Brn_No ,
I_Itm.Brn_Year ,
I_Itm.Brn_Usr ) ;
Rollback ;
Raise_Application_Error (-20303,'Error When Insert Into Ias_Itm_Sales_Age ='
||Sqlerrm||Chr(13)||'Item_No='||I_Itm.I_Code||Chr(13)||'Warehouse No ='||I_Itm.W_Code);
Elsif I_Itm.In_Out = 1 Then
And W_Code = I_Itm.W_Code
And Serial < I_Itm.Serial ;
Set Doc_Ser_Inc = I_Itm.Doc_Ser ,
Doc_Seq_Inc = I_Itm.Doc_Sequence ,
First_Inc_Date = I_Itm.I_Date
Where I_Code = I_Itm.I_Code
End Loop ;
End Recalc_Sales_Ages ;
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE Get_Net_Sales_Py ( P_Usr In Varchar2 ,
P_Fld_Name In Varchar2 ,
P_Fld_Value In Varchar2 ,
P_Fdate In Date ,
P_Tdate In Date ,
P_Tname In Varchar2 Default Null ,
P_Whr In Varchar2 Default Null ,
P_Sign In Varchar2 Default Null ,
P_Per In Number Default Null ,
P_Type In NUMBER ,
P_Net_Amt_Py In Out NUMBER ,
P_Net_Amt_Aftr In Out NUMBER) IS
V_Sale Number:=0;
V_RtSale Number:=0;
V_NetSale Number:=0;
V_Tname Varchar2(50);
V_whr Varchar2(8000);
V_Fld_Name Varchar2(50);
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
If P_Tname Is Not Null Then
V_Tname := ','||P_Tname;
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Execute Immediate 'Select Decode('||P_Type||',1,Sum(Nvl(I_Qty,0)),2,Sum(Nvl(I_Qty,0)*(Nvl(I_Price,0)-Nvl(dis_amt,0))))
From '||P_Usr||'.Ias_Bill_Mst,'||P_Usr||'.Ias_Bill_Dtl '||V_Tname||'
Where '||P_Usr||'.Ias_Bill_Mst.Bill_Ser='||P_Usr||'.Ias_Bill_Dtl.Bill_Ser'||P_Whr||'
AND '||P_Usr||'.Ias_Bill_Mst.Bill_Date Between '''||To_Char(P_Fdate,'DD/MM/YYYY')||''' And '''||To_Char(P_Tdate,'DD/MM/YYYY')||'''
AND '||P_Fld_Name||'='||''''||P_Fld_Value||'''' InTo V_Sale;
Execute Immediate 'Select Decode('||P_Type||',1,Sum(Nvl(I_Qty,0)),2,Sum
(Nvl(I_Qty,0)*(Nvl(I_Price,0)-Nvl(dis_amt,0))))
From '||P_Usr||'.Ias_Rt_Bill_Mst,'||P_Usr||'.Ias_Rt_Bill_Dtl'||V_Tname||'
Where '||P_Usr||'.Ias_Rt_Bill_Mst.Rt_Bill_Ser='||P_Usr||'.Ias_Rt_Bill_Dtl.Rt_Bill_Ser'||Replace(P_Whr,'Bill','Rt_Bill')||'
AND '||P_Usr||'.Ias_Rt_Bill_Mst.Rt_Bill_Date Between '''||To_Char(P_Fdate,'DD/MM/YYYY')||''' And '''||To_Char(P_Tdate,'DD/MM/YYYY')||'''
AND '||Replace(P_Fld_Name,'Bill','Rt_Bill')||'='||''''||P_Fld_Value||'''' InTo V_RtSale;
V_NetSale := Nvl(V_Sale,0)-Nvl(V_RtSale,0);
P_Net_Amt_Py := V_NetSale;
If Nvl(V_NetSale,0) >= 0 Then
If P_Sign Is Not Null And P_Per Is Not Null Then
If P_Sign='+' Then
V_NetSale := V_NetSale + (V_NetSale*P_Per/100);
ElsIf P_Sign='-' Then
V_NetSale := V_NetSale - (V_NetSale*P_Per/100);
ElsIf P_Sign='*' Then
V_NetSale := V_NetSale * (V_NetSale*P_Per/100);
ElsIf P_Sign='/' Then
V_NetSale := V_NetSale / (V_NetSale*P_Per/100);
P_Net_Amt_Aftr := V_NetSale;
P_Net_Amt_Py := 0;
P_Net_Amt_Aftr := 0;
END Get_Net_Sales_Py;

Function Get_Itm_Ser_Prc( P_Icode In Ias_Itm_Mst.I_Code%Type ,

CREATE OR REPLACE Procedure Chk_Upd_ChqNo_Prc (P_TRS_TYP IN Varchar2,
P_bank_no IN Number,
P_Cur_Code IN Varchar2,
P_Cheque_No IN Varchar2,
P_DOC_NO IN Number,
P_DOC_DATE IN DATE ,
P_DOC_SRL IN Number,
P_DOC_TYP IN Numb
P_DOC_JV_TYP IN Number,
P_CHQ_ST out Number,
P_Msg out varchar2 ,
P_lng_no IN Number default 1) IS
V_Cnt Number;
V_CHQ_ST Number;
V_DOC_NO_REF Number;
V_DOC_SRL_REF Number;
V_DOC_TYP_REF Number;
V_DOC_JV_TYP_REF Number;
V_TBL_NM Varchar2(60);
V_DOC_SRL Varchar2(60);
V_CHQ_NO Number;
V_DUP_CHQ_PRMTR Number;
V_DUP_CHQ_PRMTR:=Nvl(IAS_GEN_PKG.GET_FLD_VALUE('IAS_PARA_GL','NVL(DUP_CHQ_NO_PAYMNT,0)'),0);
IF P_DOC_TYP=3 THEN
V_TBL_NM:='VOUCHER_DETAIL';
V_DOC_SRL:='V_SER';
ELSIF P_DOC_TYP=6 THEN
V_TBL_NM:='IAS_PI_BILL_MST';
V_DOC_SRL:='BILL_SER';
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Select 1
Into V_Cnt
from GLS_BNK_CHQ_MST
where bank_no = p_bank_no
And CUR_CODE = P_Cur_Code
And RowNum<=1;
when others Then
If NVL(V_Cnt,0) = 1 THEN
from GLS_BNK_CHQ_DTL
where bank_no = P_bank_no
And CHQ_NO = P_CHEQUE_NO
P_Msg:= YS_GEN_PKG.Get_Msg(P_Lng_no ,1935)||' '||IAS_CSHBNK_PKG.GET_CB_NAME(2,P_bank_no,P_Lng_no);
Return;
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
If NVL(V_Cnt,0) = 1 Then
Select CHQ_ST ,CHQ_NO,DOC_NO_REF,DOC_TYP_REF,DOC_JV_TYP_REF,DOC_SRL_REF
Into V_CHQ_ST,V_CHQ_NO,V_DOC_NO_REF,V_DOC_TYP_REF,V_DOC_JV_TYP_REF,V_DOC_SRL_REF
And CHQ_NO =P_CHEQUE_NO
V_CHQ_ST:=1;
P_CHQ_ST:=V_CHQ_ST;
IF NVL(V
_CHQ_ST,1)=2 AND P_TRS_TYP IN ('I','U') then --AND P_DUP_CHQ=0 THEN --USED
IF V_DUP_CHQ_PRMTR=1 AND P_DOC_TYP=3 AND NVL(V_DOC_SRL_REF,0)<>NVL(P_DOC_SRL,0) THEN
P_MSG:= YS_GEN_PKG.Get_Msg(P_Lng_no ,763); --763
ELSIF V_DUP_CHQ_PRMTR=1 AND P_DOC_TYP=3 AND NVL(V_DOC_SRL_REF,0)=NVL(P_DOC_SRL,0) THEN
P_MSG:= YS_GEN_PKG.Get_Msg(P_Lng_no ,763);
ELSIF NVL(V_CHQ_ST,1)=3 THEN -- CANCELED
P_Msg:= YS_GEN_PKG.Get_Msg(P_Lng_no ,1936);
ELSIF NVL(V_CHQ_ST,1)=4 THEN -- STOPPED
P_Msg:= YS_GEN_PKG.Get_Msg(P_Lng_no ,1937);
IF NVL(V_CHQ_ST,1)=1 AND P_TRS_TYP IN ('I','U') THEN
UPDATE GLS_BNK_CHQ_DTL SET CHQ_ST = 2,
DOC_NO_REF = P_DOC_NO,
DOC_DATE_REF = P_DOC_DATE,
DOC_SRL_REF = P_DOC_SRL,
DOC_TYP_REF = P_DOC_TYP,
DOC_JV_TYP_REF = P_DOC_JV_TYP
WHERE Bank_No = P_bank_no
AND CHQ_NO = P_CHEQUE_NO;
End IF;
IF NVL(V_CHQ_ST,1) =2 AND P_TRS_TYP ='U' THEN
UPDATE GLS_BNK_CHQ_DTL SET DOC_DATE_REF = P_DOC_DATE,
AND DOC_SRL_REF = P_DOC_SRL
If V_CHQ_ST =2 AND P_TRS_TYP ='D' THEN
UPDATE GLS_BNK_CHQ_DTL SET CHQ_ST = 1,
DOC_NO_REF = Null,
DOC_DATE_REF = Null,
DOC_SRL_REF = Null,
DOC_TYP_REF = Null,
DOC_JV_TYP_REF = Null
WHERE bank_no = p_bank_no
And DOC_SRL_REF = V_DOC_SRL_REF
End Chk_Upd_ChqNo_Prc;
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE Chk_Bdgt_Blnc_Prc(P_Chk_Amt In number,
P_A_CODE Account.a_code%type,
P_A_Cy Ex_rate.CUR_CODE%type,
P_Cc_Code Cost_centers.cc_CODE%type,
P_PJ_NO Ias_projects.pj_no%type,
P_Actv_NO Ias_Actvty.actv_no%type,
P_DATE IN DATE DEFAULT IAS_GEN_PKG.Get_Sysdate,
P_User_No In Number,
P_BGT_Amt_L out Number,
P_BGT_Amt_F
out Number,
P_BAL out Number,
P_Pass_Prv out Number,
P_Msg out Varchar2 ,
P_Lng In Number,
P_Bgt_Srl In Number Default 0) IS
V_Bal Number:=0;
V_USE_MULTI_CUR_BDGT Number:=0;
V_Frc_No Number:=0;
V_Chk_Bgt_Amt Number:=0;
V_BGT_CUR
Number:=0;
V_local_Cur Varchar2(10);
V_F_Date Date;
V_T_Date Date;
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- PURPOSE: to Check the Budget Balance
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--##----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------##--
V_local_Cur:=Ys_Gen_Pkg.Get_local_Cur;
Select Nvl(USE_MULTI_CUR_BDGT,0),Nvl(Chk_Bgt_Amt,0),Nvl(NO_OF_DECIMAL,2)
Into V_USE_MULTI_CUR_BDGT,V_Chk_Bgt_Amt, V_Frc_No
From ias_para_gl ;
P_Pass_Prv:=1;
-----hare
--## P_Pass_Prv 1= not allow ,2=allow ,3=allow with worning
Select Nvl(BGT_LMT_PRV,1)
Into P_Pass_Prv
From Privilege_Fixed
Where u_id=P_User_No;
Select Round((Nvl(Amt_L,0)+Nvl(Amt_L_Add,0)+Nvl(Amt_L_Add_Mov,0)-Nvl(Amt_L_Disc,0)-Nvl(Amt_L_Disc_Mov,0)),V_Frc_no),
Round((Nvl(Amt_F,0)+Nvl(Amt_F_Add,0)+Nvl(Amt_F_Add_Mov,0)-Nvl(Amt_F_Disc,0)-Nvl(Amt_F_Disc_Mov,0)),V_Frc_no),
F_Date,
T_Date
Into P_BGT_Amt_L,
P_BGT_Amt_F,
V_F_Date,
V_T_Date
From IAS_BDGT_BLNC_MST M,IAS_BDGT_BLNC_DTL D
where M.DOC_SER=D.doc_ser
AND M.DFLT=Decode(P_Bgt_Srl,0,1,M.DFLT)
and M.DOC_SER=Decode(P_Bgt_Srl,0,M.DOC_SER,P_Bgt_Srl)
AND A_CODE= P_A_CODE
And Nvl(d.a_cy,'0')= Decode(V_USE_MULTI_CUR_BDGT,0,Nvl(d.a_cy,'0'),P_A_Cy)
And P_Date between F_Date and T_Date
And nvl(cc_code,'0') = Decode(nvl(cc_code,'0'),'0',nvl(cc_code,'0'),P_cc_code)
And nvl(pj_no,'0') = Decode(nvl(pj_no,'0'),'0',nvl(pj_no,'0'),P_PJ_NO)
And nvl(actv_no,'0') = Decode(nvl(actv_no,'0'),'0',nvl(actv_no,'0'),P_ACTV_NO)
Exception when Others Then
P_BGT_Amt_L :=0;
P_BGT_Amt_F:=0;
--## Balance
If V_USE_MULTI_CUR_BDGT=0 THEN
V_BGT_CUR:=1;
V_BGT_CUR:=0;
V_Bal:=Round(Ys_Get_Blnc_Ac_Dtl_Fnc(P_A_CODE =>P_A_CODE,
P_AC_DTL_TYP => 0,
P_AC_CODE_DTL => NULL,
P_LOC_CUR =>V_local_Cur,
P_CUR_CODE =>P_A_CY,
P_CC_CODE =>P_CC_CODE,
P_PJ_CODE =>P_PJ_NO,
P_ACTV_CODE =>P_ACTV_NO,
P_F_DATE =>V_F_DATE,
P_T_DATE =>V_T_DATE,
P_BLNC_TYP => 2,
P_LOC_AMT => V_BGT_CUR ,
P_DOC_POST => 2 ),V_frc_no);
P_Bal:=Nvl(V_Bal,0);
--## BGT_AMT_L
IF V_Chk_Bgt_Amt=1 THEN ---(1)
If V_USE_MULTI_CUR_BDG
T=0 Or (V_USE_MULTI_CUR_BDGT=1 and P_A_Cy=V_local_Cur ) Then
IF P_BGT_AMT_L Is Not Null And nvl(V_Bal,0)+Nvl(P_Chk_Amt,0)>P_BGT_AMT_L Then
P_Msg:=Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(P_Lng,6074)||' = '||P_BGT_AMT_L||' '||
Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(P_Lng,139)||' = '||Round((nvl(V_Bal,0)+NVL(P_Chk_Amt,0)),V_Frc_No)||
Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(P_Lng,999)||' = '||Round(abs(P_BGT_AMT_L-(nvl(V_Bal,0)+NVL(P_Chk_Amt,0))),V_Frc_No)||' , '||
Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(P_Lng,3604)||' = '||Abs(Round(((nvl(P_BGT_AMT_L,0)-Nvl(NVL(P_Chk_Amt,0),0)-(nvl(nvl(V_Bal,0),0))) /nvl(P_BGT_AMT_L,0))*100,2));
ElsIf V_USE_MULTI_CUR_BDGT=1 And P_A_Cy<>V_local_Cur Then
IF P_BGT_AMT_F Is Not Null And nvl(V_Bal,0)+Nvl(P_Chk_Amt,0)>P_BGT_AMT_F Then
P_Msg:=Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(P_Lng,6074)||' = '||P_BGT_AMT_F||' '||
Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(P_Lng,999)||' = '||Round(abs(P_BGT_AMT_F-(nvl(V_Bal,0)+NVL(P_Chk_Amt,0))),V_Frc_No)||' , '||
Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(P_Lng,3604)||' = '||Abs(Round(((nvl(P_BGT_AMT_F,0)-Nvl(NVL(P_Chk_Amt,0),0)-(nvl(nvl(V_Bal,0),0))) /nvl(P_BGT_AMT_F,0))*100,2));
End If;---(1)
End Chk_Bdgt_Blnc_Prc;
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE Ias_Get_Icode_Reserve_Qty_Prc ( P_Icode In Ias_Itm_Mst.I_CODE%TYPE,
P_Psize In Ias_Itm_Dtl.P_Size%Type ,
P_Wcode In WAREHOUSE_DETAILS.W_CODE%TYPE DEFAULT NUll,
P_Tdate In DATE DEFAULT NULL ,
P_Doc_Ser In Number DEFAULT NULL ,
P_C_Code In Customer.C_Code%Type DEFAULT NULL,
P_Expire_Date In Order_Detail.Expire_Date%Type,
P_Batch_No In Order_Detail.Batch_No%Type,
P_Qty In Out Number,
P_Exp_Btch_Qty In Out Number) Is
V_Whr Varchar2(8000);
V_Whr_Exp_Btch Varchar2(8000);
V_Qty NUMBER:=0;
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
If P_Doc_Ser Is Not Null Then
V_Whr := V_Whr||' And Nvl(Doc_Ser_Ref,0) <> '||P_Doc_Ser;
If P_C_Code Is Not Null Then
V_Whr := V_Whr||' And Nvl(C_Code,''0'') <> '''||P_C_Code||'''';
If P_Wcode Is Not Null Then
V_Whr := V_Whr||' And Nvl(W_Code,0) = Decode('||P_Wcode||',Null,Nvl(W_Code,0),'||P_Wcode||')';
If P_Expire_Date Is Not Null Then
V_Whr_Exp_Btch := ' And Nvl(Expire_Date,''01/01/1900'') ='''||P_Expire_Date||'''';
If P_Batch_No Is Not Null Then
V_Whr_Exp_Btch := V_Whr_Exp_Btch||' And Nvl(Batch_No,''0'') ='''||P_Batch_No||'''';
------------
P_Qty := Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Cnt('Select Nvl(Sum(Nvl(CP_Qty,0)),0) /Nvl( '||P_Psize||',1)
From Ias_Reserve_Dtl
Where I_Code = '''||P_Icode||'''
And T_Date >= Decode('''||P_Tdate||''',Null,T_Date,'''||P_Tdate||''')'||V_Whr||'
And Nvl(Reserved,0) = 1
And Nvl(Cp_Qty,0) >= 0');
P_Exp_Btch_Qty := Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Cnt('Select Nvl(Sum(Nvl(CP_Qty,0)),0) /Nvl('||P_Psize||',1)
And T_Date >= Decode('''||P_Tdate||''',Null,T_Date,'''||P_Tdate||''') '||V_Whr||V_Whr_Exp_Btch||'
P_Qty := 0;
P_Exp_Btch_Qty := 0;
End Ias_Get_Icode_Reserve_Qty_Prc;
CREATE OR REPLACE Procedure Itm_Mov_Ratio_Qty_Prc ( P_Whr In Varchar2 ,
P_W_Code In Varchar2 ,
P_G_Code In Varchar2 ,
P_F_Ratio In Number Default 0 ,
P_T_Ratio In Number Default 100 ,
P_F_Date In Date ,
P_T_Date In Date ,
P_Itm_Unt_Typ In Number,
P_Itm_Unt_Lvl In Number )Is
Type Rec_Data Is Record(I_CODE VARCHAR2(100),
W_Code NUMBER,
G_Code Varchar2(6));
Type Tab_Data Is Table Of Rec_Data Index By Pls_Integer;
V_Tab_Data Tab_Data;
Execute Immediate 'Select I_Code,I_Name,I_Desc,P_Size Unit_Of_Item,P_Size,Open_Stock ( I_Code,
'||P_W_Code||',
To_Date('||''''||P_F_Date||''''||' ,''DD/MM/YYYY'') ,
Null) /P_Size Op_Stock,(In_Qty/P_Size)Iqty,(Out_Qty/P_Size)Oqty ,'||P_W_Code||' W_Code ,'|| P_G_Code|| ' G_Code
From (Select C.I_Code,Nvl(Ias_Itm_Mst.I_Name,Ias_Itm_Mst.I_E_Name) I_Name ,
Nvl(Ias_Itm_Mst.I_Desc,Ias_Itm_Mst.I_Desc) I_Desc ,'||P_W_Code||','|| P_G_Code||' ,
Sum(Decode(Doc_Type,0,0,Decode(C.In_Out,1,((Nvl(P_Qty,0)+Nvl(Pf_Qty,0))),0))) In_qty ,
Sum(Decode(Doc_Type,0,0,Decode(C.In_Out,-1,((Nvl(P_Qty,0)+Nvl(Pf_Qty,0))),0))) Out_qty ,
Nvl((Select P_Size From Ias_Itm_Dtl
Where I_Code=C.I_Code
And Decode('||P_Itm_Unt_Typ||',1,Main_Unit,2,Sale_Unit,3,Pur_Unit,4,Lvl_Unit,5,Lvl_Unit)=
Decode('||P_Itm_Unt_Typ||',1,1,2,1,3,1,4,(Select Max(Lvl_Unit) From Ias_Itm_Dtl Where I_Code=c.I_Code),5,Nvl('||P_Itm_Unt_Lvl||',1))),1)P_Size
From Ias_Itm_Mst ,Ias_Itm_Dtl ,Item_Movement C
Where C.I_Code = Ias_Itm_Mst.I_Code And Ias_Itm_Dtl.I_Code = Ias_Itm_Mst.I_Code '
||' And C.I_Date Between To_Date('||''''||P_F_Date||''''||' ,''DD/MM/YYYY'') And To_Date('||''''||P_T_Date||''''||' ,''DD/MM/YYYY'') '
|| P_Whr||'
Group By C.I_Code,
Nvl(Ias_Itm_Mst.I_Name,Ias_Itm_Mst.I_E_Name),
Nvl(Ias_Itm_Mst.I_Desc,Ias_Itm_Mst.I_Desc) ,'||P_W_Code||','|| P_G_Code||'
Group By I_Code,I_name,I_Desc,P_Size,(In_Qty/P_Size),(Out_Qty/P_Size) ,'||P_W_Code||','|| P_G_Code||'
Having ((Out_Qty/P_Size)*100)/Decode((((In_Qty/P_Size)
+ (Open_Stock ( I_Code,
Null) /P_Size))),0,1,
(((In_Qty/P_Size)+ (Open_Stock ( I_Code,
Null) /P_Size))))
Between '||P_F_Ratio||' And '||P_T_Ratio||' ' Bulk Collect Into V_Tab_Data ;
For I In V_Tab_Data.First .. V_Tab_Data.Last Loop
Insert Into Inv_V_Mov_Ratio_Qty (I_Code,I_Name,I_Desc,Unit_Of_Item,Psize,Op_Stock,Iqty,Oqty,W_Code ,G_Code )
Values (V_Tab_Data(I).I_Code,V_Tab_Data(I).I_Name,V_Tab_Data(I).I_Desc,V_Tab_Data(I).Unit_Of_Item,V_Tab_Data(I).Psize,V_Tab_Data(I).Op_Stock,V_Tab_Data(I).Iqty,V_Tab_Data(I).Oqty,V_Tab_Data(I).W_Code,V_Tab_Data(I).G_Code);
End Loop;
End Itm_Mov_Ratio_Qty_Prc ;
RS_TYP IN ('I','U') THEN
DBA_PACKAGE_SCRIPT9
"PKG INIT"DBA_PACKAGE_SCRIPT9""

P_Ret_Val In Out NUMBER ) Is
cnt NUMBER;

From '||P_Tbl_Nam ||' Dtl

End Chk_CshBnk_Cnfrm;

NAME: IAS_MEASURMENTS
1.0 08/11/2010 1. Created this package body.
FUNCTION Calc_Sales_Cst_Amt(CCode Varchar2,FDate Date,TDate Date) RETURN Number IS --- SALES _amt(1)
Sum_Sales Number;
Select Nvl(Sum(((Nvl(Bill_Amt,0)-Nvl(Disc_Amt,0))) * nvl(Bill_Rate,1)),0)
InTo Sum_Sales
From Ias_Bill_Mst
Where Ias_Bill_Mst.C_Code = Nvl(CCode , Ias_Bill_Mst.C_Code)
And Bill_Date Between FDate And Decode(TDate,Null,FDate,TDate);
Return(Nvl(Sum_Sales,0));
END Calc_Sales_Cst_Amt ;
FUNCTION Calc_Sales_Cst_Qty(CCode Varchar2,FDate Date,TDate Date) RETURN Number IS --- SALES _qty (2)
Select nvl(Sum(Nvl(i_Qty,0))+ Sum(Nvl(Free_Qty,0)),0)
From Ias_Bill_Mst,Ias_Bill_dtl
Where Ias_Bill_Mst.bill_ser =Ias_Bill_dtl.bill_ser
And Ias_Bill_Mst.C_Code = Nvl(CCode , Ias_Bill_Mst.C_Code)
END Calc_Sales_Cst_Qty ;
FUNCTION Calc_Net_Sales_Cst_Amt(CCode Varchar2,FDate Date,TDate Date) RETURN Number IS ---NET SALES (3)
Sum_Rt_Sales Number;
Select Nvl(Sum((Nvl(Bill_Amt,0)-Nvl(Disc_Amt,0)) * nvl(Rt_Bill_Rate,1) ),0)
InTo Sum_Rt_Sales
From Ias_Rt_Bill_Mst
Where Ias_Rt_Bill_Mst.C_Code = Nvl(CCode , Ias_Rt_Bill_Mst.C_Code)
And Rt_Bill_Date Between FDate And Decode(TDate,Null,FDate,TDate);
Return(Nvl(Sum_Sales,0) - Nvl(Sum_Rt_Sales,0));
END Calc_Net_Sales_Cst_Amt ;
FUNCTION Calc_Net_Sales_Cst_Qty(CCode Varchar2,FDate Date,TDate Date) RETURN Number IS ---NET SALES (4)
From Ias_Bill_Mst,
Ias_Bill_dtl
From Ias_Rt_Bill_Mst,Ias_Rt_Bill_Dtl
Where Ias_Rt_Bill_Mst.Rt_Bill_Ser=Ias_Rt_Bill_Dtl.Rt_Bill_Ser
And Ias_Rt_Bill_Mst.C_Code = Nvl(CCode , Ias_Rt_Bill_Mst.C_Code)
END Calc_Net_Sales_Cst_Qty ;
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
FUNCTION Calc_Net_Sales_Cst_Mnth(CC
ode Varchar2,FDate Date,TDate Date) RETURN Number IS --Manthly(7)
And to_char(Bill_Date,'MM') Between to_char(FDate,'MM')
And Decode(to_char(TDate,'MM'),Null,to_char(FDate,'MM'),to_char(TDate,'MM'));
And to_char(Rt_Bill_Date,'MM') Between to_char(FDate,'MM')
END Calc_Net_Sales_Cst_Mnth;
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
FUNCTION Calc_Rec_Cst (CCode Varchar2 , FDate Date , TDate Date) RETURN Number IS --
Sum_Rec Number;
Select Nvl(Sum(Nvl(Cr_Amt,0)),0) InTo Sum_Rec
Where Doc_Type In (1,2)
And c_code is not null
And C_Code = CCode
And Doc_Date Between FDate And TDate;
Return(Nvl(Sum_Rec,0));
END Calc_Rec_Cst;
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
FUNCTION Calc_Stk_Cost (CCode Varchar2,FDate Date,TDate Date) RETURN Number IS ---
Sum_Stk_Sales Number;
Sum_Stk_Rt_Sales Number;
Select Sum(Nvl(Ias_Bill_Dtl.Stk_Cost,0)*Nvl(Ias_Bill_Mst.Stock_Rate,1)*(Nvl(Ias_Bill_Dtl.I_Qty,0)+Nvl(Ias_Bill_Dtl.Free_Qty,0)))
InTo Sum_Stk_Sales
From Ias_Bill_Mst,Ias_Bill_Dtl
Where Ias_Bill_Mst.Bill_Ser=Ias_Bill_Dtl.Bill_Ser
Select Sum(Nvl(Ias_Rt_Bill_Dtl.Stk_Cost,0)*Nvl(Ias_Rt_Bill_Mst.Stock_Rate,1)*(Nvl(Ias_Rt_Bill_Dtl.I_Qty,0)+Nvl(Ias_Rt_Bill_Dtl.Free_Qty,0)))
InTo Sum_Stk_Rt_Sales
Return(Nvl(Sum_Stk_Sales,0) - Nvl(Sum_Stk_Rt_Sales,0));
END Calc_Stk_Cost;
Function Dr_Rate(Local_Cur Varchar2, -- --
Cc_Code Varchar2,
C_Code Varchar2,
A_Cy Varchar2,
Fdate Date,
Tdate Date) Return Number Is
V_Avg Number;
V_Dr_Rate Number;
V_Avg:=(Get_Bl_Cst_Fnc (Local_Cur,Null,C_Code,A_Cy,Fdate,Null )+ --
Get_Bl_Cst_Fnc (Local_Cur
,Null,C_Code,A_Cy,Tdate,Null ))/2;
if V_Avg =0 THEN
V_Avg:=1;
V_Dr_Rate:=ROUND(NVL(Calc_Net_Sales_Cst_Amt(C_Code ,Fdate ,Tdate ),1)/NVL(V_Avg,1),3);
Return(V_Dr_Rate);
End Dr_Rate;
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
FUNCTION Calc_Rt_Sales_Cst_Percentage(CCode Varchar2,FDate Date,TDate Date) RETURN Number IS
Return(Nvl(Sum_Rt_Sales,0)/Nvl(Sum_Sales,0) * 100);
End Calc_Rt_Sales_Cst_Percentage;
FUNCTION Get_Sale_Day_Avg (CCode Varchar2 , FDate Date , TDate Date) RETURN Number IS --
V_Itm_Sale_Age Number :=0;
--##----------------------------------------------------------------------------------##--
Select Round(Sum(Nvl(Get_Itm_Sales_Age (2,1,Ias_Bill_Dtl.I_Code,Ias_Bill_Dtl.Itm_Unt,FDate,TDate,Ias_Bill_Dtl.W_Code),0))/Count(1),2)
InTo V_Itm_Sale_Age
Where Ias_Bill_Mst.Bill_Ser = Ias_Bill_Dtl.Bill_Ser
And Ias_Bill_Mst.C_Code = CCode
And Bill_Date Between FDate And TDate;
V_Itm_Sale_Age := 0;
Return(V_Itm_Sale_Age);

P_Brn_No IN NUMBER ) RETURN NUMBER IS
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
V_Cnt Number:=1;
For I In (Select Rcrd_No,Fld_Nm From Ias_Gl_Cshflw_fld Where Doc_Ser=P_Doc_Ser And Rcrd_No_Dtl=P_Rcrd_No_Dtl And Rcrd_No_Ac=P_Rcrd_No_Ac) Loop
V_Cnt := Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Cnt('Select 1 From Ias_Gl_Cshflw_fld_Dtl
Where Doc_Ser='||P_Doc_Ser||'
And Rcrd_No_Dtl='||P_Rcrd_No_Dtl||'
And Rcrd_No_Ac='||P_Rcrd_No_Ac||'
And Rcrd_No_Fld='||I.Rcrd_No||'
And Fld_val=Decode('''||I.Fld_Nm||''',''DOC_TYPE'','''||P_Doc_Type||''',
''CC_CODE'','''||NVL(P_Cc_Code,'0')||''',
''PJ_NO'','''||NVL(P_Pj_No,'0')||''',
''ACTV_NO'','''||NVL(P_Actv_No,'0')||''',
''A_CY'','''||P_A_Cy||''',
''REF_NO'','''||NVL(P_Ref_No,'0')||''',
''C_CODE'','''||NVL(P_C_Code,'0')||''',

''REP_CODE'','''||NVL(P_Rep_Code,'0')||''',
''BRN_NO'','''||P_Brn_No||''')
And RowNum<=1');
If Nvl(V_Cnt,0)=0 Then
V_Cnt :=0;
Exit;

END Chk_CshFlw_Fld;

PROCEDURE Update_Rcrd_Formula (P_Doc_Ser IN NUMBER ) IS
Cursor C_CshFlw Is Select Rcrd_No,Rcrd_Formula_Desc,Rcrd_Formula From Ias_Gl_CshFlw_Dtl Where Doc_Ser=P_Doc_Ser And Rcrd_Conn_Type=2 Order By Rcrd_No;
V_Max_Rcrd_No Number;
V_Rcrd_No Number;
V_Rcrd_Formula Varchar2(2000);
Update Ias_Gl_CshFlw_Dtl Set Rcrd_Formula=Null Where Doc_Ser=P_Doc_Ser;
V_Max_Rcrd_No := Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Cnt('Select Max(Rcrd_No) From Ias_Gl_CshFlw_Dtl Where Doc_Ser='||P_Doc_Ser);
If Nvl(V_Max_Rcrd_No,0)>0 Then
For I In C_CshFlw
Loop
V_Rcrd_No := V_Max_Rcrd_No;
V_Rcrd_Formula := I.Rcrd_Formula_Desc;
V_Rcrd_Formula := Replace(V_Rcrd_Formula,'R'||V_Rcrd_No,'Get_Rcrd_Val('||V_Rcrd_No||')');
V_Rcrd_No := V_Rcrd_No-1;
Exit When V_Rcrd_No=0;
Update Ias_Gl_CshFlw_Dtl Set Rcrd_Formula=V_Rcrd_Formula Where Doc_Ser=P_Doc_Ser And Rcrd_No=I.Rcrd_No;
For I In (Select Rcrd_No,Rcrd_Formula From Ias_Gl_CshFlw_Dtl Where Doc_Ser=P_Doc_Ser And Rcrd_Conn_Type=2) Loop
For J In ( Select Rcrd_No,Rcrd_Formula From Ias_Gl_CshFlw_Dtl Where Doc_Ser=P_Doc_Ser And Rcrd_Conn_Type=2 And Rcrd_No<>I.Rcrd_No) Loop
If I.Rcrd_Formula Like '%Get_Rcrd
_Val('||J.Rcrd_No||')%' Then
Update Ias_Gl_CshFlw_Dtl Set Rcrd_Formula=Replace(Rcrd_Formula,'Get_Rcrd_Val('||J.Rcrd_No||')','('||J.Rcrd_Formula||')') Where Doc_Ser=P_Doc_Ser And Rcrd_No=I.Rcrd_No;
Exception When Others Then Null;
P_Fld_Grp_Val IN VARCHAR2 ,
P_Slct_Doc_Typ IN VARCHAR2 ) RETURN NUMBER IS
V_Amt Number:=0;
V_Whr Varchar2(4000);
If P_Fld_Grp<>'Null' Then
V_Whr := ' And Ias_V_Post_Dtl_OPN_YR.'||P_Fld_Grp||'='''||P_Fld_Grp_Val||'''';
If P_Slct_Doc_Typ Is Not Null Then
V_Whr := V_Whr||' And Ias_V_Post_Dtl_OPN_YR.Doc_Type In '||P_Slct_Doc_Typ;
V_Amt := Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Cnt('Select Sum( Case When Ias_Gl_CshFlw_Pkg.Chk_CshFlw_Fld ( Ias_Gl_Cshflw_Ac.Doc_Ser ,
Ias_Gl_Cshflw_Ac.Rcrd_No_Dtl,
Ias_Gl_Cshflw_Ac.Rcrd_No,
Ias_V_Post_Dtl_OPN_YR.Doc_Type,
Ias_V_Post_Dtl_OPN_YR.Cc_Code,
Ias_V_Post_Dtl_OPN_YR.Pj_No,
Ias_V_Post_Dtl_OPN_YR.Actv_No,
Ias_V_Post_Dtl_OPN_YR.A_Cy,
Ias_V_Post_Dtl_OPN_YR.Ref_No,
Ias_V_Post_Dtl_OPN_YR.C_Code,
Ias_V_Post_Dtl_OPN_YR.V_Code,
Ias_V_Post_Dtl_OPN_YR.Col_No,
Ias_V_Post_Dtl_OPN_YR.Rep_Code,
Ias_V_Post_Dtl_OPN_YR.Brn_No)=1 Then '||Nvl(P_Rcrd_Calc,'Amt')||' else 0 End)
From Ias_V_Post_Dtl_OPN_YR,I
as_Acc_Tree,Ias_Gl_Cshflw_Ac
Where Ias_V_Post_Dtl_OPN_YR.A_Code = Ias_Acc_Tree.A_Code
And Ias_Acc_Tree.Ac_Tree = Ias_Gl_Cshflw_Ac.A_Code
And Ias_Gl_Cshflw_Ac.Doc_Ser = '||P_Doc_Ser||'
And Ias_Gl_Cshflw_Ac.Rcrd_No_Dtl = '||P_Rcrd_No_Dtl||'
And Ias_V_Post_Dtl_OPN_YR.Doc_Date Between '''||P_Fdate||''' And '''||P_Tdate||''' '||V_Whr||'
And Decode('||P_Grp_Type||', 1 , TO_CHAR(Ias_V_Post_Dtl_OPN_YR.Doc_Date,''DD/MM/YYYY''),
2 , TO_CHAR(Ias_V_Post_Dtl_OPN_YR.Doc_Date,''WW (MM/YYYY)''),
3 , TO_CHAR(Ias_V_Post_Dtl_OPN_YR.Doc_Date,''MM/YYYY''),
4 , TO_CHAR(Ias_V_Post_Dtl_OPN_YR.Doc_Date,''Q/YYYY''),
5 , (CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(Ias_V_Post_Dtl_OPN_YR.Doc_Date,''MM'') IN (''01'',''02'',''03'',''04'') THEN ''01''
WHEN TO_CHAR(Ias_V_Post_Dtl_OPN_YR.Doc_Date,''MM'') IN (''05'',''06'',''07'',''08'') THEN ''02''
WHEN TO_CHAR(Ias_V_Post_Dtl_OPN_YR.Doc_Date,''MM'') IN (''09'',''10'',''11'',''12'') THEN ''03'' END)||''/''||TO_CHAR(Ias_V_Post_Dtl_OPN_YR.Doc_Date,''YYYY''),
6 , (CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(Ias_V_Post_Dtl_OPN_YR.Doc_Date,''Q'') IN (1,2) THEN ''01''
WHEN TO_CHAR(Ias_V_Post_Dtl_OPN_YR.Doc_Date,''Q'') IN (3,4) THEN ''02'' END)||''/''||TO_CHAR(Ias_V_Post_Dtl_OPN_YR.Doc_Date,''YYYY''),
7 , TO_CHAR(Ias_V_Post_Dtl_OPN_YR.Doc_Date,''YYYY''))='''||P_Prd_Val||'''');
RETURN(Nvl(V_Amt,0));
Exception When Others Then RETURN(0);
P_Rcrd_Formula IN VARCHAR2 ) RETURN NUMBER IS
V_Foumula Varchar2(5000);
SELECT Replace(P_Rcrd_Formula,'Get_Rcrd_Val(','(Select Nvl(sum(Blnc_amt),0) From Ias_Gl_CshFlw_Tmp Where Doc_Ser='||P_Doc_Ser||' And Prd='''||P_Prd_Val||''' And Nvl(Fld_Grp,''0'')='''||Nvl(P_Fld_Grp,'0')||''' And Rcrd_No=')
InTo V_Foumula
V_Amt := Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Cnt('Select '||V_Foumula||' From Dual');
RETURN(V_Amt);

,PJ_A_Name)) Cod_Name,

Cod_Group

CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE YS_Mnd_Ac_Dtl_Pkg IS

---## Get_Para
PROCEDURE Get_Para (P_Lng_No In NUMBER) Is
v_lng_no:=P_Lng_No;
Select Post_Cheque_Type
Into v_Post_Cheque_Type
From Ias_Para_GL;
v_Post_Cheque_Type:=0;
End Get_Para;
PROCEDURE Chk_Ac_Dtl_Trns_Prc (P_DocType In NUMBER Default Null) Is
Select nvl(post_cheque_type,0)
Into V_Post_Cheque_Type
From Ias_Para_GL,Ias_Para_AR;
V_Post_Cheque_Type:=0;
--## open_bal
If P_DocType = 0 Or P_DocType Is Null Then
Select Count(1) Into Cnt From open_bal
where ac_code_dtl Is Not Null;
Select Count(1) Into Cnt1 From Ias_Post_dtl
Where doc_type=0
and ac_code_dtl Is Not Null;
--## Journal
If P_DocType = 1 Or P_DocType Is Null Then
'Create Or Replace Force View Ias_V_Chk_Ac_Dtl_Trns as
From Ias_Post_dtl
and ac_code_dtl Is Not Null';
Into cnt
From Ias_V_Chk_Ac_Dtl_Trns
when No_Data_Found then
when Others then
Raise_application_error(-20561,' Error In Inserting Ac_code_Dtl. Trans From Detail_Journal_v = '||chr(13)||SqlErrm) ;
--## vouchers (Receipts)
If P_DocType = 2 Or P_DocType Is Null Then
Select 2 doc_type,D.ac_code_dtl,D.ac_dtl_typ, D.a_cy,D.voucher_no doc_no,
D.voucher_pay_type jv_type,M.v_ser doc_ser,nvl(sum(abs(ac_amt)),0) amt,
D.cc_code, D.rcrd_no
From vouchers M,voucher_detail D
where D.voucher_type=1
and M.voucher_type=D.voucher_type
and M.v_ser=D.v_ser
and nvl(M.Stand_by,0)= 0
and ( ((D
.voucher_pay_type=2 and '||V_Post_Cheque_Type||'=0 and D.cheque_valued=1 and M.cheq_type In (3,4)) Or M.cheq_type in (0,1,2) Or '||v_Post_Cheque_Type||'=1 ) Or D.voucher_pay_type=1)
group by 2 ,D.ac_code_dtl,D.ac_dtl_typ,D.a_cy,D.voucher_no,D.voucher_pay_type,M.v_ser,D.cc_code,D.rcrd_no
Select doc_type,ac_code_dtl,ac_dtl_typ,a_cy,doc_no,jv_type,doc_ser ,nvl(sum(cr_amt),0),cc_code,rcrd_no
where doc_type=2
group by doc_type,ac_code_dtl,a_cy,doc_no,jv_type,doc_ser,cc_code,rcrd_no';
Raise_application_error(-20562,' Error In Inserting Ac_code_Dtl Trans From Rec. Vouchers = '||chr(13)||SqlErrm) ;
--## Endrsmnt
Select 2 doc_type,D.ac_code_dtl_end,D.ac_dtl_typ_End,D.a_cy,D.voucher_no doc_no,
and M.voucher_pay_type=2
and D.ac_code_dtl_end Is Not Null
and M.cheq_type = 3
and nvl(d.Endrsmnt,0)= 1
and D.cheque_valued=1
group by 2 ,D.ac_code_dtl_end,D.ac_dtl_typ_End,D.a_cy,D.voucher_no,D.voucher_pay_type,M.v_ser,D.cc_code, D.rcrd_no
Select doc_type,ac_code_dtl,ac_dtl_typ,a_cy,doc_no,jv_type,doc_ser ,nvl(sum(dr_amt),0),ac_code_dtl,rcrd_no
and jv_type=2
and nvl(dr_amt,0)>0
and nvl(Cheque_Valued,0) <> 2
group by doc_type,ac_code_dtl,ac_dtl_typ,a_cy,doc_no,jv_type,doc_ser,cc_code,rcrd_no';
Raise_application_error(-20562,' Error In Inserting Ac_code_Dtl. Trans From Rec. Vouchers (Endrsmnt) = '||chr(13)||SqlErrm) ;
--## vouchers (Payments)
If P_DocType = 3 Or P_DocType Is Null Then
Select 3 doc_type,D.ac_code_dtl.D.ac_dtl_typ,D.a_cy, D.voucher_no doc_no,
D.voucher_pay_type jv_type ,M.v_ser doc_ser,nvl(sum(abs(ac_amt)),0) amt,
where D.voucher_type=2
group by 3 ,D.ac_code_dtl,D.ac_dtl_typ,D.a_cy,D.voucher_no,D.voucher_pay_type ,M.v_ser,D.cc_code,D.rcrd_no
Select doc_type,ac_code_dtl,ac_dtl_typ,a_cy,doc_no,jv_type ,doc_ser,nvl(sum(dr_amt),0),cc_code,rcrd_no
where doc_type=3
Raise_application_error(-20563,' Error In Inserting Ac_Code_Dtl. Trans From Pay. Vouchers = '||chr(13)||SqlErrm) ;
--## bills
If P_DocType = 4 Or P_DocType Is Null Then
Select 4 doc_type,ac_code_dtl,ac_dtl_typ,bill_currency a_cy,bill_no doc_no,bill_doc_type jv_type ,
bill_ser doc_ser,ac_code_dtl,1 rcrd_no,
Round(abs(((nvl(bill_amt,0)-nvl(disc_amt_mst,0)-nvl(disc_amt_dtl,0)+nvl(othr_amt,0)+nvl(vat_amt,0))* bill_rate)),2) bill_amt
where nvl(Stand_by,0)= 0
and bill_doc_type=4
Select doc_type,ac_code_dtl,ac_dtl_typ,a_cy,doc_no,jv_type,Doc_Ser,
ac_code_dtl,1 rcrd_no,Round(nvl(dr_amt,0),2)
where doc_type=4
Raise_application_error(-20564,' Error In Inserting Cst. Trans From bills = '||chr(13)||SqlErrm) ;
--## Add_Disc_Bills
If P_DocType = 15 Or P_DocType Is Null Then
Select 15 doc_type,ac_code_dtl,ac_dtl_typ,A_cy a_cy,doc_no doc_no,4 jv_type ,
doc_ser doc_ser,cc_code,1 rcrd_no,
Round(abs((nvl(ADD_DISC_AMT_MST,0)+nvl(ADD_DISC_AMT_DTL,0))*nvl(Doc_Rate,1)),4) disc_amt
From IAS_BILL_MST_ADD_DISC
where ac_code_dtl Is not Null
cc_code,rcrd_no,Round(nvl(cr_amt,0),4)
where doc_type=15
Raise_application_error(-20564,' Error In Inserting Cst. Trans From Add_Disc_Bills = '||chr(13)||SqlErrm) ;
--## rt_bills
If P_DocType = 5 Or P_DocType Is Null Then
Select 5 doc_type,ac_code_dtl,ac_dtl_typ,rt_bill_currency a_cy,rt_bill_no doc_no,
rt_bill_doc_type jv_type ,rt_bill_ser doc_ser,cc_code,1 rcrd_no,
Round(abs(((nvl(bill_amt,0)-nvl(disc_amt,0)+nvl(othr_amt,0)+nvl(vat_amt,0))* rt_bill_rate)),2) bill_amt
where rt_bill_doc_type=4
Select doc_type,ac_code_dtl,ac_dtl_typ,a_cy,doc_no,jv_type,Doc_Ser,cc_code,1 rcrd_no,Round(nvl(cr_amt,0),2)
where doc_type=5
Raise_application_error(-20565,' Error In Inserting Cst. Trans From return bills = '||chr(13)||SqlErrm) ;
--## Purchase Return
If P_DocType = 7 Or P_DocType Is Null Then
Select 7 doc_type,M.ac_code_dtl,M.ac_dtl_typ,M.rt_bill_currency a_cy,M.rt_bill_no doc_no,
M.rt_bill_doc_type jv_type, M.rt_bill_ser doc_ser,M.cc_code,1 rcrd_no
From Ias_Pr_Bill_Mst M
Select doc_type,ac_code_dtl,ac_dtl_typ,a_cy,doc_no,jv_type,Doc_Ser,cc_code,1 rcrd_no
where doc_type=7
--Ias_Mnd_CstTrns_Pkg.CT_Pur_Return (1) ;
--## Incoming
If P_DocType = 8 Or P_DocType Is Null Then
Select 8 doc_type,M.ac_code_dtl,M.ac_dtl_typ,M.a_cy,M.gr_no doc_no,M.Incom_Type jv_type ,
M.g_ser doc_ser,M.cc_code,1 rcrd_no,
Decode(m.rt_out,1,nvl(Sum(nvl(i_qty,0)*nvl(i_price,0)*M.ac_rate),0),nvl(Sum(nvl(i_qty,0)*nvl(c_price,0)*M.ac_rate),0)) gr_amt
From gr_note M,gr_detail D
where M.pi_type=5
and M.ac_code_dtl Is Not Null
and M.gr_no=D.gr_no
and M.pi_type=D.pi_type
and nvl(M.g_ser,0)=nvl(D.g_ser,0)
group by M.ac_code_dtl,M.ac_dtl_typ,M.a_cy,M.gr_no,M.Incom_Type,M.g_ser,M.cc_code,M.rt_out
Select doc_type,ac_code_dtl,ac_dtl_typ,a_cy,doc_no,jv_type,Doc_Ser,cc_code,1 rcrd_no,nvl(cr_amt,0)
where doc_type=8
--If cnt > 0 Then
-- Ias_Mnd_CstTrns_Pkg.CT_Incoming (1) ;
--End If;
--## Outgoing
If P_DocType = 9 Or P_DocType Is Null Then
Select 9 doc_type,M.ac_code_dtl,M.ac_dtl_typ,M.a_cy,M.Out_no doc_no,
out_type jv_
type ,Out_ser doc_ser,M.ac_code_dtl,1 rcrd_no,
Decode( M.pur_type,1,((nvl(M.Out_amt,0)* nvl(M.Ac_rate,1)) + (nvl(M.exp_amt,0)*nvl(M.exp_rate,1))),( nvl(M.Out_amt,0)* nvl(M.ac_rate,1) ) ) doc_amt
From Ias_Outgoing_Mst M
where M.ac_code_dtl=C.ac_code_dtl
Select doc_type,ac_code_dtl,ac_dtl_typ,a_cy,doc_no,jv_type,Doc_Ser,ac_code_dtl,1 rcrd_no,nvl(dr_amt,0)
Where doc_type=9
where doc_type=9
-- Ias_Mnd_CstTrns_Pkg.CT_OutGoing (1) ;
If P_DocType = 95 Or P_DocType Is Null Then --prepaid airway bill no
Select 95 doc_type,ac_code_dtl,ac_dtl_typ,a_cy a_cy,doc_no doc_no,bill_doc_type jv_type ,
doc_ser doc_ser,ac_code_dtl,1 rcrd_no,
Round(abs(((nvl(bill_amt,0)-nvl(disc_amt,0)+nvl(othr_amt,0)+nvl(vat_amt,0))* bill_rate)),2) bill_amt
From SHP_PREPAID_SLS_MST
where doc_type=95
If P_DocType = 96 Or P_DocType Is Null Then --billing airway bill no
Select 96 doc_type,ac_code_dtl,ac_dtl_typ,a_cy a_cy,doc_no doc_no,bill_doc_type jv_type ,
From SHP_BILLING
where doc_type=96
End Chk_Ac_Dtl_Trns_Prc;
T_Date In Date Default ias_gen_pkg.get_final_day ) Is
v_aralt NUMBER;
Select nvl(AR_AC_LINK_TYPE,1)
Into v_aralt
From ias_para_ar;
Exception when others
then
v_aralt :=1;
If P_doc_type Is Null Or P_doc_type =1 Then -- Journal
Select 1 Into cnt
From Master_journal_v M,Detail_journal_v D
Where M.J_ser = D.J_ser
And D.ac_code_dtl Is Null
And Exists ( Select 1 From Account where a_code=d.a_code and nvl(ac_dtl_typ,0) <> 0 and RowNum<=1)
And nvl(M.j_post,0) = Decode(P_Doc_Post,0,0,1,1,nvl(M.j_post,0))
And M.j_date between f_date and t_date and RowNum<=1;
P_Ret_Val:=0;
If P_doc_type Is Null Or P_doc_type In ( 2 ,3) Then -- Receipt
From Vouchers M,Voucher_Detail D
Where M.V_ser = D.V_ser
and M.voucher_type = Decode (P_doc_type,2,1,3,2,M.voucher_type)
and D.ac_code_dtl Is Null
and Exists ( Select 1 From Account where a_code=d.a_code and nvl(ac_dtl_typ,0) <> 0 and RowNum<=1)
and nvl(M.voucher_post,0) = Decode(P_Doc_Post,0,0,1,1,nvl(M.voucher_post,0))
and M.Voucher_date between f_date and t_date
If P_doc_type Is Null Or P_doc_type = 8 Then -- Incoming
From Gr_Note M
Where M.pi_type=5
and M.ac_code_dtl Is Null
and Exists ( Select 1 From Account where a_code=M.a_code and nvl(ac_dtl_typ,0) <> 0 and RowNum<=1)
and nvl(M.gr_post,0) = Decode(P_Doc_Post,0,0,1,1,nvl(M.gr_post,0))
and M.GR_DATE between f_date and t_date
If P_doc_type Is Null Or P_doc_type = 9 Then -- Outgoing
Where M.ac_code_dtl Is Null
and nvl(M.out_post,0) = Decode(P_Doc_Post,0,0,1,1,nvl(M.out_post,0))
and M.OUT_DATE between f_date and t_date
If P_doc_type Is Null Then -- Posting
From Ias_Post_Dtl M
End Chk_Ac_Dtl_Null;

P_Sman_Comm_Amt := 0 ;
P_Qty := 0 ;
P_Amt := 0 ;
P_Stk := 0 ;
END Ias_Ar_Get_Sales_Data ;
FUNCTION Get_Disc_Age (P_Grp_Type Varchar2,P_Round_Slice_Disc number,P_Icode Varchar2,P_Wcode Number,F_Dis_Per Number,T_Dis_Per Number,P_FDate Date,P_TDate Date) RETURN Number IS
V_BDate Date;
V_Date Date;
V_Age Number:=0;
V_Add Number:=0;
If P_Grp_Type='I_CODE' Then
Declare
Cursor C_age Is Select Distinct Bill_Date,Round(Nvl(Ias_Bill_Dtl.Dis_Per,0),Nvl(P_Round_Slice_Disc,20)) Dis_Per
And Bill_Date Between P_FDate And P_TDate
And Ias_Bill_Dtl.I_Code = P_Icode
And Nvl(Ias_Bill_Dtl.W_Code,0) = Nvl(P_Wcode,Nvl(Ias_Bill_Dtl.W_Code,0))
Order By Bill_Date;
For i In C_Age Loop
V_Bdate := I.Bill_Date;
If (Nvl(i.Dis_Per,0) Between Nvl(F_Dis_Per,0) And Nvl(T_Dis_Per,0)) Then
If V_Date Is Null Then
V_Date := I.Bill_Date;
V_Add := 0;
If V_Date Is Not Null Then
If I.Bill_Date=V_Date Then
V_Age := V_Age + 1;
V_Age := V_Age + To_Number(I.Bill_Date-V_Date);
V_Add := 1;
V_Date := Null;
If V_Date Is Not Null And V_Add=0 Then
If V_BDate=V_Date Then
V_Age := V_Age + To_Number(V_BDate-V_Date);
Cursor C_age Is Select Distinct Bill_Date,Dis_Per
And Exists (Select 1 From Ias_Ar_Itm_Disc_Tmp_Nw Where I_Code=Ias_Bill_Dtl.I_Code And RownUM<=1)
And Ias_Bill_Dtl.W_Code = Nvl(P_Wcode,Ias_Bill_Dtl.W_Code);
V_Date Is Not Null Then
Select Round(V_Age/Count(1),2) InTo V_Age From Ias_Ar_Itm_Disc_Tmp_Nw;
V_Age := 0;
Return(V_Age);
--gen_pkg.msgbox(null,'Error In Get Items Age');
END Get_Disc_Age ;
P_Icode In Ias_Itm_Mst.I_Code%Type Default Null) Return Number Is
V_Wtavg Number:=0;
If P_Wtavg_Type=2 Then
Select Nvl(I_Cwtavg,0)
Into V_Wtavg
From Ias_Itm_Wcode,Warehouse_Details
Where Ias_Itm_Wcode.W_Code=Warehouse_Details.W_Code
And I_Code=P_Icode
And Nvl(Main_Wcode,0)=1
Return(V_Wtavg);
End Get_Wc_Wtavg_Main;
FUNCTION Get_Sman_Comm_Per( P_Machine_No In Number ) Return Number Is
V_Comm_Per Number:=0;
V_Comm_Per := Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Cnt('Select b.Comm_Per
From Ias_Pos_Machine a,Sales_Man b
Where a.Rep_Code = b.Reprs_Code
And a.Machine_No = '||P_Machine_No||'
Return(Nvl(V_Comm_Per,0));
End Get_Sman_Comm_Per;
P_AvlQty_Amt In Out Number ) IS
Execute Immediate P_SqlStr Into P_AvlQty,
P_AvlQty_Amt;
END Ias_Ar_Get_AvlQty_Data;
P_Tr_Amt In Out Number ) IS
Execute Immediate P_SqlStr Into P_Tr_Qty,
P_Tr_Amt;
END Ias_Ar_Get_Tr_Data ;

CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY Ias_Weight_Sys_Pkg IS
--##-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------##--
P_Itm_Unt In Ias_Conn_Itm_Msur_Unt.Msur_Qty_Code%Type ) Return Number Is
V_Arg_No Ias_Conn_Itm_Msur_Unt.Argmnt_No%Type ;
If P_Itm_Code Is Not Null And P_Itm_Unt Is Not Null And P_Itm_Wt_Unt Is Not Null Then
Select Nvl(ARGMNT_NO,0)
Into V_Arg_No
From Ias_Conn_Itm_Msur_Unt
Where I_Code = P_Itm_Code
And Msur_Wt_Code = P_Itm_Unt
And Msur_Qty_Code = P_Itm_Wt_Unt ;
Return (V_Arg_No);
Return (Null);
End Get_Argmnt_NO ;
P_Qty_Unit In Ias_Conn_Itm_Msur_Unt.Msur_Qty_Code%Type ,
P_Argmnt_No In Number ) Return Number Is
If P_Wt_Qty Is Not Null Then
Select Decode(Factor,'/',P_Wt_Qty/Decode(Nvl(P_Argmnt_No,0),0,Argmnt_No,P_Argmnt_No),P_Wt_Qty*Decode(Nvl(P_Argmnt_No,0),0,Argmnt_No,P_Argmnt_No))
And Msur_Wt_Code = P_Wt_Unit
And Msur_Qty_Code = P_Qty_Unit;
ElsIf P_I_Qty Is Not Null Then
Select Decode(Factor,'/',P_I_Qty*Decode(Nvl(P_Argmnt_No,0),0,Argmnt_No,P_Argmnt_No),P_I_Qty/Decode(Nvl(P_Argmnt_No,0),0,Argmnt_No,P_Argmnt_No))
End Get_Arg_Unt ;
--##---------------------------
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------##--
P_Qty_Unit In Ias_Conn_Itm_Msur_Unt.Msur_Qty_Code%Type ) Return Number IS
V_Use_Fraction Ias_Conn_Itm_Msur_Unt.Use_Fraction%Type ;
Select Nvl(Use_Fraction,0) Into V_Use_Fraction
And Msur_Qty_Code = P_Qty_Unit
And Rownum <= 1 ;
Return (V_Use_Fraction);
End Get_Use_Frct_Qty_Unt ;
P_Number In Number ) Return Number Is
V_Qty Number ;
If P_Inpt_Unt_Factor_Wt Is Not Null Then
If P_Argmnt_Type = 2 Then -- Size
If P_Length Is Not Null And P_Width Is Not Null And P_Height Is Not Null And P_Number Is Not Null Then
V_Qty := (Nvl(P_Length,0)*Nvl(P_Inpt_Unt_Factor_Wt,0))*(Nvl(P_Width,0)*Nvl(P_Inpt_Unt_Factor_Wt,0))*(Nvl(P_Height,0)*Nvl(P_Inpt_Unt_Factor_Wt,0))*Nvl(P_Number,0);
ElsIf P_Argmnt_Type = 3 Then -- Area
If P_Length Is Not Null And P_Width Is Not Null And P_Number Is Not Null Then
V_Qty := (Nvl(P_Length,0)*Nvl(P_Inpt_Unt_Factor_Wt,0))*(Nvl(P_Width,0)*Nvl(P_Inpt_Unt_Factor_Wt,0))*Nvl(P_Number,0);
ElsIf P_Argmnt_Type = 4 Then -- Length
If P_Length Is Not Null And P_Number Is Not Null Then
V_Qty := (Nvl(P_Length,0)*Nvl(P_Inpt_Unt_Factor_Wt,0))*Nvl(P_Number,0);
V_Qty := Nvl(P_Length,0)*Nvl(P_Width,0)*Nvl(P_Height,0)*Nvl(P_Number,0);
V_Qty := Nvl(P_Length,0)*Nvl(P_Width,0)*Nvl(P_Number,0);
V_Qty := Nvl(P_Length,0)*Nvl(P_Number,0);
Return(V_Qty) ;
End Calc_Area_Size_Prc ;

Return (Sqlerrm);
End Get_Min_Unt ;

d ( P_Itm_Code In Ias_Itm_Mst.I_Code%Type ,

Into V_Arg_No_Upd

V_Cost Number ;

V_Op_
Qty Number ;
V_Final_Cost Number ;
If P_Costing_Type = 2 And P_Wtavg_Type = 1 Then
Select Sum(((Nvl(P_Qty,0)+Nvl(Pf_Qty,0)) )* Nvl(Stk_Cost,0) ) /(Nvl(P_Qty,0)+Nvl(Pf_Qty,0)) ,
Sum(Nvl(P_Qty,0)+Nvl(Pf_Qty,0))
Into V_Cost ,
V_Qty
Where Doc_Type In (0,2,5)
And I_Code = P_I_Code
And I_Date Between P_F_Date And P_T_Date ;
V_Cost := 0 ;
V_Qty := 0 ;
Into V_Op_Cost ,
V_Op_Qty
And I_Date <= P_F_Date ;
V_Op_Cost := 0 ;
V_Op_Qty := 0 ;
ElsIf P_Costing_Type = 2 And P_Wtavg_Type = 2 Then
Select Sum(((Nvl(P_Qty,0)+Nvl(Pf_Qty,0)) )* Nvl(Stk_Cost,0) ) /(Nvl(P_Qty,0)+Nvl(Pf_Qty,0)),
V_OP_Cost := 0 ;
V_OP_Qty := 0 ;
ElsIf P_Costing_Type = 1 Then
V_Final_Cost := 0 ;
V_Final_Cost := ((Nvl(V_Cost,0) * Nvl(V_Qty,0)) + (Nvl(V_Op_Cost,0) * Nvl(V_Op_Qty,0))) /(Nvl(V_Op_Qty,0)+Nvl(V_Qty,0));
Return(V_Final_Cost);
P_T_Date In Date ) Is

Where Ias_Rt_
Bill_Mst.Rt_Bill_Ser = Ias_Rt_Bill_Dtl.Rt_Bill_Ser
And Nvl(P_Year,0) = 0
Raise_Application_Error(-20005,'Err. When Update Cost In Ias_Rt_Bill_Dtl '||Chr(13)||SqlErrm );

And Ias_Whtrns_Mst.Tr_Cost_Type = 1
And Tr_Date Between P_F_Date And P_T_Date

--## Update Cost In Rec Warehouse Transfer

From Ias_Whtrns_Dtl

FUNCTION Get_Usr_Nm (P_Usr_No In USER_R.U_ID%TYPE,P_Lng_no In Number Default 1 ) Return VARCHAR2 Is
Select Decode(P_Lng_no,1,u_a_name,nvl(u_e_name,u_a_name))
From User_r
where U_id = P_Usr_No
End Get_Usr_Nm ;
FUNCTION Get_Usr_St (P_Usr_No In USER_R.U_ID%TYPE) Return NUMBER Is
v_inc
Select nvl(Inactive,0)
Into v_inc
Return(v_inc);
End Get_Usr_St ;
FUNCTION Get_Usr_Def_Val ( P_Usr_No In USER_R.U_ID%TYPE , P_Def_Type In Varchar2) Return VARCHAR2 Is
v_val varchar2(30);
-- P_Def_Type = W_CODE , CC_CODE , Cash_No
If P_Def_Type = 'W_CODE' Then
Select W_CODE_DEF
Into v_val
where U_Id = P_Usr_No
and Exists (Select 1 From Privilege_wh
Where U_id = P_Usr_No
and w_code=User_r.W_CODE_DEF
and add_flag = 1
ElsIf P_Def_Type = 'CC_CODE' Then
Select CC_CODE_DEF
and Exists (Select 1 From Privilege_cc
and cc_code=User_r.CC_CODE_DEF
ElsIf P_Def_Type = 'CASH_NO' Then
Select Cash_No_DEF
and Exists (Select 1 From Priv_Cash
and cash_no=User_r.CASH_NO_DEF
and cash_type = 1
Return(v_val);
End Get_Usr_Def_Val ;
FUNCTION Get_Usr_Def_Rep ( P_Usr_No In USER_R.U_ID%TYPE , P_Form_no In FORM_DETAIL.FORM_NO%TYPE ) Return NUMBER Is
v_def Number;
Select REP_SMPLE_NO
Into v_def
From IAS_REP_SMPLE_USER
and Form_no = P_Form_no
and REP_SMPLE_DFLT = 1
and nvl(PRIV_FLAG,0)= 1
Return (v_def);
END Get_Usr_Def_Rep;
FUNCTION Chk_Usr_Frm_Prv (P_UserNo In Number , P_Frm_no In Number, P_Priv_Type In Varchar2) RETURN NUMBER Is

Select nvl(Include_Flag,0)

ElsIf Upper(P_Priv_Type) = 'ADD' Then

ElsIf Upper(P_Priv_Type) = 'MOD' Then
Select nvl(Mod_Flag,0)
ElsIf Upper(P_Priv_Type) = 'DEL' Then
Select nvl(Del_Flag,0)
ElsIf Upper(P_Priv_Type) = 'VIEW' Then
Select nvl(View_Flag,0)
From PRIVILEGE
ElsIf Upper(P_Priv_Type) = '
PRINT' Then
Select nvl(Print_Flag,0)
ElsIf Upper(P_Priv_Type) = 'VWREP' Then
Select nvl(VWREP_FLAG,0)
ElsIf Upper(P_Priv_Type) = 'VRFY' Then
Select nvl(Vrfy_Flag,0)
End Chk_Usr_Frm_Prv;

FUNCTION CHK_USR ( P_USR_NO IN USER_R.U_ID%TYPE,P_PASSWORD IN VARCHAR2 ,P_LNG_NO IN NUMBER DEFAULT 1) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
V_Inactive User_R.Inactive%Type;
V_Pwd User_R.Password%Type;
V_S_Sdate User_R.S_Sdate%Type;
V_S_Edate User_R.S_Edate%Type;
SELECT NVL(INACTIVE,0) ,
PASSWORD ,
S_SDATE,
INTO V_INACTIVE,
V_PWD,
V_S_SDATE,
V_S_EDATE
FROM USER_R
WHERE U_ID = P_USR_NO
AND ROWNUM<=1;
IF V_PWD <> Ias_Get_Enc_Pass_fnc( P_Pass=>P_PASSWORD) THEN
RETURN(IAS_GEN_PKG.GET_MSG(P_LNG_NO =>P_LNG_NO,P_MSG_NO=>452));
ELSIF V_INACTIVE =1 THEN
RETURN(IAS_GEN_PKG.GET_MSG(P_LNG_NO =>P_LNG_NO,P_MSG_NO=>380 ));
ELSIF V_S_SDATE IS NOT NULL AND V_S_EDATE IS NOT NULL AND SYSDATE NOT BETWEEN V_S_SDATE AND V_S_EDATE THEN
RETURN(750);
RETURN(IAS_GEN_PKG.GET_MSG(P_LNG_NO =>P_LNG_NO, P_MSG_NO=>750 ));
RETURN(NULL);
RETURN(IAS_GEN_PKG.GET_MSG(P_LNG_NO =>P_LNG_NO, P_MSG_NO=>453 ));
END CHK_USR;

V_Appr Number:=0;

Where Doc_Typ=P_Doc_Typ
And U_Id=P_Usr_No
And Prv_Flg=1
And Rownum<=1;
Return(V_Appr);
END Get_Usr_Apprv;
