FUNCTION Get_Wc_St ( P_W_code In WAREHOUSE_DETAILS.W_CODE%TYPE) Return NUMBER;
FUNCTION Get_Wc_Ser ( P_W_code In WAREHOUSE_DETAILS.W_CODE%TYPE) Return NUMBER;
FUNCTION Get_Wc_cc ( P_W_code In WAREHOUSE_DETAILS.W_CODE%TYPE) Return VARCHAR2;
FUNCTION Get_Wc_Brn ( P_W_code In WAREHOUSE_DETAILS.W_CODE%TYPE ) Return NUMBER ;
FUNCTION Chk_Wc_Brn ( P_W_code In WAREHOUSE_DETAILS.W_CODE%TYPE, P_BRN_NO In S_BRN.BRN_NO%TYPE ) Return NUMBER;
Function Get_Whg_Code ( P_W_Code In Warehouse_Details.W_Code%Type ) Return Number ;
End IAS_Wcode_Pkg;
CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE Body IAS_Wcode_Pkg as
FUNCTION Get_Wc_Nm ( P_W_code In WAREHOUSE_DETAILS.W_CODE%TYPE,P_Lng_no In Number) Return VARCHAR2 Is
Select Decode(P_Lng_no,1,w_name,nvl(w_e_name,w_name))
where W_code = P_W_code
End Get_Wc_Nm ;
FUNCTION Get_Wc_St ( P_W_code In WAREHOUSE_DETAILS.W_CODE%TYPE) Return NUMBER Is
v_inc Number;
Select nvl(INACTIVE,0)
End Get_Wc_St ;
FUNCTION Get_Wc_Ser ( P_W_code In WAREHOUSE_DETAILS.W_CODE%TYPE) Return NUMBER Is
v_ser Number;
Select nvl(w_ser,0)
Into v_ser
Return(v_ser);
End Get_Wc_Ser ;
--===========================================================
=====
FUNCTION Get_Wc_cc ( P_W_code In WAREHOUSE_DETAILS.W_CODE%TYPE) Return VARCHAR2 Is
v_cc VARCHAR2 (30);
Select cc_code
Into v_cc
Return(v_cc);
End Get_Wc_cc ;
FUNCTION Get_Wc_Brn ( P_W_code In WAREHOUSE_DETAILS.W_CODE%TYPE ) Return NUMBER Is
v_brn_no Number;
Into v_brn_no
Return(v_brn_no);
End Get_Wc_Brn ;
FUNCTION Chk_Wc_Brn ( P_W_code In WAREHOUSE_DETAILS.W_CODE%TYPE, P_BRN_NO In S_BRN.BRN_NO%TYPE ) Return NUMBER Is
v_cnt Number;
Into v_cnt
and Conn_Brn_No = P_BRN_NO
Return(v_cnt);
End Chk_Wc_Brn ;
Function Get_Whg_Code ( P_W_Code In Warehouse_Details.W_Code%Type ) Return Number Is
V_Whg_Code Warehouse_Details.Whg_Code%Type ;
Select Whg_Code
Into V_Whg_Code
From Warehouse_Details
Where W_Code = P_W_Code
Return(V_Whg_Code);
End Get_Whg_Code ;
CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE Ias_Insrt_Out_Bills_Pkg AS
FUNCTION Get_Out_No ( P_Invs In Number, P_Si_Type In Number, P_Cc_Code In Varchar2,P_w_code In Number, P_bill_doc_type In Number,P_Brn_No In Number) Return Number;
FUNCTION Get_Out_Ser ( P_Out_No In Number, P_Si_Type In Number, P_Invs In Number, P_Cc_Code In Varchar2,P_w_code In Number,P_bill_doc_type In Number,P_Brn_No In Number,P_Brn_Year In Number) Return Number;
PROCEDURE Insrt_Out_Bills ( P_Invs In Number, P_Doc_Ser In Number, P_Out_No In Number, P_Out_Ser In Number,P_Extrnl_Post Number,P_Lang_No Number,P_Brn_No In Number);
FUNCTION Get_Ret_No ( P_Invs_Sr In Number, P_Sr_Type In Number, P_Cc_Code In Varchar2,P_w_code In Number, P_bill_doc_type In Number,P_Brn_No In Number) Return Number;
FUNCTION Get_Ret_Ser ( P_Ret_No In Number, P_Sr_Type In Number, P_Invs_Sr In Number, P_Cc_Code In Varchar2,P_w_code In Number,P_bill_doc_type In Number,P_Brn_No In Number,P_Brn_Year In Number) Return Number;
PROCEDURE Insrt_Ret_Bills ( P_Invs_Sr In Number, P_Pyear In Number, P_Doc_Ser In Number, P_Ret_No In Number, P_Ret_Ser In Number, P_Out_No In Number, P_Out_Ser In Number, P_Extrnl_Post Number, P_Lang_No Number,P_Brn_No In Number);
END Ias_Insrt_Out_Bills_Pkg;
CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY Ias_Insrt_Out_Bills_Pkg AS
--=====================================================================================--
FUNCTION Get_Out_No (P_Invs In Number,P_Si_Type In Number,P_Cc_Code In Varchar2,P_w_code In Number,P_bill_doc_type In Number,P_Brn_No In Number
) Return Number Is
V_Out_No Number;
If P_Invs=1 Then -- accumulated
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Select nvl(max(to_Number(Out_No)),0)+1 Into V_Out_No From Master_Out_Bills Where Brn_No=P_Brn_No;
ElsIf P_Invs=2 Then -- bill_doc_type
Select nvl(max(to_Number(Out_No)),0) +1 into V_Out_No From Master_Out_Bills
where bill_doc_type=P_bill_doc_type And Brn_No=P_Brn_No;
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
ElsIf P_Invs = 3 Then -- by cost_center
Select nvl(max(to_Number(Out_No)),0)+1 Into V_Out_No From Master_Out_Bills
where Cc_Code in (select Cc_Code From cost_centers
where nvl(c_sr,0)=(select nvl(c_sr,0) From Cost_Centers
where Cc_Code=P_Cc_Code)) And Brn_No=P_Brn_No;
ElsIf P_Invs=6 Then -- bty cost_center + bill_doc_type
where bill_doc_type=P_bill_doc_type and Cc_Code=P_Cc_Code And Brn_No=P_Brn_No;
ElsIf P_Invs=4 Then --warehouse
where w_code in (select w_code From Warehouse_Details
where nvl(w_ser,0)=(select nvl(w_ser,0) From Warehouse_Details
where w_code=P_w_code)) And Brn_No=P_Brn_No;
ElsIf P_Invs=5 Then --warehouse + bill_doc_type
where bill_doc_type=P_bill_doc_type and w_code=P_w_code And Brn_No=P_Brn_No;
ElsIf P_Invs=7 Then -- si_type
where si_type=P_si_type And Brn_No=P_Brn_No;
ElsIf P_Invs=8 Then --Si_TYPE + warehouse
Select nvl(max(to_Number(Out_No)),0) +1
Into V_Out_No
From Master_Out_Bills
Where Si_TYPE=P_si_type
And W_Code=P_w_code
And Brn_No = P_Brn_No;
ElsIf P_Invs=9 Then --Si_TYPE + warehouse + Pay Type
And Bill_Doc_Type=P_bill_doc_type
ElsIf P_Invs=10 Then --Si_TYPE + Pay Type
And Bill_Doc_
Type=P_bill_doc_type
Return(V_Out_No);
Exception when others Then
FUNCTION Get_Out_Ser (P_Out_No In Number, P_Si_Type In Number,P_Invs In Number, P_Cc_Code In Varchar2,P_w_code In Number,P_bill_doc_type In Number,P_Brn_No In Number,P_Brn_Year In Number) Return Number Is
V_Out_Ser Number;
V_c_sr Number;
V_cc_no Number;
V_w_sr Number;
If P_Invs In (3,6) Then
V_c_sr:=ias_cc_code_pkg.Get_Cc_ser(P_Cc_Code);
V_cc_no:=ias_cc_code_pkg.Get_Cc_no(P_Cc_Code);
ElsIf P_Invs = 4 Then
V_W_Sr := IAS_Wcode_Pkg.Get_Wc_Ser(P_W_Code);
If P_Invs=1 Then
V_Out_Ser := P_brn_Year||Lpad(P_Brn_No,6,'0')||113||P_Out_No;
ElsIf P_Invs=2 Then
V_Out_Ser := P_brn_Year||Lpad(P_Brn_No,6,'0')||113||ltrim(Lpad(P_Bill_doc_type,2,'0'))||P_Out_No;
ElsIf P_Invs =4 Then
V_Out_Ser := P_brn_Year||Lpad(P_Brn_No,6,'0')||113||ltrim(P_Out_No)||ltrim(lpad(V_w_sr,5,'0'));
ElsIf P_Invs =5 Then
V_Out_Ser := P_brn_Year||Lpad(P_Brn_No,6,'0')||113||ltrim(Lpad(P_Bill_doc_type,2,'0'))||P_Out_No||ltrim(Lpad(P_W_code,6,'0'));
ElsIf P_Invs =3 Then
V_Out_Ser := P_brn_Year||Lpad(P_Brn_No,6,'0')||113||P_Out_No||ltrim(lpad(V_c_sr,5,'0'));
ElsIf P_Invs =6 Then
V_Out_Ser := P_brn_Year||Lpad(P_Brn_No,6,'0')||113||ltrim(Lpad(P_Bill_doc_type,2,'0'))||P_Out_No||ltrim(lpad(V_cc_no,5,'0'));
ElsIf P_Invs=7 Then
V_Out_Ser := P_brn_Year||Lpad(P_Brn_No,6,'0')||113||ltrim(Lpad(P_si_type,5,'0'))||P_Out_No;
ElsIf P_Invs =8 Then
V_Out_Ser := P_brn_Year||Lpad(P_Brn_No,6,'0')||113||ltrim(Lpad(P_si_type,5,'0'))||P_Out_No||ltrim(Lpad(P_W_code,6,'0'));
ElsIf P_Invs =9 Then
V_Out_Ser := P_brn_Year||Lpad(P_Brn_No,6,'0')||113||ltrim(Lpad(P_Bill_doc_type,2,'0'))||ltrim(Lpad(P_si_type,5,'0'))||P_Out_no||ltrim(Lpad(P_W_code,6,'0'));
ElsIf P_Invs =10 Then
V_Out_Ser := P_brn_Year||Lpad(P_Brn_No,6,'0')||113||ltrim(Lpad(P_Bill_doc_type,2,'0'))||ltrim(Lpad(P_si_type,5,'0'))||P_Out_no;
V_Out_Ser := P_brn_Year||Lpad(P_Brn_No,6,'0')||113||ltrim(Lpad(P_Bill_doc_type,2,'0'))||P_Out_No||ltrim(Lpad(P_W_code,6,'0'))||ltrim(Lpad(V_cc_no,5,'0'));
Return(V_Out_Ser);
PROCEDURE Insrt_Out_Bills (P_Invs In Number , P_Doc_Ser In Number, P_Out_No In Number, P_Out_Ser In Number, P_Extrnl_Post Number,P_Lang_No Number,P_Brn_No In Number) Is
V_Cc_Code Ias_Bill_Mst.cc_code%TYPE;
V_w_code Ias_Bill_Mst.w_code%TYPE;
V_bill_doc_type Ias_Bill_Mst.bill_doc_type%TYPE;
V_Use_Audit_Doc Ias_Para_Gen.Use_Audit_Doc%Type ;
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Select Nvl(Use_Audit_Doc,0)
Into V_Use_Audit_Doc
From Ias_Para_Gen ;
V_Use_Audit_Doc := 0 ;
Select 1 InTo V_Cnt From Master_Out_Bills
Where Bill_Ser=P_Doc_Ser
V_Cnt := 0;
If Nvl(V_Cnt,0)=1 Then
Raise_application_error(-20801,Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Msg(P_Lang_No,1332)||' '||SqlErrm) ;
Select 1 InTo V_Cnt From M
aster_Out_Bills
Where Out_Ser=P_Out_Ser
Raise_application_error(-20802,Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Msg(P_Lang_No,17)||' '||SqlErrm) ;
Select 1 InTo V_Cnt From Ias_Bill_Dtl
And Nvl(Service_Item,0)=0
Select Cc_Code,w_code,bill_doc_type
InTo V_Cc_Code,V_w_code,V_bill_doc_type
Raise_application_error(-20603,SqlErrm) ;
INSERT INTO master_out_bills ( out_no,
out_ser,
bill_doc_type,
out_date,
bill_currency,
bill_rate,
stock_rate,
bill_no,
bill_ser,
w_code,
cash_no,
c_code,
c_name,
driver_no,
r_code,
out_post,
ref_no,
a_desc,
External_Post,
si_type,
UP_CNT,
brn_no,
brn_year,
cmp_no,
brn_usr,
Audit_Ref ,
Audit_Ref_Desc ,
Audit_Ref_U_Id ,
Audit_Ref_Date ,
Doc_Brn_No )
SELECT P_Out_No,
P_Out_Ser,
Bill_date,
Bill_post,
P_Extrnl_Post,
Decode(V_Use_Audit_Doc,1,1,0),
ad_u_id ,
Doc_Brn_No
From Ias_bill_Mst
WHERE Bill_Ser=P_Doc_Ser;
INSERT INTO detail_out_bills ( out_no,
i_code,
i_qty,
free_qty,
p_size,
p_qty,
i_price,
stk_cost,
expire_date,
batch_no,
use_serialno,
dis_amt,
vat_amt,
vat_per,
rcrd_no,
doc_sequence,
barcode,
use_attch,
rec_attch,
brn_usr)
SELECT P_out_no,
P_out_ser,
brn_usr
From Ias_bill_dtl
WHERE Bill_Ser=P_Doc_Ser
AND Nvl(Service_Item,0)=0;
Raise_application_error(-20804,SqlErrm) ;
FUNCTION Get_Ret_No (P_Invs_Sr In Number,P_Sr_Type In Number,P_Cc_Code In Varchar2,P_w_code In Number,P_bill_doc_type In Number,P_Brn_No In Number) Return Number Is
V_Ret_No Number;
If P_Invs_Sr=1 Then -- accumulated
Select nvl(max(to_Number(Ret_No)),0)+1 Into V_Ret_No From Ias_Ret_Bill_Mst Where Brn_No=P_Brn_No;
ElsIf P_Invs_Sr=2 Then -- bill_doc_type
Select nvl(max(to_Number(Ret_No)),0) +1 into V_Ret_No From Ias_Ret_Bill_Mst
where Rt_bill_doc_type=P_bill_doc_type And Brn_No=P_Brn_No;
ElsIf P_Invs_Sr = 3 Then -- by cost_center
Select nvl(max(to_Number(Ret_No)),0)+1 Into V_Ret_No From Ias_Ret_Bill_Mst
where Cc_Code in(select Cc_Code From cost_centers
ElsIf P_Invs_Sr=6 Then -- bty cost_center + bill_doc_type
where Rt_bill_doc_type=P_bill_doc_type and Cc_Code=P_Cc_Code And Brn_No=P_Brn_No;
ElsIf P_Invs_Sr=4 Then --warehouse
where w_code in(select w_code From Warehouse_Details
where w_code=P_w_code) ) And Brn_No=P_Brn_No;
ElsIf P_Invs_Sr=5 Then --warehouse + bill_doc_type
where Rt_bill_doc_type=P_bill_doc_type and w_code=P_w_code And Brn_No=P_Brn_No;
ElsIf P_Invs_Sr=7 Then -- sr_type
where sr_type=P_sr_type And Brn_No=P_Brn_No;
ElsIf P_Invs_Sr=8 Then --sr_type + warehouse
Select nvl(max(to_Nu
mber(Ret_No)),0) +1
Into V_Ret_No
From Ias_Ret_Bill_Mst
Where sr_type=P_sr_type
ElsIf P_Invs_Sr=9 Then --sr_type + warehouse + Pay Type
Select nvl(max(to_Number(Ret_No)),0) +1
And Rt_Bill_Doc_Type=P_bill_doc_type
ElsIf P_Invs_Sr=10 Then --sr_type + Pay Type
Return(V_Ret_No);
FUNCTION Get_Ret_Ser (P_Ret_No In Number,P_Sr_Type In Number,P_Invs_Sr In Number,P_Cc_Code In Varchar2,P_w_code In Number,P_bill_doc_type In Number,P_Brn_No In Number,P_Brn_Year In Number) Return Number Is

If P_Invs_Sr In (3,6) Then
ElsIf P_Invs_Sr = 4 Then
If P_Invs_Sr=1 Then
V_Ret_Ser := P_brn_Year||Lpad(P_Brn_No,6,'0')||114||P_Ret_No;

V_Ret_Ser := P_brn_Year||Lpad(P_Brn_No,6,'0')||114||ltrim(Lpad(P_Bill_doc_type,2,'0'))||P_Ret_No;
ElsIf P_Invs_Sr =4 Then
V_Ret_Ser := P_brn_Year||Lpad(P_Brn_No,6,'0')||114||P_Ret_No||ltrim(lpad(V_W_sr,5,'0'));
ElsIf P_Invs_Sr =5 Then
V_Ret_Ser := P_brn_Year||Lpad(P_Brn_No,6,'0')||114||ltrim(Lpad(P_Bill_doc_type,2,'0'))||P_Ret_No||ltrim(Lpad(P_W_code,6,'0'));
ElsIf P_Invs_Sr =3 Then
V_Ret_Ser := P_brn_Year||Lpad(P_Brn_No,6,'0')||114||P_Ret_No||ltrim(lpad(V_c_sr,5,'0'));
ElsIf P_Invs_Sr =6 Then
V_Ret_Ser := P_brn_Year||Lpad(P_Brn_No,6,'0')||114||ltrim(Lpad(P_Bill_doc_type,2,'0'))||P_Ret_No||ltrim(lpad(V_cc_no,5,'0'));
ElsIf P_Invs_Sr=7 Then
V_Ret_Ser := P_brn_Year||Lpad(P_Brn_No,6,'0')||114||ltrim(Lpad(P_sr_type,5,'0'))||P_Ret_No;
ElsIf P_Invs_Sr =8 Then
V_Ret_Ser := P_brn_Year||Lpad(P_Brn_No,6,'0')||114||ltrim(Lpad(P_sr_type,5,'0'))||P_Ret_No||ltrim(Lpad(P_W_code,6,'0'));
ElsIf P_Invs_Sr =9 Then

ElsIf P_Invs_Sr =10 Then
V_Ret_Ser := P_brn_Year||Lpad(P_Brn_No,6,'0')||114||ltrim(Lpad(P_Bill_doc_type,2,'0'))||ltrim(Lpad(P_sr_type,5,'0'))||P_Ret_No;
V_Ret_Ser := P_brn_Year||Lpad(P_Brn_No,6,'0')||114||ltrim(Lpad(P_Bill_doc_type,2,'0'))||P_Ret_No||ltrim(Lpad(P_W_code,6,'0'))||ltrim(Lpad(V_cc_no,5,'0'));

PROCEDURE Insrt_Ret_Bills ( P_Invs_Sr In Number, P_Pyear In Number, P_Doc_Ser In Number, P_Ret_No In Number, P_Ret_Ser In Number, P_Out_No In Number, P_Out_Ser In Number, P_Extrnl_Post Number, P_Lang_No Number,P_Brn_No In Number) Is
c_Code Ias_Ret_Bill_Mst.cc_code%TYPE;
V_w_code Ias_Ret_Bill_Mst.w_code%TYPE;
V_bill_doc_type Ias_Ret_Bill_Mst.Rt_bill_doc_type%TYPE;
Select 1 InTo V_Cnt From Ias_Ret_Bill_Mst
Where Rt_Bill_Ser=P_Doc_Ser
Raise_application_error(-20805,Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Msg(P_Lang_No,1333)||' '||SqlErrm) ;
Where Ret_Ser=P_Ret_Ser
Raise_application_error(-20806,Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Msg(P_Lang_No,17)||' '||SqlErrm) ;
InTo V_Cnt
From Ias_Rt_Bill_Dtl
Select Cc_Code,w_code,rt_bill_doc_type
Raise_application_error(-20807,SqlErrm) ;
If P_Pyear=0 Then
SELECT 1 InTo V_Cnt
From ias_rt_bill_dtl a,detail_out_bills b
Where a.bill_Ser=b.bill_Ser(+)
and a.I_code=b.I_code(+)
and a.w_code=b.w_code(+)
and a.si_rcrd_no=b.rcrd_no(+)
and a.rt_bill_ser=P_Doc_Ser
and nvl(a.service_item,0)=0
Group By a.bill_Ser,a.I_code,a.w_code,a.si_rcrd_no
Having Sum(Nvl(NVL(a.p_qty,0) +(NVL(a.free_qty,0)*NVL(a.p_size,0)),0))>
Sum(Nvl(NVL(b.p_qty,0) +(NVL(b.free_qty,0)*NVL(b.p_size,0)),0));
Raise_application_error(-20808,Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Msg(P_Lang_No,1329)||' '||SqlErrm) ;
INSERT INTO ias_ret_bill_mst ( ret_no,
ret_ser,
rt_bill_doc_type,
rt_bill_no,
rt_bill_ser,
ret_date,
ac_rate,
stk_rate,
_no,
ret_post,
doc_desc,
rt_type,
sr_type,
SELECT P_ret_no,
P_ret_ser,
rt_bill_date,
rt_bill_currency,
rt_bill_rate,
rt_bill_post,
p_year,
From ias_rt_bill_mst
WHERE Rt_Bill_Ser=P_Doc_Ser;
INSERT INTO ias_ret_bill_dtl ( ret_no,
dis_per,
rt_rcrd_no,
out_no,
si_rcrd_no,
doc_sequence_si,
a.rt_bill_no,
a.rt_bill_ser,
a.i_code,
a.i_qty,
a.free_qty,
a.Itm_Unt,
a.p_size,
a.p_qty,
a.i_price,
b.stk_cost,
a.w_code,
a.cc_code,
a.Pj_No,
a.Actv_No,
a.expire_date,
a.batch_no,
a.use_serialno,
a.dis_amt,
a.dis_per,
a.rcrd_no,
a.vat_amt,
a.vat_per,
a.barcode,
a.bill_no,
a.bill_ser,
P_out_no,
a.doc_sequence,
b.doc_sequence,
a.use_attch,
a.rec_attch,
a.sr_type,
a.cmp_no,
a.brn_no,
a.brn_year,
a.brn_usr
From ias_rt_bill_dtl a,Detail_Out_Bills b
WHERE a.rt_bill_ser = P_Doc_Ser
AND a.Bill_Ser = b.Bill_Ser
AND a.I_Code = b.I_Code
AND a.W_Code = b.W_Code
AND a.Si_Rcrd_No = b.Rcrd_No
AND Nvl(a.Service_Item,0) = 0;
From ias_rt_bill_dtl
WHERE rt_bill_ser = P_Doc_Ser
AND Nvl(Service_Item,0) = 0;
Raise_application_error(-20809,SqlErrm) ;

FUNCTION Check_Ac_Cc_Pj_Use_Lmt( P_Lmt_Type In Number ,

If P_Lmt_Type = 1 Then
From Ias_Ac_Cc_Lmt ,Ias_Acc_Tree
Where Ias_Acc_Tree.Ac_Tree = Ias_Ac_Cc_Lmt.A_Code
And Ias_Acc_Tree.A_Code = P_A_Code
And ((Ias_Ac_Cc_Lmt.A_Cy = '0') Or (Ias_Ac_Cc_Lmt.A_Cy = P_aCy))
Cnt :=0;
ElsIf P_Lmt_Type = 2 Then
From Ias_Ac_Cc_Lmt ,Ias_Cc_Tree
Where Ias_Cc_Tree.Cc_Tree = Ias_Ac_Cc_Lmt.Cc_Code
And Ias_Cc_Tree.Cc_Code = P_Cc_Code
ElsIf P_Lmt_Type = 3 Then
From Ias_Ac_Cc_Lmt ,Ias_Acc_Tree,Ias_Cc_Tree
And Ias_Cc_Tree.Cc_Tree = Ias_Ac_Cc_Lmt.Cc_Code
ElsIf P_Lmt_Type = 4 Then
From Ias_Ac_Cc_Lmt ,Ias_Pj_Tree
Where Ias_Pj_Tree.Pj_Tree = IAS_AC_CC_LMT.Pj_No
And Ias_Pj_Tree.Pj_No = P_Pj_No
ElsIf P_Lmt_Type = 5 Then
From Ias_Ac_Cc_Lmt ,Ias_Acc_Tree,Ias_Pj_Tree
And Ias_Pj_Tree.Pj_Tree = Ias_Ac_Cc_Lmt.Pj_No
End Check_Ac_Cc_Pj_Use_Lmt;
P_Doc_No In
Number ,
P_Doc_Ser In

P_Aud_Lmt In Out Number ,-- Insert Into Aud 0 - Not Insert 1 - Insert Into Aud --

Number ,-- 0 - Call From POST-CHANGE 1 - Call From POST-FORMS-COMMIT --

P_BRN_YEAR In
P_CMP_NO In

Number ) Is

G_Doc_Type := P_Doc_Type;

Gl_Lmt_Type
, No_Of_Decimal

V_Gl_Lmt_Type
:=0;

Doc_Exst

Exst :=0;

ACC_LMT_PRV

Cursor AcLmt Is

--==============================================
PROCEDURE GET_COL_PK ( P_TAB_NM IN VARCHAR2 , V_COL_NM1 OUT VARCHAR2, V_COL_NM2 OUT VARCHAR2,V_COL_NM3 OUT VARCHAR2 ) IS
v_one number:=0;
cursor pk_cv Is
Select B.Column_Name
From User_Constraints A, User_Cons_Columns B
Where A.Owner=B.Owner
And A.Constraint_Name=B.Constraint_Name
And A.Table_Name=P_Tab_Nm
And Constraint_Type = 'P';
For i in pk_cv loop
If v_one = 0 Then
V_COL_NM1:=i.Column_Name;
If v_one = 1 Then
V_COL_NM2:=i.Column_Name;
If v_one = 2 Then
V_COL_NM3:=i.Column_Name;
v_one:=v_one + 1;
END Get_Col_Pk;
FUNCTION Get_Aud_Cols_Fnc ( P_Tab In Varchar2) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
V_Sql LONG;
Cursor Tb Is Select Table_name,column_name From Tab,User_Tab_Cols --User_Tables
Where Tab.Tname = User_Tab_Cols.Table_name
and Table_name = P_Tab
and Data_Type not in('LONG RAW','LONG','RAW','UNDEFINED','BLOB','ROWID','CLOB','BFILE')
and column_name Not In ('UP_U_ID','UP_DATE','UP_CNT','PR_REP',
'CMP_NO','BRN_USR','BRN_NO','BRN_YEAR',
'P_SIZE','P_QTY','PF_QTY','TRMNL_LGN',
'LOGIN','LOGIN_CNT','LOGGED_ON','LOGOUT','OPEN_BAL',
'OPEN_FBAL','CURR_BAL','CURR_FBAL','OPEN_BAL_L','OPEN_BAL_F',
'CURR_BAL_L','CURR_BAL_F','I_CWTAVG','ITEM_STORE','INCOME_DATE',
'PROCESSED','PO_PROCESSED','PROCESED','STK_PROCESSED','JV_PROCESSED','TD_PROCESSED',
'LAST_UPDATE','LAST_DATE_LGN','MAX_POST_DATE','FILE_CV')
Order by Table_name,column_name,column_id;
v_col_nm1 varchar2(30);
v_col_nm2 varchar2(30);
v_col_nm3 varchar2(30);
v_col_nm_1 varchar2(30);
v_col_nm_2 varchar2(30);
v_col_nm_3 varchar2(30);
v_cols varchar2(3000);
For i in Tb Loop
IAS_AUD_SYS_PKG.Get_Col_Pk(i.Table_name,v_col_nm1,v_col_nm2,v_col_nm3);
If v_col_nm1 is not null Then
v_col_nm_1:=':NEW.'||v_col_nm1;
v_col_nm_1:='NULL';
If v_col_nm2 is not null Then
v_col_nm_2:=':NEW.'||v_col_nm2;
v_col_nm_2:='NULL';
If v_col_nm3 is not null Then
v_col_nm_3:=':NEW.'||v_col_nm3;
v_col_nm_3:='NULL';
--=================================
IF IAS_DBS_Sys_Pkg.Check_Object ( i.Table_name , 'TABLE' , 'CMP_NO' ) > 0 THEN
v_cols:=',NVL(:NEW.CMP_NO,:OLD.CMP_NO)';
v_cols:=',NULL';
IF IAS_DBS_Sys_Pkg.Check_Object ( i.Table_name , 'TABLE' , 'BRN_NO' ) > 0 THEN
v_cols:= v_cols||',NVL(:NEW.BRN_NO,:OLD.BRN_NO)';
v_cols:=v_cols||',NULL';
IF IAS_DBS_Sys_Pkg.Check_Object ( i.Tabl
e_name , 'TABLE' , 'BRN_USR' ) > 0 THEN
v_cols:= v_cols||',NVL(:NEW.BRN_USR,:OLD.BRN_USR)';
IF IAS_DBS_Sys_Pkg.Check_Object ( i.Table_name , 'TABLE' , 'BRN_YEAR' ) > 0 THEN
v_cols:= v_cols||',NVL(:NEW.BRN_YEAR,:OLD.BRN_YEAR)';
V_Sql:= V_Sql||'
IAS_AUD_SYS_PKG.ADD_HIST( V_OP_TYPE,'''||i.Table_name||''','''||i.column_name||''',:NEW.'||i.column_name||',:OLD.'||i.column_name||','||v_col_nm_1||','||v_col_nm_2||','||v_col_nm_3||''||v_cols||');' ;
Return(V_Sql);
When others Then
Return(null);
END Get_Aud_Cols_Fnc;
FUNCTION Get_Aud_Cols_Fnc2 ( P_Tab In Varchar2) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
IAS_AUD_SYS_PKG.ADD_HIST( V_OP_TYPE,'''||i.Table_name||''','''||i.column_name||''',:NEW.'||i.column_name||',:OLD.'||i.column_name||','||v_col_nm_1||','||v_col_nm_2||','||v_col_nm_3||');' ;
END Get_Aud_Cols_Fnc2;
P_AUD_ST IN NUMBER DEFAULT 1) Is
V_USER_NO:=P_USER_NO;
V_FRM_NO:=P_FRM_NO;
V_AUD_ST:=P_AUD_ST;
End SET_PARA;

P_PK1_VAL IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
P_PK2_VAL IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
P_PK3_VAL IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
P_BRN_YEAR IN NUMBER DEFAULT NULL ) Is
egin
If (nvl(P_NEW_VAL,'0') <> nvl(P_OLD_VAL,'0') Or P_OPR_TYPE = 2 ) and V_USER_NO Is Not Null and NVL(V_AUD_ST,1) = 1 Then

P_ORDR_BY IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL) IS
V_ORDR_BY VARCHAR2(1000);

V_ORDR_BY:=' ORDER BY M.AUD_DATE DESC';
OPEN P_LST_QRY For
'SELECT M.OPR_SER,
DECODE(M.OPR_TYPE,1,YS_GEN_PKG.GET_PROMPT(P_LNG_NO=>:P_LNG_NO,P_LBL_NO=>5),2,YS_GEN_PKG.GET_PROMPT(P_LNG_NO=>:P_LNG_NO,P_LBL_NO=>4)) OPR_TYP_NM,
M.FORM_NO,
YS_SCR_PKG.GET_SCR_NM(P_Lng_No=>:P_LNG_NO,P_Scr_no=>M.FORM_NO) FORM_NM,
M.TAB_NM,
IAS_DBS_SYS_PKG.Get_Comment (P_Lng => :P_LNG_NO
,P_TabNm => M.TAB_NM
,P_ColNm => NULL
,P_Usr_Nm => NULL) TBL_LBL_NM,
M.COL_NM,
,P_ColNm => M.COL_NM
,P_Usr_Nm => NULL) COL_LBL_NM,
M.OLD_VAL,
M.NEW_VAL,
M.COL_PK1,
M.COL_PK2,
M.COL_PK3,
M.AUD_U_ID,
IAS_USR_PKG.GET_USR_NM(P_USR_NO=>M.AUD_U_ID , P_Lng_no => :P_LNG_NO) AUD_USR_NM,
M.AUD_DATE,
M.BRN_NO,
M.CMP_NO,
M.BRN_YEAR,
M.BRN_USR
FROM IAS_AUD_HIST M , FORM_DETAIL D
WHERE M.FORM_NO = D.FORM_NO '||P_WHR||' '||V_ORDR_BY
USING P_LNG_NO,
P_LNG_NO,
P_LNG_NO;
END FTCH_AUD_DATA;

CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE Body IAS_AUDIT_PKG AS
Procedure Check_Audit_User Is
V_Aud_Del Number(1);
V_Aud_Mod Number(1);
--## Form No.
If G_Frm_No Is Null Or G_Doc_Type Is Null Then--Jornal_V --
If Nvl(G_Frm_No,888) = 20 Or Nvl(G_Doc_Type,555) = 1 Then--Jornal_V --
G_Frm_No := 20 ;
G_Doc_Type := 1 ;
Elsif Nvl(G_Frm_No,888)=23 Or Nvl(G_Doc_Type,555) =2 Then--Recpt --
G_Frm_No := 23 ;
G_Doc_Type := 2 ;
Elsif Nvl(G_Frm_No,888)=21 Or Nvl(G_Doc_Type,555) = 3 Then--Paymnt --
G_Frm_No := 21 ;
G_Doc_Type := 3 ;
Elsif Nvl(G_Frm_No,888)=24 Or Nvl(G_Doc_Type,555) = 21 Then --Note Dr --
G_Frm_No := 24 ;
G_Doc_Type := 21 ;
Elsif Nvl(G_Frm_No,888)=25 Or Nvl(G_Doc_Type,555) = 22 Then--Note Cr --
G_Frm_No := 25 ;
G_Doc_Type := 22 ;
Elsif Nvl(G_Frm_No,888)=226 Or Nvl(G_Doc_Type,555) = 8 Then--incoming --
G_Frm_No := 226 ;
G_Doc_Type := 8 ;
Elsif Nvl(G_Frm_No,888)=227 Or Nvl(G_Doc_Type,555) = 9 Then--outgoing --
G_Frm_No := 227 ;
G_Doc_Type := 9 ;
Elsif Nvl(G_Frm_No,888)=235 Or Nvl(G_Doc_Type,555) = 12 Then--TrANsFeR --
G_Frm_No := 235 ;
G_Doc_Type := 12 ;
Elsif Nvl(G_Frm_No,88
8)=228 Or Nvl(G_Doc_Type,555) = 11 Then--TrANsFeR --
G_Frm_No := 228 ;
G_Doc_Type := 11 ;
Elsif Nvl(G_Frm_No,888)=229 Or Nvl(G_Doc_Type,555) = 10 Then--StkAdj --
G_Frm_No := 229 ;
G_Doc_Type := 10 ;
Elsif Nvl(G_Frm_No,888)=130 Or Nvl(G_Doc_Type,555) = 6 Then--PI --
G_Frm_No := 130 ;
G_Doc_Type := 6 ;
Elsif Nvl(G_Frm_No,888)=133 Or Nvl(G_Doc_Type,555) = 7 Then--PR --
G_Frm_No := 133 ;
G_Doc_Type := 7 ;
Elsif Nvl(G_Frm_No,888)=158 Or Nvl(G_Doc_Type,555) = 4 Then--SI --
G_Frm_No := 158 ;
G_Doc_Type :=
Elsif Nvl(G_Frm_No,888)=160 Or Nvl(G_Doc_Type,555) = 5 Then--SR --
G_Frm_No := 160 ;
G_Doc_Type := 5 ;
Elsif Nvl(G_Frm_No,888)=159 Or Nvl(G_Doc_Type,555) = 13 Then--Out Si --
G_Frm_No := 159 ;
G_Doc_Type := 13 ;
Elsif Nvl(G_Frm_No,888)=161 Or Nvl(G_Doc_Type,555) = 14 Then--Ret Sr --
G_Frm_No := 161 ;
G_Doc_Type := 14 ;
Elsif Nvl(G_Frm_No,888)= 298 Or Nvl(G_Doc_Type,555) = 85 Then--Req. Journal
G_Frm_No := 298 ;
G_Doc_Type := 85 ;
Elsif Nvl(G_Frm_No,888)= 300 Or Nvl(G_Doc_Type,555) = 92 Then-- Req receipt
G_Frm_No := 300 ;
G_Doc_Type := 92 ;
Elsif Nvl(G_Frm_No,888)= 299 Or Nvl(G_Doc_Type,555) = 93 Then--Req Payement
G_Frm_No := 299 ;
G_Doc_Type := 93 ;
Elsif Nvl(G_Frm_No,888)= 2104 Or Nvl(G_Doc_Type,555) = 97 Then --import from extrnal file to Journal
G_Frm_No := 2104 ;
G_Doc_Type := 97 ;
Elsif Nvl(G_Frm_No,888)= 2012 Or Nvl(G_Doc_Type,555) = 95 Then --prepaid shepment
G_Frm_No := 2012 ;
G_Doc_Type := 95 ;
Elsif Nvl(G_Frm_No,888)= 2013 Or Nvl(G_Doc_Type,555) = 96 Then --airway bill no
G_Frm_No := 2013 ;
G_Doc_Type := 96 ;
Elsif Nvl(G_Frm_No,888)= 2105 Or Nvl(G_Doc_Type,555) between 9001 and 9100 Then --import from extrnal file to ias_post_dtl
G_Frm_No := 2105 ;
-- G_Doc_Type := ;
If Nvl(G_Frm_No,888) Not In (20,21,23,24,25,298,299,300,2104) Then
Select Nvl(AUDIT_Mod,1),Nvl(AUDIT_DEL,1)
Into V_Aud_Mod,V_Aud_Del
From Aud
Where Form_No=G_Frm_No
And U_Id=G_User_No;
when no_data_Found Then
Raise_application_error(-20449,' Not Audit In Aud Table For This User');
Raise_application_error(-20450,'Error When Select Audit For This User = '||SqlErrm);
V_Aud_Mod :=1;
V_Aud_Del :=1;
If Nvl(G_Aud_Type,1) = 1 Then
IsAud:=Nvl(V_Aud_Mod,1);
IsAud:=Nvl(V_Aud_Del,1);
End Check_Audit_User;
Procedure Get_Max_AudNo Is
If G_Doc_Type <=3 Or G_Doc_Type In (21,22,85,92,93,95,96,97)or G_Doc_Type between 9001 and 9100 Then
From IAS_AUD_ACC_MST
Where Aud_type = G_Aud_Type;
From IAS_AUD_Itm_MST
End Get_Max_AudNo;
Procedure Audit_Prc ( P_UserNo
In NUMBER ,
P_Aud_Type In NUMBER) Is
G_Frm_No := P_Frm_No;
G_Aud_Type := P_Aud_Type;
G_User_No := P_UserNo;
Check_Audit_User();
If Nvl(IsAud,1) =1 Then
Insrt_Audit();
End Audit_Prc;
Procedure Insrt_Audit Is
Get_Max_AudNo();
Get_SqlStr_MstDtl();
Insrt_Aud_Acc_Mst();
--insert into sqlstr values(sqlstr_mst,sqlstr_dtl);
Insrt_Aud_Acc_Dtl();
ElsIf G_Doc_Type >=4 Then
Insrt_Aud_Itm_Mst();
Insrt_Aud_Itm_Dtl();
End Insrt_Audit;

And Brn_No = Rem_Bill_Mst.Brn_No
ElsIf P_Aud_Jv_Type = 504 Then
NVL(CNTRCT_AMT,0)*NVL(Ex_Rate,1) Amt,
From Rem_Cntrct_Sale_Mst
And Brn_No = Rem_Cntrct_Sale_Mst.Brn_No
ElsIf P_Aud_Jv_Type = 603 Then
INCRS_TYP Jv_type,
Nvl(INCRS_AMT,0)* Nvl(Cur_Rate, 1) Amt,
From FAS_INCRS_MST
Where Doc_No between nvl(:P_F_Doc_No,DOC_NO) AND nvl(:P_T_Doc_No,DOC_NO)
And Brn_No = FAS_INCRS_MST.Brn_No
ElsIf P_Aud_Jv_Type = 604 Then
DCRS_TYP Jv_type,
Nvl(Dcrs_AMT,0)* Nvl(Cur_Rate, 1) Amt,
From FAS_Dcrs_MST
And Brn_No = FAS_Dcrs_MST.Brn_No
ElsIf P_Aud_Jv_Type = 605 Then
TRNS_TYP Jv_type,
Null A_Cy,
From FAS_TRNS_MST
And Brn_No = FAS_TRNS_MST.Brn_No
ElsIf P_Aud_Jv_Type = 606 Then
RCVD_TYP Jv_type,
From FAS_RCVD_MST
And Brn_No = FAS_RCVD_MST.Brn_No
ElsIf P_Aud_Jv_Type = 607 Then
DEPR_TYP Jv_type,
From FAS_DEPR_MST
And Brn_No = FAS_DEPR_MST.Brn_No
ElsIf P_Aud_Jv_Type = 609 Then
From FAS_ADJST_MST
And Brn_No = FAS_ADJST_MST.Brn_No
ElsIf P_Aud_Jv_Type = 610 Then
From FAS_EVL_MST
And Brn_No = FAS_EVL_MST.Brn_No
Raise_application_error(-20447,'Error When Query From Table '||SqlErrm) ;

Procedure Update_Aud ( AudRef IN Number,
--P_CUR_DATE IN DATE DEFAULT Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_CurDate,
V_Up_Date varchar2(100);
V_Up_Date := Ys_Gen_Pkg.Get_Fld_Value (P_Tab_Nm => TablNameMst ,P_Fld_Nm=> 'To_CHAR(UP_DATE,''DD/MM/YYYY HH:MI:SS AM'')', P_WHR => ' Where '||ClmnNam||' = '||DocSer||' AND ROWNUM<=1');
If V_Up_Date Is Not Null And To_Date(V_Up_Date,'DD/MM/YYYY HH:MI:SS AM') > To_Date(P_AUD_DATE,'DD/MM/YYYY HH:MI:SS AM') Then
P_Msg_No:=1854;
If nvl(P_CHQ_DUE,0)=1 then
'Update '||TablNameMst||' Set AUDIT_REF = '||AudRef || '
, AUDIT_REF_U_ID = ' ||AudUid || '
, AUDIT_REF_DATE = '''||P_AUD_DATE|| '''
Where '|| ClmnNam ||' = ' ||DocSer||'
And DOC_SEQUENCE='||P_DOC_SEQUENCE ;
Raise_application_error(-20448,'Error When Update Table '||SqlErrm) ;
, AUDIT_REF_DATE = '''||P_AUD_DATE||'''
Where '|| ClmnNam ||' = ' ||DocSer ;
end if;
'Update IAS_POST_DTL Set AUDIT_REF = '||AudRef || '
Where Doc_Ser = ' ||DocSer ;
End Update_Aud ;

P_Flex_No In NUMBER)

P_BRN_USR In NUMBER) IS
wtavg NUMBER;
Rqty NUMBER := 0; -- Remain Qty.
Ent_Qty NUMBER := 0; -- Enter Qty.
v_icost NUMBER := 0;
-- p_Cost_Type (stk_Evl) ==>> 1=FiFo , 2=Watavg
--============================= FIFO & WatAvg ========================================
If p_Cost_Type = 2 Then -- Watavg --
v_icost := IAS_ITM_PKG.Get_grand_wtavg(P_Wtavg_Type=> P_Wtavg_Type,P_Icode=>P_Icode,P_Wcode=>p_WCode);
Raise_Application_Error(-20419,'Error When Select WatAvg From Ias_Itm_Mst '||P_Icode||chr(13)||SqlErrm);
End if; --(1)
Cursor C_gr_rec Is Select Gr_Detail.I_Code,Gr_Detail.Gr_No,Gr_Detail.Cp_Qty,P_Size,
Gr_Detail.Pi_Type,nvl(Gr_Detail.stk_cost,0) stk_cost,
Gr_Detail.W_Code,Gr_Detail.Rec_no,Gr_Detail.Expire_Date,
Gr_Detail.Batch_No,Gr_detail.G_ser,Gr_Detail.Doc_Sequence
From Gr_Detail
And Gr_Detail.W_Code =p_wcode
And Nvl(Expire_Date,'01/01/1900')=Nvl(p_ExpDate,'01/01/1900')
And Nvl(Batch_No,'0')=Nvl(p_BatchNo,'0')
And nvl(CP_qty,0) > 0
For Update NoWait
Order By Gr_detail.Gr_Date, Gr_detail.Rec_no ;
p_Cst :=0;
-- Rqty:=1;
Ent_Qty:= (nvl(p_Iqty,0)+ nvl(p_Freeqty,0))* nvl(p_Psize,1);
For gr_rec In C_gr_rec Loop --(2)
Rqty := nvl(Gr_Rec.CP_Qty,0);
If Rqty >= Ent_Qty Then --(3
Update Gr_Detail Set CP_Qty = Rqty - Ent_Qty
Where G_Ser = Gr_Rec.G_Ser
And Rec_no = Gr_Rec.Rec_No
And W_Code = Gr_Rec.W_Code
And I_Code = Gr_Rec.I_Code;
Raise_Application_Error(-20420,'Error when update gr_detail '||Gr_Rec.I_Code||chr(13)||SqlErrm);
If p_Cost_Type = 1 Then -- Fifo
If Nvl(P_Itm_Cst_Gr,0) > 0 Then
v_icost:= Nvl(P_Itm_Cst_Gr,0)/Gr_Rec.p_size;
v_icost:= Nvl(Gr_Rec.stk_cost,0)/Gr_Rec.p_size;
Insert Into Sale_Cost ( BILL_TYPE,
BILL_DOC_TYPE,
BILL_NO,
I_QTY,
P_QTY,
I_COST,
PI_TYPE,
GR_NO,
G_SER,

Values( p_DOCTYPE,

p_DOCNO,

P_Icode,
Ent_Qty/p_PSize,
p_Itm_Unt,
p_PSize,
Ent_Qty,
v_icost*p_Psize,
Gr_Rec.Pi_Type,
Gr_Rec.Gr_No,
Gr_Rec.G_SER,
Gr_Rec.Doc_Sequence,
Gr_Rec.W_Code,
Ias_Wcode_Pkg.Get_Whg_Code(Gr_Rec.W_Code),
P_Cc_Code,
P_Pj_No ,
P_Actv_No,
Gr_Rec.Expire_Date,
Gr_Rec.Batch_No,
p_RcrdNo,
Gr_Rec.Rec_No,
p_DocSer,
p_DocSeq,
p_outno,
p_outgrser,
P_Itm_Length ,
P_Itm_Width ,

P_Itm_Number ,
P_Wt_Qty ,
P_Wt_Unt ,
P_Argmnt_No ,
p_Brn_No,
p_Brn_Year,
MP_NO ,
P_BRN_USR );
Raise_Application_Error(-20421,'Error When Insert sale_cost , i_code = '||P_Icode||chr(13)||SqlErrm);
p_Cst :=p_Cst + (v_icost * Ent_Qty);
Rqty:=0;
Ent_Qty:=0;
Else --(3)
Update Gr_Detail Set CP_Qty = 0
And rec_no = Gr_Rec.Rec_no
Excepti
on When Others Then
Raise_Application_Error(-20422,'Error When Update gr_detail ,i_code ='||Gr_Rec.I_Code||chr(13)||SqlErrm);
Values ( p_DOCType,
p_billdoctype,
Gr_Rec.CP_Qty/p_Psize,
Gr_Rec.CP_Qty,
Ias_Wcode_Pkg.Get_Whg_Code (Gr_Rec.W_Code),
p_Cc_Code,
Raise_Application_Error(-20423,'Error When Insert Sale Cost i_code = '||P_Icode||chr(13)||SqlErrm);
p_Cst :=p_Cst+((v_icost)*Gr_Rec.CP_Qty);
Ent_Qty:=Ent_Qty - Gr_Rec.CP_Qty;
End if; --(3)
End Loop; --(2)
--===================================================================
If Ent_Qty <> 0 Then
GRNO NUMBER ;
PITYPE NUMBER ;
RECNO NUMBER;
Gr_cost NUMBER;

Gr_Detail.Rec_no ,Gr_Detail.Doc_Sequence,Gr_Detail.W_Code,Gr_detail.Stk_cost,
nvl(Gr_detail.p_size,1) p_size,
Gr_Detail.Expire_date,Gr_Detail.Batch_No
Into GRNO,PITYPE,Gser,RECNO,v_docseq_gr,WC,Gr_cost,Gr_size,Expd,Bn

And Nvl(Batch_No,'0')=Nvl(p_BatchNo,'0') ;
Insert Into Sale_Cost ( bill_type,
i_cost,

gr_no,
g_ser,
Expire_date,
rec_no,
VALUES ( p_doctype,

pitype,
grno,

Ias_Wcode_Pkg.Get_Whg_Code(Wc),

p_Brn_Year ,
Raise_Application_Error(-20424,'Error When Insert Sale Cost ,i_code ='||P_Icode||chr(13)||SqlErrm);
p_Cst :=p_Cst+((Gr_cost/Gr_size)*Ent_Qty);
Raise_Application_Error(-20425,'Error When Insert Sale Cost ,i_code ='||P_Icode||chr(13)||SqlErrm);
P_Cst :=p_Cst/((nvl(p_Iqty,0)+ nvl(p_Freeqty,0))*nvl(p_Psize,1));
When zero_divide Then
Raise_Application_Error(-20426,'Divided by zero qty for i_code ='||P_Icode||chr(13)||SqlErrm);
END Insrt_To_Sale_Cost ;

FUNCTION GET_PRD_NM (P_PRD_NO IN S_PRD_DTL.PRD_NO%TYPE ,P_LNG_NO IN NUMBER DEFAULT 1 ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
V_PRD_NM S_PRD_DTL.PRD_L_NM%TYPE;

FROM S_PRD_DTL

END GET_PRD_NM;
PROCEDURE Get_Prd_YR_No (P_Doc_Date In Date , P_PRD_NO IN OUT NUMBER , P_YR_NO IN OUT NUMBER) Is
V_prd_no Number;
Select Prd_No , YR_NO
Into P_PRD_NO, P_YR_NO
From S_Prd_Dtl
Where P_Doc_Date Between F_Date And T_Date;
P_PRD_NO := To_Number (To_Char (P_Doc_Date, 'MM'));

Function Get_Cur_Rate (P_cur_code In Varchar2 ,
P_Date In Date Default Null ) Return Number Is
V_Cur_Rate Number ;
V_Up_Date Date ;
-- P_Type = 0 Get Current Rate
-- P_Type = 1 Get Period Rate
If P_cur_code Is Not Null Then
If P_Rate_Type = 1 And P_Date Is Not Null Then -- Get Rate For Specific Period
Select Max(Up_Date)
Into V_Up_Date
From Ias_Ex_Rate_Trace
Where Cur_Code = P_cur_code
And To_Date(Up_Date,'DD/MM/YYYY') <= To_Date(P_Date,'DD/MM/YYYY') ;
V_Up_Date := Null ;
If V_Up_Date Is Not Null Then
Select Nvl(Cur_Rate,1)
Into V_Cur_Rate
And Up_Date = V_Up_Date
From Ex_Rate
Where Cur_Code = P_cur_code;
Except
Raise_Application_Error(-20408,' Error When Get Currency rate = '||Sqlerrm) ;
Raise_Application_Error(-20408,' Error When
Get Currency rate = '||Sqlerrm) ;
Else -- Get Last Rate
Return(V_Cur_Rate);
End Get_Cur_Rate;
P_Doc_Date In Date Default Null ) Return Number Is
V_Min_Rate Number;
V_Max_Rate Number;
If P_Cur_Code Is Not Null And P_Cur_Code <> P_Local_Cur Then
If P_Rate_Type = 1 Then
Where Cur_Code = P_Cur_Code
And To_Date(Up_Date,'DD/MM/YYYY') <= To_Date(P_Doc_Date,'DD/MM/YYYY') ;
Select Min_Cur_Rate , Max_Cur_Rate
Into V_Min_Rate ,V_Max_Rate
Select Nvl(Min_Cur_Rate,0) ,Nvl(Max_Cur_Rate,0)
Into V_Min_Rate,V_Max_Rate
Where Cur_Code = P_Cur_Code ;
If P_Cur_Rate Is Not Null Then
If Nvl(P_Cur_Rate,0) > Nvl(V_Max_Rate,0) And Nvl(V_Max_Rate,0) > 0 Then
Return(2); --Message No= 593
Elsif Nvl(P_Cur_Rate,0) < Nvl(V_Min_Rate,0) And Nvl(V_Min_Rate,0) > 0 Then
Return(3); --Message No= 594
Return(1);
Raise_Application_Error(-20408,'Error When Get Limit CurrencyRate = '||Sqlerrm) ;
End Chk_Cur_Rate;
P_Ad_Date In Date ) RETURN NUMBER Is
V_Doc_Day_Prd Privilege_Fixed.Upd_Doc_Day_Prd%Type ;
V_Doc_Hrs_Prd Privilege_Fixed.Upd_Doc_Hrs_Prd%Type ;
V_Ret_Value Number := 0 ;
Select Upd_Doc_Day_Prd ,
Upd_Doc_Hrs_Prd
Into V_Doc_Day_Prd ,
V_Doc_Hrs_Prd
Where U_Id = P_UserNo ;
If Nvl(V_Doc_Day_Prd,0) <> 0 Then

V_Ret_Value := 1 ;

If P_Ad_Date + (V_Doc_HRS_Prd/24) < YS_GEN_PKG.Get_Curdate Then
V_Ret_Value := 2 ;
Return(V_Ret_Value);
End Get_Update_Doc_Period ;
V_Doc_Day_Prd Privilege_Fixed.Del_Doc_Day_Prd%Type ;
V_Doc_Hrs_Prd Privilege_Fixed.Del_Doc_Hrs_Prd%Type ;
Select Del_Doc_Day_Prd ,
Del_Doc_Hrs_Prd
End Get_Delete_Doc_Period ;

FUNCTION GET_FRMT_FLD_FNC ( P_NO_OF_DCML IN NUMBER ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
V_FRMT VARCHAR2(1000):='';
IF NVL(P_NO_OF_DCML,0)>0 THEN
FOR I IN 1..P_NO_OF_DCML LOOP
V_FRMT := V_FRMT||0;
END LOOP;
V_FRMT := 'FM999,999,999,999,999,999,999.'||V_FRMT;
V_FRMT := 'FM999,999,999,999,999,999,999';
RETURN(V_FRMT);
END GET_FRMT_FLD_FNC;

FUNCTION Chk_Lock_Rcrd (P_Tab Varchar2,P_Whr Varchar) Return Boolean Is
Row_Locked Exception;
Pragma Exception_Init(Row_Locked, -54);
V_Count Number:=0;
Execute Immediate ('SELECT 1 FROM '||P_Tab ||' WHERE '||P_Whr||' AND ROWNUM <=1 FOR UPDATE NOWAIT ') Into V_Count;
Return False;
EXCEPTION WHEN Row_Locked THEN
RETURN True;
END Chk_Lock_Rcrd;
--## Check Date
--===================================================================================
P_chk_cls In Number Default 1 ) Return Number IS
V_St Number;
V_cur_Date Date;
V_Fld varchar2(200);
V_Msg_No Number:=0;
If P_doc_date Is Not Null Then --(1)
If Upper(P_Scr_Type) In ('REP','FRM') Then --(2)
Select PRD_CLS Into V_St from S_PRD_BRN_CLS
where BRN_NO=P_BRN_NO
AND P_doc_date between F_date and T_date;
If V_St=1 and Upper(P_Scr_Type) = 'FRM' and P_chk_cls = 1 Then
V_Msg_No:=1096;
when no_data_found then
V_Msg_No:=9;
If P_chk_cls = 1 Then
Select Status Into V_St from IAS_CLOSE_DAY_PERIODS
where P_doc_date between f_date and t_date
If V_St>0 and Upper(P_Scr_Type) = 'FRM' Then
If Upper(P_Scr_Type) = 'FRM' Then --(3)
--## Date Lock
Select Count(1) Into V_St From date_lock
Where P_doc_date between ufd and utd or P_doc_date between lfd and ltd;
If V_St>0 then
Select Count(1) Into V_St from ias_date_lock_User
where u_id = P_Usr_No
and (P_doc_date between ufd and utd or P_doc_date between lfd and ltd);
--## check inv close.
If P_Frm_Type = 1 Then
Select Count(1) Into V_St from S_PRD_MST
where INV_CLS = 1;
If V_St >0 then
V_Msg_No:=1204;
--## Sysdate Greater Then Today
Select Sysdate Into V_cur_Date from dual;
If P_doc_date> V_cur_Date Then
V_Msg_No:=365;
Exception when no_data_found Then
End If; --(3)
Return(V_Msg_No);
END CHECK_DATE;

RETURN(V_PST_BRN_NO);
End Get_PST_BRN_NO;

v_doc_desc:= Ias_gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(v_lang_no,1860)||M_cv.doc_no;
p_jv_type=> M_cv.jv_type,
p_doc_no=> M_cv.doc_no,
p_doc_ser=> M_cv.doc_ser,
p_a_code=> M_cv.out_diff_a_code,

p_amt_f=>(D_cv.diff_amtf),
p_j_date=> M_cv.doc_date,
p_j_desc=> v_doc_desc,
p_cc_code=> v_cc_code,
p_pj_no=> V_pj_no,
p_Actv_No=> V_Actv_No,
p_w_code=> M_cv.w_code,
p_cb_before=> v_curr_bal,
p_ref_no=> M_cv.ref_no);
--==============================================================
v_amt:= nvl(D_cv.amt,0) + ( nvl(D_cv.vat_amt ,0)* M_cv.ac_rate);
If M_cv.a_cy = v_local_cur Then
v_amtf:=nvl(D_cv.amtf,0)+nvl(D_cv.vat_amt,0);
v_curr_bal:=IAS_Posting_Pkg.Check_Acode (M_cv.a_code,M_cv.a_cy);
p_a_code=> M_cv.a_code,
p_a_cy=> M_cv.a_cy,
p_amt=> -(v_amt),

p_cc_cod
e=> v_cc_code,
p_Cash_no=> M_cv.Csh_Bnk_no,
p_pj_no=> V_Pj_No,
p_c_code=> M_cv.c_code,
p_v_code=> M_cv.v_code,
P_Ac_Dtl_Typ => M_Cv.Ac_Dtl_Typ ,
P_Ac_Code_Dtl => M_Cv.Ac_Code_Dtl ,

If v_use_vat = 1 and nvl(D_cv.vat_amt,0) <> 0 Then --(5)

Raise_application_error(-20666,Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Msg(V_Lang_No,1125)||' ,'||SqlErrm) ;
v_curr_bal:=IAS_Posting_Pkg.Check_Acode (v_vat_ac,v_local_cur);

p_j_desc=>v_doc_desc,
p_Doc_jv_type_ref=>M_cv.pur_type);
End If;--(5)
--## Group Account From Inventory
For D_cv_g in
( Select sum((i_qty * c_price) * (nvl(ac_rate,1)/nvl(stk_rate,1))) amt,
Decode(v_stk_cur,v_local_cur,0,sum((i_qty * c_price) * (nvl(ac_rate,1)/nvl(stk_rate,1)))) amtf,
Pst.Post_Code Post_Code,
Decode(v_Incoming_Cs_Type,2,Dg.cc_code,Null) cc_code ,

Decode(V_Inc_Actv_Type,2,Dg.Actv_No,Null))
Loop --(3)
v_cc_code:=D_cv_g.cc_code;
V_Pj_No := D_cv_g.Pj_No ;
V_Actv_No := D_cv_g.Actv_No ;
v_a_code:=Ias_Posting_Pkg.Get_G_A_code(D_cv_g.Post_Code,'G_A_CODE');

p_a_code=> v_a_code,
p_a_cy=> v_stk_cur,
p_amt=> nvl(D_cv_g.amt,0) * M_cv.stk_rate,
p_amt_f=> nvl(D_cv_g.amtf,0),
P_G_CODE => D_cv_g.Post_Code);
End Loop; --(3)
End If ;--(End Chk Exist)
Update gr_note Set gr_post=1,
Where pi_type= 5
and g_ser=M_cv.doc_ser;
Raise_application_error(-20644,'Income, '||Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Msg(V_Lang_No,1123)||SqlErrm) ;
Raise_application_error(-20645,'Income, '||Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Msg(V_Lang_No,1123)||SqlErrm) ;
P_cc_code => nvl(v_cc_code,M_cv.cc_code),
P_PJ_NO => Nvl(V_PJ_No,M_Cv.Pj_No),
P_ACTV_NO => Nvl(V_Actv_No,M_Cv.Actv_No),
P_CMP_NO => M_cv.CMP_NO ,

Procedure Post_Outgoing ( P_f_doc_no In NUMBER Default Null
--=======================================================
( Select 9 doc_type
,Mout.Out_no
,Mout.Out_type
,Mout.Out_date
,Mout.a_desc
,Mout.a_code
,Mout.a_cy
,nvl(Mout.stock_rate,1) stk_rate
,nvl(Mout.ac_rate,1) ac_rate
,Mout.cc_code cc_code
,Mout.pj_no pj_no
,Mout.Actv_No Actv_No
,Mout.Csh_Bnk_no Csh_Bnk_no
,Mout.Lc_No Lc_No
,Mout.Doc_Brn_No Doc_Brn_No
,Mout.w_code w_code
,Mout.ref_no ref_no
,Mout.exp_a_code
,Mout.exp_a_cy
,nvl(Mout.exp_amt,0) Exp_amt
,Decode(Mout.exp_a_cy,v_local_cur,0,nvl(Mout.exp_amt,0)) Exp_amtf
,nvl(Mout.exp_rate,1) Exp_rate
,Mout.c_code
,Mout.v_code
,Mout.Ac_Dtl_Typ Ac_Dtl_Typ
,Mout.Ac_Code_Dtl Ac_Code_Dtl
,Mout.pur_type
,Mout.Out_ser
,Mout.ad_u_id ad_u_id
,Mout.Brn_no Brn_no
,Mout.Brn_Year Brn_Year
,Mout.CMP_NO
,Mout.BRN_USR
From Ias_Outgoing_Mst Mout
Where nvl(Mout.Out_post,0)=Decode(Nvl(P_Post_Type,0),0,0,nvl(Mout.Out_post,0))
and nvl(Mout.Audit_ref,0) = Decode(v_Use_Audit_Doc,1,1,nvl(Mout.Audit_ref,0))
and nvl(Mout.HUNG,0)=0
and Mout.Out_type = nvl(P_jv_type, Mout.Out_type)
and Mout.Out_no between nvl(P_f_doc_no,Mout.Out_no) and nvl(P_t_doc_no,Mout.Out_no)
and Mout.Out_date between nvl(P_f_doc_date,Mout.Out_date) and nvl(P_t_doc_date,Mout.Out_date)
and Mout.Out_ser = nvl(P_doc_ser, Mout.Out_ser)
And Mout.Brn_No = nvl(P_Brn_No, Mout.Brn_No)
and Mout.ad_u_id = nvl(P_ad_u_id, Mout.ad_u_id)
And S_Brn_Usr_Priv.Brn_No = Mout.Brn_No
-- pur_type ==> 1 = Cost , 2- Last Income Price,3- Sales Price
M_cv.Install_Type
_cc_code => M_cv.cc_code ,
p_pj_no => M_cv.pj_no ,
p_Actv_No => M_cv.Actv_No ,
p_w_code => M_cv.w_code ,
If v_hide_ac = 0 Then --(3)
( Select Decode(M_cv.pur_type,1,
Sum(((nvl(i_qty,0)*nvl(i_price,0))* Mout.ac_rate)+(nvl(i_qty,0)*nvl(Dout.exp_amt,0) )* nvl(Mout.exp_rate,1)) ,
Sum((nvl(i_qty,0)*nvl(i_price,0))* Mout.ac_rate)) amt,
Sum(Decode(M_cv.a_cy,v_local_cur,0,(nvl(i_qty,0)*nvl(i_price,0)) )) amtf,
Sum(nvl(i_qty,0)*nvl(Dout.exp_amt,0)) Exp_amt,
Sum(Decode(M_cv.Exp_a_cy,v_local_cur,0,nvl(i_qty,0)*nvl(Dout.exp_amt,0))) Exp_amtf,
Sum(Decode(M_cv.Exp_a_cy,v_local_cur,0,Decode(M_cv.pur_type,1,(nvl(i_qty,0)*nvl(Dout.exp_amt,0))),0)) Exp_Cost_amtf,
Decode(v_outgoing_cs_type,2,Dout.cc_code,Null) cc_code ,
Decode(V_Out_Pj_Type,2,Dout.Pj_No,Null) Pj_No ,
Decode(V_Out_Actv_Type,2,Dout.Actv_No,Null) Actv_No
From Ias_Outgoing_Mst Mout ,Ias_Outgoing_Dtl Dout
Where Mout.Out_ser=Dout.Out_ser
and Dout.Out_ser=M_cv.doc_ser
Group by Decode(v_outgoing_cs_type,2,Dout.cc_code,Null),
Decode(V_Out_Pj_Type,2,Dout.Pj_No,Null) ,
Decode(V_Out_Actv_Type,2,Dout.Actv_No,Null))
Loop --(4)
If v_outgoing_cs_type = 2 Then -- Multi cc_code
If V_Out_Pj_Type = 2 Then -- Multi Pj_No
If V_Out_Actv_Type = 2 Then -- Multi Actv_No
--## it will be add exp_amt In (dr amt) when pur_type = 1 Only
If M_cv.pur_type = 1 Then -- by item cost
v_amtf:=nvl(D_cv.amtf,0)+ ( nvl(D_cv.Exp_Cost_amtf,0) * nvl(M_cv.Exp_rate,0)/nvl(M_cv.ac_rate,0));
p_amt=>D_cv.amt,
p_amt_f=>v_amtf ,
p_cash_no=> M_cv.Csh_Bnk_no,
p_lc_no => M_cv.Lc_No,
p_w_code => M_cv.w_code,
---## Exp_a_code
If M_cv.Exp_a_code Is Not Null and M_cv.Exp_a_cy Is Not Null and M_cv.Exp_amt <> 0 Then --(2)
v_curr_bal:=IAS_Posting_Pkg.Check_Acode (M_cv.Exp_a_code,M_cv.Exp_a_cy);
v_doc_desc:= Ias_gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(v_lang_no,1861)||M_cv.doc_no;
p_a_code=> M_cv.exp_a_code,
p_a_cy=> M_cv.exp_a_cy,
p_amt=> -(nvl(D_cv.Exp_amt,0)*M_cv.Exp_rat
p_amt_f=>-(nvl(D_cv.Exp_amtf,0)),
End loop; --(4)
--=======================================
Else -- Not show Account In Master
Sum(((nvl(i_qty,0)*nvl(i_price,0))*Mout.ac_rate)+(nvl(i_qty,0)*nvl(Dout.exp_amt,0) )* nvl(Mout.exp_rate,1)) ,
Sum((nvl(i_qty,0)*nvl(i_price,0))*Mout.ac_rate)) amt,
Sum(Decode(M_cv.Exp_a_cy,v_local_cur,0,Decode(M_cv.pur_type,1,(nvl(i_qty,0)*nvl(Dout.exp_amt,0))),0)) Exp_cost_amtf,
From Ias_Outgoing_Mst Mout ,Ias_Outgoing_Dtl Dout,Ias_Post_Details Pst
and Pst.Code_No=Decode(V_Item_Posting_Flag,1,Dout.i_code,2,Dout.w_code)
group by Pst.Post_Code,Decode(v_outgoing_cs_type,2,Dout.cc_code,Null),
Decode(V_Out_Actv_Type,2,Dout.Actv_No,Null) )
Loop --(5)
If v_outgoing_cs_type = 2 Then
-- Multi cc_code
Into v_a_code
From outgoing_accounts
Where Decode(V_Item_Posting_Flag,1,g_code,WHG_CODE) = D_cv.Post_Code
and out_type = M_cv.Jv_Type;
When no_data_found Then
Raise_application_error(-20646,'Error When Select Account From outgoing_accounts ='||SqlErrm) ;
--## It will be add exp_amt In (dr amt) when pur_type = 1 Only
If v_a_code Is Null Then
Raise_application_error(-20646,Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Msg(V_Lang_No,41)||' ,'||SqlErrm) ;
v_amtf:=nvl(D_cv.amtf,0) + ( nvl(D_cv.Exp_Cost_amtf,0) * nvl(M_cv.Exp_rate,0)/nvl(M_cv.ac_rate,0)); --+ ( nvl(D_cv.Exp_amtf,0) * nvl(M_cv.Exp_rate,0));
_c_code=> M_cv.c_code,
p_amt=> -(nvl(D_cv.Exp_amt,0)*M_cv.Exp_rate),
P_G_CODE => D_cv.Post_Code);
End loop; --(5)
( Select (sum(nvl(i_qty,0) * nvl(stk_cost,0) )* nvl(M_cv.stk_rate,1)) amt,
Decode(v_stk_cur,v_local_cur,0,sum(nvl(i_qty,0) * nvl(stk_cost,0))) amtf,
From Ias_Outgoing_Dtl Dout ,Ias_Post_Details Pst
Where Pst.Code_No=Decode(V_Item_Posting_Flag,1,Dout.i_code,2,Dout.w_code)
and Dout.Out_ser = M_cv.doc_ser
Group by Pst.Post_Code,Decode(v_outgoing_cs_type,2,Dout.cc_code,Null),
Loop --(6)
p_amt=> -(D_cv_g.amt) ,
p_amt_f=> -(D_cv_g.amtf),
End Loop; --(6)
End If ;--( End Chk Exist )
Update Ias_Outgoing_Mst Set O
ut_post=1,
Where Out_ser=M_cv.doc_ser;
Raise_application_error(-20647,'Outgoing, '||Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Msg(V_Lang_No,1123)||SqlErrm) ;
Raise_application_error(-20648,'Outgoing, '||Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Msg(V_Lang_No,1123)||SqlErrm) ;
P_PJ_NO => Nvl(V_PJ_NO,M_Cv.Pj_No) ,
P_ACTV_NO => Nvl(V_Actv_NO,M_Cv.Actv_No),
End Post_Outgoing;

Procedure Post_Stk_Adjst ( P_f_doc_no In NUMBER Default Null
( Select 10 doc_type
,Mskj.doc_no doc_no
,Mskj.adjust_type jv_type
,Mskj.doc_date doc_date
,Mskj.stk_desc
,Mskj.a_code a_code
,Mskj.V_Code V_Code
,Null Ac_Dtl_Typ
,Mskj.V_Code
Ac_Code_Dtl
,Mskj.a_cy a_cy
,Mskj.stk_acc_rate ac_rate
,Mskj.cc_code cc_code
,Mskj.pj_no pj_no
,Mskj.Actv_No Actv_No
,Mskj.Doc_Brn_No Doc_Brn_No
,Mskj.ref_no ref_no
,Mskj.doc_ser doc_ser
,Mskj.ad_u_id ad_u_id
,Mskj.Brn_no Brn_no
,Mskj.Brn_Year Brn_Year
,Mskj.CMP_NO
,Mskj.BRN_USR
_Cnt
From STK_ADJUSTMENT Mskj
Where nvl(Mskj.stk_post,0)=Decode(Nvl(P_Post_Type,0),0,0,nvl(Mskj.stk_post,0))
and nvl(Mskj.Audit_ref,0) = Decode(v_Use_Audit_Doc,1,1,nvl(Mskj.Audit_ref,0))
and nvl(Mskj.HUNG,0)=0
and Mskj.adjust_type = Decode(nvl(P_jv_type,0),0, Mskj.adjust_type,P_jv_type)
and Mskj.doc_no between nvl(P_f_doc_no,Mskj.doc_no) and nvl(P_t_doc_no,Mskj.doc_no)
and Mskj.doc_date between nvl(P_f_doc_date,Mskj.doc_date) and nvl(P_t_doc_date,Mskj.doc_date)
and Mskj.doc_ser = nvl(P_doc_ser, Mskj.doc_ser)
And Mskj.Brn_No = nvl(P_Brn_No, Mskj.Brn_No)
and Mskj.ad_u_id = nvl(P_ad_u_id, Mskj.ad_u_id)
And S_Brn_Usr_Priv.Brn_No = Mskj.Brn_No
P_Pos
t_Type
p_cc_code=> M_cv.cc_code,
p_pj_no=> M_cv.pj_no,
p_Actv_No=> M_cv.Actv_No,
For D_cv_g In
( Select Decode(M_cv.jv_type,1,Sum(nvl(PLS_MINS,0) * nvl(wtavg,0) ), Sum((nvl(avl_qty,0)*nvl(pls_mins,0))-(nvl(avl_qty,0)*nvl(wtavg,0))) ) amt,
Decode(v_local_cur,v_stk_cur,0,Decode(M_cv.jv_type,1,Sum(PLS_MINS * nvl(wtavg,0) ) ,Sum((nvl(avl_qty,0)*nvl(pls_mins,0))-(nvl(avl_qty,0)*nvl(wtavg,0))))) amtf,
Pst.Post_Code Post_Code,Sign(nvl(pls_mins,0)-nvl(wtavg,0)),
Decode(v_StkAdj_Cs_Type,2,Dskj.cc_code,Null) cc_code ,
Decode(V_Stk_Pj_Type,2,Dskj.Pj_No,Null) Pj_No ,
Decode(V_Stk_Actv_Type,2,Dskj.Actv_No,Null) Actv_No ,
Dskj.Brn_No

Procedure Post_Purchase( P_f_doc_no In NUMBER Default Null
,P_pur_type In NUMBER Default Null
( Select Mb.bill_no doc_no,
Mb.bill_ser doc_ser,
Mb.pur_type pur_type
From Ias_PI_BIll_Mst Mb
Where nvl(Mb.Audit_ref,0) = Decode(v_Use_Audit_Doc,1,1,nvl(Mb.Audit_ref,0))
and nvl(Mb.Hung,0)=0
and Mb.pur_type = Decode(nvl(P_pur_type,0),0,Mb.pur_type,P_pur_type)
and Mb.bill_doc_type = Decode(nvl(P_jv_type,0),0,Mb.bill_doc_type,P_jv_type)
and Mb.bill_no between nvl(P_f_doc_no,Mb.bill_no) and nvl(P_t_doc_no,Mb.bill_no)
and Mb.bill_date between nvl(P_f_doc_date,Mb.bill_date) and nvl(P_t_doc_date,Mb.bill_date)
and Mb.bill_ser = nvl(P_doc_ser, Mb.bill_ser)
And Mb.Brn_No = nvl(P_Brn_No, Mb.Brn_No)
and Mb.ad_u_id = nvl(P_ad_u_id, Mb.ad_u_id)
And S_Brn_Usr_Priv.Brn_No = Mb.Brn_No
If M_cv.pur_type = 1 Then --Local
Post_Local_Purchase(M_cv.doc_ser , P_Post_type,P_Brn_no);
Elsif M_cv.pur_type = 2 Then --Foriegn
Post_Foreign_Purchase(P_doc_ser =>M_cv.doc_ser,P_Post_type => P_Post_type,P_Brn_no=>P_Brn_no,P_G_Ser=>P_G_Ser);
Elsif M_cv.pur_type = 3 Then --Service
Select 1 Into V_Cnt From
(select bill_no,bill_ser,bill_currency,bill_rate from Ias_pi_bill_mst where Pur_type = 3 And bill_ser=M_cv.doc_ser
select bill_no,bill_ser,a_cy,ac_rate from Ias_pi_bill_jrnl where bill_ser=M_cv.doc_ser);
If Nvl(V_Cnt,0)> 0 Then
Raise_application_error(-20670,'pi bills, '||Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Msg(V_Lang_No,423)||SqlErrm) ;
Post_Service_Purchase(M_cv.doc_ser, P_Post_type,P_Brn_no);
End Post_Purchase;
Procedure Post_Local_Purchase ( P_doc_ser In NUMBER ,
P_Post_type In NUMBER Default 0,
P_Brn_no In NUMBER Default Null,
P_Ad_U_Id In NUMBER Default Null) Is
cnt NUMBER:=0;
v_bill_amtf NUMBER:=0;
v_disc_amt NUMBER:=0;
v_disc_amt_gp NUMBER:=0;
v_disc_amtf_gp NUMBER:=0;
v_bill_amt NUMBER:=0;
v_amtf NUMBER:=0;
--====================
============================================
( Select 6 doc_type
,Mb.bill_no doc_no
,Mb.pur_type pur_type
,Mb.bill_doc_type jv_type
,Mb.bill_date doc_date
,Mb.a_desc doc_desc
,Mb.cash_no cash_no
,Mb.Cash_Ac_Fcc Cash_Ac_Fcc
,Mb.Cash_No_Fcc Cash_No_Fcc
,Mb.a_code a_code
,Mb.Doc_Brn_No Doc_Brn_No
,Mb.bill_currency a_cy
,Mb.cc_code cc_code
,Mb.pj_no pj_no
,Mb.Actv_No Actv_No
,Mb.w_code w_code
,Mb.ref_no ref_no
,Mb.cheque_amt cheque_amt
,nvl(Mb.bill_amt,0) bill_amt
,Decode(Mb.bill_currency,v_local_cur,0,Mb.cheque_amt) cheque_amtf
,Decode(Mb.bill_doc_type,4,Mb.v_code) v_code
,Decode(Mb.bill_doc_type,4,Mb.Ac_Dtl_Typ ) Ac_Dtl_Typ
,Decode(Mb.bill_doc_type,4,Mb.Ac_Code_Dtl) Ac_Code_Dtl
,nvl(Mb.stock_rate,1) stk_rate
,nvl(Mb.bill_rate,1) ac_rate
,nvl(Mb.disc_amt,0) disc_amt
,nvl(Mb.Disc_Amt_Not_Effect,0) Disc_Amt_Not_Effect
,Decode(Mb.bill_currency,v_local_cur,0,Mb.Disc_Amt_Not_Effect) Disc_Amt_Not_Effect_f
,nvl(Mb.vat_amt,0) vat_amt
,Mb.bill_ser doc_ser
,Mb.ad_u_id ad_u_id
,Mb.Brn_no Brn_no
,Mb.Brn_Year Brn_Year
,Mb.CMP_NO CMP_NO
,Mb.BRN_USR BRN_USR
,Audit_Ref Audit_Ref
,Audit_Ref_U_Id Audit_Ref_U_Id
,Unpost_Date Unpost_Date
,BILL_DUE_DATE DOC_DUE_DATE
,pur_type INSTALL_TYPE
,srvc_bill srvc_bill
Where Mb.Pur_type = 1
and nvl(Mb.bill_post,0)=Decode(Nvl(P_Post_Type,0),0,0,nvl(Mb.bill_post,0))
and Mb.bill_ser = P_doc_ser
If Nvl(M_cv.Up_Cnt,0) >0 Then
Delete From Ias_Post_Mst Where Doc_Ser=M_cv.doc_ser;
If Nvl(IAS_Posting_Pkg.Chk_Exist_Pst_Doc(M_cv.doc_type,M_cv.doc_ser ) ,0) = 0 Then -- (Begin Chk Exist) --
IAS_Posting_Pkg.Set_Doc_Info ( P_Audit_Ref => M_cv.Audit_Ref ,
P_Audit_Ref_Desc => M_cv.Audit_Ref_Desc ,
P_Audit_Ref_U_Id => M_cv.Audit_Ref_U_Id ,
P_Unpost_Date => M_cv.Unpost_Date ,
P_Brn_No => M_cv.brn_no ,
P_Brn_Year => M_cv.brn_year ,
P_BRN_USR => M_cv.BRN_USR ,
P_Post_Type => P_Post_Type ,
P_DOC_DUE_DATE => M_cv.DOC_DUE_DATE ,
P_INSTALL_TYPE => M_cv.INSTALL_TYPE );
p_Doc_jv_type_ref=>M_cv.pur_type,
If v_pur_disc = 2 Then -- 1= Distribute , 2= Not Distribute, Post To Disc. Account
v_disc_amt:=M_cv.disc_amt;
v_disc_amt:=0;
-- ## Not Effect Discount
If V_DISC_AMT_NOT_EFFECT_AC Is Null and nvl(M_cv.Disc_Amt_Not_Effect,0) <> 0 Then
Raise_application_error(-20668,Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Msg(V_Lang_No,1094)||SqlErrm) ;
( Select Sum( (nvl(i_qty,0)+nvl(free_qty,0) ) * nvl(stk_cost,0)) amt,
Decode(v_stk_cur,v_local_cur,0,sum( (nvl(i_qty,0)+nvl(free_qty,0) ) * nvl(stk_cost,0))) amtf,
Sum( nvl(free_qty,0) * nvl(i_price,0) * ac_rate / stk_rate) free_cost_amt,
Decode(v_stk_cur,v_local_cur,0,sum(nvl(free_qty,0) * nvl(i_price,0) * ac_rate / stk_rate)) free_cost_amtf,
Sum(nvl(i_qty,0) * nvl(vat_amt,0)) vat_amt,
Decode(V_Ap_Cs_Type,2,Db.Cc_Code,Null) Cc_Code ,
Decode(V_Ap_Pj_Type,2,Db.Pj_No,Null) Pj_No ,
Decode(V_Ap_Actv_Type,2,Db.Actv_No,Null) Actv_No
From Gr_Detail Db,Ias_Post_Details Pst
Where Pst.Code_No=Decode(V_Item_Posting_Flag,1,Db.i_code,2,Db.w_code)
and Db.pi_type=2
and pi_no=M_cv.doc_no
Group by Pst.Post_Code,
Decode(V_Ap_Cs_Type,2,Db.Cc_Code,Null) ,
Decode(V_Ap_Pj_Type,2,Db.Pj_No,Null) ,
Decode(V_Ap_Actv_Type,2,Db.Actv_No,Null) )
If V_Ap_Cs_Type = 2 Then -- Multi Cc_Code
V_Cc_Code := D_Cv_G.Cc_Code ;
V_Cc_Code := M_Cv.Cc_Code ;
If V_Ap_Pj_Type = 2 Then -- M
ulti Pj_No
V_Pj_No := M_Cv.Pj_No ;
If V_Ap_Actv_Type = 2 Then -- Multi Actv_No
V_Actv_No := M_Cv.Actv_No ;
p_amt_f=> D_cv_g.amtf,
p_cc_code => V_Cc_Code ,
p_pj_no => V_Pj_No ,
p_Actv_No => V_Actv_No ,
P_G_Code => D_cv_g.Post_Code);
If v_pur_disc = 2 and nvl(v_disc_amt,0) <> 0 Then --(4)
Select Sum(nvl(dis_amt,0)*nvl(i_qty,0)),
Decode(M_cv.a_cy,v_local_cur,0,sum(nvl(dis_amt,0)*nvl(i_qty,0)))
Into v_disc_amt_gp ,v_disc_amtf_gp
From Ias_PI_BIll_Dtl pid,Ias_Post_Details Pst
Where Pst.Code_No=Decode(V_Item_Posting_Flag,1,pid.i_code,2,pid.w_code)
and Pst.Post_Code=D_cv_g.Post_Code
and bill_no=M_cv.doc_no
and bill_ser=M_cv.doc_ser
and Nvl(Pid.SERVICE_ITM,0)=0
and Nvl(Pid.Cc_Code,'0') = Nvl(V_Cc_Code,'0')
and Nvl(Pid.Pj_No,'0') = Nvl(V_Pj_No,'0')
and Nvl(Pid.Actv_No,'0') = Nvl(V_Actv_No,'0')
order by Pst.Post_Code;
v_disc_amt_gp:=0;
If nvl(v_disc_amt_gp,0) <> 0 Then --(5)
v_a_code:=Ias_Posting_Pkg.Get_G_A_code(D_cv_g.Post_Code,'G_DSC_PI_A_CODE'); -- Add New select In Get_a_Post_Code Proc.
v_doc_desc:= Ias_gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(v_lang_no,1793)||D_cv_g.Post_Code;
p_amt=> -(nvl(v_disc
_amt_gp,0) * M_cv.ac_rate),
p_amt_f=> -(v_disc_amtf_gp),
End If; --(5)
End If; --(4)
If v_pur_free_qty_cost =2 and nvl(D_cv_g.free_cost_amt,0) <> 0 Then --(6)
v_a_code:=Ias_Posting_Pkg.Get_G_A_code(D_cv_g.Post_Code,'G_CST_FREE_PI_A_CODE'); -- Add New select In Get_a_Post_Code Proc.
If v_a_code is null then
Raise_application_error(-20604,Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Msg(V_Lang_No,943)||' = '||D_cv_g.Post_Code) ;
v_doc_desc:= Ias_gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(v_lang_no,1867)||D_cv_g.Post_Code;
p_amt=> -(nvl(D_cv_g.free_cost_amt,0) * M_cv.stk_rate),
p_amt_f=> -(nvl(D_cv_g.free_cost_amtf,0)),
End If; --(6)
If v_use_vat = 1 and nvl(D_cv_g.vat_amt,0) <> 0 Then --(12)
v_doc_desc:= Ias_gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(v_lang_no,647)||M_cv.doc_no;
p_a_
code=> v_vat_ac,
p_amt=> nvl(D_cv_g.vat_amt ,0)* M_cv.ac_rate,
p_cb_before=> V_curr_bal,
End If;--(12)
--## Group Account From Purchase Service Items
For D_cv_g_srv In
( Select Sum( nvl(i_qty,0) * nvl(stk_cost,0)) amt,
--Sum( nvl(free_qty,0) * nvl(i_price,0) * ac_rate / stk_rate) free_cost_amt,
--Decode(v_stk_cur,v_local_cur,0,sum(nvl(free_qty,0) * nvl(i_price,0) * ac_rate / stk_rate)) free_cost_amtf,
Sum(nvl(i_qty,0) * nvl(db.vat_amt,0)) vat_amt,
Decode(V_Ap_Actv_Type,2,Db.Actv_No,Null) Actv_No ,
Mst.Srvc_Bill
From IAS_PI_BILL_DTL Db,Ias_Post_Details Pst,ias_pi_bill_mst Mst
and Db.PUR_TYPE=1
and Mst.bill_ser=db.bill_ser
and Nvl(Db.SERVICE_ITM,0)=1
and db.bill_no=M_cv.doc_no
and db.bill_ser=M_cv.doc_ser
Group by Pst.Post_Code,Mst.Srvc_Bill,
V_Cc_Code := D_cv_g_srv.Cc_Code ;
If V_Ap_Pj_Type = 2 Then -- Multi Pj_No
V_Pj_No := D_cv_g_srv.Pj_No ;

Procedure Post_Foreign_Purchase ( P_doc_ser In NUMBER,
P_Ad_U_Id In NUMBER Default Null,
P_pur_type
In Number Default Null ) Is
v_stk_rate_gn NUMBER;
v_ac_rate_gn NUMBER;
v_lc_ac VarChar2(30);
v_vat_amt NUMBER:=0;
--v_disc_amt_gp Number:=0;
--v_disc_amtf_gp Number:=0;
v_ac_amtf NUMBER:=0;
v_gramt NUMBER:=0;
v_diff_amt NUMBER:=0;
v_lc_rate NUMBER:=0;
v_gr_ser NUMBER:=0;
,Gr.Gr_Date doc_date
,Mb.Actv_No Actv_no
,Decode(Mb.bill_doc_type,4,Mb.Ac_Dtl_Typ) Ac_Dtl_Typ
,Mb.Audit_Ref Audit_Ref
,Mb.Audit_Ref_Desc Audit_Ref_Desc
,Mb.Audit_Ref_U_Id Audit_Ref_U_Id
,Mb.Audit_Ref_Date Audit_Ref_Date
,Mb.Ad_Date Ad_Date
,Mb.Up_U_Id Up_U_Id
,Mb.Up_Date Up_Date
,Mb.Up_Cnt Up_Cnt
,Mb.Unpost_U_Id Unpost_U_Id
,Mb.Unpost_Date Unpost_Date
,Mb.BILL_DUE_DATE DOC_DUE_DATE
,Mb.pur_type INSTALL_TYPE
From Ias_PI_BIll_Mst Mb,GR_NOTE Gr
Where nvl(Mb.
Pur_type,2) = 2
AND Mb.bill_ser=GR.DOC_SER
AND Gr.pi_type=2
and nvl(GR.Gr_Post,0)=Decode(Nvl(P_Post_Type,0),0,0,nvl(GR.Gr_Post,0))
And Gr.G_Ser=Nvl(P_G_Ser,Gr.G_Ser)
And Gr.C_Flag=1
And Mb.Brn_No = Nvl(P_Brn_No, Mb.Brn_No)
And Mb.Ad_U_Id = Nvl(P_Ad_U_Id, Mb.Ad_U_Id)
If Nvl(IAS_Posting_Pkg.Chk_Exist_Pst_Doc(P_DOC_TYPE=>M_cv.doc_type,P_DOC_SER=>M_cv.doc_ser ,P_Doc_Ser_Ref=>P_G_Ser ) ,0) = 0 Then -- (Begin Chk Exist) --
P_Audit_Ref => M_cv.Audit_Ref ,
P_Doc_Ser_Ref => P_G_Ser ,
P_INSTALL_TYPE => M_cv.INSTALL_TYPE
P_Actv_No=> M_cv.Actv_No,
p_ad_u_id=> M_cv.ad_u_id,
For Gn_cv in
( Select gr_no,g_ser From gr_note
where pi_type=2
and c_flag=1
and g_ser
=nvl(P_G_Ser,g_ser)
order by gr_no)
Select nvl(ac_rate,1),nvl(stk_rate,1)
Into v_ac_rate_gn,v_stk_rate_gn
Where pi_type=2
and g_ser=Gn_cv.g_ser
and gr_no=Gn_cv.gr_no
and c_flag=1;
Raise_application_error(-20671,'Error When Select Stk_Rate From Gr_Note ='||SqlErrm) ;
If v_gr_ser = 0 Or v_gr_ser Is null Then
v_gr_ser:=Gn_cv.g_ser;
Sum(nvl(grd.dis_amt,0)*nvl(i_qty,0)) disc_amt_gr ,
Decode(M_cv.a_cy,v_local_cur,0,sum(nvl(grd.dis_amt,0)*nvl(i_qty,0))) disc_amtf_gr,
From gr_detail Grd,Ias_Post_Details Pst
Where Pst.Code_No=Decode(V_Item_Posting_Flag,1,Grd.i_code,2,Grd.w_code)
and Grd.pi_type=2
and Grd.gr_no=Gn_cv.gr_no
and Grd.g_ser=Gn_cv.g_ser
and Grd.pi_no=M_cv.doc_no
and Grd.doc_ser=M_cv.doc_ser
p_amt=> D_cv_g.amt * v_stk_rate_gn,
p_w_code=> M_cv.w_code
P_Doc_No_Ref =>Gn_Cv.Gr_No,
P_Doc_Ser_Ref =>Gn_Cv.G_Ser,
P_G_CODE =>D_cv_g.Post_Code);
If v_pur_disc = 2 and nvl( M_cv.disc_amt,0) <> 0 and nvl(v_gr_ser,0) = Gn_cv.g_ser Then --(4)
If D_cv_g.disc_amt_gr <> 0 Then --(5)
p_amt=> -(nvl(D_cv_g.disc_amt_gr,0) * M_cv.ac_rate),
p_amt_f=> -(D_cv_g.disc_amtf_gr),
p_amt=> -(nvl(D_cv_g.free_cost_amt,0) * v_stk_rate_gn),
End if; --(6)
If nvl(M_cv.pur_type,2) = 2 Then --(7) --For Foregin Purchase
--## Post vat ===================================
If v_use_vat = 1 Then --(15)
Raise_application_er
ror(-20672,Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Msg(V_Lang_No,1125)||', '||SqlErrm) ;
Select sum(nvl(((nvl(vat_per,0)*nvl(i_qty,0)*nvl(i_price,0))/100),0))
Into v_vat_amt
and doc_ser=M_cv.doc_ser ;
v_vat_amt:=0;
If nvl(v_vat_amt,0) > 0 Then --(16)
p_amt=> nvl(v_vat_amt,0) * v_ac_rate_gn,
P_Doc_Ser_Ref =>Gn_Cv.G_Ser);
End If;--(16)
End If;--(15)
End If;--(7)
--End Loop; --(2)
If nvl(M_cv.pur_type,2) = 2 Then --(20) --For Foregin Purchase
For Lc_cv in
(Select gr_no,g_ser,lc_no,lc_desc doc_desc From Cost_Master
where pi_no=M_cv.doc_no
Loop --(8)
Select lc_ac
Into v_lc_ac
From lc_master
where lc_no=lc_cv.lc_no;
raise_application_error(-20673,'Error When select lc_ac ='||SqlErrm) ;

p_a_code=> v_lc_ac,

p_cb_before=> v_curr
_bal,
For Cd_cv In

cost_dist_type

P_Ac

End If; --(11)

v_diff_amt:=0;
Select Count(1)
From gr_note
and pending=0 --peinding=0 no pending all cleared
and nvl(c_flag,0)=1;
If cnt > 0 Then ---nothing is pending All Items Received
Select nvl( Sum(nvl(i_qty
,0) * nvl(i_price,0)),0)
Into v_gramt
and gr_detail.pi_no=M_cv.doc_no
and gr_detail.doc_ser=M_cv.doc_ser ;
v_gramt:=0;
If v_pur_disc = 2 Then
Select sum(nvl(i_qty,0)*nvl(i_price,0))
Into v_bill_amt
From Ias_PI_Bill_Dtl
Where bill_no=M_cv.doc_no
ElsIf v_pur_disc=1 Then
Select sum(nvl(i_qty,0)*(nvl(i_price,0)-nvl(dis_amt,0)))
raise_application_error(-20674,'Error When select bill amt. ='||SqlErrm) ;
If nvl(v_bill_amt,0) - nvl(v_gramt,0) <> 0 Then
If v_loss_ofg_ac Is Null Then
Raise_Application_Error(-20674,'Error When select Loss Of good Account From Interface Account ='||SqlErrm) ;
v_diff_amt :=nvl(v_bill_amt,0) - nvl(v_gramt,0);
v_curr_bal:=IAS_Posting_Pkg.Check_Acode (v_loss_ofg_ac,v_stk_cur);
If v_stk_cur<>v_local_cur Then
Select distinct nvl(ex_rate,1)
Into v_lc_rate
Where cost_dist_type=9
Select Avg(nvl(ex_rate,1))
v_lc_rate:=1;
v_amtf:=(nvl(v_diff_amt,0)*nvl(v_lc_rate,1))/nvl(v_stk_rate_gn,1);
v_doc_desc:= Ias_gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(v_lang_no,1870)||M_cv.doc_no;
p_a_code=> v_loss_ofg_ac,
p_amt=> nvl(v_diff_amt,0) * nvl(v_ac_rate_gn,1),
p_amt_f=> v_amtf,
p_j_desc=>M_cv.do
c_desc,
p_Lc_no=> Null,
--======== End loss Of Good
End If; --(20) --For Foregin Purchase
--End Loop;
End If ; --(Chk Exist)
If M_cv.doc_type =6 Then -- Update In Post Purchase Foreign Package
Update Cost_Master
Set Hung = 0
Where Pur_type = 2
Raise_application_error(-20676,'pi_bills, '||Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Msg(V_Lang_No,1123)||SqlErrm) ;
Raise_application_error(-20677,'pi_bills, '||Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Msg(V_Lang_No,1123)||SqlErrm) ;
and g_ser=nvl(p_g_ser,g_ser);
Raise_application_error(-20677,'gr_note, '||Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Msg(V_Lang_No,1123)||SqlErrm) ;
P_doc_ser_ref=>P_G_Ser,
P_Post_Type => P_Post_
P_Brn_Year => M_cv.Brn_Year ,
End Post_Foreign_Purchase;
,P_Post_type In NUMBER Default 0 ) Is
--=================================================================================
For M_Cv In
16 Doc_Type

P_DOC_TYPE_REF => M_cv.P_DOC_TYPE_REF ,

Else -- (2) By Item --
(Select Round(sum(nvl(Avl_QTY,0) ),4) Avl_Qty,

Round(Decode(M_cv.a_cy,v_local_cur,0,sum(nvl(ADD_DIS_QTY,0) * nvl(ADD_DIS_AMT_DTL,0))- sum(nvl(Avl_QTY,0) * nvl(ADD_DIS_AMT_DTL,0))),4) Out_Amtf,
--Round(sum(nvl(ADD_DIS_QTY,0) * nvl(ADD_DIS_AMT_DTL,0)),4) add_disc_amt,
--Round(Decode(M_cv.a_cy,v_local_cur,0,sum(nvl(ADD_DIS_QTY,0) * nvl(ADD_DIS_AMT_DTL,0))),4) add_disc_amtf,
C.Post_Code ,
Decode(V_Ap_Cs_Type,2,D.Cc_Code,Null) Cc_Code ,

cv.ac_rate),

p_j_desc => v_doc_desc ,
P_Actv_No => V_Actv_No ,
p_ref_no => M_cv.ref_no );
End If; --(5) --
If nvl(D_cv.ADD_DIS_QTY,0) > nvl(D_cv.Avl_Qty,0) Then --(6) --
v_a_code:=Ias_Posting_Pkg.Get_g_a_code(D_cv.Post_Code,'G_DSC_PI_A_CODE');

v_doc_desc:=Ias_gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(v_lang_no,3440)||' '|| Ias_gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(v_lang_no,1793)||D_cv.Post_Code;
p_amt => -(nvl(D_cv.Out_amt,0) * M_cv.ac_rate),
p_amt_f => -nvl(D_cv.Out_amtf,0) ,
p_amt => -(nvl(D_cv.Disc_Avl_Amt,0) * M_cv.ac_rate),
p_amt_f => -nvl(D_cv.Disc_Avl_amtf,0) ,
p_w_code => M_cv.w_
code ,
End If; --(6) --
If V_Ap_Cs_Type = 2 Then -- Single cc_code
--## (Credit side) V_code

V_A_Code := M_Cv.A_Code_Intrm_Disc_Pi ;

V_Ac_Dtl_Typ := Null ;
V_Ac_Code_Dtl := Null ;
ELse
V_A_Code := M_Cv.A_Code ;

V_Ac_Code_Dtl := M_Cv.Ac_Code_Dtl ;

p_a_code => V_A_Code ,
p_amt => (nvl(M_cv.add_disc_amt,0) * M_cv.ac_rate),
p_amt_f => (nvl(M_cv.add_disc_amtf,0)) ,
p_j_desc => M_cv.doc_desc ,
p_v_code => V_V_Code ,
P_Ac_Dtl_Typ => V_Ac_Dtl_Typ ,
P_Ac_Code_Dtl => V_Ac_Code_Dtl ,
End Loop;--(3) --
End If;--(2) --
If (M_cv.jv_type = 1 and V_AP_Cs_Type = 2) Or V_Ap_Cs_Type In (0,1) Then -- (Disc by Sales Invoice + Multi cc_code) Or Single cc_code
--## (Debit side) V_code
End If ;-- ( chk exist )
Update IAS_PI_BILL_MST_ADD_DISC Set doc_post=1,
Where doc_ser=M_cv.doc_ser;
Raise_application_error(-20659,'Error When Update Post Flag ='||SqlErrm) ;
Raise_application_error(-20660,'Error Not Update Post Flag ='||SqlErrm) ;

Ias_Posting_Pkg.Update_IntrM_Tab ( P_doc_type => M_cv.doc_type ,

Procedure Post_Purchase_Return ( P_f_doc_no In NUMBER Default Null
( Select 7 doc_type
,Mpri.rt_bill_no doc_no
,Mpri.rt_bill_doc_type jv_type
,Mpri.rt_bill_date doc_date
,Mpri.a_desc doc_desc
,Mpri.a_code a_code
,Mpri.cash_no cash_no
,Mpri.Doc_Brn_No Doc_Brn_No
,Mpri.rt_bill_currency a_cy
,nvl(Mpri.stock_rate,1) stk_rate
,nvl(Mpri.rt_bill_rate,1) ac_rate
,nvl(Mpri.bill_amt,0) amt
,Decode(v_local_cur,Mpri.rt_bill_currency,0,nvl(Mpri.bill_amt,0)) amtf
,nvl(Mpri.disc_amt,0) disc_amt
,Decode(v_local_cur,Mpri.rt_bill_currency,0,nvl(Mpri.disc_amt,0)) Disc_amtf
,nvl(Mpri.Disc_Amt_Not_Effect,0) Disc_Amt_Not_Effect
,Decode(v_local_cur,Mpri.rt_bill_currency,0,Mpri.Disc_Amt_Not_Effect) Disc_Amt_Not_Effect_f
,Mpri.Cc_Code Cc_Code
,Mpri.Pj_No Pj_No
,Mpri.Actv_No Actv_No
,Mpri.w_code w_code
,Mpri.ref_no ref_no
,Mpri.diff_a
c_code
,Mpri.c_code c_code
,Mpri.Ac_Dtl_Typ Ac_Dtl_Typ
,Mpri.Ac_Code_Dtl Ac_Code_Dtl
,Decode(Mpri.RT_BILL_DOC_TYPE,4,Mpri.v_code) v_code
,Mpri.rt_bill_ser doc_ser
,Mpri.ad_u_id ad_u_id
,Mpri.Brn_no Brn_no
,Mpri.Brn_Year Brn_Year
,Mpri.CMP_NO CMP_NO
,Mpri.BRN_USR BRN_USR
,RT_BILL_DUE_DATE DOC_DUE_DATE
,PR_PRICE_TYPE INSTALL_TYPE
From Ias_Pr_Bill_Mst Mpri
Where nvl(Mpri.rt_bill_post,0)=Decode(Nvl(P_Post_Type,0),0,0,nvl(Mpri.rt_bill_post,0))
and nvl(Mpri.Audit_ref,0) = Decode(v_Use_Audit_Doc,1,1,nvl(Mpri.Audit_ref,0))
and nvl(Mpri.Hung,0)=0
and Mpri.rt_bill_doc_type = Decode(nvl(P_jv_type,0),0,Mpri.rt_bill_doc_type,P_jv_type)
and Mpri.rt_bill_no between nvl(P_f_doc_no,Mpri.rt_bill_no) and nvl(P_t_doc_no,Mpri.rt_bill_no)
and Mpri.rt_bill_date between nvl(P_f_doc_date,Mpri.rt_bill_date) and nvl(P_t_doc_date,Mpri.rt_bill_date)
and Mpri.rt_bill_ser = nvl(P_doc_ser, Mpri.rt_bill_ser)
And Mpri.Brn_No = nvl(P_Brn_No, Mpri.Brn_No)
and Mpri.ad_u_id = nvl(P_ad_u_id, Mpri.ad_u_id)
And S_Brn_Usr_Priv.Brn_No = Mpri.Brn_No
-- PR_PRICE_TYPE ==> 1 = By Vendor Price , 2- By after final Cost
p_cc_code=> M_Cv.Cc_Code,
p_pj_no=> M_Cv.Pj_No,
p_Actv_No=> M_Cv.Actv_No,
--## Dr. amount (a_cod)
( Select Sum(nvl(i_qty ,0) * (nvl(i_price,0)- nvl(dis_amt,0)+ nvl(Dis_Amt_Not_Effect,0))* M_cv.ac_rate) amt,
Decode(M_cv.a_cy,v_local_cur,0,Sum( nvl(i_qty ,0) * (nvl(i_price,0)- nvl(dis_amt,0)+ nvl(Dis_Amt_Not_Effect,0)))) amtf,
Decode(M_cv.a_cy,v_local_cur,0,Sum(nvl(i_qty,0) * nvl(vat_amt,0))) vat_amtf,
Sum(nvl(i_qty,0) * nvl(othr_amt,0)) Othr_amt,
Decode(M_cv.a_cy,v_local_cur,0,Sum(nvl(i_qty,0) * nvl(Othr_amt,0))) othr_amtf,
Sum( nvl(i_qty ,0) * nvl(Dis_Amt_Not_Effect,0)* M_cv.ac_rate) Dis_Amt_Not_Effect,
Decode(M_cv.a_cy,v_local_cur,0,Sum( nvl(i_qty ,0) * nvl(Dis_Amt_Not_Effect,0))) Dis_Amt_Not_Effectf,
Decode(V_Ap_Cs_Type,2,Cc_Code,Null) Cc_Code ,
Decode(V_Ap_Pj_Type,2,Pj_No,Null) Pj_No ,
Decode(V_Ap_Actv_Type,2,Actv_No,Null) Actv_No
Where rt_bill_ser=M_cv.doc_ser
Group By Decode(V_Ap_Cs_Type,2,Cc_Code,Null),
Decode(V_Ap_Pj_Type,2,Pj_No,Null) ,
Decode(V_Ap_Actv_Type,2,Actv_No,Null))
p_cash_no=> M_cv.cash_no ,
p_amt=> D_cv.amt+ ((D_cv.vat_amt+Nvl(D_cv.othr_amt,0))*M_cv.ac_rate),
p_amt_f=> D_cv.amtf+ D_cv.vat_amtf ,
p_cc_code=> V_Cc_Code,
If V_DISC_AMT_NOT_EFFECT_AC Is Null and nvl(D_cv.Dis_Amt_Not_Effect,0) <> 0 Then
If V_DISC_AMT_NOT_EFFECT_AC Is Not Null and nvl(D_cv.Dis_Amt_Not_Effect,0) <> 0 Then --()
v_curr_bal:=IAS_Posting_Pkg.Check_A
code (V_DISC_AMT_NOT_EFFECT_AC,M_cv.a_cy);
p_amt=> - (nvl(D_cv.Dis_Amt_Not_Effect,0)) ,
p_amt_f=> -(nvl(D_cv.Dis_Amt_Not_Effectf,0)),
p_Doc_jv_type_ref=>M_cv.Install_type);
If v_use_vat = 1 and nvl(D_cv.vat_amt,0) <> 0 Then -- Vat Amount
p_amt=> -(nvl(D_cv.vat_amt ,0)* M_cv.ac_rate),
--## Othr_charges
(b.Chrg_name ||Ias_gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(v_lang_no,1792)
||M_cv.doc_no) doc_desc,
Sum(a.amt/M_cv.amt * (nvl(i_price,0)*nvl(i_qty,0))) Othr_amt,
Decode(a.a_cy,V_local_cur,0,Sum(a.amt/M_cv.amt * (nvl(i_price,0)*nvl(i_qty,0)))) Othr_amtf
From Ias_Ap_Othr_Charges a,Ias_AP_charges b,ias_Pr_bill_dtl c
and a.bill_ser=c.rt_bill_ser
And a.bill_type=3
p_amt=>-(Chrg_cv.Othr_amt * Chrg_cv.ac_rate),
p_amt_f=>-(nvl(Chrg_cv.Othr_amtf,0)),
( Select Sum((nvl(i_qty ,0)+nvl(free_qty ,0)) * nvl(stk_cost,0) ) amt,
Sum( nvl(i_qty ,0) * nvl(i_price,0) ) prc_amt,
Sum( nvl(free_qty ,0) * nvl(stk_cost,0) ) cost_Freeqty_amt,
Decode(v_local_cur,v_stk_cur,0,Sum( nvl(free_qty ,0) * nvl(stk_cost,0))) cost_Freeqty_amtf,
(Sum( (nvl(i_qty ,0) * nvl(stk_cost,0) ) *M_cv.stk_rate)/M_cv.ac_rate) stk_amt_bill_cur,
(Sum( ((nvl(i_qty ,0) ) * nvl(stk_cost,0) ) *M_cv.stk_rate)/M_cv.ac_rate) - (Sum( nvl(i_qty ,0) * nvl(i_price,0)) -decode(v_pur_disc,1,sum(nvl(i_qty,0) * nvl(dis_amt,0)) ,0)) Diff_amt,
((((Sum( ((nvl(i_qty ,0)+Decode(v_pur_free_qty_cost,1,nvl(free_qty ,0),0)) * nvl(stk_cost,0) ) *M_cv.stk_rate)/M_cv.ac_rate) - (Sum( nvl(i_qty ,0) * nvl(i_price,0))-decode(v_pur_disc,1,sum(nvl(i_qty,0) * nvl(dis_amt,0)) ,0) ) ) * M_cv.ac_rate)/M_cv.stk_rate) Diff_amt_stk,
Decode(v_stk_cur,v_local_cur,0,(((Sum( (((nvl(i_qty ,0)+Decode(v_pur_free_qty_cost,1,nvl(free_qty ,0),0)) * nvl(stk_cost,0) ) *M_cv.stk_rate)/M_cv.ac_rate) - (Sum( nvl(i_qty ,0) * nvl(i_price,0))-decode(v_pur_disc,1,sum(nvl(i_qty,0) * nvl(dis_amt,0)) ,0) ) ) * M_cv.ac_rate)/M_cv.stk_rate)) Diff_amtf_stk,
Decode(v_stk_cur,v_local_cur,0,sum( nvl(i_qty ,0) * nvl(stk_cost,0) )) amtf,
sum(nvl(i_qty,0) * nvl(dis_amt,0)) disc_amt_gcode,

FUNCTION GET_ACODE_DIFF(P_A_CODE VARCHAR2,P_BRN_NO NUMBER ) RETURN VARCHAR2 Is
V_A_Code_Diff account.a_code%type;
V_Diff_Type Number:=0;
Select nvl(Curr_Type,2) Into V_Diff_Type
If V_Diff_Type=2 Then
Select Curdif_Code Into V_A_Code_Diff
From Account
Where A_Code=P_A_Code
Select Curr_Diff Into V_A_Code_Diff
Where Brn_no=P_Brn_no
Return V_A_Code_Diff;
End Get_Acode_Diff;
P_BRN_USR In NUMBER) Is
v_doc_desc VARCHAR2(250);
v_Curr_bal NUMBER;
v_Brn_No NUMBER(6);
V_Amt_New NUMBER;
Cursor c1 Is Select D.a_code,
D.a_cy,
D.AC_RATE,
D.lc_no,
D.Cmp_No,
D.cc_code cc_code,
D.Pj_No Pj_No,
D.Actv_No Actv_No,
Sum(nvl(j_amt,0)) j_amt,
Sum(nvl(j_amt_f,0)) j_amt_f ,
From Master_Journal_V M , Detail_Journal_V D
Where M.j_doc_no=D.j_doc_no
and M.jv_type=D.jv_type
and M.j_ser=D.j_ser
and M.j_DATE between P_F_DATE and P_T_DATE
and nvl(M.revrs_jrnl,0)=1
group by D.a_code,D.a_cy,D.lc_no,
D.Brn_No,D.Cmp_No,D.cc_code ,D.Pj_No ,D.Actv_No,AC_CODE_DTL,
AC_DTL_TYP, D.AC_RATE;
CSHNO NUMBER(30);
CCODE VARCHAR2(30);
VCODE VARCHAR2(30);
For i in c1 Loop --Main Loop
If nvl(i.j_amt,0)<> 0 Then
If nvl(v_Brn_No,0) <> nvl(i.Brn_No,0) Then -- There Will be Only One Master Record For Revers Journal For Each Period and Brn_no

If Ys_Gen_Pkg.Get_Cur_Rate(I.A_Cy)<>I.Ac_Rate And Ys_Gen_Pkg.Get_Local_Cur<>I.a_cy Then
V_Amt_New:=i.j_amt_f*Ys_Gen_Pkg.Get_Cur_Rate(i.a_cy);
V_Amt_New:=i.j_amt;
IF I.AC_DTL_TYP IN(1,2) THEN

VCODE:=NULL;
ELSIF I.AC_DTL_TYP=3 THEN

Into ch_co

where a_code=D_cv.a_code
and Rownum<=1;

If ch_co > 0 Then --(3)

Procedure Upd_Prim_Wtavg( p_cst_type In NUMBER ,
p_wtavg_type In NUMBER ) Is
If p_cst_type = 2 And p_wtavg_type = 1 Then -- Wtavg & By Item
Update Ias_v_ny_Ias_Itm_Mst a
Set i_cwtavg = ( Select Nvl(i_cwtavg,0)
Where I_Code = A.I_Code )
Where Exists( Select 1 From Ias_Itm_Mst
Where Ias_Itm_Mst.I_Code = A.I_Code
And RowNum <=1 ) ;
Raise_Application_Error(-20534,'Error When Update ias_v_ny_Ias_Itm_Mst From Ias_Itm_Mst '||SqlErrm);
ElsIf p_cst_type = 2 And p_wtavg_type In (2,3) Then -- Wtavg & By Item + Wcode
Update ias_v_ny_ias_itm_wcode a
From ias_itm_wcode
Where i_code = a.I_code
And w_code = a.w_code
And Itm_Unt=a.Itm_Unt)
Where Ias_Itm_Mst.i_code = a.i_code
If p_cst_type = 2 Then --wt_avg
If p_wtavg_type = 1 Then
Update ias_v_ny_Ias_Itm_Mst
Set primary_cost = Nvl(i_cwtavg,0) ;
Raise_Application_Error(-20536,'Error When Update primary cost to equal i_cwtavg '||SqlErrm);
ElsIf p_wtavg_type In (2,3) Then
Update ias_v_ny_ias_itm_wcode
Set primary_cost = Nvl(i_cwtavg,0)* Nvl(p_size,1);
Raise_Application_Error(-20535,'Error When Update primary cost In ias_v_ny_ias_itm_wcode View '||SqlErrm);
Else --fifo,lifo
--##-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------##--
--## Update Cost To Items Not Have Any Avl_Qty
Update Ias_V_Ny_Ias_Itm_Wcode
Set Primary_Cost= Last_Incoming_Price ( P_Wtavg_Type ,
Where P_Size = 1
And Exists (Select 1 From Ias_Itm_Wcode
Where Ias_Itm_Wcode.I_Code = Ias_V_Ny_Ias_Itm_Wcode.I_Code
And Ias_Itm_Wcode.W_Code = Ias_V_Ny_Ias_Itm_Wcode.W_Code
And Nvl(Avl_Qty,0) = 0
Raise_Application_Error(-20539,'Error When Update Primary Cost To Equal Last_Incoming_Price '||Chr(13)||SqlErrm);
Update Ias_V_Ny_Ias_Itm_Mst
Where Exists (Select 1 From Ias_Itm_Wcode
Where Ias_Itm_Wcode.I_Code = Ias_V_Ny_Ias_Itm_Mst.I_Code
And RowNum <= 1
Group By Ias_Itm_Wcode.I_Code
Having Nvl(Sum(Avl_Qty),0) = 0 ) ;
Set primary_cost=(Select (Sum((cp_qty/p_size)*stk_cost)/Sum(cp_qty))
Where gr_detail.I_Code = ias_v_ny_ias_itm_wcode.I_Code
And gr_detail.W_Code = ias_v_n
y_ias_itm_wcode.W_Code
And cp_qty<>0 ) ;
Raise_Application_Error(-20537,'Error When Update primary cost to equal i_cwtavg '||SqlErrm);
Update ias_v_ny_ias_itm_wcode Set primary_cost = nvl(primary_cost,0) * nvl(P_size,1);
Raise_Application_Error(-20535,'Error When Update ias_v_ny_Ias_Itm_Mst From Ias_Itm_Mst '||SqlErrm);
If (p_cst_type = 2 And p_wtavg_type In (2,3) ) Then -- wtavg & By Item + Wcode
UPDATE ias_v_ny_ias_open_stock a
Set stk_cost = ( Select Nvl(primary_cost,0)
From ias_v_ny_ias_itm_wcode
Where i_code = a.i_code
And Itm_Unt=a.Itm_Unt);
Raise_Application_Error(-20538,'Error When Update stk_cost In ias_v_ny_ias_open_stock '||SqlErrm);
ElsIf p_cst_type = 2 And p_wtavg_type = 1 Then
From Ias_v_ny_Ias_Itm_Mst
Where i_code = a.i_code ) ;
End Upd_Prim_Wtavg;

Select 3 doc_type,D.v_code,D.a_cy, D.voucher_no doc_no,
and D.v_code=C.v_code
and nvl(M.Move_Cheq_Py,0)= 0
group by 3 ,D.v_code,D.a_cy,D.voucher_no,D.voucher_pay_type ,M.v_ser,D.cc_code
Select doc_type,v_code,a_cy,doc_no,jv_type ,doc_ser,nvl(sum(dr_amt),0),cc_code

If P_DocType = 6 Or P_DocType Is Null Then
Select 6 doc_type,v_code,bill_currency a_cy,bill_no doc_no,bill_doc_type jv_type ,bill_ser doc_ser,
cc_code,Round(abs(((nvl(Ias_Pi_Bill_Mst.bill_amt,0)+ nvl(Disc_Amt_Not_Effect,0)-nvl(Ias_Pi_Bill_Mst.disc_amt,0)+nvl(Ias_Pi_Bill_Mst.vat_amt,0))* bill_rate)),2) bill_amt

cc_code,Round(nvl(cr_amt,0),2)
where doc_type=6
and v_code Is Not Null';
-- Ias_Mnd_VndTrns_Pkg.VT_bills (1) ;
Select 7 doc_type,v_code,rt_bill_currency a_cy,rt_bill_no doc_no,
rt_bill_doc_type jv_type ,rt_bill_ser doc_ser,cc_code,
Round(abs(((nvl(Ias_Pr_Bill_Mst.bill_amt,0)+ nvl(Disc_Amt_Not_Effect,0)-nvl(Ias_Pr_Bill_Mst.disc_amt,0))* rt_bill_rate)),2) bill_amt
Select doc_type,v_code,a_cy,doc_no,jv_type,Doc_Ser,cc_code,Round(nvl(dr_amt,0),2)
Where doc_type=7
-- Ias_Mnd_VndTrns_Pkg.VT_Rt_bills (1) ;
Select 8 doc_type,M.v_code,M.a_cy,M.gr_no doc_no,M.Incom_Type jv_type ,
M.g_ser doc_ser,M.cc_code,Decode(M.rt_out,1,nvl(Sum(nvl(i_qty,0)*nvl(i_price,0)*M.ac_rate),0),nvl(Sum(nvl(i_qty,0)*nvl(c_price,0)*M.ac_rate),0)) gr_amt
From gr_note M,gr_detail D,v_details V
and M.a_code=V.v_a_code
and M.v_code
=V.v_code
and M.v_code Is Not Null
group by M.v_code,M.a_cy,M.gr_no,M.Incom_Type,M.g_ser,M.cc_code,M.rt_out
Select doc_type,v_code,a_cy,doc_no,jv_type,Doc_Ser,cc_code,nvl(cr_amt,0)
-- Ias_Mnd_VndTrns_Pkg.VT_Incoming (1) ;
Select 9 doc_type,M.v_code,M.a_cy,Out_no doc_no,
out_type jv_type ,Out_ser doc_ser,M.cc_code,
From Ias_Outgoing_Mst M,v_details V
where M.a_code=V.v_a_code
and M.v_code=V.v_code
Select doc_type,v_code,a_cy,doc_no,jv_type,Doc_Ser,cc_code,nvl(dr_amt,0)
-- Ias_Mnd_VndTrns_Pkg.VT_OutGoing (1) ;
End Chk_VndTrns_Prc;

Select nvl(Ap_AC_LINK_TYPE,1)
From ias_para_ap;
And ac_dtl_typ=4
and Exists ( Select 1 From v_details where v_a_code=D.a_code and RowNum<=1)
Update Detail_journal_v dj Set ac_code_dtl = (Select v_code From v_details where v_a_code=dj.a_code)
where Exists ( Select 1 From v_details where v_a_code=dj.a_code and RowNum<=1)
And ac_code_dtl is not null
And D.ac_dtl_typ=4
Update Voucher_Detail vd Set ac_code_dtl = (Select v_code From v_details where v_a_code=vd.a_code)
where Exists ( Select 1 From v_details where v_a_code=vd.a_code and RowNum<=1)
and vd.ac_code_dtl Is Null
And vd.ac_dtl_typ=4;
and M.v_code Is Null
and Exists ( Select 1 From v_details where v_a_code=M.a_code and RowNum<=1)
Update Gr_Note gn Set v_code = (Select v_code From v_details where v_a_code=gn.a_code)
where Exists ( Select 1 From v_details where v_a_code=gn.a_code and RowNum<=1)
and v_code Is Null;
Where M.v_code Is Null
Update Ias_Outgoing_Mst Outg Set v_code = (Select v_code From v_details where v_a_code=Outg.a_code)
where Exists ( Select 1 From v_details where v_a_code=Outg.a_code and RowNum<=1)
Update Ias_Post_Dtl Pd Set v_code = (Select v_code From v_details where v_a_code=Pd.a_code)
where Exists ( Select 1 From v_details where v_a_code=Pd.a_code and RowNum<=1)
End Chk_v_code_Null;

PROCEDURE Chk_Installmnet_Prc (P_DocType In NUMBER Default Null) Is
Where nvl(j_amt,0) > 0
and c_code Is Not Null;
Select Count(1) Into Cnt1 From Installment
Where doc_type=0;
If Cnt <> Cnt1 Then
Ias_Installment_Ar_Pkg.Rebuild_Installmnet(0);
Select 1 Into Cnt From
Select 1 doc_type,j_ser,j_doc_no,rcrd_no,Ac_code_DTL C_CODE,Decode(nvl(j_amt_f,0),0,nvl(j_amt,0),nvl(j_amt_f,0))
From Detail_journal_v
where Ac_code_DTL Is Not Null
AND AC_DTL_TYP=3
and j_amt > 0
Select doc_type,bill_ser,bill_no,rcrd_no,c_code,nvl(i_amt,0)
where doc_type = 1
and nvl(i_py,0) = 0
Where Rownum<=1;
Ias_Installment_Ar_Pkg.Rebuild_Installmnet(1);
--When no_Data_Found Then
--Null;
--## Payment vouchers
Select 3 doc_type,v_ser,voucher_no,rcrd_no,AC_CODE_DTL c_code,Decode(nvl(ac_amtf,0),0,nvl(ac_amt,0),nvl(ac_amtf,0))
where voucher_type = 2
and nvl(ac_amt,0) > 0
where doc_type = 3
Ias_Installment_Ar_Pkg.Rebuild_Installmnet(3);
Select 9 doc_type,out_ser,out_no,c_code,Decode(Pur_Type,1,(Nvl(Out_Amt,0)+Nvl(Exp_Amt,0)),Nvl(Out_Amt,0))
where c_code Is Not Null
Select doc_type,bill_ser,bill_no,c_code,nvl(i_amt,0)
where doc_type = 9
Ias_Installment_Ar_Pkg.Rebuild_Installmnet(9);
Select 4 doc_type,bill_ser,bill_no,c_code,Round(nvl(sum(nvl(bill_amt,0)-nvl(disc_amt_mst,0)-nvl(disc_amt_dtl,0)+nvl(othr_amt,0)+nvl(vat_amt,0)),0),3)
From ias_bill_mst
where bill_doc_type= 4
and nvl(BILL_PY,0) = 0
group by bill_ser,bill_no,c_code
Select doc_type,bill_ser,bill_no,c_code,Round(nvl(sum(i_amt),0),3)
where doc_type = 4
group by doc_type,bill_ser,bill_no,c_code
Ias_Installment_Ar_Pkg.Rebuild_Installmnet(4);
End Chk_Installmnet_Prc;

v_i_no := v_i_no + 1;

PROCEDURE Update_Adj_Installmnet (P_Up_All In Number Default 0) Is
If P_Up_All = 0 Then -- Check Err. Data and Updated Only
Group by doc_ser_ref,i_no,c_code,nvl(rcrd_no,0),nvl(i_py,0)
From Installment';
Cursor adj_cv Is Select Doc_No,Doc_Type_Ref,Doc_No_Ref ,Doc_Ser_Ref ,C_Code,Cc_Code, A_Cy, I_No, nvl(Paid_Amt_Doc,0) Paid_Amt_Doc,
nvl(Rcrd_No,0) Rcrd_No ,nvl(I_PY,0) i_py
Where DOC_SER_ref Is Not Null
and doc_ser_ref||i_no||c_code In (Select doc_ser||i_no||c_code From Ias_V_Chk_Adj_Instll_AR)
Order by Doc_no;
Update Installment Set Adj_amt = 0
Where bill_ser||i_no||c_code In (Select doc_ser||i_no||c_code From Ias_V_Chk_Adj_Instll_AR)
and nvl(Adj_amt,0) <> 0;
For i In adj_cv Loop
Update Installment Set Adj_amt = nvl(Adj_amt,0) + i.Paid_Amt_Doc
Where c_code= i.c_code
and doc_type = i.Doc_Type_Ref
and bill_ser = i.Doc_Ser_Ref
and i_no = i.i_no
and nvl(rcrd_no,0)=i.rcrd_no
and nvl(cc_code,'0')=nvl(i.cc_code,'0')
and nvl(i_py,0) = i.i_py;
Else -- Update All Adj_Data
Where nvl(Adj_amt,0) <> 0;
End Update_Adj_Installmnet;

PROCEDURE Rebuild_Installmnet (P_Doc_Type In NUMBER Default Null,p_stp In NUMBER Default 0) IS
V_APALT NUMBER;
Select nvl(AP_AC_LINK_TYPE,1) Into V_APALT From Ias_Para_Ap;
V_APALT:=1;
Delete From ias_Installment_pi Where doc_type=0;
Cursor op_cv Is Select m.v_code,Decode(nvl(m.j_amt_f,0),0,nvl(m.j_amt,0),nvl(m.j_amt_f,0)
) j_amt ,m.cc_code,m.pj_no,m.actv_no,
m.a_cy,m.ac_rate,m.ob_py,m.brn_no,m.brn_year,m.CMP_NO,m.BRN_USR
From open_bal m
where m.v_code Is Not Null
and nvl(j_amt,0) < 0

CREATE OR REPLACE package Ias_Get_Othr_Qty_Pkg as
FUNCTION Out_Bill_Diff (P_Icode In Ias_Itm_Mst.I_CODE%TYPE,
P_Psize In NUMBER DEFAULT 1,
P_Tdate In DATE DEFAULT NULL,
P_Whr In Varchar2 DEFAULT NULL ) Return Number;
FUNCTION Out_Rt_Bill_Diff (P_Icode In Ias_Itm_Mst.I_CODE%TYPE,
P_Wc
ode In WAREHOUSE_DETAILS.W_CODE%TYPE DEFAULT NUll,
FUNCTION P_Order_Diff (P_Icode In Ias_Itm_Mst.I_CODE%TYPE,
FUNCTION Pi_Bill_Diff (P_Icode In Ias_Itm_Mst.I_CODE%TYPE,
Function Pos_Diff ( P_Icode In Ias_Itm_Mst.I_CODE%TYPE,
P_User In Varchar2,
P_Whr In Varchar2 DEFAULT NULL ) Return Number ;
Function Tr_Qty_Not_Rec ( P_Icode In Ias_Itm_Mst.I_CODE%TYPE,
End Ias_Get_Othr_Qty_Pkg;
CREATE OR REPLACE Package Body Ias_Get_Othr_Qty_Pkg is
P_Whr In Varchar2 DEFAU
LT NULL ) Return Number Is
V_Qty Number;
Select Sum((Nvl(Ias_Bill_Dtl.I_Qty,0)+Nvl(Ias_Bill_Dtl.Free_Qty,0))*Ias_Bill_Dtl.P_Size)-
Sum((Nvl(Ias_Bill_Dtl.Out_Qty,0)+Nvl(Ias_Bill_Dtl.Out_Free_Qty,0))*Ias_Bill_Dtl.P_Size)
From Ias_Bill_Dtl,Ias_Bill_Mst
Where Ias_Bill_Dtl.Bill_Ser=Ias_Bill_Mst.Bill_ser
And I_code=P_Icode
And Decode(P_Wcode,Null,1,Ias_Bill_Dtl.W_Code)=Decode(P_Wcode,Null,1,P_Wcode)
And Decode(P_Tdate,Null,'1',Ias_Bill_Mst.Bill_Date)<=Decode(P_Tdate,Null,'1',P_Tdate)||P_Whr;
Return (Nvl(V_Qty,0)/P_Psize);
Return 0;
End Out_Bill_Diff;
P_Whr In Varchar2 DEFAULT NULL ) Return Number Is
Select Sum((Nvl(Ias_Rt_Bill_Dtl.I_Qty,0)+Nvl(Ias_Rt_Bill_Dtl.Free_Qty,0))*Ias_Rt_Bill_Dtl.P_Size)-
Sum((Nvl(Ias_Rt_Bill_Dtl.Ret_Qty,0)+Nvl(Ias_Rt_Bill_Dtl.Ret_Free_Qty,0))*Ias_Rt_Bill_Dtl.P_Size)
From Ias_Rt_Bill_Dtl,Ias_Rt_Bill_Mst
Where Ias_Rt_Bill_Dtl.Rt_Bill_Ser=Ias_Rt_Bill_Mst.Rt_Bill_ser
And Decode(P_Wcode,Null,1,Ias_Rt_Bill_Dtl.W_Code)=Decode(P_Wcode,Null,1,P_Wcode)
And Decode(P_Tdate,Null,'1',Ias_Rt_Bill_Mst.Rt_Bill_Date)<=Decode(P_Tdate,Null,'1',P_Tdate)||P_Whr;
End Out_Rt_Bill_Diff;
Select Sum((Nvl(P_Order_Detail.I_Qty,0)+Nvl(P_Order_Detail.Free_Qty,0))*P_Order_Detail.P_Size)-
Sum((Nvl(P_Order_Detail.Pi_Qty,0)+Nvl(P_Order_Detail.Pi_Free_Qty,0))*P_Order_Detail.P_Size)
From P_Order ,P_Order_Detail
Where P_Order.Po_Ser=P_Order_Detail.Po_Ser
And Nvl(P_Order.APproved,0)=1
And Decode(P_Wcode,Null,1,P_Order_Detail.W_Code)=Decode(P_Wcode,Null,1,P_Wcode)
And Decode(P_Tdate,Null,'1',P_Order.Po_Date)<=Decode(P_Tdate,Null,'1',P_Tdate)||P_Whr;
End P_Order_Diff;
Select Sum((Nvl(Gr_Detail.I_Qty,0)+Nvl(Gr_Detail.Free_Qty,0))*Gr_Detail.P_Size)
From Gr_Note,Gr_Detail
Where Gr_Note.Gr_No = Gr_Detail.Gr_No
And Gr_Note.Pi_No = Gr_Detail.Pi_No
And Gr_Note.G_Ser = Gr_Detail.G_Ser
And Gr_Note.Pi_Type = Gr_Detail.Pi_Type
And Gr_Note.Pi_Type=2
And Nvl(C_Flag,0)=0
And Decode(P_Wcode,Null,1,Gr_Detail.W_Code)=Decode(P_Wcode,Null,1,P_Wcode)
And Decode(P_Tdate,Null,'1',Gr_Detail.Gr_Date)<=Decode(P_Tdate,Null,'1',P_Tdate)||P_Whr;
End Pi_Bill_Diff;
P_Wcode I
n WAREHOUSE_DETAILS.W_CODE%TYPE DEFAULT NUll,
V_Bill_Qty Number:=0;
V_Rt_Bill_Qty Number:=0;
V_SqlStr Varchar2(4000);
P_Tbl_Nm_Mst Varchar2(250);
P_Tbl_Nm_Dtl Varchar2(250);
------------------------------------------------ Get Qty Pos_Bills And Not Posted Onyx
P_Tbl_Nm_Mst:=P_User||'.Ias_Pos_Bill_Mst';
P_Tbl_Nm_Dtl:=P_User||'.Ias_Pos_Bill_Dtl';
V_SqlStr:=' Select Nvl(Sum(P_Qty),0) From '||P_Tbl_Nm_Mst||','||P_Tbl_Nm_Dtl||
' Where '||P_Tbl_Nm_Mst||'.Bill_no='||P_Tbl_Nm_Dtl||'.Bill_no
And Nvl(Posted,0)=0
And I_code='||''''||P_ICode||'''';
If P_WCode Is Not Null Then
V_SqlStr:=V_SqlStr||' And '||P_Tbl_Nm_Dtl||'.W_Code ='||P_Wcode;
If P_Tdate Is Not Null Then
V_SqlStr:=V_SqlStr||' And '||P_Tbl_Nm_Mst||'.Bill_Date <='||''''||P_Tdate||'''';
Execute Immediate V_SqlStr Into V_Bill_Qty ;
------------------------------------------------ Get Qty Pos_Rt_Bills And Not Posted Onyx
P_Tbl_Nm_Mst:=P_User||'.Ias_Pos_Rt_Bill_Mst';
P_Tbl_Nm_Dtl:=P_User||'.Ias_Pos_Rt_Bill_Dtl';
' Where '||P_Tbl_Nm_Mst||'.Rt_Bill_no='||P_Tbl_Nm_Dtl||'.Rt_Bill_no
V_SqlStr:=V_SqlStr||' And '||P_Tbl_Nm_Mst||'.Rt_Bill_Date <='||''''||P_Tdate||'''';
Execute Immediate V_SqlStr Into V_Rt_Bill_Qty ;
Return ((Nvl(V_Bill_Qty,0)/P_Psize)-(Nvl(V_Rt_Bill_Qty,0)/P_Psize));
End Pos_Diff;
Select Sum(Decode(Ias_Whtrns_Mst.Tr_Inout_Type,1,Nvl(P_Qty,0),2,-1*Nvl(P_Qty,0)))
From Ias_Whtrns_Mst,Ias_Whtrns_Dtl
And Ias_Whtrns_Dtl.I_Code = P_ICode
And Decode(P_Wcode,Null,1,Ias_Whtrns_Dtl.T_W_Code)=Decode(P_Wcode,Null,1,P_Wcode)
And Decode(P_Tdate,Null,'1',Ias_Whtrns_Mst.Tr_Date)<=Decode(P_Tdate,Null,'1',P_Tdate)||P_Whr;
End Tr_Qty_Not_Rec;
