CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE IAS_PRMTR_PKG IS
G_BRN_YEAR NUMBER(4);
G_USER_NO USER_R.U_ID%TYPE;
G_LANG_NO NUMBER;
G_LANG_DIR NUMBER;
G_LANG_DFLT NUMBER;
G_LOCAL_CUR EX_RATE.CUR_CODE%TYPE;
G_FORM_NO NUMBER;
G_SCR_TYP NUMBER;
FUNCTION GetPval (P_Prmtr VARCHAR2) RETURN VARCHAR2;
PROCEDURE SetPval(P_Prmtr VARCHAR2, P_Val VARCHAR2);
END IAS_PRMTR_PKG ;
CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY IAS_PRMTR_PKG IS
FUNCTION GetPval(p_prmtr VARCHAR2) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
If 'G_BRN_YEAR' ='G_'||p_prmtr Then
RETURN IAS_PRMTR_PKG.G_BRN_YEAR ;
ElsIf 'G_USER_NO' ='G_'||p_prmtr Then
RETURN IAS_PRMTR_PKG.G_USER_NO;
ElsIf 'G_LANG_NO' ='G_'||p_prmtr Then
RETURN IAS_PRMTR_PKG.G_LANG_NO ;
ELSIF 'G_LANG_DIR' ='G_'||p_prmtr Then
RETURN IAS_PRMTR_PKG.G_LANG_DIR ;
ELSIF 'G_LANG_DFLT' ='G_'||p_prmtr Then
RETURN IAS_PRMTR_PKG.G_LANG_DFLT ;
ElsIf 'G_LOCAL_CUR' ='G_'||p_prmtr Then
RETURN IAS_PRMTR_PKG.G_LOCAL_CUR ;
ELSIF 'G_FORM_NO' ='G_'||p_prmtr Then
RETURN IAS_PRMTR_PKG.G_FORM_NO ;
ELSIF 'G_SCR_TYP' ='G_' ||p_prmtr Then
RETURN IAS_PRMTR_PKG.G_SCR_TYP ;
RETURN '';
END GetPval;
/*_____________________________________________________________________*/
PROCEDURE SetPval(p_prmtr VARCHAR2,p_val VARCHAR2) IS
IF 'G_BRN_YEAR' ='G_'||p_prmtr Then
IAS_PRMTR_PKG.G_BRN_YEAR :=to_number (p_val) ;
ELSIF 'G_USER_NO' ='G_'||p_prmtr Then
IAS_PRMTR_PKG.G_USER_NO:=to_number (p_val) ;
ELSIF 'G_LANG_NO' ='G_'||p_prmtr Then
IAS_PRMTR_PKG.G_LANG_NO :=to_number (p_val) ;
IAS_PRMTR_PKG.G_LANG_DIR :=to_number (p_val) ;
IAS_PRMTR_PKG.G_LANG_DFLT :=to_number (p_val) ;
ElsIf 'G_LOC_CUR' ='G_'||p_prmtr Then
IAS_PRMTR_PKG.G_LOCAL_CUR := (p_val) ;
IAS_PRMTR_PKG.G_FORM_NO :=to_number (p_val) ;
IAS_PRMTR_PKG.G_SCR_TYP :=to_number (p_val) ;
END SetPval;
END IAS_PRMTR_PKG;

CREATE OR REPLACE Package Ys_Alrt_Sys_Pkg As
Procedure Chk_Alrt_Prc ( P_Usr_No In User_R.U_Id%Type ,
P_Lng_No In Pls_Integer Default 1 ) ;
Function Get_Alrt_Usr
_Hide_Date ( P_Alrt_No In S_Alrt_Sys_Mst.Alrt_No%Type ,
P_Usr_No In User_R.U_Id%Type ) Return Date ;
End Ys_Alrt_Sys_Pkg;
CREATE OR REPLACE Package Body Ys_Alrt_Sys_Pkg As
P_Lng_No In Pls_Integer Default 1 ) Is
Cursor Alrt_Cv Is
Select M.Alrt_No,M.Lbl_No,M.Msg_No,M.SYS_NO,M.Ordr_No,M.Alrt_Day Alrt_Day,
M.Alrt_Slct,M.Alrt_Slct_Whr,M.Alrt_Slct_Ordr,M.Alrt_Grp_By,
M.Alrt_Actn, M.Alrt_Prd_Typ ,M.Alrt_Hide ,M.Alrt_Hide_Whr,M.RPRT_NM
From S_Alrt_Sys_Mst M
Where ( M.Alrt_Day Is Not Null Or Alrt_Actn <> 1)
And Nvl(M.Inactive,0) = 0
And Nvl(M.Alrt_St,0) = 1
And M.Lbl_No Is Not Null
And M.Alrt_Slct Is Not Null
And (P_Usr_No = 1 Or Exists (Select 1 From S_Usr_Alrt_Sys_Priv
Where Alrt_No = M.Alrt_No
And Prv_Flg = 1
And Rownum<=1 ))
And Exists (Select 1 From S_Erp_System_Dbs
Where Sys_No = M.Sys_No
And Brn_Usr =Substr(User,8)
And Nvl(Inactive,0) = 0
And Rownum<=1)
Order By M.Ordr_No , M.Alrt_No ;
V_Slct Varchar2(32000);
V_Slct_Whr Varchar2(10000);
V_Date_Whr Date ;
Delete From S_Alrt_Data_Tmp Where U_Id = P_Usr_No;
For I In Alrt_Cv Loop
If I.Alrt_Actn = 1 Then -- By Period
V_Slct := I.Alrt_Slct||' '||I.Alrt_Slct_Whr||' '||I.Alrt_Day;
V_Slct_Whr:=I.Alrt_Slct_Whr||' '||I.Alrt_Day||' '||I.Alrt_Grp_By;
V_Slct := I.Alrt_Slct||' '||I.Alrt_Slct_Whr;
V_Slct_Whr:=I.Alrt_Slct_Whr||' '||I.Alrt_Grp_By;
If Nvl(I.Alrt_Hide,0) = 1 Then
V_Date_Whr := Ys_Alrt_Sys_Pkg.Get_Alrt_Usr_Hide_Date ( P_Alrt_No => I.Alrt_No ,
P_Usr_No => P_Usr_No ) ;
V_Slct:=Replace (Upper(V_Slct),'V_USR_NO',P_Usr_No);
V_Slct:=Replace (Upper(V_Slct),'V_LNG_NO',P_Lng_No);
V_Slct_Whr:=Replace (Upper(V_Slct_Whr),'V_USR_NO',P_Usr_No);
V_Slct_Whr:=Replace (Upper(V_Slct_Whr),'V_LNG_NO',P_Lng_No);
If Nvl(I.Alrt_Hide,0) = 1 And I.Alrt_Hide_Whr Is Not Null And V_Date_Whr Is Not Null Then
Execute Immediate V_Slct ||' '|| I.Alrt_Hide_Whr ||' '||'To_Date('||''''||V_Date_Whr||''''||',''DD/MM/Y
YYY'')' Into V_Cnt;
Execute Immediate V_Slct Into V_Cnt;
Insert Into S_Alrt_Data_Tmp ( Alrt_No ,
Msg_No ,
Lbl_No ,
U_Id ,
SYS_NO
Ordr_No ,
Alrt_Day ,
Alrt_Prd_Typ ,
Alrt_Slct_Whr ,
Alrt_Slct_Ordr ,
Alrt_Cnt ,
Alrt_Hide ,
Alrt_Hide_Whr
RPRT_NM)
Values ( I.Alrt_No ,
I.Msg_No ,
I.Lbl_No ,
P_Usr_No ,
I.SYS_NO
I.Ordr_No ,
I.Alrt_Day ,
I.Alrt_Prd_Typ ,
V_Slct_Whr ,
I.Alrt_Slct_Ordr ,
V_Cnt ,
I.Alrt_Hide
I.Alrt_Hide_Whr
I.RPRT_NM );
Raise_Application_Error (-20001,'Err. In Insrt Tmp Table '||SqlErrm);
Raise_Application_Error (-20001,'Err.Last In Insrt Tmp Table '||SqlErrm);
End Chk_Alrt_Prc;
Function Get_Alrt_Usr_Hide_Date ( P_Alrt_No In S_Alrt_Sys_Mst.Alrt_No%Type ,
P_Usr_No In User_R.U_Id%Type ) Return Date Is
V_Nt_Dis_Date Date ;
Select Nt_Dis_Date Into V_Nt_Dis_Date
From Ias_Trace_Lgn_Note
Where Nt_No = P_Alrt_No
And Nt_Dis_U_Id = P_Usr_No
Return(TO_Date(V_Nt_Dis_Date,'DD/MM/YYYY'));
Return(TO_Date(Ias_gen_Pkg.Get_Frst_Day,'DD/MM/YYYY'));
End Get_Alrt_Usr_Hide_Date ;
End Ys_Alrt_Sys_Pkg ;

FUNCTION Get_Emp_Nm (P_Emp_No In S_Emp.Emp_No%Type , P_Lng_No In Number Default Null) Return Varchar2 Is
V_Empnm S_Emp.Emp_L_Nm%Type;
Select Decode (P_Lng_No,1,Emp_L_Nm,Nvl(Emp_F_Nm,Emp_L_Nm) ) Into V_Empnm
From S_Emp
Where Emp_No = P_Emp_No
Return(V_Empnm);
End Get_Emp_Nm
FUNCTION Get_Emp_Brn (P_EMP_NO In S_EMP.EMP_NO%TYPE ) RETURN S_BRN.BRN_NO%TYPE Is
v_unt S_BRN.BRN_NO%TYPE;
SELECT BRN_NO
INTO v_unt
From S_EMP
Where EMP_NO = P_EMP_NO
AND RowNum<=1;
Return(v_unt);
End Get_Emp_Brn;
--##------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------##--
FUNCTION Get_Mngr_No (P_EMP_NO In S_EMP.EMP_NO%TYPE) RETURN NUMBER IS
V_MNGR_NO S_EMP.EMP_NO_MNGR%TYPE;
SELECT EMP_NO_MNGR
Into V_MNGR_NO
Return(V_MNGR_NO);
End Get_Mngr_No;
FUNCTION Get_Emp_No_Mchn (P_EMP_NO In S_EMP.EMP_NO%TYPE ) RETURN NUMBER Is
V_EMP_NO_MCHN S_EMP.EMP_NO_MCHN%TYPE;
SELECT EMP_NO_MCHN
Into V_EMP_NO_MCHN
Return(V_EMP_NO_MCHN);
End Get_Emp_No_Mchn;
FUNCTION Get_Emp_Wrk_Hour (P_EMP_NO In S_EMP.EMP_NO%TYPE , P_Wrk_Hour_Typ In Number Default 1) RETURN NUMBER Is
V_WRK_HRS S_EMP.WRK_HRS_YR%TYPE;
-- P_Wrk_Hour_Typ = 1 = WRK_HRS_DY , 2 = WRK_HRS_MNTH , 3 = WRK_HRS_YR
SELECT Decode( P_Wrk_Hour_Typ,1,WRK_HRS_DY,2,WRK_HRS_MNTH,3,WRK_HRS_YR)

End Get_Emp_Wrk_Hour;
FUNCTION Get_Emp_Slry_Calc ( P_Emp_No IN S_EMP.EMP_NO%TYPE) RETURN NUMBER Is

End Get_Emp_Slry_Calc ;
FUNCTION Get_Hrchy_Nm (P_HRCHY_NO In S_HRCHY.HRCHY_NO%TYPE, P_Lng_NO In NUMBER DEFAULT 1) RETURN VARCHAR2 Is
V_HRCHY_NM S_HRCHY.HRCHY_L_NM%TYPE;

RETURN(V_HRCHY_NM);
End Get_Hrchy_Nm;
Function Get_Grntr_Nm (P_Grntr_No In S_Grntr.Grntr_No%Type, P_Lng_No In Number Default 1) Return Varchar2 Is

Return(V_Grntr_Nm);
End Get_Grntr_Nm;

P_Msg_No IN Out NUMBER ) Is

V_Slry_St NUMBER;
V_Fng_Calc NUMBER;
-- P_Scr_Typ = ( 1 = SCR , 2 = Report )
IF P_Usr_No = 1 THEN -- ADMIN ROLE
Select Decode(P_Lng_No,1,M.EMP_L_NM,nvl(M.EMP_F_NM,M.EMP_L_NM)),Emp_St,NVL(Slry_Calc,0),NVL(Fng_Calc,0),
Nvl(Slry_St,0) , Nvl(Emp_Crnt_St,0) , 1 BRN_ADD_FLAG, 1 BRN_VIEW_FLAG , 1 EMP_ADD_FLAG, 1 EMP_VIEW_FLAG, M.Brn_No
Into P_Emp_Nm,V_Emp_St,V_Slry_Calc,V_Fng_Calc,V_Slry_St,V_Emp_Crnt_St,V_Brn_Prv_Scr,V_Brn_Prv_Rprt,V_Emp_Prv_Scr,V_Emp_Prv_Rprt,V_Brn_No
From S_EMP M
Where M.EMP_NO = P_Emp_No
If P_Emp_Prv_Typ Is Null Then
V_Emp_Prv_Typ := Ys_Gen_Pkg.Get_Fld_Value('IAS_PARA_GEN','EMP_PRV_TYP');
V_Emp_Prv_Typ :=P_Emp_Prv_Typ;
IF V_Emp_Prv_Typ = 1 Then
Select Decode(P_Lng_No,1,M.EMP_L_NM,nvl(M.EMP_F_NM,M.EMP_L_NM)),Emp_St,nvl(Slry_Calc,0),nvl(Fng_Calc,0),
Nvl(Slry_St,0) , Nvl(Emp_Crnt_St,0) ,nvl(C.ADD_FLAG,0),nvl(C.VIEW_FLAG,0), M.Brn_No
Into P_Emp_Nm,V_Emp_St,V_Slry_Calc,V_Fng_Calc,V_Slry_St,V_Emp_Crnt_St,V_Emp_Prv_Scr,V_Emp_Prv_Rprt,V_Brn_No
From S_EMP M,S_V_EMP_PRV C
Where M.Emp_No = C.Empno_Hrchyno
and C.U_ID = P_Usr_No
and M.EMP_NO = P_Emp_No
ElsIF V_Emp_Prv_Typ = 2 Then
From S_EMP M, S_V_HRCHY_PRV C
Where M.HRCHY_NO = C.Empno_Hrchyno
Nvl(Slry_St,0) , Nvl(Emp_Crnt_St,0) ,nvl(D.ADD_FLAG,0),nvl(D.VIEW_FLAG,0), 1 EMP_ADD_FLAG, 1 EMP_VIEW_FLAG, M.Brn_No
From S_EMP M,
S_BRN_USR_PRIV D
Where M.BRN_NO = D.BRN_NO
and D.U_ID = P_Usr_No
IF P_scr_typ = 1 and V_Emp_St <> 1 And P_Hrs_Sys >0 THEN
P_Msg_No:=1655; --Inactive employee
ElsIF P_scr_typ = 1 and V_Emp_Prv_Scr = 0 THEN
P_Msg_No:=1608; --do not have priv.
ElsIF P_scr_typ = 2 and V_Emp_Prv_Rprt = 0 THEN
P_Msg_No:=1608;
P_Msg_No:=1609; --Employee Is Not Found
END Chk_Emp;
--## Chk_Emp
Nvl(Slry_St,0) , Nvl(Emp_Crnt_St,0) ,nvl(D.ADD_FLAG,0),nvl(D.VIEW_FLAG,0),nvl(C.ADD_FLAG,0),nvl(C.VIEW_FLAG,0), M.Brn_No
From S_EMP M, S_BRN_USR_PRIV D ,S_V_EMP_PRV C
AND M.Emp_No = C.Empno_Hrchyno
and d.U_ID = c.U_ID
From S_EMP M, S_BRN_USR_PRIV D ,S_V_HRCHY_PRV C
AND M.HRCHY_NO = C.Empno_Hrchyno
From S_EMP M, S_BRN_USR_PRIV D
IF P_scr_typ = 1 and P_Brn_No Is Not Null and P_Brn_No <> V_Brn_No Then
P_Msg_No:= 2007;
ElsIF P_scr_typ = 1 and V_Emp_St <> 1 THEN
P_Msg_No:=3149; --Inactive employee
ElsIf P_scr_typ = 1 and V_Slry_Calc = 1 and P_Chk_Slry_Calc = 1 THEN
P_Msg_No:=1656; -- employee Salary Calc
ElsIf P_scr_typ = 1 and V_Fng_Calc = 1 and P_Chk_Fng_Calc = 1 THEN
P_Msg_No:=1926; -- employee Finger Calc
ElsIf P_scr_typ = 1 and V_Slry_St = 1 and P_Chk_Slry_St = 1 THEN
P_Msg_No:=1655; -- employee Salary Status
ElsIf P_scr_typ = 1 and V_Emp_Crnt_St = 1 and P_Chk_Emp_Crnt_St = 1 THEN
P_Msg_No:=1655; -- employee Current Status
ElsIF P_scr_typ = 1 and (V_Brn_Prv_Scr = 0 Or V_Emp_Prv_Scr = 0) THEN
ElsIF P_scr_typ = 2 and (V_Brn_Prv_Rprt = 0 Or V_Emp_Prv_Rprt = 0) THEN
FUNCTION Get_Code_Nm (P_COD_TYP S_EMP_CODE_DTL.CODE_TYP%TYPE,P_COD_NO S_EMP_CODE_DTL.CODE_NO%TYPE , P_Lng_no In NUMBER DEFAULT NULL ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
V_Code_Nm S_EMP_CODE_DTL.Code_L_Nm%TYPE;
SELECT DECODE(P_Lng_no,1,Code_L_Nm,Code_F_Nm)
INTO V_Code_Nm
FROM S_EMP_CODE_DTL

AND CODE_NO = P_COD_NO
RETURN V_Code_Nm;
RETURN NULL;
END Get_Code_Nm;

END Get_Code_Typ_Nm;

FROM HRS_

PROCEDURE Get_Rep_Head Is
v_Head_Type Number;
Select nvl(Head_type,1) Into v_Head_Type
From Ias_Para_Gen;
v_Head_Type:=1;
If v_Head_Type = 1 Then
Select Decode(G_Lang_no,1,CMP_LNAME,CMP_FNAME),
Decode(G_Lang_no,1,CMP_FNAME,CMP_LNAME),
Decode(G_Lang_no,1,BRN_LDES,BRN_FDES),
Decode(G_Lang_no,1,BRN_FDES,BRN_LDES),
Decode(G_Lang_no,1,BRN_LAdd,BRN_FAdd),
Decode(G_Lang_no,1,BRN_FAdd,BRN_LAdd),
Decode(G_Lang_no,1,BRN_LTele,BRN_FTele),
Decode(G_Lang_no,1,BRN_FTele,BRN_LTele),
Decode(G_Lang_no,1,BRN_LFax,BRN_FFax),
Decode(G_Lang_no,1,BRN_FFax,BRN_LFax),
Decode(G_Lang_no,1,BRN_LBox,BRN_FFax),
Decode(G_Lang_no,1,BRN_FBox,BRN_LBox),
Into CmpAName ,
CmpEName ,
BAName ,
BEName ,
BAdd ,
BEAdd ,
BTele ,
BETele ,
BFax ,
BEFax ,
BBox ,
BEBox ,
BIMG
Where Brn_No=G_BRN_No;
Select Decode(G_Lang_no,1,CMP_ANAME,CMP_ENAME),
Decode(G_Lang_no,1,CMP_ENAME,CMP_ANAME),
Decode(G_Lang_no,1,BRN_ADES,BRN_EDES),
Decode(G_Lang_no,1,BRN_EDES,BRN_ADES),
Decode(G_Lang_no,1,BRN_AAdd,BRN_EAdd),
Decode(G_Lang_no,1,BRN_EAdd,BRN_AAdd),
Decode(G_Lang_no,1,BRN_ATele,BRN_ETele),
Decode(G_Lang_no,1,BRN_ETele,BRN_ATele),
Decode(G_Lang_no,1,BRN_AFax,BRN_EFax),
Decode(G_Lang_no,1,BRN_EFax,BRN_AFax),
Decode(G_Lang_no,1,BRN_ABox,BRN_EFax),
Decode(G_Lang_no,1,BRN_EBox,BRN_ABox),
From IAS_USER_HEAD
Where U_id=G_Usr_No;
Where Brn_No=G_BRN_No And RowNum<=1;
CmpANAME:=replace(CmpANAME,'','');
CmpENAME:=replace(CmpENAME,'','');
BANAME :=replace(BANAME,'','');
BENAME :=replace(BENAME,'','');
BADD :=replace(BADD,'','');
BEADD :=replace(BEADD,'','');
BTELE :=replace(BTELE,'','');
BFAX :=replace(BFAX,'','');
BBOX :=replace(BBOX,'','');
BETELE :=replace(BETELE,'','');
BEFAX :=replace(BEFAX,'','');
BEBOX :=replace(BEBOX,'','');
BIMG :=replace(BIMG,'','');
End Get_Rep_Head ;

Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(Lang_No,To_Number(Comments)) Else Comments End)
Into Cment From User_Col_Comments
Where Table_Name ||'.'|| Column_Name = Nvl(Tabl,Table_Name)||'.'|| Clmn;
To_Ch
ar(Case When To_Number(Ascii(Substr(Comments,1,1))) Between 49 And 57 Then
Where Table_Name ||'.'|| Column_Name = Nvl(Tabl,Table_Name)||'.'|| Clmn
And To_Number(Ascii(Substr(Comments,1,1))) Between 49 And 57;
Select Comments
Cment:= P_TBLFLD_NAME;
Return(Cment);
End Get_Clmn_Labl ;
P_LENGTH In Out Number ) RETURN VarChar2 Is
TypeD VarChar2(20);
Lngth Number;
Select Data_Type , Data_Length
Into TypeD , P_LENGTH
From USER_TAB_COLS
Where TABLE_NAME||'.'||COLUMN_NAME = Nvl(Tabl,Table_Name)||'.'|| Clmn
And Table_Name In (Select Table_Name From User_Tab_Comments Where Table_Type='TABLE') ;
And Table_Name In (Select Table_Name From User_Tab_Comments Where Table_Type='TABLE')
Select Data_Type
Into TypeD
TypeD:='VARCHAR2';
Return(TypeD);
End Get_Clmn_Type;
CREATE OR REPLACE Package IAS_SMAN_PKG is
FUNCTION Get_Sman_Name (P_Rep_Code In Sales_Man.Reprs_Code%Type,P_Lng_no In Number) RETURN VARCHAR2 ;
FUNCTION Chk_Sman_CrLmt ( P_Rep_Code In Sales_Man.Reprs_Code%Type , P_Lng_no In Number ) Return Varchar2;
FUNCTION Get_Acode (P_Rep_code In SALES_MAN.Reprs_Code%TYPE) Return VARCHAR2 ;
End IAS_SMAN_PKG;
CREATE OR REPLACE Package Body IAS_SMAN_PKG is
FUNCTION Chk_Sman_CrLmt ( P_Rep_Code In Sales_Man.Reprs_Code%Type , P_Lng_no In Number ) Return Varchar2 Is
V_CrLmt Number;
V_Blnc_Amt Number;
V_Msg Varchar2(3000)
If P_Rep_Code Is Not Null Then
Select Cr_Lmt InTo V_CrLmt From Sales_Man Where Reprs_Code=P_Rep_Code And RowNum<=1;
V_CrLmt := Null;
If V_CrLmt Is Not Null Then
Select Sum(Amt) InTo V_Blnc_Amt From Ias_Post_Dtl Where Rep_Code=P_Rep_Code AND C_CODE IS NOT NULL;
V_Blnc_Amt := 0;
If Nvl(V_Blnc_Amt,0)>0 And Nvl(V_Blnc_Amt,0)>Nvl(V_CrLmt,0) Then
V_Msg := Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Msg(P_Lng_no,1965)||' '||V_CrLmt||
Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Msg(P_Lng_no,1967)||' '||Round(Nvl(V_Blnc_Amt,0),2)||
Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Msg(P_Lng_no,676)||' '||Round(abs(V_CrLmt-Nvl(V_Blnc_Amt,0)),2)||' , '||
Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(P_Lng_no,3604)||' '||Abs(Round(((nvl(V_CrLmt,0)-Nvl(V_Blnc_Amt,0))
/nvl(V_CrLmt,0))*100,2));
Return(V_Msg);
END Chk_Sman_CrLmt;
--##--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------##--
FUNCTION Get_Sman_Name (P_Rep_Code In Sales_Man.Reprs_Code%Type,P_Lng_no In Number) RETURN VARCHAR2 Is
V_Name Sales_Man.Reprs_Code%Type;
Select Decode(P_Lng_no,1,Reprs_A_Name,nvl(Reprs_E_Name,Reprs_A_Name))
where Reprs_code=P_Rep_Code
And RowNum<=1 ;
RETURN(v_name);
RETURN(Null);
End Get_Sman_Name ;
FUNCTION Get_Acode (P_Rep_code In SALES_MAN.Reprs_Code%TYPE) Return VARCHAR2 Is
v_ac varchar2(30);
select R_A_CODE
Into v_ac
From SALES_MAN
where Reprs_Code=P_Rep_code ;
return(v_ac);
return(Null);
End Get_Acode ;

CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY Ys_Itm_Lov_Pkg AS
-----------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE Clr_Itm_Lst Is
V_Slct_Itms.Delete;
P_Itm_Inx In OUT NUMBER ) Is
If P_Itm_Inx Is Null And Not V_Slct_Itms.Exists(V_Slct_Itms.Count+1) Then
P_Itm_Inx := V_Slct_Itms.Count+1;
V_Slct_Itms(P_Itm_Inx).I_Code := P_I_Code ;
V_Slct_Itms(P_Itm_Inx).Itm_Unt := P_Itm_Unt ;
V_Slct_Itms(P_Itm_Inx).W_Code := P_W_Code ;
V_Slct_Itms(P_Itm_Inx).Expire_Date := P_Expire_Date ;
V_Slct_Itms(P_Itm_Inx).Batch_No := P_Batch_No;
V_Slct_Itms(P_Itm_Inx).I_Price := P_I_Price ;
ElsIf V_Slct_Itms.Exists (P_Itm_Inx) Then
V_Slct_Itms.Delete (P_Itm_Inx);
PROCEDURE Deslct_Itm (P_Itm_Inx In Number) Is
If V_Slct_Itms.Exists (P_Itm_Inx) Then
FUNCTION POP_SLCT_DATA RETURN RCRD_TBL PIPELINED
PRAGMA AUTONOMOUS_TRANSACTION;
TYPE RF_DT IS REF CURSOR;
RFC_DATA RF_DT;
DSH_FILL ITM_RCRD;
If V_Slct_Itms.Count > 0 Then
For Ndx In V_Slct_Itms.First..V_Slct_Itms.Last Loop
If V_Slct_Itms.Exists (Ndx) Then
----------------------------------------------
SELECT V_Slct_Itms(Ndx).I_Code,V_Slct_Itms(Ndx).Itm_Unt,V_Slct_Itms(Ndx).W_Code,V_Slct_Itms(Ndx).Expire_Date,V_Slct_Itms(Ndx).Batch_No ,V_Slct_Itms(Ndx).I_Price,Null,Null,Null,Null INTO V_ITM_RCRD FROM DUAL;
PIPE ROW(V_ITM_RCRD);
Raise_application_error(-20201,' Error When Fetch Data. '|| chr(13) || SqlErrm);
END POP_SLCT_DATA;
PROCEDURE Fetch_Slct_Itms ( SQL_CV IN OUT RCRD_CV) IS
OPEN SQL_CV FOR
SELECT R_Col1,
R_Col2,
R_Col3,
R_Col4,
R_Col5,
R_Col6,
R_Col7,
R_Col8,
R_Col9,
R_Col10
FROM TABLE(POP_SLCT_DATA) ;
Raise_application_error(-20202,' Error When Fetch Data. '|| chr(13) || SqlErrm);
END Fetch_Slct_Itms;
End Ys_Itm_Lov_Pkg;

CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE Ias_Dstr_Cst_Dr_Pkg as
PROCEDURE Ias_Dstr_Cst_Dr_Amt_Prc ( P_c_code In Customer.C_Code%TYPE,
P_Doc_Date In Date,
P_Aralt In Number,
P_No_Of_Decimal In Number) ;
PROCEDURE Ias_Dstr_Cst_Dr_Amt_Acy_Prc ( P_c_code In Customer.C_Code%TYPE,
End Ias_Dstr_Cst_Dr_Pkg;
CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY Ias_Dstr_Cst_Dr_Pkg as
P_No_Of_Decimal In Number) Is
CrRem Number:=0;
CrAmt Number:=0;
Cursor Cst_Dr Is Select b.C_Code,b.A_Cy,b.Bill_No,b.Doc_Type,b.Bill_Doc_Type,b.Bill_Ser,
b.i_no,Decode(A.Credit_Period,Null,B.I_Date,Decode(B.Doc_Date,Null,B.I_Date,B.Doc_Date+A.Credit_Period)) I_Date,b.i_amt,(Nvl(b.i_Amt,0)*Nvl(b.Ac_Rate,1)) I_amt_loc,b.ac_rate,b.Pj_No,b.Actv_No,b.Rcrd_No,
b.Brn_No,b.Brn_Year,b.Cmp_No,b.Brn_Usr
From customer a,Installment b
where a.c_code = b.c_code
and b.c_code = P_C_Code
and b.i_date <= Nvl(P_Doc_Date ,b.i_date)
and b.Dr_No Is Null
and ((P_User_No = 1)
Or (((P_Aralt = 1)
And Exists (
From Priv_Acc
Where U_Id = P_User_No
And A_Code = a.c_a_code
And A_Cy = b.a_cy
And Nvl(Add_Flag,0) = 1
And RowNum <=1 ))
Or ((P_Aralt = 2)
From Ias_Priv_customer
And c_code = a.c_code
And a_cy = b.a_cy
And RowNum <=1 ))))
Order By I_Date,Doc_Type,Bill_No;
Cursor Cst_Cr Is Select b.C_Code,b.Doc_Date,b.Cr_Amt Cr_Amt,Decode(nvl(b.Cr_Amt_F,0),0,1,(nvl(b.Cr_Amt,0)/nvl(b.Cr_Amt_F,0))) Ac_Rate
From customer a,Ias_Post_Dtl b
where a.c_code=b.c_code
and Nvl(Cr_Amt,0)>0
and b.doc_date <= Nvl(P_Doc_Date ,b.doc_date)
Order By b.C_Code,b.Doc_Date;
For I In Cst_Dr Loop
Insert Into Ias_Si_Dr_Dtl_Tmp ( C_Code,A_Cy,Doc_No,Doc_Type,Doc_Jv_Type,Doc_Ser,i_no,Doc_Date,
i_amt,I_amt_loc,bill_rate,Paid_Amt,paid_amt_loc,Paid_Date,Paid,Trmnl_Name,
Pj_No,Actv_No,Rcrd_No,
Brn_No,Brn_Year,Cmp_No,Brn_Usr )
Values(i.C_Code,i.A_Cy,i.Bill_No,i.Doc_Type,i.Bill_Doc_Type,i.Bill_Ser,
i.i_no,i.i_Date,i.i_amt,i.I_amt_loc,NVL(i.ac_rate,1),Null,null,Null,0,Null,
I.Pj_No,I.Actv_No,I.Rcrd_No,
i.Brn_No,i.Brn_Year,i.Cmp_No,i.Brn_Usr);
Raise_application_error(-20400,' Error When Insert InTo Ias_Si_Dr_Dtl_Tmp. '|| chr(13) || SqlErrm);
CrRem := 0;
For Cr In Cst_Cr Loop
Cursor C_Paid Is Select Doc_Ser,DOC_NO,i_no,Doc_Date,I_amt_loc,Paid_Amt_Loc,Paid_Date,Paid,c_code
From Ias_Si_Dr_Dtl_Tmp
Where nvl(paid,0)=0
And C_Code=Cr.C_code
Order By c_code,Doc_Date,Doc_Ser;
CrAmt := Cr.Cr_Amt+CrRem;
For Cp In C_Paid Loo
If CrAmt > Cp.I_amt_loc Then
CrAmt := CrAmt - Cp.I_amt_loc;
Update Ias_Si_Dr_Dtl_Tmp Set Paid_Amt_Loc = I_amt_loc,
Paid_Amt = Round((I_amt_loc/cr.ac_rate),P_No_Of_Decimal),--I_amt_loc
Paid =1,
Paid_Date =Cr.Doc_date
Where Doc_Ser = Cp.Doc_Ser
AND c_code=Cr.c_code
and i_no=cp.i_no;
--##
ElsIf CrAmt = Cp.I_amt_loc Then
CrAmt := 0;
Paid_Amt = Round((I_amt_loc/cr.ac_rate),P_No_Of_Decimal),
Paid=1,
Paid_Date=Cr.Doc_date
and c_code=cr.c_code
and i_no=cp.i_no ;
CrRem:=0;
ElsIf CrAmt < Cp.I_amt_loc Then
CrRem := CrAmt;
CrAmt:=0;
Update Ias_Si_Dr_Dtl_Tmp Set Paid_Amt_Loc = CrRem,
Paid_Amt = Round((CrRem/cr.ac_rate),P_No_Of_Decimal),
Paid_Date = Cr.Doc_date
End loop; --C_Paid
End loop; --Cst_Cr
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Cursor Cst_Dr Is Select b.C_Code,b.A_Cy,b.Bill_No,b.DOC_Date,b.Doc_Type,b.Bill_Doc_Type,b.Bill_Ser,
and b.i_date <= Nvl(P_Doc_Date,b.i_date)
Cursor Cst_Cr Is Select b.C_Code,b.Doc_Date,b.DOC_SER,b.DOC_type,b.DOC_no,Decode(b.A_cy,P_Local_Cur,b.Cr_Amt,b.Cr_Amt_f) Cr_Amt,Decode(nvl(b.Cr_Amt_F,0),0,1,(nvl(b.Cr_Amt,0)/nvl(b.Cr_Amt_F,0))) Ac_Rate
i_amt,I_amt_loc,bill_rate,Paid_Amt,paid_amt_loc,Paid_Date,Paid,bill_Date,Trmnl_Name,
i.i_no,i.i_Date,i.i_amt,i.I_amt_loc,NVL(i.ac_rate,1),Null,null,Null,0,I.i_Date,Null,
Raise_application_error(-20401,' Error When Insert InTo Ias_Si_Dr_Dtl_Tmp. '|| chr(13) || SqlErrm);
Cursor C_Paid Is Select Doc_Ser,DOC_NO,i_no,Doc_Date,I_Amt,I_amt_loc,Paid_Amt,Paid_Amt_Loc,Paid_Date,Paid,c_code
-- and i_no=Cr.i_no
For Cp In C_Paid Loop
If CrAmt > Cp.I_amt Then
CrAmt := CrAmt - Cp.I_amt;
Update Ias_Si_Dr_Dtl_Tmp Set Paid_Amt_Loc = Round((I_Amt*cr.ac_rate),P_No_Of_Decimal),
Paid_Amt = I_amt,
--Paid_Amt = I_amt,
ElsIf CrAmt = Cp.I_amt Then
ElsIf CrAmt < Cp.I_amt Then
Update Ias_Si_Dr_Dtl_Tmp Set Paid_Amt_Loc = Round((CrRem*cr.ac_rate),P_No_Of_Decimal),
Paid_Amt = CrRem,
bill_rate=Cr.ac_rate,
ENd Ias_Dstr_Cst_Dr_Pkg;

V_Apalt:=2;
--TRUNCATE TABLE IAS_VNDR_CRAGE_TMP REUSE STORAGE;

Declare Cursor C_Vnd_Bal Is

From V_Details A,Ias_Post_Dtl B

And B.V_Code =Nvl(P_v_code, B.V_Code)
And A.V_Code Is Not Null

And ((P_User_No = 1)
Or (((V_Apalt = 1)
And A_Code = A.V_A_Code
And Rownum <=1 ))
Or ((V_Apalt = 2)
And V_Code = B.V_Code
And Rownum <=1 ))))
Group By B.V_Code,B.A_Cy
Having (Sum(Dr_Amt) - Sum(Cr_Amt)< 0);
--Order By B.V_Code,B.A_Cy;
--##------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------##---
For I In C_Vnd_Bal Loop
Cursor C_Credit Is
Select B.V_Code,B.A_Cy, Doc_No, Doc_Type, Jv_Type, Doc_Ser,
Doc_Date, Nvl(Cr_Amt,0) Cr_Amt,Nvl(Cr_Amt_F,0) Cr_Amt_F, Doc_Desc,

B.Brn_No,B.Brn_Year,B.Cmp_No,B.Brn_Usr
From V_De
tails A ,Ias_Post_Dtl B
Where A.V_Code = B.V_Code
And B.V_Code = I.V_Code
And B.A_Cy = I.A_Cy
And Nvl(Cr_Amt,0)>0
Order By B.V_Code,B.A_Cy,B.Doc_Date Desc;
V_Cr :=0;
V_Crf :=0;
V_Cr_Rem :=0;
V_Crf_Rem :=0;
For J In C_Credit Loop
If I.A_Cy = V_Local_Cur Then --(1) Local
V_Cr:= V_Cr + J.Cr_Amt;
If Abs(I.Bal) >= V_Cr Then
Insert Into Ias_Vndr_Crage_Tmp( V_Code, A_Cy, Doc_No, Doc_Type, Doc_Jv_Type, Doc_Ser,
Doc_Date, Cr_Amt, Cr_Amtf, Doc_Desc,
Ref_No, Rcrd_No, Cc_Code, Cheque_Valued,Per_No,Trmnl_Name,
Brn_No,Brn_Year,Cmp_No,Brn_Usr)
Values( J.V_Code, J.A_Cy, J.Doc_No, J.Doc_Type, J.Jv_Type, J.Doc_Ser,
J.Doc_Date, J.Cr_Amt, 0, J.Doc_Desc,
J.Ref_No, J.Rcrd_No, J.Cc_Code, J.Cheque_Valued,J.Per_No,V_Trmnlname,
J.Brn_No,J.Brn_Year,J.Cmp_No,J.Brn_Usr);
If V_Cr-J.Cr_Amt = Abs(I.Bal) Then
Elsif V_Cr > Abs(I.Bal) Then
V_Cr_Rem:=(Abs(I.Bal) - (V_Cr-J.Cr_Amt));
V_Cr_Rem:=Abs(I.Bal);
Insert Into Ias_Vndr_Crage_Tmp(V_Code, A_Cy, Doc_No, Doc_Type, Doc_Jv_Type, Doc_Ser,
Values(J.V_Code, J.A
_Cy, J.Doc_No, J.Doc_Type, J.Jv_Type, J.Doc_Ser,
J.Doc_Date, V_Cr_Rem, 0,J.Doc_Desc,
Else --(1) Foreign A
V_Crf:= V_Crf+J.Cr_Amt_F;
If Abs(I.Fbal) >= V_Crf Then
J.Doc_Date, J.Cr_Amt, J.Cr_Amt_F, J.Doc_Desc,
If V_Crf-J.Cr_Amt_F = Abs(I.Fbal) Then
Elsif V_Crf > abs(I.Fbal) Then
V_Crf_Rem:=(Abs(I.Fbal) - (V_Crf-J.Cr_Amt_F));
V_Crf_Rem:=Abs(I.Fbal);
If J.Cr_Amt_F>0 Then
V_Rate:=J.Cr_Amt/J.Cr_Amt_F;
If V_Crf_Rem >0 Then
J.Doc_Date, ( V_Crf_Rem*V_Rate), V_Crf_Rem, J.Doc_Desc,
End; -- Ias_Dstr_Vndr_Cr_Amt_Prc ;
P_User_No In Number DEFAULT 1) Is
V_DrRem Number:=0;
V_DrAmt Number:=0;
V_T_Date Date ; --
:=Nvl(P_T_Date,to_char(IAS_GEN_PKG.Get_Sysdate,'DD/MM/YYYY'));
Declare Cursor Vndr_Cr Is Select b.V_Code,b.A_Cy,b.Bill_No,b.Doc_Type,b.Bill_Doc_Type,b.Bill_Ser,
b.i_no,b.i_Date,b.i_amt,(Nvl(b.i_Amt,0)*Nvl(b.Ac_Rate,1)) I_amt_loc,b.ac_rate,
From V_Details a,IAS_Installment_PI b
where a.V_code = b.V_code
and b.V_code = Nvl(P_v_code, B.V_Code)
and b.i_date <= Nvl(V_T_Date ,b.i_date)
And A_Code = a.v_a_code
And V_code = a.V_code
For I In Vndr_Cr Loop
Insert Into Ias_Pi_Dstr_Cr_Amt_Tmp ( V_Code,A_Cy,Doc_No,Doc_Type,Doc_Jv_Type,Doc_Ser,i_no,Doc_Date,
Values(i.V_Code,i.A_Cy,i.Bill_No,i.Doc_Type,i.Bill_Doc_Type,i.Bill_Ser,
Raise_application_error(-20400,' Error When Insert InTo Ias_Pi_Cr_Amt_Tmp. '|| chr(13) || SqlErrm);
Declare Cursor c_vndr is select v_code from Ias_Pi_Dstr_Cr_Amt_Tmp where v_code = Nvl(p_v_code, V_Code)
Group by v_code order by v_code;
For C_v In c_vndr Loop
V_DrRem := 0;
V_DrAmt :=0;
Declare Cursor Vndr_Dr Is Select b.V_Code,b.Doc_Date,b.Dr_Amt Dr_Amt,Decode(nvl(b.Dr_Amt_F,0),0,1,(nvl(b.Dr_Amt,0)/nvl(b.Dr_Amt_F,0))) Ac_Rate
From V_Details a,Ias_Post_Dtl b
where a.V_code=b.V_code
and Nvl(Dr_Amt,0)>0
and b.V_code = C_v.v_code-- Nvl(p_v_code, B.V_Code)
and b.doc_date <= Nvl(V_T_Date ,b.doc_date)
And A_Code = a.V_a_code
Order By b.V_Code,b.Doc_Date;
For C_Dr In Vndr_Dr Loop
Cursor C_Paid Is Select Doc_Ser,DOC_NO,i_no,Doc_Date,I_amt_loc,Paid_Amt_Loc,Paid_Date,Paid,V_code
And V_Code=C_Dr.V_code
Order By V_code,Doc_Date,Doc_Ser;
V_DrAmt := C_Dr.Dr_Amt+V_DrRem;
If V_DrAmt > Cp.I_amt_loc Then
V_DrAmt := V_DrAmt - Cp.I_amt_loc;
Update Ias_Pi_Dstr_Cr_Amt_Tmp Set Paid_Amt_Loc = I_amt_loc,
Paid_Amt = Round((I_amt_loc/C_Dr.ac_rate),P_No_Of_Decimal),--I_amt_loc
Paid_Date =C_Dr.Doc_date
And V_code=C_Dr.V_code
ElsIf V_DrAmt = Cp.I_amt_loc Then
V_DrAmt := 0;
Paid_Amt = Round((I_amt_loc/C_Dr.ac_rate),P_No_Of_Decimal),
Paid_Date=C_Dr.Doc_date
and V_code=C_Dr.V_code
V_DrRem:=0;
ElsIf V_DrAmt < Cp.I_amt_loc Then
V_DrRem := V_DrAmt;
V_DrAmt:=0;
Update Ias_Pi_Dstr_Cr_Amt_Tmp Set Paid_Amt_Loc = V_DrRem,
Paid_Amt = Round((V_DrRem/C_Dr.ac_rate),P_No_Of_Decimal),
Paid_Date = C_Dr.Doc_date
End loop; --Vndr_dr
End loop; --c_vndr
commit;
CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE Ys_Lov_Slct_Pkg AS
TYPE Data_Rcrd IS RECORD ( R_Col1 VARCHAR2(2000)) ;
TYPE T_Slct_Data IS TABLE OF Data_Rcrd Index By Binary_Integer;
V_Slct_Data T_Slct_Data;
V_Data_Rcrd Data_Rcrd;
TYPE Rcrd_Cv IS REF CURSOR RETURN Data_Rcrd;
TYPE Rcrd_Tbl IS TABLE OF Data_Rcrd;
PROCEDURE Clr_Data ;
PROCEDURE Slct_Data ( P_Col1 In Varchar2) ;
PROCEDURE Deslct_Data (P_Col1 In Varchar2);
PROCEDURE Fetch_Slct_Data ( SQL_CV IN OUT RCRD_CV);
END Ys_Lov_Slct_Pkg;
CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY Ys_Lov_Slct_Pkg AS
PROCEDURE Clr_Data Is
V_Slct_Data.Delete;
PROCEDURE Slct_Data ( P_Col1 In Varchar2) Is
V_Slct_Data(V_Slct_Data.Count+1).R_Col1 := P_Col1 ;
PROCEDURE Deslct_Data (P_Col1 In Varchar2) Is
If V_Slct_Data.Count > 0 Then
For Ndx In V_Slct_Data.First..V_Slct_Data.Last Loop
If V_Slct_Data.Exists (Ndx) Then
If V_Slct_Data(Ndx).R_Col1 = P_Col1 Then
V_Slct_Data.Delete (Ndx);
FUNCTION POP_SLCT_Data RETURN RCRD_TBL PIPELINED
PRAGMA AUTONOMOUS_TRAN
SACTION;
RFC_Data RF_DT;
DSH_FILL Data_RCRD;
SELECT V_Slct_Data(Ndx).R_Col1 INTO V_Data_Rcrd FROM DUAL;
PIPE ROW(V_Data_RCRD);
END POP_SLCT_Data;
PROCEDURE Fetch_Slct_Data ( SQL_CV IN OUT Rcrd_CV) IS
SELECT R_Col1
FROM TABLE(POP_SLCT_Data) ;
END Fetch_Slct_Data;
End Ys_Lov_Slct_Pkg;
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION GET_VER_CODE_NAME( P_Lng_no In Number DEFAULT 1,
P_CLM_NAM IN VARCHAR2,
P_CLM_VAL IN VARCHAR2,
P_Ac_Dtl_Typ IN NUMBER DEFAULT 0
)RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
V_Name VARCHAR2(250);
P_CLM VARCHAR2(60);
P_CLM :=''||P_CLM_NAM||'';
IF UPPER(P_CLM)='A_CODE' THEN
V_Name:=IAS_Acode_Pkg.Get_A_Name(P_CLM_VAL,P_Lng_no);
Elsif UPPER(P_CLM)='C_CODE' THEN
V_Name:=IAS_Cst_Pkg.Get_C_Name(P_CLM_VAL,P_Lng_no);
Elsif UPPER(P_CLM)='V_CODE' THEN
V_Name:=IAS_Vndr_Pkg.Get_v_Name(P_CLM_VAL,P_Lng_no);
Elsif UPPER(P_CLM)='CASH_NO' THEN
V_Name:=IAS_CshBnk_Pkg.Get_CB_Name (1,P_CLM_VAL,P_Lng_no);
Elsif UPPER(P_CLM)='BANK_NO' THEN
V_Name:=IAS_CshBnk_Pkg.Get_CB_Name (2,P_CLM_VAL,P_Lng_no);
Elsif UPPER(P_CLM)='EMP_NO' THEN
V_Name:=YS_EMP_PKG.Get_EMP_NM (P_CLM_VAL,P_Lng_no);
Elsif UPPER(P_CLM)='CC_CODE' THEN
V_Name:=IAS_Cc_Code_Pkg.Get_Cc_Name(P_CLM_VAL,P_Lng_no);
Elsif UPPER(P_CLM)='PJ_NO' THEN
V_Name:=IAS_PJ_Pkg.Get_PJ_Name(P_CLM_VAL,P_Lng_no);
Elsif UPPER(P_CLM)='ACTV_NO' THEN
V_Name:=IAS_Actv_Pkg.Get_Actv_Name(P_CLM_VAL,P_Lng_no);
Elsif UPPER(P_CLM)='BRN_NO' THEN
V_Name:=IAS_BRN_PKG.Get_Br_Nm(P_CLM_VAL,P_Lng_no);
Elsif UPPER(P_CLM)='REP_CODE' THEN
Select Decode(P_Lng_no,1,Nvl(REPRS_A_NAME,REPRS_E_NAME) ,Nvl(REPRS_E_NAME,REPRS_A_NAME) )
InTo V_Name
From Sales_man
Where REPRS_CODE=P_CLM_VAL And RowNum<=1;
Elsif UPPER(P_CLM)='COL_NO' THEN
Select Decode(P_Lng_no,1,Nvl(COL_NAME,COL_E_NAME) ,Nvl(COL_E_NAME,COL_NAME) )
From COLLERCTOR
Where COL_NO=P_CLM_VAL And RowNum<=1;
Elsif UPPER(P_CLM)='R_CODE' THEN
Select Decode(P_Lng_no,1,Nvl(R_A_NAME,R_E_NAME), Nvl(R_E_NAME,R_A_NAME) )
From REGIONS
Where R_CODE=P_CLM_VAL And RowNum<=1;
Elsif UPPER(P_CLM)='CNTRY_NO' THEN
Select Decode(P_lng_no,1,Nvl(CNTRY_A_NAME,CNTRY_E_NAME),Nvl(CNTRY_E_NAME,CNTRY_A_NAME))
From CNTRY
Where CNTRY_NO=P_CLM_VAL And RowNum<=1;
Elsif UPPER(P_CLM)='PROV_NO' THEN
Select Decode(P_lng_no,1,Nvl(PROV_A_NAME,PROV_E_NAME),Nvl(PROV_E_NAME,PROV_A_NAME))
From IAS_PROVINCES
Where PROV_NO=P_CLM_VAL And RowNum<=1;
Elsif UPPER(P_CLM)='CITY_NO' THEN
Select Decode(P_lng_no,1,Nvl(CITY_A_NAME,CITY_E_NAME),Nvl(C
ITY_E_NAME,CITY_A_NAME))
From CITIES
Where CITY_NO=P_CLM_VAL And RowNum<=1;
Elsif UPPER(P_CLM)='CMP_NO' THEN
Select Decode(P_lng_no,1,Nvl(CMP_LNAME,CMP_FNAME),Nvl(CMP_FNAME,CMP_LNAME))
Where CMP_NO=P_CLM_VAL And RowNum<=1;
Elsif UPPER(P_CLM)='LC_NO' THEN
Select LC_DESC
From LC_MASTER
Where LC_NO=P_CLM_VAL And RowNum<=1;
Elsif UPPER(P_CLM)='ZONE_NO' THEN
Select Decode(P_Lng_no,1,Nvl(ZONE_L_NM,ZONE_F_NM), Nvl(ZONE_F_NM,ZONE_L_NM) )
From S_ZONE
Where ZONE_NO=P_CLM_VAL And RowNum<=1;
Elsif UPPER(P_CLM)='AC_CODE_DTL' THEN
--P_Cb_Type
If P_Ac_Dtl_Typ in(1,2) then
V_Name:=IAS_CshBnk_Pkg.Get_CB_Name (P_Ac_Dtl_Typ,P_CLM_VAL,P_Lng_no);
ElsIf P_Ac_Dtl_Typ=3 Then
ElsIf P_Ac_Dtl_Typ=4 Then
ElsIf P_Ac_Dtl_Typ =7 Then
V_Name:=YS_EMP_Pkg.Get_EMP_NM(P_CLM_VAL,P_Lng_no);
-- YS_AC_DTL_PKG.GET_AC_DTL_NM(D.AC_CODE_DTL,D.A_CODE,D.AC_DTL_TYP,:Lang_No) ,
V_Name:=NULL;
END GET_VER_CODE_NAME;
PACKAGE DATE_CNVRTR_PKG IS
FUNCTION GREGORIAN_TO_HIJRI(P_DATE DATE) RETURN DATE;
FUNCTION HIJRI_TO_GREGORIAN(P_DATE DATE) RETURN DATE;

CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY DATE_CNVRTR_PKG IS
--##---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------##--
FUNCTION INTPART(FLOATNUM FLOAT) RETURN FLOAT IS
IF (FLOATNUM< -0.0000001) THEN
RETURN CEIL(FLOATNUM-0.0000001);
RETURN FLOOR(FLOATNUM+0.0000001) ;
END INTPART ;
FUNCTION GREGORIAN_TO_HIJRI(P_DATE DATE) RETURN DATE IS
JD NUMBER;
L NUMBER;
N NUMBER;
J NUMBER;
D NUMBER:= TO_CHAR(P_DATE,'DD');
M NUMBER:= TO_CHAR(P_DATE,'MM');
Y NUMBER:= TO_CHAR(P_DATE,'YYYY');
IF P_DATE IS NULL THEN
IF ((Y>1582)OR((Y=1582)AND(M>10))OR((Y=1582)AND(M=10)AND(D>14))) THEN
JD:=INTPART((1461*(Y+4800+INTPART((M-14)/12)))/4)+INTPART((367*(M-2-12*(INTPART((M-14)/12))))/12)-
INTPART( (3* (INTPART( (Y+4900+ INTPART( (M-14)/12) )/100) ) ) /4)+D-32075;
JD := 367*Y-INTPART((7*(Y+5001+INTPART((M-9)/7)))/4)+INTPART((275*M)/9)+D+1729777;
L:=JD-1948440+10632;
N:=INTPART((L-1)/10631);
L:=L-10631*N+354;
J:=(INTPART((10985-L)/5316))*(INTPART((50*L)/17719))+(INTPART(L/5670))*(INTPART((43*L)/15238));
L:=L-(INTPART((30-J)/15))*(INTPART((17719*J)/50))-(INTPART(J/16))*(INTPART((15238*J)/43))+29;
M:=INTPART((24*L)/709);
D:=L-INTPART((709*M)/24);
Y:=30*N+J-30;
RETURN TO_DATE(LPAD(D,2,'0') || LPAD(M,2,'0')|| LPAD(Y,4,'0'),'DDMMYYYY');
END GREGORIAN_TO_HIJRI;
FUNCTION HIJRI_TO_GREGORIAN(P_DATE DATE) RETURN DATE IS
I NUMBER;
K NUMBER;
Y NUMBER:= TO_CHAR(P_
DATE,'YYYY');
JD:=INTPART((11*Y+3)/30)+354*Y+30*M-INTPART((M-1)/2)+D+1948440-385;
IF (JD> 2299160 ) THEN
L:=JD+68569;
N:=INTPART((4*L)/146097);
L:=L-INTPART((146097*N+3)/4);
I:=INTPART((4000*(L+1))/1461001);
L:=L-INTPART((1461*I)/4)+31;
J:=INTPART((80*L)/2447);
D:=L-INTPART((2447*J)/80);
L:=INTPART(J/11);
M:=J+2-12*L;
Y:=100*(N-49)+I+L;
J:=JD+1402;
K:=INTPART((J-1)/1461);
L:=J-1461*K;
N:=INTPART((L-1)/365)-INTPART(L/1461);
I:=L-365*N+30;
J:=INTPART((80*I)/2447);
D:=I-INTPART((2447*J)/80);
I:=INTPART(J/11);
M:=J+2-12*I;
Y:=4*K+N+I-4716;
END HIJRI_TO_GREGORIAN ;
FUNCTION GET_MNTH_NM (P_DATE DATE,P_LNG_NO NUMBER DEFAULT 1) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
V_Mnth_Nm Varchar2(30);
V_Lng_Nm Varchar2(99):='ARABIC';
If P_Lng_No =1 Then
V_Lng_Nm:='ARABIC';
Elsif P_Lng_No =2 Then
V_Lng_Nm:='AMERICAN';
Elsif P_Lng_No =3 Then
V_Lng_Nm:='FRENCH';
Elsif P_Lng_No =4 Then
V_Lng_Nm:='TURKISH';
Elsif P_Lng_No =5 Then
V_Lng_Nm:='GERMAN';
Select To_Char(P_Date,'MONTH','NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE='||V_Lng_Nm)
Into V_Mnth_Nm
Return V_Mnth_Nm;
END GET_MNTH_NM ;
END DATE_CNVRTR_PKG ;

PROCEDURE Post_Sales_Coupon(P_Pst_Typ In NUMBER Default 0
,P_Brn_No In S_BRN.BRN_NO%TYPE Default Null ) Is
Decode (Mb.A_Cy,V_loc_cur_Code,0,Nvl (Mb.Doc_Amt,0)) Doc_Amtf,
Decode (Mb.A_Cy,V_loc_cur_Code,0,Nvl (Mb.Cheque_Amt, 0)) Cheque_Amtf,
Decode(Mb.Bill_Doc_Type,4,Mb.C_Code,1,Mb.Cash_No,2,Mb.Cash_No) Ac_Code_Dtl,
Where nvl(Mb.Doc_Pst,0)= Decode(Nvl(P_Pst_Typ,0),0,0,nvl(Mb.Doc_Pst,0))
and Mb.doc_ser = nvl(P_doc_srl, Mb.doc_ser)
and Mb.Brn_No = nvl(P_Brn_No,Mb.Brn_No)
and Exists (Select 1 from S_BRN_USR_PRIV Prv
Where Prv.U_Id = V_Usr_No
and Prv.Brn_No = Mb.Brn_No
and Prv.Add_Flag = 1
If Nvl (Chk_Exist_Doc_Fnc (M_Cv.Doc_Type,M_Cv.Doc_Ser),0) = 0 Then -- (Begin Chk Exist) --
P_Unpost_U_Id => M_Cv.Unpost_U_Id,
P_Post_Type => P_Pst_Typ);
Ias_Posting_Pkg.Insrt_Post_Mst (P_Doc_Type => M_Cv.Doc_Type ,
P_Ref_No => M_Cv.Ref_No
V_Count:=V_Count+1;
P_AC_CODE_DTL => M_Cv.AC_CODE_DTL ,
P_AC_DTL_TYP => M_Cv.AC_DTL_TYP ,
P_Rcrd_No => V_Count ,

From IAS_V_USR_AR_PRV p , Ias_V_Ar_Types m
Where p.ar_type = m.ar_type
ElsIF P_Tbl_Nm = 'IAS_V_USR_COLLECTOR_PRV' Then
,p.col_no P_code
,p.col_nm P_code_nm
From IAS_V_USR_COLLECTOR_PRV p , Collerctor m
Where p.col_no = m.col_no
ElsIF P_Tbl_Nm = 'IAS_V_USR_SALES_MAN_PRV' Then
,p.rep_code P_code
,p.sales_man_nm P_code_nm
From IAS_V_USR_SALES_MAN_PRV p , Sales_Man m
Where p.rep_code = m.reprs_code
END Ftch_Inpt_Ars_Prv;
IF P_Tbl_Nm = 'IAS_V_USR_DTS_OPTN_PRV' Then
,p.Optn_No P_code
,p.Optn_Nm P_code_nm
From IAS_V_USR_DTS_OPTN_PRV p , Dts_Optn m
Where p.Optn_No = m.Optn_No
END Ftch_Inpt_Dts_Prv;
IF P_Tbl_Nm = 'HRS_V_USR_ARTCL_PRV' Then
,p.Artcl_no P_code
,p.Artcl_nm P_code_nm
From HRS_V_USR_ARTCL_PRV p , HRS_ARTCL m
Where p.Artcl_no = m.Artcl_no
ELSIF P_Tbl_Nm = 'S_V_EMP_PRV' Then
,p.EMPNO_HRCHYNO P_code
,p.EMPNM_HRCHYNM P_code_nm
From S_V_EMP_PRV p
Where 1 = 1
ElsIF P_Tbl_Nm = 'S_V_HRCHY_PRV' Then
From S_V_HRCHY_PRV p
END Ftch_Inpt_Hrs_Prv;

--##=============================================================================================================##--
edure Insrt_Usr_Prv_Prc ( P_Usr_No In User_R.U_Id%Type ,
P_Rcrd_Src In Varchar2 Default 0 ) Is
If P_Tbl_Nm = 'IAS_V_USR_WC_PRV' Then
Merge Into Privilege_Wh P
Using (Select U.U_Id,M.W_Code From User_R U,Warehouse_Details M
Where U.U_Id=Nvl(P_Usr_No_Slct,U.U_Id) And M.W_Code=Nvl(P_Val_Code1,M.W_Code)) S
On (P.U_Id=S.U_Id And P.W_Code=S.W_Code)
When Matched Then
Update Set Add_Flag=Substr(P_Prv,1,1),View_Flag=Substr(P_Prv,2,1)
Delete Where (Add_Flag=0 And View_Flag=0)
When Not Matched Then
Insert ( U_Id,W_Code,Add_Flag,View_Flag,Ad_U_Id,Ad_Date)
Values (Decode(P_Usr_No_Slct,Null,S.U_Id,P_Usr_No_Slct),S.W_Code,Decode(P_Usr_No_Slct,Null,Decode(S.U_Id,P_Usr_No,1,0),Substr(P_Prv,1,1)),
Decode(P_Usr_No_Slct,Null,Decode(S.U_Id,P_Usr_No,1,0),Substr(P_Prv,2,1)),
P_Usr_No,Sysdate )
Where (Substr(P_Prv,1,1)=1 Or Substr(P_Prv,2,1)=1);
Raise_Application_Error(-20003,'Err. View. User Wareouse Privilege= '||Sqlerrm);
ElsIf P_Tbl_Nm = 'IAS_V_USR_ACTIVITY_PRV' Then
Merge Into Ias_Priv_Actvty P
Using (Select U.U_Id,M.Actv_No From User_R U,Ias_Actvty M
Where U.U_Id=Nvl(P_Usr_No_Slct,U.U_Id) And M.Actv_No=Nvl(P_Val_Code1,M.Actv_No)) S
On (P.U_Id=S.U_Id And P.Actv_No=S.Actv_No)
Insert ( U_Id,Actv_No,Add_Flag,View_Flag,Ad_U_Id,Ad_Date)
Values (Decode(P_Usr_No_Slct,Null,S.U_Id,P_Usr_No_Slct),S.Actv_No,Decode(P_Usr_No_Slct,Null,Decode(S.U_Id,P_Usr_No,1,0),Substr(P_Prv,1,1)),
Raise_Application_Error(-20003,'Err. View. User Activity Privilege= '||Sqlerrm);
ElsIf P_Tbl_Nm = 'IAS_V_USR_BNK_PRV' Then
If P_Rcrd_Src = 1 Then
If P_Prv = '00' Then
Delete Priv_Cash
Where Cash_No = P_Val_Code1
And A_Cy = P_Val_Code2
And Cash_Type = 2
And U_Id = P_Usr_No_Slct ;
Raise_Application_Error(-20001,'Err. Del. User Bank Privilege = '||Sqlerrm);
Update Priv_Cash
Set Add_Flag = Substr(P_Prv,1,1) ,
View_Flag = Substr(P_Prv,2,1)
And U_Id = P_Usr_No_Slct;
Raise_Application_Error(-20002,'Err. Upd. User Bank Privilege = '||Sqlerrm);
Insert Into Priv_Cash ( U_Id,
Ad_Date)
Select Decode(P_Usr_No_Slct,Null,A.U_Id,P_Usr_No_Slct),
B.Bank_No,
B.A_Cy ,
Decode(P_Usr_No_Slct,Null,Decode(A.U_Id,P_Usr_No,1,0),Substr(P_Prv,1,1)),
Decode(P_Usr_No_Slct,Null,Decode(A.U_Id,P_Usr_No,1,0),Substr(P_Prv,2,1)),
Sysdate
From User_R A , Ias_Cash_At_Bank_Dtl B
Where B.Bank_No = P_Val_Code1
And B.A_CY = P_Val_Code2
And A.U_Id = Decode ( P_Usr_No_Slct,Null,P_Usr_No, P_Usr_No_Slct ) ;
Raise_Application_Error(-20003,'Err. View. User Bank Privilege= '||Sqlerrm);
ElsIf P_Tbl_Nm = 'IAS_V_USR_CSH_PRV' Then
And Cash_Type = 1
Raise_Application_Error(-20001,'Err. Del. User Cash Privilege = '||Sqlerrm);
Raise_Application_Error(-20002,'Err. Upd. User Cash Privilege = '||Sqlerrm);
B.Cash_No,
B.A_Cy,
From User_R A , Ias_Cash_In_Hand_Dtl B
Where B.Cash_No = P_Val_Code1
Raise_Application_Error(-20003,'Err. View. User Cash Privilege= '||Sqlerrm);
ElsIf P_Tbl_Nm = 'IAS_V_USR_BRN_PRV' Then
Merge Into S_Brn_Usr_Priv P
Using (Select U.U_Id,M.Brn_No From User_R U,S_Brn M
Where U.U_Id=Nvl(P_Usr_No_Slct,U.U_Id) And M.Brn_No=Nvl(P_Val_Code1,M.Brn_No)) S
On (P.U_Id=S.U_Id And P.Brn_No=S.Brn_No)
Update Set Add_Flag=Substr(P_Prv,1,1),View_Flag=Substr(P_Prv,2,1),Fill_Flag=Substr(P_Prv,3,1)
Insert ( U_Id,Brn_No,Add_Flag,View_Flag,Fill_Flag,Ad_U_Id,Ad_Date)
Values (Decode(P_Usr_No_Slct,Null,S.U_Id,P_Usr_No_Slct),S.Brn_No,
Decode(P_Usr_No_Slct,Null,Decode(S.U_Id,P_Usr_No,1,0),Substr(P_Prv,1,1)),
Decode(P_Usr_No_Slct,Null,Decode(S.U_Id,P_Usr_No,1,0),Substr(P_Prv,3,1)),
Raise_Application_Error(-20003,'Err. View. User Branch Privilege= '||Sqlerrm);
ElsIf P_Tbl_Nm = 'IAS_V_USR_COLLECTOR_PRV' Then
Merge Into Ias_Priv_Collectors P
Using (Select U.U_Id,M.Col_No From User_R U,Collerctor M
Where U.U_Id=Nvl(P_Usr_No_Slct,U.U_Id) And M.Col_No=Nvl(P_Val_Code1,M.Col_No)) S
On (P.U_Id=S.U_Id And P.Col_No=S.Col_No)
Insert ( U_Id,Col_No,Add_Flag,View_Flag,Ad_U_Id,Ad_Date)

V_Whr_Chk Varchar2(4000);
------------------------------------------------------------------
If P_Tbl_Nm Is Not Null Then
If P_Fld_Nm1 Is Not Null And P_Fld_Val1 Is Not Null Then

If P_Fld_Nm3 Is Not Null And P_Fld_Val3 Is Not Null Then
V_Whr := V_Whr|| ' And '||P_Fld_Nm3||'='''||P_Fld_Val3||'''';

If P_Fld_Nm6 Is Not Null And P_Fld_Val6 Is Not Null Then
V_Whr := V_Whr|| ' And '||P_Fld_Nm6||'='''||P_Fld_Val6||'''';

END Get_Sys_Sq;

ELSIF I.DOC_TYP = 53 AND I.ALRT_FLG <> 0 THEN -- SALES ORDER
INSRT_OUT_BILL_ALRT ( P_DOC_SRL => P_DOC_SRL);
ELSIF I.DOC_TYP = 54 AND I.ALRT_FLG <> 0 THEN -- WORK ORDER
INSRT_MNT_ALRT ( P_DOC_SRL => P_DOC_SRL );

and ( nvl(A.Trns_Typ,0) = DECODE(Sign(P_AMT),-1,2,1) Or nvl(A.Trns_typ,0) = 0)
and nvl(A.Pst_Typ,1) = DECODE(A.Pst_Typ,2,A.Pst_Typ,P_Doc_Pst)
and A.a_code = P_A_CODE;
If Abs(P_AMT) >= Abs(i.blnc_amt) and P_AMT <> 0 and (i.Mobile_no Is Not Null Or i.E_Mail Is Not Null ) Then
IF P_AMT_F <> 0 THEN
V_AMT :=P_AMT_F ;
V_AMT :=P_AMT;
IF P_AMT >= 0 Then -- DEBIT
V_DSC := '
V_MSG_TXT:= P_A_CY ||' '||V_AMT||' = '||V_DSC||' '||i.a_name||' '||ias_gen_pkg.get_prompt (G_Lng_no,2244);
P_LNG_NO => G_Lng_NO,
P_MSG_TYP => 3, -- ACCNT MOVEMTN
P_MSG_TXT => V_MSG_TXT,
P_MOBILE_NO => i.Mobile_no,
P_E_MAIL => i.E_Mail,
P_SUBJCT_MAIL => i.Subjct_Mail,
P_DOC_TYP => P_Doc_Typ,
P_DOC_SRL => P_Doc_Srl,
P_AD_DATE => P_Ad_Date,
P_CMP_NO => NVL(P_CMP_NO,G_CMP_NO),
P_BRN_NO => NVL(P_BRN_NO,G_BRN_NO),
P_BRN_USR => G_BRN_USR,
P_BRN_YEAR => G_BRN_YEAR );
END CHK_ACCNT_MOVMNT;
PROCEDURE CHK_CSTMR_BLNC IS
V_Y_CLOSE Number;
V_MSG_TXT Varchar2(4000);
IF G_GET_CST_ALRT = 1 THEN -- (1) USE GET_CST_BLNC
Select NVL(YR_CLS,0)
Into V_Y_Close
From S_PRD_MST;
If V_Y_Close = 0 THEN --AND nvl(V_Max_Upd_Post_Date,'0') <> nvl(V_Max_Post_Date,'0') Then
Select 1 Into V_Cnt From IAS_CSTMR_MSG
where nvl(INACTV,0) = 0
If V_Cnt > 0 Then
Cursor bl_cv Is Select A.c_code,A.Mobile_no,A.E_MAIL,nvl(A.Mov_Typ,1) Mov_Typ, nvl(A.Send_Typ,1) Send_Typ,nvl(A.blnc_amt,0) blnc_amt,
nvl(A.Trns_Typ,0) Trns_Typ, Decode(G_lng_no,1,C.CMP_LNAME,nvl(C.CMP_FNAME,C.CMP_LNAME) ) Subjct_Mail,
Round(Sum(nvl(B.amt,0)),2) Balance
From IAS_CSTMR_MSG A, Ias_Post_Dtl B , S_CMPNY C
Where A.c_code = B.c_code
and nvl(A.Inactv,0) = 0
and nvl(A.Mov_Typ,1) = 1 -- balance
and nvl(Doc_Post,0) = Decode( A.Pst_Typ, 2,nvl(Doc_Post,0),A.Pst_Typ)
group by A.c_code,A.Mobile_no ,A.E_MAIL,nvl(A.Mov_Typ,1), nvl(A.Send_Typ,1),nvl(A.blnc_amt,0),
nvl(A.Trns_Typ,0),Decode(G_lng_no,1,C.CMP_LNAME,nvl(C.CMP_FNAME,C.CMP_LNAME) )
Order by A.c_code;
ElsIf i.Trns_Typ = 1 and i.Balance > 0 Then -- Dr
--If i.Mobile_no Is Not Null OR i.E_MAIL Is Not Null Then
If v_amt <> -1 and Abs(v_amt) >= Abs(i.blnc_amt) and (i.Mobile_no Is Not Null Or i.E_Mail Is No
t Null ) Then
If i.Balance > 0 Then
V_MSG_TXT:= IAS_GEN_PKG.GET_LOCAL_CUR||' '||i.Balance||' = '||ias_gen_pkg.get_prompt (G_Lng_no,2494)||' '||Ias_Cst_Pkg.Get_c_name(i.c_code,G_Lng_No);
ElsIf i.Balance < 0 Then
V_MSG_TXT:= IAS_GEN_PKG.GET_LOCAL_CUR||' '||Abs(i.Balance)||' = '||ias_gen_pkg.get_prompt (G_Lng_no,2493)||' '||Ias_Cst_Pkg.Get_c_name(i.c_code,G_Lng_No);
V_MSG_TXT:= IAS_GEN_PKG.GET_LOCAL_CUR||' '||i.Balance||' = '||ias_gen_pkg.get_prompt (G_Lng_
no,2599)||' '||Ias_Cst_Pkg.Get_c_name(i.c_code,G_Lng_No);
=> 10, -- CST BALANCE
End If; -- (1)
END CHK_CSTMR_BLNC;
--GET_PRMTR;
--IF G_GET_CST_ALRT = 1 THEN -- USE GET_CST_ALRT
Cursor bl_cv Is Select A.c_code,
Decode(G_lng_no,1,B.C_A_NAME,nvl(B.C_E_NAME,B.C_A_NAME)) C_NAME,
nvl(A.blnc_amt,0) blnc_amt,nvl(A.Trns_Typ,0) Trns_Typ,nvl(A.Send_Typ,1) Send_Typ,
nvl(A.Mov_Typ,1) Mov_Typ,A.Mobile_no ,A.E_MAIL ,
Decode(G_lng_no,1,C.CMP_LNAME,nvl(C.CMP_FNAME,C.CMP_LNAME) ) Subjct_Mail
From IAS_CSTMR_MSG A, CUSTOMER B , S_CMPNY C
Where A.c_code
= B.c_code
and nvl(A.Mov_Typ,1) = 2 -- Cst. Movement
and nvl(A.Pst_Typ,1) = DECODE(A.Pst_Typ,2,nvl(A.Pst_Typ,1),P_Doc_Pst)
and ( P_DOC_TYP In ( Select doc_typ from s_doc_typ_msg where nvl(inactv,0) = 0 ) Or P_DOC_TYP Is Null)
and A.c_code = P_C_CODE;
V_MSG_TXT:= P_A_CY ||' '||V_AMT||' = '||V_DSC||' '||i.c_name||' '||ias_gen_pkg.get_prompt (G_Lng_no,2244);
P_MSG_TYP => 11, -- CST MOVEMTN
=> P_Doc_Typ,
=> P_Doc_Srl,
=> P_Ad_Date,
=> NVL(P_CMP_NO,G_CMP_NO),
=> NVL(P_BRN_NO,G_BRN_NO),
-- End If; --end cnt
--End If; -- END GET_CST_ALRT
END CHK_CSTMR_MOVMNT;
PROCEDURE CHK_PYMNT_DUE_CHQ IS
V_MSG_TXT VARCHAR2(4000);
V_SqlStr VARCHAR2(2000);
V_SqlStr:=' Select count(*)
From voucher_detail vd
Where voucher_type = 2
and nvl(vd.Cheque_Valued,0) In (0,3)
and vd.value_date Is Not Null
and to_date(vd.value_date) - (to_date(Ias_gen_pkg.Get_sysdate,''DD/MM/RRRR'')) between 0 and '||G_PRD_ALRT_PYMNT_DUE_CHQ||' ';
IF G_USR_NO IS NOT NULL THEN
V_SqlStr:=V_SqlStr||' and ( G_USR_NO IS NULL OR Exists ( select 1 from priv_cash
where u_id= G_USR_NO
and cash_no=vd.cash_no
and a_cy=vd.a_cy
and Cash_Type =2
and view_flag =1
and RowNum<=1) )';
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE V_SqlStr Into V_Cnt;
IF V_Cnt > 0 Then
V_MSG_TXT:=Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(G_Lng_No,976)||' '|| G_PRD_ALRT_PYMNT_DUE_CHQ ||' '||Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(G_Lng_No,971)||' '||Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(G_Lng_No,2585)||' = '||V_Cnt||' '||Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(G_Lng_No,154);
Cursor Mob_cv Is Select A.MOBILE_NO , A.E_MAIL , Decode(G_lng_no,1,C.CMP_LNAME,nvl(C.CMP_FNAME,C.CMP_LNAME) ) Subjct_Mail
From S_CODE_SEND_MSG A , S_CMPNY C
Where A.CODE_TYP = 1 -- Payment Cheq
and nvl(A.inactv,0) = 0;
--Order by A.a_code;
For i in Mob_cv Loop
=> 5, -- PAYMENT CHEQ
=> i.MOBILE_NO,
END CHK_PYMNT_DUE_CHQ ;

PROCEDURE INSRT_SO_ALRT ( P_DOC_SRL IN NUMBER) IS
V_ALRT_FLG NUMBER:=0;
IF P_DOC_SRL IS NOT NULL THEN
CURSOR SO_CV IS
SELECT (GET_MSG_TXT_FNC(D.Msg_Txt||' and d.order_ser = '||A.order_ser)) MSG_TXT , --(A.A_DESC||' '||Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(G_Lng_No,343)||' '||A.ORDER_NO) MSG_TXT
B.C_MOBILE MOBILE_NO ,B.C_E_MAIL E_MAIL,D.SEND_TYP,
Decode(G_lng_no,1,C.CMP_LNAME,nvl(C.CMP_FNAME,C.CMP_LNAME)) Subjct_Mail, A.AD_DATE , A.CMP_NO , A.BRN_NO ,A.BRN_USR,A.BRN_YEAR
FROM SALES_ORDER A, CUSTOMER B , S_CMPNY C , S_DOC_MSG_ALRT D
WHERE ORDER_SER = P_DOC_SRL
AND A.C_CODE = B.C_CODE
AND A.CMP_NO = C.CMP_NO
AND A.C_CODE IS NOT NULL
AND B.SEND_MSG = 1
AND D.DOC_TYP = 53
AND NVL(D.ALRT_FLG,0) <> 0
AND NVL(A.APPROVED,0) = DECODE (D.ALRT_FLG,2,1,NVL(A.APPROVED,0))
AND (B.C_MOBILE IS NOT NULL OR B.C_E_MAIL IS NOT NULL )
FOR I IN SO_CV LOOP
P_MSG_MTHD_SEND => I.SEND_TYP,
P_MSG_TYP => 20, -- SALES_ORDER
P_MSG_TXT => I.MSG_TXT,
=> I.MOBILE_NO,
=> I.E_MAIL,
=> I.Subjct_Mail,
=> 53,
=> P_DOC_SRL,
=> I.AD_DATE,
=> I.CMP_NO,
=> I.BRN_NO,
=> I.BRN_USR,
=> I.BRN_YEAR );
END INSRT_SO_ALRT;
PROCEDURE INSRT_MNT_ALRT ( P_DOC_SRL IN NUMBER ) IS
CURSOR WO_CV IS
SELECT (GET_MSG_TXT_FNC(D.Msg_Txt||' and d.Doc_ser = '||A.Doc_ser)) MSG_TXT ,
--(A.DOC_DESC||' '||Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(G_Lng_No,2084)||' '||A.DOC_NO) MSG_TXT ,
B.C_MOBILE MOBILE_NO,B.C_E_MAIL E_MAIL,D.SEND_TYP,
Decode(G_lng_no,1,C.CMP_LNAME,nvl(C.CMP_FNAME,C.CMP_LNAME) ) Subjct_Mail, A.AD_DATE, A.CMP_NO , A.BRN_NO , A.BRN_USR , A.BRN_YEAR
FROM IAS
_RECEIPT_DOC A, CUSTOMER B , S_CMPNY C ,S_DOC_MSG_ALRT D
WHERE DOC_SER = P_DOC_SRL
AND (A.I_READY = 1 OR A.APPRV_MNTN_FLG = 1 OR A.CANNOT_MAINT = 1)
AND D.DOC_TYP = 54
FOR I IN WO_CV LOOP
=> 21, -- IAS_RECEIPT_DOC
=> I.MSG_TXT,
=> 54,
END INSRT_MNT_ALRT;
PROCEDURE INSRT_OUT_BILL_ALRT ( P_DOC_SRL IN NUMBER ) IS
CURSOR OUT_CV IS
SELECT (GET_MSG_TXT_FNC(D.Msg_Txt||' and d.out_ser = '||A.out_ser)) MSG_TXT ,--(A.A_DESC||' '||Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(G_Lng_No,1412)||' '||A.OUT_NO) MSG_TXT ,
Decode(G_lng_no,1,C.CMP_LNAME,nvl(C.CMP_FNAME,C.CMP_LNAME) ) Subjct_Mail, A.AD_DATE , A.CMP_NO , A.BRN_NO ,A.BRN_USR,A.BRN_YEAR
FROM MASTER_OUT_BILLS A, CUSTOMER B , S_CMPNY C ,S_DOC_MSG_ALRT D
WHERE OUT_SER = P_DOC_SRL
AND D.DOC_TYP = 13
FOR I IN OUT_CV LOOP
P_MSG_TYP => 23, -- OUT BILLS
P_MOBILE_NO => I.MOBILE_NO,
P_E_MAIL => I.E_MAIL,
P_SUBJCT_MAIL => I.Subjct_Mail,
P_DOC_TYP => 13,
P_DOC_SRL => P_DOC_SRL,
P_AD_DATE => I.AD_DATE,
P_CMP_NO => I.CMP_NO,
P_BRN_NO => I.BRN_NO,
P_BRN_USR => I.BRN_USR,
P_BRN_YEAR => I.BRN_YEAR );
END INSRT_OUT_BILL_ALRT;
PROCEDURE CHK_CST_CR_LMT_PRC IS
CURSOR CST_CV IS
SELECT M.C_CODE, M.C_Mobile Mobile_no,M.C_E_MAIL E_MAIL,NVL(D.CR_LIMIT,0) CR_LIMIT,
D.A_CY,M.SEND_MSG,Decode(G_lng_no,1,C.CMP_LNAME,nvl(C.CMP_FNAME,C.CMP_LNAME) ) Subjct_Mail,C.CMP_NO,
SUM(NVL(A.AMT,0)) BLNC_AMT
FROM CUSTOMER M,CUSTOMER_CURR D , IAS_POST_DTL A , S_CMPNY C
WHERE M.C_CODE = D.C_CODE
AND M.C_CODE = A.C_C
AND D.A_CY = A.A_CY
AND NVL(D.CR_LIMIT,0) > 0
GROUP BY M.C_CODE, M.C_Mobile ,M.C_E_MAIL ,NVL(D.CR_LIMIT,0),D.A_CY,M.SEND_MSG,Decode(G_lng_no,1,C.CMP_LNAME,nvl(C.CMP_FNAME,C.CMP_LNAME) ),C.CMP_NO
HAVING NVL(D.CR_LIMIT,0) > SUM(NVL(A.AMT,0))
AND SUM(NVL(A.AMT,0)) > 0
AND M.SEND_MSG = 1 AND ( M.C_E_MAIL IS NOT NULL OR M.C_Mobile IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY M.C_CODE;
FOR I IN CST_CV LOOP
IF G_LNG_NO = 1 OR G_LNG_NO IS NULL THEN
V_MSG_TXT := I.A_CY||' '||'
= ' || I.BLNC_AMT;
V_MSG_TXT := ' Exceed Credit Limit , Your Balance = ' || I.BLNC_AMT||' '||I.A_CY;
--P_MSG_MTHD_SEND
=> 30, -- CST BALANCE
=> NVL(I.CMP_NO,G_CMP_NO),
END CHK_CST_CR_LMT_PRC;
PROCEDURE INSRT_SO_INSRNC_ALRT ( P_DOC_SRL IN NUMBER) IS
B.PRSON_TEL MOBILE_NO ,B.PRSON_E_MAIL E_MAIL,D.SEND_TYP,
FROM SALES_ORDER A, IAS_INSRNCE_CARD B , S_CMPNY C , S_DOC_MSG_ALRT D
AND A.INSRNCE_CMP_NO = B.INS_CMP_NO
AND A.INSRNCE_BNF_NO = B.BNF_NO
AND A.INSRNCE_CARD_NO = B.PRSON_CARD_NO
AND (B.PRSON_TEL IS NOT NULL OR B.PRSON_E_MAIL IS NOT NULL )
D IF;
END INSRT_SO_INSRNC_ALRT;

P_Dis_Amt Out Num
ber,
P_No_Of_Dcml In Number) IS
V_Whr Varchar2(3000);
V_Qt_Qty Number;
V_Qt_Qty_Bill Number;
V_By_Comp_Qty Number;
V_Calc_All_Slides Number;
Select Ias_Qut_Prm_Mst.Quot_No,
Ias_Qut_Prm_Mst.Quot_Ser,
Ias_Qut_Prm_Mst.Qt_Prm_Type,
Ias_Qut_Prm_Mst.Qt_Prm_Method,
Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.Qt_I_Code,

(Case When Ias_Qut_Prm_Mst.Qt_Prm_Method=Decode(Ias_Qut_Prm_Mst.Qt_Prm_Type,3,1,2) And Disc_type=2 Then Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.Disc_Amt_Per Else Null End),
Nvl(Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.I_Price,0) * Nvl(round(Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Cur_rate(Ias_Qut_Prm_Mst.Quot_cur)/P_Bill_Rate,P_No_Of_Dcml),0),
Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.Free_Qty,
Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.Qt_Qty,
Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.Card_Amt,

And (Case When Ias_Qut_Prm_Mst.Qt_Prm_Type=1 And Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.I_Code=P_Icode And Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.Itm_Unt=P_ItmUnt Then 1
When Ias_Qut_Prm_Mst.Qt_Prm_Type=2 And Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.I_Code=P_Icode And Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.Itm_Unt=P_ItmUnt And P_Iqty Between Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.F_Qty And Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.T_Qty Then 1
When Ias_Qut_Prm_Mst.Qt_Prm_Type=3 And P_Bill_Amt Between Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.F_Amt And Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.T_Amt Then 1
Else 0 End)=1
And (Case
When Ias_Qut_Prm_Mst.Qt_Prm_Wc_Type=0 Then 1
When Ias_Qut_Prm_Mst.Qt_Prm_Wc_Type=1 And Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.W_Code = P_Wcode Then 1
When Ias_Qut_Prm_Mst.Qt_Prm_Wc_Type=2 And Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.Whg_Code =(Select Whg_Code From Warehouse_Details Where W_Code=P_Wcode And RowNum<=1) Then 1
When Ias_Qut_Prm_Mst.Qt_Prm_Wc_Type=3 And Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.Cntry_No =(Select Cntry_No From Warehouse_Details Where W_Code=P_Wcode And RowNum<=1) Then 1
When Ias_Qut_Prm_Mst.Qt_Prm_Wc_Type=4 And Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.Prov_No =(Select Prov_No From Warehouse_Details Where W_Code=P_Wcode And RowNum<=1) Then 1
When Ias_Qut_Prm_Mst.Qt_Prm_Wc_Type=5 And Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.City_No =(Select City_No From Warehouse_Details Where W_Code=P_Wcode And RowNum<=1) Then 1
When Ias_Qut_Prm_Mst.Qt_Prm_Wc_Type=6 And Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.R_Code =(Select R_Code From Warehouse_Details Where W_Code=P_Wcode And RowNum<=1) Then 1
And Decode(P_Bill_Doc_Type,4,2,1) = Decode(Ias_Qut_Prm_Mst.Bill_Doc_Type,Null,Decode(P_Bill_Doc_Type,4,2,1),Ias_Qut_Prm_Mst.Bill_Doc_Type)
And Nvl(Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.B
atch_No,'0')=Nvl(P_Batch_No,Nvl(Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.Batch_No,'0'))
And Nvl(Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.Expire_Date,'01/01/1900')=Nvl(P_Exp_Date,Nvl(Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.Expire_Date,'01/01/1900'))
If P_Qt_Ser Is Not Null And P_Qt_Rcrd_No Is Not Null And P_Qt_Prm_Type in (1,2) And P_Qt_Prm_Method<5 Then
If V_Qt_Qty Is Not Null Then
Select Nvl(Sum(Nvl(I_Qty,0)+Nvl(Free_Qty,0)),0) InTo V_Qt_Qty_Bill From Ias_Bill_Dtl Where Qt_Prm_Ser=P_Qt_Ser And Qt_Prm_Rcrd_No=P_Qt_Rcrd_No;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN V_Qt_Qty_Bill:=0;
If V_By_Comp_Qty=1 Or V_Calc_All_Slides=1 Then
If P_Qt_Ser Is Not Null And P_Qt_Prm_Type=2 And P_Qt_Prm_Method In (3,4) Then
Select TRUNC(SUM(Case When Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.T_Qty<=P_Iqty And V_Calc_All_Slides=1 Then TRUNC((T_Qty-F_Qty+1)/Decode(V_By_Comp_Qty,1,Comp_Qty,(T_Qty-F_Qty+1)))*Free_Qty
When Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.T_Qty>P_Iqty And V_Calc_All_Slides=1 Then TRUNC((P_Iqty-F_Qty+1)/Decode(V_By_Comp_Qty,1,Comp_Qty,(T_Qty-F_Qty+1)))*Free_Qty
When V_Calc_All_Slides=0 And (P_Iqty Between Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.F_Qty And Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.T_Qty) And V_Calc_All_Slides=0 Then TRUNC(TRUNC(P_Iqty/Comp_Qty)*Free_Qty)
End))
InTo P_Fqty
And Ias_Qut_Prm_Mst.Quot_Ser = P_Qt_Ser
And Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.I_Code=P_Icode
And Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.Itm_Unt=P_ItmUnt
And Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.F_Qty<=P_Iqty
And (Case When Ias_Qut_Prm_Mst.Qt_Prm_Wc_Type=0 Then 1
Else 0 End)=1;
ElsIf P_Qt_Ser Is Not Null And P_Qt_Prm_Type=2 And P_Qt_Prm_Method=2 And V_Calc_All_Slides=1 Then
Select SUM(Case When Disc_type=1 And Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.T_Qty<=P_Iqty Then (((T_Qty-F_Qty+1)*(Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.Disc_Amt_Per/100))/P_Iqty)
When Disc_type=1 And Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.T_Qty>P_Iqty Then (((P_Iqty-F_Qty+1)*(Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.Disc_Amt_Per/100))/P_Iqty)
End)*100,
SUM(Case When Disc_type=2 And Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.T_Qty<=P_Iqty Then (((T_Qty-F_Qty+1)*Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.Disc_Amt_Per)/P_Iqty)
When Disc_type=2 And Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.T_Qty>P_Iqty Then (((P_Iqty-F_Qty+1)*Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.Disc_Amt_Per)/P_Iqty)
End)
InTo P_Dis_Per,
P_Dis_Amt
When Ias_Qut_P
rm_Mst.Qt_Prm_Wc_Type=4 And Ias_Qut_Prm_Dtl.Prov_No =(Select Prov_No From Warehouse_Details Where W_Code=P_Wcode And RowNum<=1) Then 1
If (V_Qt_Qty Is Not Null And (P_Iqty> (Nvl(V_Qt_Qty,0)-Nvl(V_Qt_Qty_Bill,0)))) Or (P_Qt_Prm_Method=4 And V_By_Comp_Qty=1 And P_Fqty=0) Then
P_Qt_Rem_Qty := (Nvl(V_Qt_Qty,0)-Nvl(V_Qt_Qty_Bill,0)) ;
P_Qt_No := Null;

and rcrd_no = P_Qt_Rcrd_No

From ias_qut_prm_sub_dtl
and i_code=P_Icode
and Itm_Unt=P_Itm_Unt
Return(Nvl(v_Qt_Fqty,0));
End Ias_Get_Qt_Prm_Fqty;

P_Tbl_Nm In Varchar2 ) Is
V_SqlStr Varchar2(4000) ;
V_SqlStr := ' Select Sum(Decode(Doc_Type,0,0,1,0,3,0,(Nvl(P_Qty,0)+Nvl(Pf_Qty,0))*In_Out)) Inc_Qty,
Sum(Decode(Doc_Type,1,(Nvl(P_Qty,0)+Nvl(Pf_Qty,0)),3,-1*(Nvl(P_Qty,0)+Nvl(Pf_Qty,0)),0)) Sale_Qty
From '||P_Tbl_Nm||'
Where I_Code = '||''''||P_I_Code||''''||'
And I_Date Between To_Date('||''''||P_F_Date||''''||',''DD/MM/YYYY'') And To_Date('||''''||P_T_Date||''''||',''DD/MM/YYYY'')' ;
If P_W_Code Is Not Null Then
V_SqlStr := V_SqlStr ||' And W_Code = '||P_W_Code ;
V_SqlStr := V_SqlStr ||' And Batch_No = '||''''||P_Batch_No||'''' ;
If P_Exp_Date Is Not Null Then
V_SqlStr := V_SqlStr ||' And Expire_Date = '||''''||P_Exp_Date||'''' ;
Execute Immediate V_SqlStr Into P_Incom_Qty , P_Sale_Qty ;
P_Incom_Qty := 0 ;
P_Sale_Qty := 0 ;
End Get_Incom_Sale_Qty ;
P_Tbl_Nm_Dtl In Varchar2 ) Return Number Is
V_Tr_Not_Rec_Qty Number ;
--## Get Qty Not Received
V_SqlStr := ' Select Nvl(Sum(P_Qty),0)
From '||P_Tbl_Nm_Dtl||'
Where Exists ( Select 1 From '||P_Tbl_Nm_Mst||'
Where '||P_Tbl_Nm_Mst||'.Tr_Ser = '||P_Tbl_Nm_Dtl||'.Tr_Ser
And '||P_Tbl_Nm_Dtl||'.Tr_InOut_Type = 1
And '||P_Tbl_Nm_Mst||'.Tr_Date Between To_Date('||''''||P_F_Date||''''||',''DD/MM/YYYY'') And To_Date('||''''||P_T_Date||''''||',''DD/MM/YYYY'')
And Nvl('||P_Tbl_Nm_Mst||'.Processed,0) = 0
And '||P_Tbl_Nm_Dtl||'.I_Code = '||''''||P_I_Code||'''' ;
V_SqlStr := V_SqlStr ||' And '||P_Tbl_Nm_Dtl||'.T_W_Code = '||P_W_Code ;
V_SqlStr := V_SqlStr ||' And Expire_Date = '||''''||
P_Exp_Date||'''' ;
Execute Immediate V_SqlStr Into V_Tr_Not_Rec_Qty ;
V_Tr_Not_Rec_Qty := 0 ;
Return(Nvl(V_Tr_Not_Rec_Qty ,0)) ;
End Get_Whtrns_Qty_Not_Rec ;
If P_Type = 1 Then
V_SqlStr := ' Select (Nvl(Sum(P_Qty),0)+Nvl(Sum(Free_Qty*P_Size),0)) - (Nvl(Sum(Out_Qty*P_Size),0)+Nvl(Sum(Out_Free_Qty*P_Size),0))
Where '||P_Tbl_Nm_Mst||'.Bill_Ser = '||P_Tbl_Nm_Dtl||'.Bill_Ser
And '||P_Tbl_Nm_Mst||'.Bill_Date Between To_Date('||''''||P_F_Date||''''||',''DD/MM/YYYY'') And To_Date('||''''||P_T_Date||''''||',''DD/MM/YYYY'')
And RowNum <= 1)
V_SqlStr := V_SqlStr ||' And '||P_Tbl_Nm_Dtl||'.W_Code = '||P_W_Code ;
Execute Immediate V_SqlStr Into V_Qty ;
ElsIf P_Type = 2 Then
V_SqlStr := ' Select (Nvl(Sum(P_Qty),0)+Nvl(Sum(Free_Qty*P_Size),0)) - (Nvl(Sum(Ret_Qty*P_Size),0)+Nvl(Sum(Ret_Free_Qty*P_Size),0))
Where '||P_Tbl_Nm_Mst||'.Rt_Bill_Ser = '||P_Tbl_Nm_Dtl||' .Rt_Bill_Ser
And '||P_Tbl_Nm_Mst||'.Rt_Bill_Date Between To_Date('||''''||P_F_Date||''''||',''DD/MM/YYYY'') And To_Date('||''''||P_T_Date||''''||',''DD/MM/YYYY'')
And '||P_Tbl_Nm_Dtl||' .I_Code = '||''''||P_I_Code||'''' ;
Return(Nvl(V_Qty,0));
End Get_Out_Bill_Qty ;
Function Get_First_Date Return Date Is
V_Frst_Date Date ;
V_Usr_Nm Varchar2(4000);
Select Username Into V_Usr_Nm From All_Users Where Username Like 'IAS%' And RowNum<=1 Order By Username ;
Execute Immediate ' Select '||V_Usr_Nm||'.Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Frst_Day From Dual' Into V_Frst_Date ;
Return(V_Frst_Date);
Return(Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Frst_Day);

v_fs Number;

where P_doc_date between F_date and t_date
If v_s=1 and Upper(P_Scr_Type) = 'FRM' Then
Raise_application_error(-20605,ias_gen_pkg.get_msg(P_Lang_no,1096));
ElsIf v_fs=1 and Upper(P_Scr_Type) = 'FRM' and P_chk_cls = 1 Then
Select Status Into cnt From IAS_CLOSE_DAY_PERIODS
If cnt>0 and Upper(P_Scr_Type) = 'FRM' Then
--If v_fld Is Not Null Then
-- Copy(Null,v_fld);
Raise_application_error(-20605,ias_gen_pkg.get_msg(P_Lang_no,9));
Select Count(1) Into cnt
From date_lock
where P_doc_date between ufd and utd or P_doc_date between lfd and ltd;
If cnt>0 Then
From ias_date_lock_User
where u_id = User_Id
If cnt>0 then
Raise_application_error(-20605,ias_gen_pkg.get_msg(P_Lang_no,1204));
--## sysdate greater then today
/* Select Sysdate Into sd From dual;
If P_doc_date> sd then
MsgBox(365);
End Check_Date;
PROCEDURE Check_Bt_Date (P_Fd In Out Date,P_Td In Out Date) Is

--P_Td:=P_Fd;

TempDate:=P_Fd;
P_Td:=TempDate;
End Check_Bt_Date;
PROCEDURE Check_Bt_Value (P_FN In Out Varchar2,P_TN In Out Varchar2,P_Type In Varchar2 Default 'N' ) Is
If P_FN Is Null and P_TN Is Not Null Then
P_FN:=P_TN;
--ElsIf P_FN Is Not Null and P_TN Is Null Then
-- P_TN:=P_FN;
If Upper(P_type) = 'N' Then -- Numeric
If To_number(P_FN) > To_number(P_TN) Then
TempNm:=To_number(P_FN);
P_TN:=TempNm;
If P_FN > P_TN Then
TempCh:=P_FN;
P_TN:=TempCh;
End Check_Bt_Value;

FUNCTION Check_Mtch_StkCst_CP (P_G_Ser In Number) RETURN NUMBER Is
cnt Number:=0 ;
v_amt Number ;
If P_G_Ser Is Not Null Then
Select 1 Into cnt From Gr_Detail
Where g_ser = P_G_Ser
and Round(nvl(stk_cost,0),4) <> Round((ac_rate/stk_rate) * nvl(c_price,0),4)
and nvl(stk_rate,0) > 0
Select Abs(nvl(Sum(nvl(stk_cost,0) - ((ac_rate/stk_rate) * nvl(c_price,0))),0))
Into v_amt
and nvl(stk_cost,0) <> (ac_rate/stk_rate) * nvl(c_price,0)
and nvl(stk_rate,0) > 0;
If nvl(v_amt,0) > 1 Then
cnt:=1;
End Check_Mtch_StkCst_CP;
Procedure Check_Avl_Qty Is
cnt Number ;
cnt1 Number ;
From Tab
Where Tname = 'IAS_V_UPAVLQTY'
cnt :=0 ;
Raise_Application_Error(-20403,'View Ias_V_Upavlqty Is Not Found '||SqlErrm);
Select count(1)
Into cnt1
From ias_v_upavlqty;
--Where RowNum <=1;
cnt1 :=0 ;
Raise_Application_Error(-20404,'Error In ias_v_upavlqty view '||SqlErrm);
If cnt1 > 0 Then
Cursor Upavl Is Select I_code ,
avlqtymv
From ias_v_upavlqty
where avlqtymv>=0;
For i In upavl Loop
Update Ias_Itm_Wcode Set avl_qty = i.avlqtymv
Where I_Code = i.I_code
And w_code = i.w_code;
Raise_Application_Error(-20405,'Error In Update Ias_Itm_Wcode From ias_v_upavlqty '||SqlErrm);
End Check_Avl_Qty;
Function Check_Lmt_Cost_Itm ( P_Wtavg_Type In Number,
P_I_Code In Ias_Itm_Mst.I_Code%Type,
P_W_Code In Warehouse_Details.W_Code%Type Default Null,
P_Itm_Cost In Number) Return Boolean Is
If P_Wtavg_Type = 1 Then -- By Items
Where I_Code =P_I_Code
And (Nvl(P_Itm_Cost,0) >= Nvl(I_Cwtavg,0) - (Nvl(I_Cwtavg,0) * Nvl(Min_Lmt_Cost_Per,0))/100 Or Min_Lmt_Cost_Per Is Null)
And (Nvl(P_Itm_Cost,0) <= Nvl(I_Cwtavg,0) + (Nvl(I_Cwtavg,0) * Nvl(Max_Lmt_Cost_Per,0))/100 Or Max_Lmt_Cost_Per Is Null Or Nvl(I_Cwtavg,0) = 0)
Return TRUE;
Elsif P_Wtavg_Type In (2,3) And P_W_Code Is Not Null Then -- By Items + W_code
/*Select 1
Where i_code =P_I_Code
and w_code = P_W_code
And (Nvl(P_Itm_Cost,0) >= Nvl(I_cwtavg,0) - (Nvl(I_cwtavg,0) * Nvl(MIN_LMT_COST_PER,0))/100 Or MIN_LMT_COST_PER Is Null)
And (Nvl(P_Itm_Cost,0) <= Nvl(I_cwtavg,0) + (Nvl(I_cwtavg,0) * Nvl(MAX_LMT_COST_PER,0))/100 Or MAX_LMT_COST_PER Is Null Or Nvl(I_cwtavg,0) = 0)
And RowNum<=1;*/
From Ias_Itm_Wcode ,Ias_Itm_Mst
Where Ias_Itm_Mst.I_Code=Ias_Itm_Wcode.I_Code
And Ias_Itm_Mst.I_Code =P_I_Code
And (Nvl(P_Itm_Cost,0) >= Nvl(Ias_Itm_Wcode.I_Cwtavg,0) - (Nvl(Ias_Itm_Wcode.I_Cwtavg,0) * Nvl(Ias_Itm_Mst.Min_Lmt_Cost_Per,0))/100 Or Ias_Itm_Mst.Min_Lmt_Cost_Per Is Null)
And (Nvl(P_Itm_Cost,0) <= Nvl(Ias_Itm_Wcode.I_Cwtavg,0) + (Nvl(Ias_Itm_Wcode.I_Cwtavg,0) * Nvl(Ias_Itm_Mst.Max_Lmt_Cost_Per,0))/100 Or Ias_Itm_Mst.Max_Lmt_Cost_Per Is Null Or Nvl(Ias_Itm_Wcode.I_Cwtavg,0) = 0)
Return FALSE;
End Check_Lmt_Cost_Itm ;

Function order_by_name(p_icode In Ias_Itm_Mst.I_CODE%TYPE) return VARCHAR2 Is
cursor nam is select i_name From Ias_Itm_Mst
where i_code=p_icode ;
rslt VARCHAR2(100):='';
open nam ;
fetch nam into rslt ;
close nam;
return rslt;
exception
return ('');
close nam ;
FUNCTION LF(p_curr In VARCHAR2 ) RETURN NUMBER Is
Select l_f Into L From Ex_Rate Where cur_code = p_curr ;
Return L ;
When Others then
return Null;
END LF;

V_LevNo Number;
If P_Icode Is Null Then

and Nvl(Add_Flag,0)=1
and Rownum <=1
ORDER BY Lev_No ;

From Ias_Pricing_Levels,Ias_Priv_Price
Where Ias_Pricing_Levels.Lev_No=Ias_Priv_Price.Lev_No
and U_Id = P_UserNo
and exis
ts(select 1 From ias_item_price
where lev_no = Ias_Pricing_Levels.lev_no
and i_code = p_icode
And Itm_Unt= P_Itm_Unt
and rownum <= 1)
ORDER BY Ias_Pricing_Levels.Lev_No ;
Select Ias_Dflt_Price_Lvl.Lev_No
Into V_Levno
From Ias_Dflt_Price_Lvl,Ias_Priv_Price
Where Ias_Dflt_Price_Lvl.Lev_No=Ias_Priv_Price.Lev_No
And Decode(P_Price_Type,2,P_Wcode,5,P_Brn_No)=Fld_Code
And U_Id = P_Userno
And Nvl(Add_Flag,0)=1
And Exists(Select 1 From Ias_Item_Price
Where Lev_No = Ias_Dflt_Price_Lvl.Lev_No
And Rownum <=1
ORDER BY Ias_Dflt_Price_Lvl.Lev_No ;
Return(v_LevNo);
End Get_Lev_Prv;

FUNCTION Get_One_Wcode RETURN NUMBER Is
v_Wcode Number;
Select w_code,Count(1)
Into v_Wcode ,cnt
From Warehouse_details
Group By w_code;
Return(v_Wcode);
End Get_One_Wcode;
P_Price_Type In Number default 1 ) RETURN NUMBER Is
v_price Number;
Select sum(decode(a_cy,P_acy , i_price,
P_Stk_cur , ((i_price*P_Stk_Rate)/P_ac_rate),
P_Loc_cur , (i_price/P_ac_rate),
((i_price * cur_rate ) / P_ac_rate)))
Into v_price
From Ias_pricing_levels,Ias_Item_Price,Ex_rate
Where Ias_pricing_levels.lev_no=Ias_Item_Price.lev_no
and Ias_Item_Price.lev_no = P_Lev_no
and i_code = P_Icode
And Ias_Item_Price.Itm_Unt = P_Itm_Unt
and cur_code= a_cy
And Decode(P_Price_Type,2,ias_item_price.w_code,0)=Decode(P_Price_Type,2,P_WCode,0)
And Nvl(ias_pricing_levels.Bill_Doc_type,0) = Decode(ias_pricing_levels.Bill_Doc_type,Null,0,
Decode(P_Bill_Doc_type,4,2,1))
And Decode(P_Price_Type,3,Nvl(P_Iqty,From_Qty),4,nvl(P_Iqty,From_Qty),0) Between
Decode(P_Price_Type,3,Nvl(From_Qty,0),4,Nvl(From_Qty,0),0) And Decode(P_Price_Type,3,Nvl(To_Qty,0),4,Nvl(To_Qty,0),0)
Return(v_price);
P_QTY IN NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
P_BRN_NO IN NUMBER DEFAULT NULL ) RETURN NUMBER IS
v_LowPr Number;
v_LowPr_Cur Varchar2(7);
v_LowPr_rate Number;
v_Rate Number;
Select (nvl(i_price,0)),a_cy,nvl(cur_rate,1)
Into v_lowpr,v_LowPr_Cur,v_LowPr_rate
and lev_Low = 1
And Decode(P_Price_Type,2,Ias_Item_Price.W_Code,4,Ias_Item_Price.W_Code,5,Ias_Item_Price.Brn_No,0)=Decode(P_Price_Type,2,P_W_Code,4,P_W_Code,5,p_brn_no,0)
And Decode(P_Price_Type,3,Nvl(P_Qty,0),4,Nvl(P_Qty,0),0) Between
Decode(P_Price_Type,3,Nvl(From_Qty,0),4,Nvl(From_Qty,0),0) And Decode(P_Price_Type,3,Nvl(To_Qty,0),4,Nvl(To_Qty,0),0);
--When no_data_found Then
-- v_lowpr:=0;
v_lowpr:=0;
If v_LowPr_Cur = P_acy Then --(1)
v_price:=v_lowpr;
Elsif v_LowPr_Cur = P_Stk_cur
Then --(1)
v_price:=(v_lowpr*P_Stk_Rate)/P_ac_rate;
Elsif v_LowPr_Cur = P_Loc_cur Then --(1)
v_price:=v_lowpr/P_ac_rate;
Else--(1)
v_price:=(v_lowpr * v_LowPr_rate ) / P_ac_rate;
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
P_BRN_NO IN NUMBER DEFAULT NULL) RETURN NUMBER is
v_HighPr Number;
v_HighPr_Cur Varchar2(7);
v_HighPr_rate Number;
Into v_Highpr,v_HighPr_Cur,v_HighPr_rate
and lev_High = 1
and cur_code = a_cy
And Decode(P_Price_Type,2,Ias_Item_Price.W_Code,4,Ias_Item_Price.W_Code,5,Ias_Item_Price.Brn_No,0)=Decode(P_Price_Type,2,P_W_Code,4,P_W_Code,5,P_Brn_No,0)
-- v_Highpr:=0;
v_Highpr:=0;
If v_HighPr_Cur = P_acy Then --(1)
v_price:=v_Highpr;
Elsif v_HighPr_Cur = P_Stk_cur Then --(1)
v_price:=(v_Highpr*P_Stk_Rate)/P_ac_rate;
Elsif v_HighPr_Cur = P_Loc_cur Then --(1)
v_price:=v_Highpr/P_ac_rate;
v_price:=(v_Highpr * v_HighPr_rate ) / P_ac_rate;

FUNCTION Get_Itm_Price (P_LevNo In Number,
P_Frc_no In Number Default 2 ) Return Number Is
v_PriceItem NUMBER;
v_RatePrice NUMBER;
v_CPL NUMBER :=0;
v_Lev_Num NUMBER (2);
v_LevCur varchar2 (7);
If P_LevNo Is Null Then
Select Min(Lev_No)
Into v_Lev_Num
From IAS_PRICING_LEVELS;
v_Lev_Num:=P_LevNo;
Select A_Cy
Into v_LevCur
From IAS_PRICING_LEVELS
Where Lev_no=v_Lev_Num;
If v_levCur = P_acy and P_billrate Is Not Null Then
v_RatePrice:=P_billrate;
v_RatePrice:=Ias_gen_Pkg.Get_cur_rate(v_LevCur);
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
--BillDocType=4 and
If P_c_code Is Not Null Then --(1)
Select Lev_No
Into v_CPL
From Customer_Curr
Where c_code = P_c_code
and a_cy = P_acy;
If v_CPL Is Not Null Then --(2)
If nvl(v_PriceItem,0) = 0 Then --(3)
Select Round((nvl(I_Price,0)* v_RatePrice * 1/P_BillRate),P_Frc_no)
nto v_PriceItem
From Ias_Item_Price
Where Lev_No = v_CPL
and I_code = P_Icode
And Ias_Item_Price.Itm_Unt = P_Itm_Unt;
If nvl(v_PriceItem,0) = 0 Then --(4)
Select Round((Nvl(I_Price,0) * v_RatePrice * 1/P_BillRate),P_Frc_no)
Into v_PriceItem
Where Lev_No = v_Lev_Num
and nvl(w_code,0) = Decode(P_w_code,null,nvl(w_code,0),P_w_code);
Return(v_PriceItem );
return(0);
END Get_Itm_Price;

FUNCTION Get_Code_Nm (P_code_Type In Varchar2 ,P_Code_No In Varchar2,P_Lng_no In Number Default 1) RETURN CHAR Is
If P_Code_No Is Not Null Then
If Upper(P_code_Type) = 'ACY' Then
Select Decode(p_Lng_no,1,Cur_Name,nvl(Cur_E_Name,Cur_Name))
Where cur_code=P_Code_No;
ElsIf Upper(P_code_Type) = 'CASH' Then
Select Decode(p_Lng_no,1,Cash_Name,nvl(Cash_E_Name,Cash_Name))
From cash_in_hand
Where cash_no=P_Code_No;
ElsIf Upper(P_code_Type) = 'BANK' Then
Select Decode(p_Lng_no,1,bank_Name,nvl(Bank_E_Name,Bank_Name))
From cash_at_bank
Where Bank_no=P_Code_No;
ElsIf Upper(P_code_Type) = 'SMAN' Then
Select Decode(p_Lng_no,1,REPRS_A_NAME,nvl(REPRS_E_NAME,REPRS_A_NAME))
Where REPRS_CODE=P_Code_No;
Elsif Upper(P_code_Type) = 'CITY' Then
Select Decode(p_Lng_no,1,CITY_A_NAME,nvl(CITY_E_NAME,CITY_A_NAME))
From cities
Where CITY_NO=P_Code_No;
Elsif Upper(P_code_Type) = 'CNTRY' Then
Select Decode(p_Lng_no,1,CNTRY_A_NAME,nvl(CNTRY_E_NAME,CNTRY_A_NAME))
Where CNTRY_NO=P_Code_No;
Elsif Upper(P_code_Type) = 'RCODE' Then
Select Decode(p_Lng_no,1,R_A_NAME,nvl(R_E_NAME,R_A_NAME))
From Regions
Where r_code=P_Code_No;
Elsif Upper(P_code_Type) = 'COLNO' Then
Select Decode(p_Lng_no,1,COL_NAME,nvl(COL_E_NAME,COL_NAME))
From Collerctor
Where col_no=P_Code_No;
Elsif Upper(P_code_Type) = 'WCODE' Then
Select Decode(p_Lng_no,1,w_name,nvl(w_e_name,w_name))
From warehouse_details
Where w_code=P_Code_No;
Elsif Upper(P_code_Type) = 'GCODE' Then
Select Decode(p_Lng_no,1,g_a_name,nvl(g_e_name,g_a_name))
From group_details
Where g_code=P_Code_No;
Elsif Upper(P_code_Type) = 'ITMTYPE' Then
Select Decode(p_Lng_no,1,It_a_name,nvl(It_e_name,It_a_name))
From Item_Types
Where Type_Of_Item=P_Code_No;
Elsif Upper(P_code_Type) = 'FORM' Then
Where Lang_no= P_Lng_no
and Form_no=P_Code_No;
Return(v_na
me);
End Get_Code_Nm;

If P_Ad_Date + V_Doc_Day_Prd < Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Curdate Then
If P_Ad_Date + (V_Doc_HRS_Prd/24) < Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Curdate Then
P_Col_Date Out Date ) Is

PROCEDURE Get_Itm_Name (P_Lng_no In Number,P_icode In Ias_Itm_Mst.I_CODE%TYPE,P_i_name Out varchar2,P_idesc Out varchar2) IS
Select Decode(P_lng_no,1,nvl(I_name,I_e_name),nvl(I_e_name,I_name)),i_desc
Into P_i_name,P_idesc
Where i_code=P_icode
--Raise_Application_Error(-20410,'Item Code Is Invalid = '||SqlErrm) ;
Raise_application_error(-20410,Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Msg(P_Lng_No,46)||' ,'||SqlErrm);
End Get_Itm_Name;
------------------------------------------------------------
FUNCTION Get_Itm_Name (p_i_code In Ias_Itm_Mst.I_CODE%TYPE, P_Lng_no In Number) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
V_ITM_NM Ias_Itm_Mst.I_name%TYPE ;
Select Decode(P_lng_no,1,I_name,nvl(I_e_name,I_name))
Into V_ITM_NM
Where i_code=p_i_code
RETURN(V_ITM_NM);
P_Blocked Out Number) IS
Select Decode(P_lng_no,1,nvl(I_name,I_e_name),nvl(I_e_name,I_name)),i_desc,
nvl(Use_Exp_date,0),nvl(Use_batch_no,0),nvl(Use_Serialno,0),
nvl(Use_Qty_Fraction,0),nvl(Allow_Free_Qty,0),nvl(Allow_Disc,0),
nvl(Service_Itm,0),nvl(Kit_Itm,0),nvl(Blocked,0)
Into P_i_name,P_idesc,P_UseExpDt ,
P_UseBtch, P_UseSer, P_UseFrc,P_UseFree,P_UseDisc,P_Srv_Itm ,
P_Kit_Itm,P_Blocked
Where i_code=P_icode;
--Raise_Application_Error(-20411,'Item Code Is Invalid = '||SqlErrm) ;
Raise_application_error(-20411,Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Msg(P_Lng_No,46)||' ,'||SqlErrm);
End Get_Itm_Info ;

FUNCTION Get_Grand_Avlqty( P_Icode In Ias_Itm_Mst.I_CODE%TYPE,
P_Wcode In WAREHOUSE_DETAILS.W_CODE%TYPE Default null) Return NUMBER Is
avlq NUMBER;
If P_wcode Is Null Then
Select Sum(avlq)
From ( Select sum(distinct Avl_qty) avlq,w_code
Where Ias_Itm_Wcode.I_Code = P_Icode
And Ias_Itm_Wcode.P_Size = 1
group by w_code );
Select Sum(distinct Avl_qty)
Into avlq From Ias_Itm_Wcode
where Ias_Itm_Wcode.I_Code = P_Icode
And W_code=P_wcode;
Return(Nvl(avlq,0));
End Get_Grand_Avlqty;
FUNCTION Get_Grand_Wtavg( P_Wtavg_Type In NUMBER,
P_Wcode In WAREHOUSE_DETAILS.W_CODE%TYPE Default Null ) Return NUMBER Is
v_Wtavg NUMBER;
If P_Icode Is Not Null Then
If P_Wtavg_Type = 1 Then --By Item
Select nvl(i_cwtavg,0)
Into v_Wtavg
Where i_code = P_Icode;
ElsIf P_Wtavg_Type = 2 Then --By Item + W_Code
Select Nvl(i_cwtavg,0)
Where i_code = P_Icode
And w_code = P_Wcode
And P_Size = 1 ;
ElsIf P_Wtavg_Type = 3 Then -- By Item + Whg_Code
And Whg_Code = Ias_Wcode_Pkg.Get_Whg_Code (P_Wcode)
And P_Size = 1
And Nvl(I_Cwtavg,0) > 0
V_Wtavg:=0;
Raise_Application_Error(-20411,'Error In Get Wtavg For I_Code '||P_Icode||Sqlerrm);
--Raise_application_error(-20412,Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Msg(P_Lng_No,46)||' ,'||SqlErrm);
Raise_Application_Error(-20412,'Error In get wtavg for i_code '||P_Icode||SqlErrm);
return(v_Wtavg);
End Get_Grand_Wtavg;

Service_Itm = 1

when No_Data_Found Then
Raise_ApplICation_Error(-20413,'Error In Check_Srv_Itm ' || '' || SqlErrm);

Where i_code = P_I_code
and w_code = Decode(P_W_code,Null,w_code,P_W_code)
and pi_type In (0,2,5);
Return(v_Date);
END Get_Last_Incom_Date;
P_I_price out NUMBER) Is
v_price Number ;
v_a_cy Varchar2(7);
--v_loc_price Number;
If P_I_code Is Not Null and P_V_code Is Not Null Then
Select nvl(Vndr_Price,0),A_cy
Into v_price,v_a_cy
From Ias_V_Vndr_Itm
Where I_code = P_I_code
And V_code = P_V_code
And A_cy = Decode(P_A_cy,null,A_cy,P_A_cy);
If P_A_cy Is Null and v_price > 0 Then
v_price:= (v_price * IAS_GEN_PKG.Get_Cur_Rate(v_a_cy)) / IAS_GEN_PKG.Get_Cur_Rate(P_A_cy);
v_price := 0 ;
P_I_price:=Nvl(v_price,0);
P_I_price:=0;
End Get_Itm_Vndr_Price;

Function Get_Icode_Unt (P_I_Code In Ias_Itm_Mst.I_Code%Type ,P_Unt_Type In Number,P_Lvl_Unt In Number Default Null) Return Varchar2 Is
V_Itm_Unt I
as_Itm_Dtl.Itm_Unt%Type;
If P_Unt_Type=1 Then -- Get Main Unit
Where I_Code= P_I_Code
And Main_Unit = 1;
Elsif P_Unt_Type=2 Then -- Get Sale Unit
And Sale_Unit=1;
Elsif P_Unt_Type=3 Then -- Get Purchase Unit
And Pur_Unit=1;
Elsif P_Unt_Type=4 Then -- Get Max Unit
And Lvl_Unit = ( Select Max(Lvl_Unit)
Where I_Code= P_I_Code);
Elsif P_Unt_Type=5 Then -- Get Specific Unit
And Lvl_Unit =Nvl(P_Lvl_Unt,1);
Return ' ';
End Get_Icode_Unt ;
----------------------------------------------------------

Return(V_Itm_Size);
Return 1;
End Get_Icode_Size ;

End Get_Sum_Blnc;

If P_Data_Typ=1 Then
'Select M.I_Code,

:P_Usr_No,

P_Conn_Itm_Act;

Decode(:P_Lng_No,1,M.I_Name,Nvl(M.I_E_Name,M.I_Name)) I_Name
Where NVL(Group_No,0)=Nvl(:P_Grp_No,-1)
AND (:P_Usr_No=1 Or Exists ( Select 1 From Privilege_gc
P_Grp_No,
ElsIf P_Data_Typ=3 Then
'Select D.I_Code,
D.I_Qty
From Ias_Itm_Mst M,Ias_Item_Requirements D
Where M.I_Code =D.I_Code
And D.REQ_ITEM_NO =:P_I_Code

And G_Code = M.G_Code
And Rownum<=1))
And Get_Items_Activity( M.Activity_No,
Order By '||P_Ordby
P_I_Code,
ElsIf P_Data_Typ=4 Then
'Select M.Itm_Unt,
M.W_Code,
M.Brn_No,
M.From_Qty,
M.To_Qty,
M.I_Price
From Ias_Item_Price M
Where M.I_Code = :P_I_Code
And M.Lev_No = :P_Lev_No
And Decode(:P_Price_Type,2,M.W_Code,4,M.W_Code,5,M.Brn_No,0) = Decode(:P_Price_Type,2,Nvl(:P_W_Code,Nvl(M.W_Code,0)),
4,Nvl(:P_W_Code,Nvl(M.W_Code,0)),
5,Nvl(:P_Brn_No,Nvl(M.Brn_No,0)),0)

'Select Distinct Ias_Itm_Wcode.W_Code,
Decode(:P_Lng_No,1,Warehouse_Details.W_Name,Nvl (Warehouse_Details.W_E_Name, Warehouse_Details.W_Name)) W_Nm,

And W_Code = Ware
house_Details.W_Code

P_PSize,

M.P_Size

'Select M.Batch_No,

P_PSize;

P_W_Code;

'Select Decode(:P_Lng_No,1,Nvl(Lev_A_Name,Lev_E_Name),Nvl(Lev_E_Name,Lev_A_Name)) Lev_Nm,Lev_No

Where ((:P_Usr_No=1) Or (Exists (Select Lev_No
And Lev_No = Ias_Pricing_Levels.Lev_No
And Nvl (Add_Flag,0)=1
And Rownum<=1)))

End Get_Lov_Itm_Data;

--## IUpdate Gr_detail
PROCEDURE Update_Gr_Dtl ( P_DocType
P_Docser
P_Icode
In Ias_Itm_Mst.I_CODE%TYPE Default Null,
P_RcrdNo
Cursor Dg_cv IS
Select Pi_Type,Gr_No,I_Code,W_Code,Rec_No,I_Qty,P_Qty,Cc_Code,Doc_Ser,Doc_Sequence,Doc_Sequence_Gr
From Sale_Cost
Where Bill_Type = P_Doctype
And Doc_Ser = P_Docser
And I_Code = Decode(P_Icode,Null,I_Code,P_Icode)
--And Doc_Sequence = Decode(P_Docseq,Null,Doc_Sequence,P_Docseq)
And Nvl(Rcrd_No,0) = Decode(P_Rcrdno,Null,Nvl(Rcrd_No,0),P_Rcrdno)
For Update Nowait;
For I in Dg_cv
Update Gr_Detail Set CP_Qty = nvl(CP_Qty,0) + nvl(I.P_Qty,0)
where Gr_No = I.Gr_No
And Pi_Type = I.Pi_type
And I_Code = I.I_Code
And W_Code = I.W_Code
--And Doc_Sequence = I.Doc_Sequence_Gr
And rec_no = I.rec_no;
Raise_Application_ERror(-20435,'Error when Update In Gr_detail ,i_code = '||P_Icode||'Doc_ser= '||P_docser||chr(13)||SqlErrm);
Raise_Application_ERror(-20436,'Error when Update In Gr_detail ,i_code = '||P_Icode||'Doc_ser= '||P_docser||chr(13)||SqlErrm);
END Update_Gr_Dtl;
--## Get_Itm_Cost
Function Get_Itm_Cost( P_costing_type In NUMBER,
P_Wcode In WAREHOUSE_DETAILS.W_CODE%TYPE,
P_Iqty In NUMBER,
P_ExpDate In Date Default Null,
p_BRN_USR In NUMBER) Return Number IS
V_item_cost Number:=0;
--P_Iqty = i_qty + Free_qty
If P_costing_type = 1 Then --(1) -- FiFo
If P_iqty > 0 Then --(2)
Cursor Fifo Is Select Gr_Detail.Cp_Qty,Gr_Detail.P_Size,nvl(Gr_Detail.stk_cost,0) stk_cost,
Gr_Detail.W_Code,Gr_Detail.Expire_Date,Gr_Detail.Batch_No
From Gr_Detail,Gr_Note
And G
r_Detail.W_Code = Decode(P_Wcode,Null,Gr_Detail.W_Code,P_Wcode)
And Nvl(Expire_Date,'01/01/1900')=Nvl(P_ExpDate,'01/01/1900')
And Nvl(Batch_No,'0') = Nvl(P_BatchNo,'0')
And Gr_Detail.Gr_No = Gr_Note.Gr_No
And Gr_Detail.Pi_Type = Gr_Note.Pi_Type
And Gr_Detail.G_Ser = Gr_Note.G_Ser
Order by Gr_Note.Gr_Date,Gr_detail.Rec_no ;
v_IQty Gr_Detail.I_Qty%Type;
v_XQty Number;
v_stk_cost Number;
v_Gsize Number;
v_exp_date Date;
v_bat_no Varchar2(15);
v_WCode Gr_Detail.W_code%Type;
v_Cost Number := 0;
--v_Rqty Number := P_iqty;
v_Rqty Number := P_iqty* P_Psize;
Open Fifo;
While(nvl(v_IQty,0) < v_RQty)
Fetch Fifo Into v_IQty,v_Gsize,v_stk_cost,v_WCode,v_exp_date,v_bat_no;
v_XQty := nvl(v_IQty,0);
If nvl(v_IQty,0) > v_RQty Then
v_Cost := nvl(v_Cost,0) + (nvl(v_RQty,0) * (nvl(v_stk_cost,0)/nvl(v_Gsize,1)));
elsif nvl(v_IQty,0)=0 then
v_RQty:=nvl(v_RQty,0) - nvl(v_IQty,0);
v_IQty:=0;
v_Cost := nvl(v_Cost,0) + (nvl(v_XQty,0) * (nvl(v_stk_cost,0)/nvl(v_Gsize,1)));
lose Fifo;
--V_item_cost := (v_Cost / P_iqty)*P_psize;
V_item_cost := (v_Cost / (P_iqty* P_Psize))*P_psize;
End if;--(2)
Else -- Wtavg
V_item_cost:=Ias_Itm_Pkg.get_grand_wtavg(P_Wtavg_Type,P_Icode,P_Wcode)* nvl(P_psize,1);
Return(V_item_cost);
End Get_Itm_Cost;
END IAS_Itm_Inv_Pkg;
