Procedure Balanced_Cc (P_Doc_Type In Number ,
P_J_Date In Date ) Is
V_Cc_Code Varchar2(30);
V_Cc_Code_Dr Varchar2(30);
V_Cc_Code_Cr Varchar2(30);
V_Local Varchar2(7):= Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Local_Cur;
V_Bal Number ;
V_Amt_Bal Number ;
V_Cnt_Cc Number ;
V_Cheq_Type Number ;
V_Cnt Number ;
--##------------------------------------------------------------------------##--
Select Ac_Balanced_Cc
Into V_Ac_Balanced_Cc
Where Brn_No=Nvl(V_Brn_No,Brn_No)
And Rownum<=1 ;
Raise_Application_Error(-20606,Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Msg(V_Lang_No,1363)||Sqlerrm) ;
Where Doc_Type = P_Doc_Type
And Nvl(Install_Type,0) = 9 ;
Select Count(Distinct Cc_Code)
Into V_Cnt_Cc
Where Doc_Ser = P_Doc_Ser
And Cc_Code Is Not Null ;
V_Cnt_Cc := 0 ;
V_Cnt_Cc := 1 ;
If Nvl(P_Doc_Type,0) = 1 Then
Select Cc_Code Into V_Cc_Code_Dr
Where Nvl(J_AMT,0) < 0
And J_Ser = P_Doc_Ser;
V_Cc_Code_Dr := Null ;
Select Cc_Code Into V_Cc_Code_Cr
Where Nvl(J_AMT,0) > 0
V_Cc_Code_Cr := Null ;
Cntdr := Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Fld_Value('DETAIL_JOURNAL_V','Count(*)',' Where Nvl(J_AMT,0) > 0 And J_Ser = '||P_Doc_Ser);
Cntdr :=0;
Cntcr := Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Fld_Value('DETAIL_JOURNAL_V','Count(*)',' Where Nvl(J_AMT,0) < 0 And J_Ser = '||P_Doc_Ser);
Cntcr :=0;
If Nvl(Cntdr,0) = 1 Then
Select Cc_Code Into V_Cc_Code
Where J_Ser = P_Doc_Ser
And Nvl(J_Amt,0) > 0;
V_Cc_Code :=Null;
ElsIf Nvl(Cntcr,0) = 1 Then
And Nvl(J_Amt,0) < 0;
Select Count(1) Cnt , Doc_Ser ,Cc_Code,Sum(Nvl(Amt,0)) Amt
Into V_Cnt ,V_J_Ser ,V_J_Cc_Code ,V_J_Amt
Where Doc_Type=1 And Doc_Ser=P_Doc_Ser
Group By Doc_Ser ,Cc_Code
Having Sum(Nvl(Amt,0)) <> 0 ;
V_Cnt := 1 ;
Cursor C_Post_Dtl Is Select Doc_Type,Jv_Type,Doc_No,Doc_Ser,Doc_Date,Cc_Code,Rcrd_No,Doc_Desc,A_Cy,
Nvl(Dr_Amt,0) Dr_Amt,Nvl(Cr_Amt,0) Cr_Amt,Nvl(Amt,0) Amt ,
Nvl(Dr_Amt_F,0) Dr_Amt_F,Nvl(Cr_Amt_F,0) Cr_Amt_F,Nvl(Amt_F,0) Amt_F
Order By Rcrd_No;
V_A Number:=0;
V_F_Rcrd_No Number;
V_L_Rcrd_No Number;
V_Dr_Amt Number;
V_Cr_Amt Number;
Cntdrcr Number;
For I_Post_Dtl In C_Post_Dtl Loop
If V_A =0 Then
V_Cc_Code := I_Post_Dtl.Cc_Code;
V_F_Rcrd_No := I_Post_Dtl.Rcrd_No;
V_L_Rcrd_No := I_Post_Dtl.Rcrd_No;
V_Dr_Amt := I_Post_Dtl.Dr_Amt;
V_Cr_Amt := I_Post_Dtl.Cr_Amt;
V_A:=1;
V_Dr_Amt := V_Dr_Amt+I_Post_Dtl.Dr_Amt;
V_Cr_Amt := V_Cr_Amt+I_Post_Dtl.Cr_Amt;
If I_Post_Dtl.Cr_Amt > 0 And V_Dr_Amt = V_Cr_Amt Then
Cntdrcr := Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Fld_Value('DETAIL_JOURNAL_V','Count(*)',' Where Nvl(J_AMT,0) > 0 And J_Ser = '||P_Doc_Ser||' And Rcrd_No Between '||V_F_Rcrd_No||' And '|| V_L_Rcrd_No);
Cntdrcr :=0;
If Nvl( Cntdrcr,0) = 1 Then
And Rcrd_No = V_F_Rcrd_No;
And Rcrd_No = V_L_Rcrd_No;
If V_Cc_Code Is Not Null Then
Cursor Cc_Dtl Is Select Doc_Type,Jv_Type,Doc_No,Doc_Ser,Doc_Date,Rcrd_No,Pj_No,ACTV_NO,
Cheque_Valued,Doc_Due_Da
te,Doc_Desc,Cheque_No,Ref_No,Wo_No,Wo_Ser,
Cc_Code,A_Cy,
-Sum(Amt) Amt, -Sum(Amt_F) Amt_F From Ias_Post_Dtl
And Nvl(Install_Type,0)<>9
And Cc_Code Is Not Null
And Cc_Code <> V_Cc_Code
And Rcrd_No Between V_F_Rcrd_No And V_L_Rcrd_No
Group By Doc_Type,Jv_Type,Doc_No,Doc_Ser,Doc_Date,Rcrd_No,Pj_No,ACTV_NO,
Cheque_Valued,Doc_Due_Date,Doc_Desc,Cheque_No,Ref_No,Wo_No,Wo_Ser,
Cc_Code,A_Cy
Having Abs(Sum(Amt))>0.1;
For M_Cv In Cc_Dtl Loop
V_Amt_Bal:=0;
Select Sum(Abs(Nvl(Amt,0))) Into V_Amt_Bal From Ias_Post_Dtl
Where Doc_Ser=M_Cv.Doc_Ser
And Cc_Code=M_Cv.Cc_Code
And Nvl(Rcrd_No,0)=Nvl(M_Cv.Rcrd_No,0);
If Abs(Nvl(V_Amt_Bal,0))>0.1 Then
V_Bal:=Ias_Posting_Pkg.Check_Acode (V_Ac_Balanced_Cc ,V_Local);
Ias_Posting_Pkg.Insrt_Post_Dtl(
P_A_Code => V_Ac_Balanced_Cc ,
P_Amt => M_Cv.Amt ,
P_Amt_F => M_Cv.Amt_F ,
P_J_Desc => Nvl(M_Cv.Doc_Desc,Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(V_Lang_No,3157)) ,
P_Cb_Before => V_Bal ,
P_Cheque_No => M_Cv.Cheque_No ,
P_Rcrd_No => M_Cv.Rcrd_No ,
P_Doc_Due_Date => M_Cv.Doc_Due_Date ,
P_Cheque_Valued => M_Cv.Cheque_Valued
P_Wo_No => M_Cv.Wo_No ,
P_Wo_Ser => M_Cv.Wo_Ser ,
P_Install_Type => 9 ,
P_From_Cc_Code => V_Cc_Code ,
P_Brn_No =>V_Brn_No ,
P_Brn_Year => V_Brn_Year ,
P_Cmp_No => Ias_Brn_Pkg.Get_Br_Cmp (V_Brn_No) ,
P_Brn_Usr => V_Brn_Usr);
P_Amt => -M_Cv.Amt ,
P_Amt_F => -M_Cv.Amt_F ,
P_Cc_Code => V_Cc_Code ,
P_Cheque_Valued => M_Cv.Cheque_Valued ,
P_From_Cc_Code => M_Cv.Cc_Code ,
P_Brn_No => V_Brn_No ,
V_F_Rcrd_No := V_L_Rcrd_No;
V_A:=0;
If Nvl(V_Cnt_Cc,0) > 1 Then
Cursor C_Post_Dtl_Db Is Select Doc_Type,Jv_Type,Doc_No,Doc_Ser,Doc_Date,
Cc_Code,Pj_No,Actv_No,Rcrd_No,Doc_Desc,
Ref_no,Cheque_No,Doc_Due_Date,Cheque_Valued,Wo_No,Wo_Ser,A_Cy,
Where Doc_Type = 1
And Nvl(Amt,0) > 0
And Nvl(Install_Type,0) <> 9
Order By Rcrd_No ;
Cursor C_Post_Dtl_Cr Is Select Doc_Type,Jv_Type,Doc_No,Doc_Ser,Doc_Date,
Nvl(Dr_Amt,0) Dr_Amt,Nvl(Cr_Amt,0) Cr_Amt, Nvl(Amt,0) Amt ,
And Nvl(Amt,0) < 0
For I_Db In C_Post_Dtl_Db Loop
Ias_Posting_Pkg.Insrt_Post_Dtl( P_Doc_Type => I_Db.Doc_Type ,
P_Jv_Type => I_Db.Jv_Type ,
P_Doc_No => I_Db.Doc_No ,
P_Doc_Ser => I_Db.Doc_Ser ,
P_A_Code => V_Ac_
Balanced_Cc ,
P_A_Cy => I_Db.A_Cy ,
P_Amt => -1*I_Db.Amt ,
P_Amt_F => -1*I_Db.Amt_F ,
P_J_Date => I_Db.Doc_Date ,
P_J_Desc => Nvl(I_Db.Doc_Desc,Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(V_Lang_No,3157)) ,
P_Cc_Code => I_Db.Cc_Code ,
P_Pj_No => I_Db.Pj_No ,
P_Actv_No => I_Db.Actv_No ,
P_Ref_No => I_Db.Ref_No ,
P_Cheque_No => I_Db.Cheque_No ,
P_Rcrd_No => I_Db.Rcrd_No ,
P_Doc_Due_Date => I_Db.Doc_Due_Date ,
P_Cheque_Valued => I_Db.Cheque_Valued ,
P_Wo_No => I_Db.Wo_No ,
P_Wo_Ser => I_Db.Wo_Ser ,
P_From_Cc_Code => V_Cc_Code_Dr ,
For I_Cr In C_Post_Dtl_Cr Loop
Ias_Posting_Pkg.Insrt_Post_Dtl( P_Doc_Type => I_Cr.Doc_Type ,
P_Jv_Type => I_Cr.Jv_Type ,
P_Doc_No => I_Cr.Doc_No ,
P_Doc_Ser => I_Cr.Doc_Ser ,
P_A_Cy => I_Cr.A_Cy ,
P_Amt => -1*I_Cr.Amt ,
P_Amt_F => -1*I_Cr.Amt_F ,
P_J_Date => I_Cr.Doc_Date ,
P_J_Desc => Nvl(I_Cr.Doc_Desc,Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(V_Lang_No,3157)) ,
P_Cc_Code => I_Cr.Cc_Code ,
P_Pj_No => I_Cr.Pj_No ,
P_Actv_No => I_Cr.Actv_No ,
P_Ref_No => I_Cr.Ref_No ,
P_Cheque_No => I_Cr.Cheque_No ,
P_Rcrd_No => I_Cr.Rcrd_No ,
P_Doc_Due_Date => I_Cr.Doc_Due_Date ,
P_Cheque_Valued => I_Cr.Cheque_Valued ,
P_Wo_No => I_Cr.Wo_No ,
P_Wo_Ser => I_Cr.Wo_Ser ,
P_From_Cc_Code => V_Cc_Code_Cr ,
Elsif Nvl(P_Doc_Type,0) In (2,3) Then
Select Cheq_Type Into V_Cheq_Type
From Vouchers Where V_Ser = P_Doc_Ser ;
If V_Cheq_Type = 3 Then
And A_Code = V_Ac_Balanced_Cc
And Nvl(Install_Type,0)= 9 ;
Elsif Nvl(P_Doc_Type,0) =11 Then
From Warehouse_Details Where W_Code In
(Select T_W_Code From Ias_Whtrns_Mst Where Tr_Ser = P_Doc_Ser);
If Nvl(V_Cnt_Cc,0) > 1 And P_Doc_Type <> 1 Then
Cursor Cc_Dtl Is Select Doc_Type,Jv_Type,Doc_No,Doc_Ser,Doc_Date,Rcrd_No,Pj_No,Actv_No,
And Cc_Code <> Nvl(V_Cc_Code,Cc_Code)
Group By Doc_Type,Jv_Type,Doc_No,Doc_Ser,Doc_Date,Rcrd_No,Pj_No,Actv_No,
=> M_Cv.Actv_No ,
P_Cmp_No => Ias_Brn_
Pkg.Get_Br_Cmp (V_Brn_No) ,
Cc_Code,A_Cy,-Sum(Amt) Amt , -Sum(Amt_F) Amt_F From Ias_Post_Dtl
End Balanced_Cc;
V_Cnt_Brn Number ;
V_Brn_No_Dr S_Brn.Brn_No%Type ;
V_Brn_No_Cr S_Brn.Brn_No%Type ;
V_F_Brn_No S_Brn.Brn_No%Type ;
V_Cnt_Cr Number ;
V_Cnt_Dr Number ;
--##------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------##--
Select Count(Distinct Brn_No)
Into V_Cnt_Brn
And Brn_No Is Not Null ;
V_Cnt_Brn := 0 ;
V_Cnt_Brn := 1 ;
Select Doc_Brn_No Into V_Brn_No_Dr
V_Brn_No_Dr := Null ;
Select Doc_Brn_No Into V_Brn_No_Cr
V_Brn_No_Cr := Null ;
If Nvl(V_Cnt_Brn,0) > 1 Then
Nvl(Dr_Amt_F,0) Dr_Amt_F,Nvl(Cr_Amt_F,0) Cr_Amt_F, Nvl(Amt_F,0) Amt_F ,
Brn_No,Doc_Brn_No,Brn_Usr,Cmp_No
Select Ac_Balanced_Brn
Into V_Ac_Balanced_Brn
Where Brn_No= I_Db.Doc_Brn_No
Raise_Application_Error(-20606,Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Msg(V_Lang_No,1508)||Sqlerrm) ;
V_Bal:=Ias_Posting_Pkg.Check_Acode (V_Ac_Balanced_Brn ,V_Local);
P_A_Code => V_Ac_Balanced_Brn ,
P_From_Cc_Code => I_Db.Cc_Code ,
P_Brn_No => I_Db.Doc_Brn_No ,
P_F_Brn_No => nvl(V_Brn_No_Dr ,I_Db.brn_no ) ,
P_Doc_Brn_No => I_Db.Doc_Brn_No ,
P_Brn_Usr => I_Db.Brn_Usr ,
P_Cmp_No => I_Db.Cmp_No )
Where Brn_No= I_Cr.Doc_Brn_No
P_A_Cy

FUNCTION GET_CC_CODE (
,P_CC_CODE IN COST_CENTERS.CC_CODE%TYPE
,P_WC_CODE IN WAREHOUSE_DETAILS.W_CODE%TYPE DEFAULT NULL
RETURN VARCHAR2 IS

CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE Body IAS_Trns_Pkg Is
FUNCTION Get_Sordr_Resvd_Qty (P_i_code In Ias_Itm_Mst.I_CODE%TYPE,P_w_code In WAREHOUSE_DETAILS.W_CODE%TYPE,P_billDate In Date)
RETURN Number IS
v_soqty Number;
Select nvl(sum(nvl(i_qty,0)+nvl(Free_qty,0)),0)
Into v_soqty
From order_detail
where i_code=P_i_code
and w_code=P_w_code
and res_date>=P_billDate
and nvl(reserved,0)=1;
Return(v_soqty);
END Get_Sordr_Resvd_Qty;
PROCEDURE Update_Bill_Disc_Prc (P_docser In Number, P_disc_type In Number) IS
If P_disc_type = 0 Then --
Discount In Master Only
and nvl(P_billamt,0)> 0
Update Ias_Bill_Dtl a Set dis_amt_mst =(Select (nvl(disc_amt_mst,0)/nvl(bill_amt,0))*nvl(a.i_price,0) From Ias_Bill_Mst
Where bill_ser=a.bill_ser
and bill_ser=P_docser),
dis_amt =(Select (nvl(disc_amt_mst,0)/nvl(bill_amt,0))*nvl(a.i_price,0) From Ias_Bill_Mst
and bill_ser=P_docser)
where bill_ser=P_docser;
ElsIf P_Disc_type = 1 Then --Discount In master & Detail
----and nvl(P_billamt,0)> 0 Then
dis_amt =(Select ((nvl(disc_amt_mst,0)/nvl(bill_amt,0))*nvl(a.i_price,0)) + nvl(a.dis_amt_dtl,0)+ nvl(a.dis_amt_dtl2,0)+ nvl(a.dis_amt_dtl3,0) From Ias_Bill_Mst
Update_Bill_Disc_Prc;

PROCEDURE Update_RtBill_Disc_Prc (P_docser In Number, P_disc_type In Number) Is

Where rt_bill_ser=a.rt_bill_ser
and rt_bill_ser=P_docser),
dis_amt =(Select (nvl(disc_amt_mst,0)/nvl(bill_amt,0))*nvl(a.i_price,0) From Ias_Rt_Bill_Mst
and rt_bill_ser=P_docser)
where rt_bill_ser=P_docser;
dis_amt =(Select ((nvl(disc_amt_mst,0)/nvl(bill_amt,0))*nvl(a.i_price,0)) + nvl(a.dis_amt_dtl,0)+ nvl(a.dis_amt_dtl2,0)+ nvl(a.dis_amt_dtl3,0) From Ias_Rt_Bill_Mst

PROCEDURE Update_Othr_Chrg (P_bill_ser In Number ,P_Dec_No In Number) Is
Oth_amt Number;
Select Round(nvl(sum(amt),0),P_Dec_No)
Into oth_amt
From Other_Charges
and bill_ser=P_bill_ser;
oth_amt:=0;
Update Ias_Bill_Mst Set Othr_amt = nvl(oth_amt,0)
where bill_ser=P_bill_ser;
End Update_Othr_Chrg;
--========================================================
P_Op_type In Varchar2 Default Null) Is
If P_Disc_Type = 1 Then
Update Ias_Bill_Mst
Set Add_Disc_Amt_Mst = (Select Nvl(Sum(Nvl(Add_Disc_Amt_Mst,0)),0)
From Ias_Bill_Mst_Add_Disc
Where Bill_Ser=P_Docser
And Decode(P_Op_type,'D',Doc_No,1)<>Decode(P_Op_type,'D',P_Doc_No,0)),
Disc_Amt = Nvl(Nvl(Disc_Amt_Mst,0)+ (Select Sum(Nvl(Add_Disc_Amt_Mst,0))
And Decode(P_Op_type,'D',Doc_No,1)<>Decode(P_Op_type,'D',P_Doc_No,0))
+ Nvl(Disc_Amt_Dtl,0) + Nvl(Add_Disc_Amt_Dtl,0),0)
Where Bill_Ser = P_Docser ;
Update Ias_Bill_Dtl A Set Add_Dis_Amt_Mst = Nvl((Select (Nvl(Add_Disc_Amt_Mst,0)/Nvl(Bill_Amt,0))*Nvl(A.I_Price,0)
Where Bill_Ser=P_Docser),0),
Dis_Amt = Nvl(Dis_Amt_Mst,0)+Nvl((Select (Nvl(Add_Disc_Amt_Mst,0)/Nvl(Bill_Amt,0))*Nvl(A.I_Price,0)
Where Bill_Ser=P_Docser),0)+Nvl(Dis_Amt_Dtl,0)+Nvl(Add_Dis_Amt_Dtl,0)
Where Bill_Ser=P_Docser;
Elsif P_Disc_Type=2 Then
Update Ias_Bill_Mst A Set Add_Disc_Amt_Dtl = (Select Nvl(Sum(Nvl(Add_Dis_Qty,0)*Nvl(Add_Dis_Amt_Dtl,0)),0)
From Ias_Bill_Dtl_Add_Disc
Where Bill_Ser=A.Bill_Ser
--And Decode(P_Op_type,'D',Doc_No,'DR',Doc_Sequence,1)<>Decode(P_Op_type,'D',Doc_No,'DR',P_Doc_Seq,0)),
Disc_Amt = Nvl(Disc_Amt_Mst,0)+Nvl(Add_Disc_Amt_Mst,0)+Nvl(Disc_Amt_Dtl,0)+
(Select Nvl(Sum(Nvl(Add_Dis_Qty,0)*Nvl(Add_Dis_Amt_Dtl,0)),0)
Where Exists(Select 1 From Ias_Bill_Dtl_Add_Disc
Where Bill_Ser = A.Bill_Ser
And Doc_No = P_Doc_No
And Rownum<=1);
Update Ias_Bill_Dtl A Set Add_Dis_Amt_Dtl = (Select Nvl(Sum((Nvl(Dtl_Disc.Add_Dis_Qty,0)*Nvl(Dtl_Disc.Add_Dis_Amt_Dtl,0))/Nvl(Dtl.I_Qty,0)),0)
From Ias_Bill_Dtl_Add_Disc Dtl_Disc,Ias_Bill_Dtl Dtl
Where Dtl_Disc.Bill_Ser = Dtl.Bill_Ser
And Dtl_Disc.Rcrd_No = Dtl.Rcrd_No
And Dtl_Disc.Doc_Sequence = Dtl.Doc_Sequence
And Dtl_Disc.Bill_Ser = A.Bill_Ser
And Dtl_Disc.Rcrd_No = A.Rcrd_No
And Dtl_Disc.Doc_Sequence = A.Doc_Sequence
--And Decode(P_Op_type,'D',Doc_No,'DR',Dtl_Disc.Doc_Sequence,1)<>Decode(P_Op_type,'D',Doc_No,'DR',P_Doc_Seq,0)),
Dis_Amt =Nvl(Dis_Amt_Mst,0)+Nvl(Add_Dis_Amt_Mst,0)+Nvl(Dis_Amt_Dtl,0)+
(Select Nvl(Sum((Nvl(Dtl_Disc.Add_Dis_Qty,0)*Nvl(Dtl_Disc.Add_Dis_Amt_Dtl,0))/Nvl(Dtl.I_Qty,0)),0)
And I_Code = A.I_Code
And Rcrd_No = A.Rcrd_No
And Doc_Sequence = A.Doc_Sequence
Update_Bill_Add_Disc_Prc;

P_Msg_No:=502;
ElsIF P_scr_typ In (4,5) and v_prv_rprt = 0 THEN
P_Msg_No:=508;

P_up_date In Date Default null) Is

and v_code = P_Vcode

Cursor Ac_cv Is Select a_code From Account
Start with A_code= P_a_code
Connect by A_code = Prior A_PARENT Order by Level;
For i in Ac_cv Loop
V_Parnt_code:=i.A_code ;
V_Parnt_code:=NULL;
Else -- Get Parent Account
Select A_Parent
Into V_Parnt_code
Where A_code=P_a_code ;
RETURN(V_Parnt_code);

FUNCTION Get_CB_Name (P_Cb_Type In Number,P_Cb_No In Number,P_Lng_no In Number) RETURN VARCHAR2 Is
If P_Cb_Type = 1 Then -- Cash
Decode(P_Lng_no,1,CASH_NAME,nvl(CASH_E_NAME,CASH_NAME))
From Cash_In_hand
where Cash_no=P_Cb_No ;
ElsIf P_Cb_Type = 2 Then -- Bank
Select Decode(P_Lng_no,1,BANK_NAME,nvl(BANK_E_NAME,BANK_NAME))
where bank_no=P_Cb_No ;
End Get_CB_Name ;
FUNCTION Get_CB_No_By_Nm (P_Cb_Type In Number,P_cb_nm In ACCOUNT.A_NAME%TYPE) RETURN VARCHAR2 Is
v_cb_no NUMBER(15);
IF P_Cb_Type = 1 THEN
select Cash_no
Into v_cb_no
where (cash_name = P_cb_nm or cash_e_name =P_cb_nm )
select Bank_no
where (bank_name = P_cb_nm or bank_e_name =P_cb_nm )
RETURN(v_cb_no);
End Get_CB_No_By_Nm ;

where Cash_no=P_Cb_No
From Ias_Cash_At_Bank_Dtl
where Bank_no=P_Cb_No

where Bank_no=P_Cb_No;

End Get_CB_Ser;

FUNCTION Get_CB_Bal(P_Cb_Type In Number,P_Cb_No In Number,P_a_cy In VARCHAR2) RETURN Number Is

From Ias_Cash_at_Bank_Dtl

PROCEDURE Get_Cshbnk_Lmt ( P_amt_Type In number,
P_amt In number,
P_Cb_Type In number,
P_local_cur In Varchar2,
P_Min_lmt out Number,
P_Min_Trns_lmt out Number,
P_Max_Trns_lmt out Number,
P_Pass out Number,
P_Lng In Number) IS
Bal Number:=0;
Select Nvl(ACC_LMT_PRV,1)
If P_Cb_Type = 1 Then --## cash limt
Select Round(Min_lmt_AMT,P_Frc_no),Round(Max_lmt_AMT,P_Frc_no),
Round(MIN_LMT_TRNS_AMT,P_Frc_no),Round(MAX_LMT_TRNS_AMT,P_Frc_no),Pass_Lmt
Into P_Min_lmt, P_Max_lmt,
P_Min_Trns_lmt, P_Max_Trns_lmt, P_Pass
From Ias_cash_in_hand_Dtl
And A_CY = P_acy
P_Min_lmt :=0;
P_Max_lmt :=0;
P_Min_Trns_lmt :=0;
P_Max_Trns_lmt :=0;
ElsIf P_Cb_Typ
e = 2 Then --## bank limt
From Ias_cash_AT_BANK_Dtl
where BANK_no = P_Cb_No
Bal:=Round(Ias_Csh
Bnk_Pkg.Get_CB_Bal( P_Cb_Type => P_Cb_Type,
P_Cb_No => P_Cb_No,
P_a_cy
=> P_acy ),P_frc_no);
V_Amt:=nvl(P_amt,0);
--## Max_lmt
If P_Max_lmt Is Not Null and P_Amt_type=1 Then
IF nvl(Bal,0)+Nvl(V_Amt,0)>P_Max_lmt Then
P_Msg:=Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(P_Lng,571)||' = '||P_MAX_LMT||' '||
Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(P_Lng,660)||' = '||Round((nvl(Bal,0)+NVL(V_Amt,0)),P_frc_no)||
Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(P_Lng,999)||' = '||Round(abs(P_MAX_LMT-(nvl(Bal,0)+NVL(V_Amt,0))),P_frc_no)||' , '||
Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(P_Lng,3604)||' = '||Abs(Round(((nvl(P_MAX_LMT,0)-Nvl(NVL(V_Amt,0),0)-(nvl(nvl(Bal,0),0))) /nvl(P_MAX_LMT,0))*100,2));
--## Min_lmt
If P_Min_lmt Is Not Null and P_Amt_type=2 Then
IF nvl(Bal,0)-Nvl(V_Amt,0)<nvl(P_Min_lmt,0) Then
P_Msg:=Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(P_Lng,570)||' = '||P_MIN_LMT||' '||
Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(P_Lng,660)||' = '||Round((nvl(Bal,0)-NVL(V_Amt,0)),P_frc_no)||' '||
Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(P_Lng,999)||' = '||Round(abs((nvl(Bal,0)-NVL(V_Amt,0))-P_MIN_LMT),P_frc_no)||' , '||
Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(P_Lng,3604)||' = '||Abs(Round(((nvl(P_MIN_LMT,0)-Nvl(NVL(V_Amt,0),0)-(nvl(nvl(Bal,0),0))) /nvl(P_MIN_LMT,0))*100,2));
--## Max_trns_lmt
If P_Max_Trns_lmt Is Not Null Then
IF Nvl(V_Amt,0)> nvl(P_Max_Trns_lmt,0) Then
P_Msg:=Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(P_Lng,573)||' = '||P_MAX_TRNS_LMT||
Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(P_Lng,660)||' = '||Round(NVL(V_Amt,0),P_frc_no)||' '||
Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(P_Lng,999)||' = '||Round(abs(nvl(P_MAX_TRNS_LMT,0)-NVL(V_Amt,0)),P_frc_no)||' , '||
Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(P_Lng,3604)||' = '||Abs(Round(((nvl(P_MAX_TRNS_LMT,0)-Nvl(NVL(V_Amt,0),0)) /nvl(P_MAX_TRNS_LMT,0))*100,2));
--## Min_trns_lmt
If P_Min_Trns_lmt Is Not Null Then
IF Nvl(V_Amt,0)< nvl(P_Min_Trns_lmt,0) Then
P_Msg:=Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(P_Lng,572)||' = '||P_Min_TRNS_LMT||
Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(P_Lng,660)||' = '||Round(ABS(NVL(V_Amt,0)),P_frc_no)||' '||
Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(P_Lng,999)||' = '||Round(abs(nvl(P_Min_TRNS_LMT,0)-ABS(NVL(V_Amt,0))),P_frc_no)||' , '||
Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(P_Lng,3604)||' = '||Abs(Round(((nvl(P_Min_TRNS_LM
T,0)-Nvl(ABS(NVL(V_Amt,0)),0)) /nvl(P_Min_TRNS_LMT,0))*100,2));
End Get_Cshbnk_Lmt;
v_Inc_Sales Number;
IF P_Ac_Dtl_Typ =1 THEN -- CASH
Select Decode(P_Lng_no,1,CASH_NAME,nvl(CASH_E_NAME,CASH_NAME)) , nvl(M.INACTIVE,0), 1 ADD_FLAG,1 VIEW_FLAG
Into P_Csh_Nm,v_Inc,v_prv_scr,v_prv_rprt
From CASH_IN_HAND M
Where M.Cash_No = P_Csh_No
And M.A_Code = P_Ac_Code
Select Decode(P_Lng_no,1,CASH_NAME,nvl(CASH_E_NAME,CASH_NAME)) , nvl(M.INACTIVE,0), Nvl(D.ADD_FLAG,0),Nvl(D.VIEW_FLAG,0)
From CASH_IN_HAND M,PRIV_CASH D
Where M.Cash_No = D.Cash_No
And M.Cash_No = P_Csh_No
And D.U_ID = P_Usr_No
And d.Cash_Type =1
ELSIF P_Ac_Dtl_Typ=2 THEN -- BANK
Select Decode(P_Lng_no,1,BANK_NAME,nvl(BANK_E_NAME,BANK_NAME)) , nvl(M.INACTIVE,0), 1 ADD_FLAG,1 VIEW_FLAG
From CASH_AT_BANK M
Where M.Bank_No = P_Csh_NO
Select Decode(P_Lng_no,1,BANK_NAME,nvl(BANK_E_NAME,BANK_NAME)), nvl(M.INACTIVE,0), Nvl(D.ADD_FLAG,0),Nvl(D.VIEW_FLAG,0)
From CASH_AT_BANK M,PRIV_CASH D
Where M.Bank_No = D.Cash_No
And M.Bank_No = P_Csh_No
And d.Cash_Type =2
P_Msg_No:=22 ;
If P_Ac_Dtl_Typ = 1 Then
P_Msg_No:=1436;
P_Msg_No:=600;
END Chk_CshBnk_No;

CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE Body IAS_DBS_Sys_Pkg IS
FUNCTION Check_Cons ( P_ConsNm In VARCHAR2 Default Null,
P_ColNm In VARCHAR2 Default Null) RETURN NUMBER Is
Cnt number;
From User_constraints a, User_cons_columns b
Where a.owner=b.owner
and a.constraint_name=b.constraint_name
and a.table_name=b.table_name
and a.table_name=Decode(P_TabNm,null,a.table_name,Upper(P_TabNm))
and b.column_name=Decode(P_ColNm,null,b.column_name,Upper(P_ColNm))
and a.constraint_type=Decode(P_ConsType,null,a.constraint_type,Upper(P_ConsType))
and a.constraint_name=Decode(P_ConsNm,null,a.constraint_name,Upper(P_ConsNm));
End Check_Cons;
and a.constraint_name=Decode(P_ConsNm,null,a.constraint_name,Upper(P_ConsNm))
and a.status = 'DISABLED';
End Check_Cons_St;
FUNCTION Get_Cons_Name ( P_TabNm In VARCHAR2 Default Null,P_ConsType In VARCHAR2 Default Null ,
P_ColNm In VARCHAR2 Default Null) RETURN CHAR Is
v_ConsNm Varchar2(50);
Select a.constraint_name Into v_ConsNm
From User_constraints a,User_cons_columns b
where a.owner=b.owner
RETURN(v_ConsNm);
RETURN Null;
End Get_Cons_Name;
FUNCTION Check_Object ( P_ObjNm In VARCHAR2 , P_ObjType In VARCHAR2 Default Null , P_ColNm In VARCHAR2 Default Null) RETURN NUMBER IS
If P_ObjNm Is Not Null and P_ColNm Is Not Null Then
From User_Tab_Columns
where Table_Name =Upper(P_ObjNm)
and Column_name=Upper(P_ColNm)
From User_Objects
Where Object_Name = Upper(P_ObjNm)
and OBJECT_TYPE = Decode(p_ObjType, Null,OBJECT_TYPE,Upper(p_ObjType))
END Check_Object;
PROCEDURE Check_St_OBJ ( P_Result In Out NUMBER ,P_ObjNm In VARCHAR2 Default Null ) Is
Into P_Result
where STATUS='INVALID'
and OBJECT_NAME =Decode( P_ObjNm,null,OBJECT_NAME,Upper(P_ObjNm))
If p_Result > 0 Then
Cursor c1 Is Select Decode(OBJECT_TYPE,'PACKAGE BODY','PACKAGE',OBJECT_TYPE) OBJECT_TYPE,OBJECT_NAME
From User_objects
Where Status='INVALID'
and OBJECT_TYPE<>'TABLE';
For i in c1 Loop
Execute Immediate 'ALTER '||i.OBJECT_TYPE||' '||i.OBJECT_NAME||' COMPILE';
p_Result:=0;
End Check_St_OBJ;
FUNCTION Check_TabSp ( P_TsNm In VARCHAR2 ) RETURN NUMBER Is
From User_Tablespaces
where TABLESPACE_NAME =Upper(P_TsNm)
END Check_TabSp;
Function Check_Ias_User( P_Brn_Year In Number
,P_Brn_no In Number)
RETURN varchar2 Is
V_User Varchar2(30);
Select UserName
Into V_User
From All_Users
where USERNAME='IAS'||P_Brn_Year||P_Brn_No
and rownum <= 1;
--when no_data_found then
--null;
Raise_Application_Error(-20460,'Error when checking Accounting user existance' || chr(10) || sqlerrm);
RETURN Upper(V_User);
End Check_Ias_User;
FUNCTION Get_Comment ( P_Lng In Number,
P_TabNm In Varchar2,
P_ColNm In Varchar2 Default Null,
P_Usr_Nm In Varchar2 Default Null) RETURN varchar2 Is
v_com_dsc Varchar2(800);
v_com_no Number;
If P_TabNm Is Not Null and P_ColNm Is Null Then -- Table
If P_Usr_Nm Is Null Then
Select COMMENTS
Into v_com_dsc
From User_Tab_Comments
where TABLE_NAME = P_TabNm
From ALL_Tab_Comments
where OWNER = P_Usr_Nm
and TABLE_NAME = P_TabNm
ElsIf P_TabNm Is Not Null and P_ColNm Is Not Null Then -- Columns
From User_Col_Comments
and COLUMN_NAME =P_ColNm
From ALL_Col_Comments
where Owner = P_Usr_Nm
v_com_no:= LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTR(v_com_dsc,1,(INSTR(v_com_dsc,'-')) -1 )));
IF v_com_no Is Null Then
v_com_no:=LTRIM(RTRIM(v_com_dsc));
v_com_no:=null;
If v_com_no Is Not Null Then
RETURN(Ys_Gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt(P_Lng,v_com_no));
Elsif v_com_dsc Is Not Null Then
RETURN(v_com_dsc);
End Get_Comment;
PROCEDURE ALTR_DBS( P_TB IN VARCHAR2, P_TR_TYPE IN VARCHAR2,P_FD IN VARCHAR2) Is
Execute Immediate 'ALTER TABLE '||P_TB||' '||P_TR_TYPE||' '||P_FD;
End ALTR_DBS;
FUNCTION GET_DATE_OBJCT_CHNG_DDL ( P_Obj_Nm In VARCHAR2 , P_Obj_Typ In VARCHAR2 Default Null) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
V_DATE VARCHAR2 (100);
If P_Obj_Nm Is Not Null Then
Select TO_CHAR(NVL(LAST_DDL_TIME, CREATED),'DD/MM/RRRR HH24:MI:SS')
Into V_DATE
Where Object_Name = Upper(P_Obj_Nm)
and OBJECT_TYPE = Decode(p_Obj_Typ, Null,OBJECT_TYPE,Upper(p_Obj_Typ))
RETURN(V_DATE);
END GET_DATE_OBJCT_CHNG_DDL;

and Status = 'VALID'
END Check_Valid_Object;

CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE Body IAS_Check_DBS_Pkg IS
PROCEDURE Check_WtAvg_Itm Is
P_Costing_Type Number;
P_Wtavg_Type Number;
Select nvl(Costing_Type,2) ,nvl(Wtavg_Type,1)
Into P_Costing_Type,P_Wtavg_Type
P_Costing_Type:=2;
P_Wtavg_Type:=1;
If P_Costing_Type = 2 Then-- Use watavg
If P_Wtavg_Type = 1 Then -- by Itm
If IAS_DBS_Sys_Pkg.Check_Object('IAS_V_DIFF_WTAVG_ITM','VIEW') > 0 AND
IAS_DBS_Sys_Pkg.Check_Object('IAS_ITM_WTAVG_TMP','TABLE') > 0 Then
Delete From IAS_ITM_WTAVG_TMP;
Insert Into IAS_ITM_WTAVG_TMP
(I_CODE,I_CWTAVG)
Select I_CODE,WT_AVG_AFTER From IAS_V_DIFF_WTAVG_ITM;
Select Count(1) Into cnt From IAS_ITM_WTAVG_TMP;
Update Ias_Itm_Mst Itm Set I_cwtavg = ( Select nvl(I_cwtavg,0) From IAS_ITM_WTAVG_TMP
where I_code = Itm.I_Code)
Where I_Code In ( Select I_code From IAS_ITM_WTAVG_TMP);
Rollback;
ElsIf P_Wtavg_Type = 2 Then -- by Itm + Wcode
If IAS_DBS_Sys_Pkg.Check_Object('IAS_V_DIFF_WTAVG_WCODE_ITM','VIEW') > 0 and
Insert Into IAS_ITM_WTAVG_TMP (I_CODE,I_CWTAVG,W_CODE)
Select I_CODE,WT_AVG_AFTER,W_CODE From IAS_V_DIFF_WTAVG_WCODE_ITM;
Update ias_itm_wcode Itm Set I_cwtavg = ( Select nvl(I_cwtavg,0) * nvl(Itm.P_size,1) From IAS_ITM_WTAVG_TMP
where I_code = Itm.I_code
and w_code = Itm.w_code)
Where (I_Code,W_Code ) In ( Select I_Code ,W_Code From IAS_ITM_WTAVG_TMP);
ElsIf P_Wtavg_Type = 3 Then -- by Itm + Whgcode
If IAS_DBS_Sys_Pkg.Check_Object('IAS_V_DIFF_WTAVG_WHGCODE_ITM','VIEW') > 0 and
Insert Into IAS_ITM_WTAVG_TMP (I_CODE,I_CWTAVG,WHG_CODE)
Select I_CODE,WT_AVG_AFTER,WHG_CODE From IAS_V_DIFF_WTAVG_WHGCODE_ITM;
where I_Code = Itm.I_Code
and whg_code = Itm.whg_code)
Where ( I_Code,Whg_Code ) In ( Select I_Code,Whg_Code From IAS_ITM_WTAVG_TMP);
End Check_WtAvg_Itm;
FUNCTION Check_Cpqty RETURN Number Is
Select 1 Into cnt From
Select gr_no,pi_type,I_Code,w_code,Rec_No,nvl(Sum(p_qty),0)
group by gr_no,pi_type,I_Code,w_code,Rec_No
Select gr_no,pi_type,I_Code,w_code,Rec_No,((nvl(p_qty,0)+(nvl(free_qty,0)*nvl(p_size,1))-nvl(cp_qty,0)))
End Check_Cpqty;
PROCEDURE Update_Cpqty Is
Rqty Number := 0;
EnQty Number := 0;
Cursor avl_cv Is
Select Item_Movement.I_Code,
Item_Movement.w_code w_code,
nvl(to_char(item_movement.Expire_date,'DD/MM/YYYY'),'01/01/1900') Expire_date,
nvl(item_movement.batch_no,'0') batch_no,
avl_qty,cp_qty,
Sum(Decode(in_out
,1,nvl(item_movement.p_qty,0)+ (nvl(item_movement.fr
ee_qty,0)*nvl(item_movement.p_size,1)),0)) -
,-1,nvl(item_movement.p_qty,0)+ (nvl(item_movement.free_qty,0)*nvl(item_movement.p_size,1)),0)) Aql
From Item_movement,Ias_Itm_Wcode,
(Select I_code,w_code,nvl(sum(cp_qty),0) cp_qty From gr_detail Group By I_Code,w_code) Gr
Where item_movement.I_Code=Ias_Itm_Wcode.I_Code
and item_movement.I_Code=gr.I_Code
and item_movement.w_code=Ias_Itm_Wcode.w_code
and item_movement.w_code=gr.w_code
and cp_qty <> avl_qty
Group by item_movement.I_Code,item_movement.w_code,avl_qty,cp_qty,item_movement.Expire_date,item_movement.batch_no;
For j In avl_cv Loop --(1)
Update Gr_Detail Set cp_qty=nvl(P_qty,0)+(Nvl(Free_Qty,0)*nvl(P_Size,1))
Where I_Code =j.I_Code
and w_code =j.w_code
and Nvl(Expire_Date,'01/01/1900')=Nvl(j.Expire_Date,'01/01/1900')
and Nvl(Batch_No,'0')=Nvl(j.batch_no,'0');
Raise_Application_Error(-20460,'Error when update gr_detail by i_code = '||j.I_Code|| chr(10) || SqlErrm);
cnt:=cnt+1;
Cursor ItmMv_cv Is
Select doc_type, bill_doc_type, doc_no, I_Code,
i_qty, Itm_Unt, nvl(p_size,1) p_size, nvl(p_qty,0) p_qty,i_date, i_cost, w_code,
cc_code, stk_cost, a_desc, a_cy, gr_no,
expire_date, nvl(free_qty,0) free_qty , nvl(pf_qty,0) pf_qty, rcrd_no, serial, batch_no,
doc_ser,doc_sequence,out_no,out_gr_ser
Where I_Code = j.I_Code
and w_code = j.w_code
and Nvl(Batch_No,'0')=Nvl(j.batch_no,'0')
and In_Out = -1
--And I_Code In(Select I_Code From Ias_Itm_Mst
-- Where Decode(:Parameter.Kit_Type,0,1,Nvl(Item_Type,0)) <> Decode(:Parameter.Kit_Type,0,0,:Parameter.Kit_Type))
Order By I_Code,I_Date,Serial;
For k In ItmMv_cv Loop --(2)
Rqty := 0;
EnQty := 0;
Cursor grd_cv Is Select Gr_Detail.I_Code,Gr_Detail.Gr_No,nvl(Gr_Detail.Cp_Qty,0) cp_qty,
nvl(Gr_Detail.p_Qty,0) p_qty,P_Size,Gr_Detail.Pi_Type,Gr_Detail.W_Code,
Gr_Detail.Rec_no,Expire_Date,Batch_No,
nvl(free_qty,0) free_qty,
nvl(Gr_Detail.G_ser,0) G_ser
And Gr_Detail.W_Code =j.w_code
And Nvl(Expire_Date,'01/01/1900')=Nvl(j.Expire_Date,'01/01/1900')
And Nvl(Batch_No,'0')=Nvl(j.Batch_No,'0')
And nvl(cp_qty,0) > 0
Order by Gr_Detail.Gr_Date, Gr_Detail.Pi_Type, Gr_Detail.Gr_No ;
Rqty:=1;
EnQty:= nvl(k.p_qty,0)+ (k.free_qty*k.p_size) ;--i,I_Qty*i.PSize;
For i In grd_cv Loop --(3)
Rqty := i.cp_qty;
If Rqty >= EnQty Then
Update Gr_Detail Set Cp_Qty = nvl(Rqty,0) - nvl(EnQty,0)
Where I_Code = i.I_Code
And Gr_No = i.Gr_No
And Pi_Type = i.Pi_Type
And W_Code = i.W_Code
And Rec_No=i.Rec_No ;
RQty:=0;
Enqty:=0;
Update Gr_Detail Set Cp_Qty = 0
And nvl(G_ser,0) = nvl(i.G_ser,0)
And Expire_Date=i.Expire_Date
And Batch_No=i.Batch_No;
Enqty:=nvl(EnQty,0)- i.cp_qty;
End Update_Cpqty;
Procedure Update_Avlqty Is
Type Rec_Data Is Record(I_Code Item_Movement.I_Code%Type,
W_Code Item_Movement.W_Code%Type,
Avlqty Number);
Select I_Code,W_Code,Nvl(Sum(In_Out*(Nvl(P_Qty,0)+Nvl(Pf_Qty,0)) ),0) Avlqty
Bulk Collect Into V_Tab_Data
Group By W_Code,I_Code;
Forall I In V_Tab_Data.First .. V_Tab_Data.Last
Update Ias_Itm_Wcode Set Avl_Qty =V_Tab_Data(I).Avlqty
Where I_Code= V_Tab_Data(I).I_Code
And W_Code=V_Tab_Data(I).W_Code
And Avl_Qty Is Null ;
RollBack;
End Update_Avlqty;
P_Doc_Post In Number Default Null,

V_Mcst :=0;

If V_Bqty <> V_Mqty Then
If V_Bcnt = V_Mcnt Then

ElsIf P_Stp = 1 then
Raise_Application_Error(-20461,ias_gen_pkg.Get_Msg(P_Lng_No,940) || chr(10) || SqlErrm);
Insert Into Ias_Logs ( F_SYS, DOC_TYPE,LOG_DATE,LOG_DESC)

If V_Bcst <> V_Mcst Then
Select i_code,doc_sequence,nvl(stk_cost,0) Stk_Cost From Ias_Bill_Dtl

r_Failure;

Select 4 doc_type,bill_doc_type jv_type,bill_no doc_no,0 w_code,0 cc_code,bill_ser
where nvl(bill_post,0)=1';
Update Ias_Bill_Mst Set bill_post = 1
--=================================== Ias_Rt_Bill_Mst ===============================================
Select 5 doc_type,rt_bill_doc_type jv_type,rt_bill_no doc_no,0 w_code,0 cc_code,rt_bill_ser
where nvl(rt_bill_post,0)=1';
Update Ias_Rt_Bill_Mst Set rt_bill_post = 1
where rt_bill_ser In (select doc_ser From Ias_V_Chk_Post where doc_type=5);
--===================================== Purchase ==============================================
Select 6 doc_type,bill_doc_type jv_type,bill_no doc_no,0 w_code,0 cc_code,bill_ser
Update Ias_pi_bill_Mst Set bill_post = 1
--===================================== Purchase RETURN ======================================
Select 7 doc_type,rt_bill_doc_type jv_type,rt_bill_no doc_no,0 w_code,0 cc_code,rt_bill_ser
Update Ias_Pr_Bill_Mst Set rt_bill_post = 1
--================================== Inco
ming ================================================
Select doc_type,jv_type,doc_no,0 w_code,0 cc_code, doc_ser
Select 8 doc_type,Incom_Type jv_type,gr_no doc_no,0 w_code,0 cc_code,g_ser
and nvl(gr_post,0)=1';
Update gr_note Set gr_post = 1
and g_ser In (Select doc_ser From Ias_V_Chk_Post where doc_type=8);
--==================================== Outgoing ================================================
Select 9 doc_type,Out_Type jv_type,out_no doc_no,0 w_code,0 cc_code,out_ser
where nvl(out_post,0)=1';
Update Ias_Outgoing_Mst Set out_post = 1
where out_ser In (select out_ser From Ias_V_Chk_Post where doc_type=9);
--=================================== Stk_Adjsment =============================================
where nvl(stk_post,0)=1';
Update stk_adjustment Set stk_post=1
Select 11 doc_type,Tr_type jv_type,Tr_no,0 w_code,0 cc_code,tr_ser doc_ser
and nvl(Tr_post,0)= 1';
Update Ias_Whtrns_Mst Set tr_post=1
--==================## Result ##=======================
End Check_Posting2;
PROCEDURE Check_Mst_Dtl (P_Doc_Type In Number Default Null, P_stp In Number Default 0,P_desc_err In out Varchar2) Is
P_Doc_Type = 1 Or P_Doc_Type Is Null Then
Select j_doc_no,j_ser From master_journal_v
Where nvl(stand_by,0)=0
Select j_doc_no,j_ser From detail_journal_v)
If cnt > 0 and P_stp = 1 Then
Raise_Application_Error(-20503,'There is Record In Journal Exists In Master Does not Exists In Detail , '||SqlErrm);
Elsif cnt > 0 and P_stp = 0 Then
P_desc_err := 'There is Record In Journal Exists In Master Does not Exists In Detail';
If P_Doc_Type = 2 Or P_Doc_Type Is Null Then
Select voucher_no,v_ser From vouchers
and nvl(stand_by,0)=0
Select voucher_no,v_ser From voucher_detail
Where voucher_type=1)
Raise_Application_Error(-20504,'There is Record In Vouchers (Rec) Exists In Master Does not Exists In Detail , '||SqlErrm) ;
P_desc_err := 'There Is Record In Vouchers (Rec) Exists In Master Does not Exists In Detail';
If P_Doc_Type = 3 Or P_Doc_Type Is Null Then
Where voucher_type=2)
Raise_Application_Error(-20505,'There is Record In Vouchers (Pay) Exists In Master Does not Exists In Detail , '||SqlErrm) ;
P_desc_err := 'There Is Record In Vouchers (Pay) Exists In Master Does not Exists In Detail';
If P_Doc_Type = 4 Or P_Doc_Type Is Null Then
Select bill_no,bill_ser From ias_bill_mst
Select bill_no,bill_ser From ias_bill_dtl)
Raise_Application_Error(-20506,'There is Record In Bills Exists In Master Does not Exists In Detail , '||SqlErrm) ;
P_desc_err := 'There Is Record In Bills Exists In Master Does not Exists In Detail';
If P_Doc_Type = 5 Or P_Doc_Type Is Null Then
Select rt_bill_no,rt_bill_ser From ias_rt_bill_mst
Select rt_bill_no,rt_bill_ser From ias_rt_bill_dtl)
Raise_Application_Error(-20507,'There is Record In Sales RETURN Exists In Master Does not Exists In Detail , '||SqlErrm) ;
P_desc_err := 'There Is Record In Purchase RETURN Exists In Master Does not Exists In Detail';

Select bill_no,bill_ser From ias_pi_bill_mst
Select bill_no,bill_ser From ias_pi_bill_dtl)

P_desc_err := 'There Is Record In Purchase Inv. Exists In Master Does not Exists In Detail';

Select rt_bill_no,rt_bill_ser From ias_pr_bill_mst
Select rt_bill_no,rt_bill_ser From ias_pr_bill_dtl)
Raise_Application_Error(-20509,'There is Record In Purchase RETURN Exists In Master D
oes not Exists In Detail , '||SqlErrm) ;
If P_Doc_Type = 8 Or P_Doc_Type Is Null Then
Select gr_no,g_ser From gr_note
Select gr_no,g_ser From gr_detail
where pi_type=5)
Raise_Application_Error(-20509,'There is Record In Incoming Exists In Master Does not Exists In Detail , '||SqlErrm) ;
P_desc_err := 'There Is Record In Incoming Exists In Master Does not Exists In Detail';
If P_Doc_Type = 9 Or P_Doc_Type Is Null Then
Select out_no,out_ser From ias_outgoing_mst
Select out_no,out_ser From ias_outgoing_dtl)
Raise_Application_Error(-20509,'There is Record In Outgoing Exists In Master Does not Exists In Detail , '||SqlErrm) ;
P_desc_err := 'There Is Record In Outgoing Exists In
Master Does not Exists In Detail';
If P_Doc_Type = 10 Or P_Doc_Type Is Null Then
Select doc_no,doc_ser From stk_adjustment

Raise_Application_Error(-20509,'There is Record In stk_adjustment Exists In Master Does not Exists In Detail , '||SqlErrm) ;

If P_Doc_Type = 12 Or P_Doc_Type Is Null Then
where tr_inout_type =2
where tr_inout_type =2)

End Check_Mst_Dtl;

FUNCTION Get_Ac_Dtl_Typ (P_A_Code IN ACCOUNT.A_CODE%TYPE) RETURN NUMBER Is
V_Ac_Dtl_Typ ACCOUNT.AC_DTL_TYP%TYPE;
Select nvl(AC_DTL_TYP,0)
Into V_Ac_Dtl_Typ
where A_CODE=P_A_Code
RETURN(V_Ac_Dtl_Typ);
End Get_Ac_Dtl_Typ ;
P_get_nm_only In NUMBER DEFAULT 1) RETURN VARCHAR2 Is
V_Cntrl_Nm ACCOUNT.A_NAME%TYPE;
V_Ac_Dtl_Typ ACCOUNT.Ac_Dtl_Typ%TYPE;
V_LNG_NO LANG_DEF.LANG_NO
%TYPE := P_LNG_NO ;--NVL(P_LNG_NO,YS_PRMTR_PKG.GetPval (P_PRMTR => 'LANG_NO'));
IF P_Ac_Dtl_Typ IS NULL and P_AC_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN
V_Ac_Dtl_Typ:= Ys_Ac_Dtl_Pkg.Get_Ac_Dtl_Typ (P_A_CODE=>P_AC_CODE);
V_Ac_Dtl_Typ:=P_Ac_Dtl_Typ;
IF P_Ac_Code_Dtl Is Not Null and NVL(V_Ac_Dtl_Typ,0) <> 0 Then
If V_Ac_Dtl_Typ = 1 Then -- cash
Select DECODE(V_LNG_NO,1,CASH_NAME,CASH_E_NAME) CSH_NM
Into V_Cntrl_Nm
where CASH_NO = P_Ac_Code_Dtl
ElsIf V_Ac_Dtl_Typ = 2 Then -- Bank
Select DECODE(V_LNG_NO,1,BANK_NAME,BANK_E_NAME) BNK_NM
From CASH_AT_BANK
where BANK_NO = P_Ac_Code_Dtl
ElsIf V_Ac_Dtl_Typ = 3 Then -- CUSTOMER
Select DECODE(V_LNG_NO,1,C_A_NAME,NVL(C_E_NAME,C_A_NAME)) C_NM
From CUSTOMER
where C_CODE = P_Ac_Code_Dtl
ElsIf V_Ac_Dtl_Typ = 4 Then -- VENDOR
Select DECODE(V_LNG_NO,1,V_A_NAME,NVL(V_E_NAME,V_A_NAME)) V_NM
where V_CODE = P_Ac_Code_Dtl
ElsIf V_Ac_Dtl_Typ = 7 Then -- Employee
Select DECODE(V_LNG_NO,1,EMP_L_NM,EMP_F_NM) EMP_NM
rom S_EMP
where EMP_NO = P_Ac_Code_Dtl
ElsIf P_get_nm_only = 1 and nvl(V_Ac_Dtl_Typ,0) = 0 And P_Ac_Code Is Not Null Then -- no control accounts
Select DECODE(V_LNG_NO,1,A_NAME,NVL(A_NAME_ENG,A_NAME)) AC_NM
where A_Code = P_Ac_Code
RETURN(V_Cntrl_Nm);
END Get_Ac_Dtl_Nm ;
P_Ac_Dtl_Nm IN OUT ACCOUNT.A_Name%TYPE ,
P_Msg_No IN OUT Number) Is
P_Ac_Dtl_Typ:= Ys_Ac_Dtl_Pkg.Get_Ac_Dtl_Typ (P_A_CODE=>P_AC_CODE);
IF P_Ac_Code_Dtl Is Not Null and NVL(P_Ac_Dtl_Typ,0) <> 0 Then
If P_Ac_Dtl_Typ IN (1,2) Then -- cash Or Bank
IAS_CshBnk_Pkg.Chk_CshBnk_No ( P_Csh_No => P_Ac_Code_Dtl,
P_Ac_Code => P_Ac_Code,
P_Csh_Nm => P_Ac_Dtl_Nm,
P_Usr_No => P_Usr_No,
P_Scr_Typ => P_Scr_Typ,
P_Msg_No => P_Msg_No);
ElsIf P_Ac_Dtl_Typ = 3 Then -- CUSTOMER
Ias_Cst_Pkg.Chk_C_code ( P_C_Code => P_Ac_Code_Dtl,
P_Cst_Nm => P_Ac_Dtl_Nm,
P_Ar_Flg => P_Ar_Flg,
ElsIf P_Ac_Dtl_Typ = 4 Then -- VENDOR
IAS_Vndr_Pkg.Chk_V_code ( P_V_Code => P_Ac_Code_Dtl,
P_Apalt => P_Apalt,
P_Vnd_Nm => P_Ac_Dtl_Nm,
ElsIf P_Ac_Dtl_Typ = 7 Then -- EMPLOYEE
Ys_Emp_Pkg.Chk_Emp ( P_Hrs_Sys => 0,
P_Emp_No => P_Ac_Code_Dtl,
P_Doc_Date => P_Doc_Date,
P_Emp_Nm => P_Ac_Dtl_Nm,
P_Msg_No := Null;
END Chk_Ac_Dtl ;
--##----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------##--
P_A_CY IN ACCOUNT_CURR.A_CY%TYPE ) RETURN NUMBER Is
IF NVL(P_Ac_Dtl_Typ,0) Not in (0,7) And P_A_CY Is Not Null Then
If P_Ac_Dtl_Typ = 1 Then -- cash
V_Cnt := Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Cnt('Select 1
Where Cash_No = '''||P_Ac_Code_Dtl||'''
And A_Cy = '''||P_A_Cy||'''

If P_Ac_Dtl_Typ=1 Then
-----------------------------------------------
Select A_Cy InTo V_Acy From Ias_Cash_In_Hand_Dtl

ACCOUNT.A_CODE%TYPE;

CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE IAS_Anls_Pkg as
FUNCTION Get_Ac_Cntct_Anls_Fnc ( P_Anls_no In Number , P_Doc_Post In Number Default 1 ) RETURN VARCHAR2 ;
FUNCTION Get_Ac_Blnc_Anls_Fnc ( P_Anls_no In Number , P_Doc_Post In Number Default 1) RETURN NUMBER ;
FUNCTION Get_Value_Anls_Fnc ( P_Fld_Value In Varchar2 ) RETURN NUMBER ;
FUNCTION Get_Indctr_Fnc ( P_Typ_no In Number , P_Doc_Post In Number Default 1 ) RETURN NUMBER ;
End IAS_Anls_Pkg;
CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY IAS_Anls_Pkg as
--##------------------------------------------------------------------------------##--
FUNCTION Get_Ac_Cntct_Anls_Fnc ( P_Anls_no In Number , P_Doc_Post In Number Default 1 ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
V_ANLS VARCHAR2(2000);
Cursor F_cv Is SELECT ANLS_NO FROM IAS_ACCOUNT_ANLSYS
connect by prior ANLS_NO = ANLS_PARNT_NO
Start With ANLS_PARNT_NO = P_Anls_no OR ANLS_NO = P_Anls_no ;
V_ANLS:= V_ANLS||','||i.ANLS_NO;
V_ANLS := Substr(V_ANLS,2);
RETURN(V_ANLS);
END Get_Ac_Cntct_Anls_Fnc;
FUNCTION Get_Ac_Blnc_Anls_Fnc ( P_Anls_no In Number , P_Doc_Post In Number Default 1 ) RETURN NUMBER IS
V_ANLS_CNTCT VARCHAR2(2000);
V_ANLS_CNTCT:=Get_Ac_CNTCT_Anls_Fnc ( P_Anls_no);
IF V_ANLS_CNTCT IS NOT NULL THEN
Execute Immediate 'SELECT ABS(Round(nvl(sum(nvl(amt,0)),0) ,2))
FROM IAS_POST_DTL D , ACCOUNT B
WHERE B.A_CODE=D.A_CODE
AND B.A_ANALYSIS IN ('||V_ANLS_CNTCT||')
And nvl(doc_post,0) = Decode('||P_Doc_Post||',2,nvl(doc_post,0),'||P_Doc_Post||') ' Into V_AMT;
RETURN(V_AMT);
END Get_Ac_Blnc_Anls_Fnc;
------------------------------
FUNCTION Get_Value_Anls_Fnc ( P_Fld_Value In Varchar2 ) RETURN NUMBER IS
V_PECNT NUMBER;
Execute Immediate ('Select '||P_Fld_Value||' From DUAL') Into V_PECNT ;
Return(V_PECNT);
Return(-0);
END Get_Value_Anls_Fnc;
FUNCTION Get_Indctr_Fnc ( P_Typ
_no In Number , P_Doc_Post In Number Default 1 ) RETURN NUMBER IS
If P_Typ_no = 1 Then -- Credit Sales
Select Round(abs(nvl(sum(nvl(amt,0)),0)) ,2) Into V_Amt
from ias_post_dtl d
where Exists ( select 1 from ias_conn_acc_inv_by_gl Where si_a_code = d.a_code and Rownum<=1)
and d.doc_type = 4
and d.jv_type = 4
and nvl(d.doc_post,0) = Decode(p_doc_post,2,nvl(d.doc_post,0),p_doc_post);
ElsIf P_Typ_no = 2 Then -- Credit Sales Return
where Exists ( select 1 from ias_conn_acc_inv_by_gl Where sr_a_code = d.a_code and Rownum<=1)
and d.doc_type = 5
ElsIf P_Typ_no = 3 Then -- Credit Purchase
where Exists ( select 1 from ias_conn_acc_inv_by_gl Where inv_a_code = d.a_code and Rownum<=1)
and d.doc_type = 6
ElsIf P_Typ_no = 4 Then -- Credit Purchase Return
and d.doc_type = 7
Return(v_amt);
End Get_Indctr_Fnc;
END IAS_Anls_Pkg;

FUNCTION Get_indctr_gen(p_indctr_type in number , p_doc_post in number default 1) RETURN NUMBER IS
If p_indctr_type = 1 Then -- revenue
from account m, ias_post_dtl d
where m.a_code = d.a_code
and nvl(dr,0) = 0
and exists (select 1 from account_report_type
where report_type=a_report
and nvl(report_bs,0)= 0
and rownum<=1)
and nvl(doc_post,0) = Decode(p_doc_post,2,nvl(doc_post,0),p_doc_post);
ElsIf p_indctr_type = 2 Then -- expense
and nvl(dr,0) = 1
ElsIf p_indctr_type = 5 Then -- cash
Select Round(nvl(sum(nvl(amt,0)),0) ,2) Into V_Amt
from cash_in_hand m, ias_post_dtl d
and m.cash_no = d.ac_code_dtl
and d.ac_dtl_t
yp = 1
ElsIf p_indctr_type = 6 Then -- bank
from cash_at_bank m, ias_post_dtl d
and m.bank_no = d.ac_code_dtl
and d.ac_dtl_typ = 2
ElsIf p_indctr_type = 10 Then -- Due Receipt cheq.
Select Round(Abs(nvl(sum(nvl(d.ac_amt,0)),0)) ,2) Into V_Amt
from vouchers m,voucher_detail d
where m.v_ser = d.v_ser
and m.voucher_type = 1 --rec
and m.voucher_pay_type = 2 -- cheq.
and nvl(d.cheque_valued,0) = 0
and nvl(voucher_post,0) = Decode(p_doc_post,2,nvl(voucher_post,0),p_doc_post);
ElsIf p_indctr_type = 11 Then -- Due Payment cheq.
Select Round(nvl(sum(nvl(d.ac_amt,0)),0) ,2) Into V_Amt
and m.voucher_type = 2 --pay
ElsIf p_indctr_type = 20 Then -- sales
and doc_type = 4
ElsIf p_indctr_type = 22 Then -- sales retrun
where Exists ( select 1 from ias_conn_acc_inv_by_gl Where ( sr_a_code = d.a_code or py_sr_a_code = d.a_code ) and Rownum<=1)
and doc_type = 5
ElsIf p_indctr_type = 23 Then -- sales discount
where Exists ( select 1 from ias_conn_acc_inv_by_gl Where dsc_si_a_code = d.a_code and Rownum<=1)
--and doc_type <> 4
RETURN (V_Amt);
END Get_indctr_gen;

'||MvName||'

PROCEDURE Ias_Update_Extrnl_Post_Br (TName Varchar2, Center_Branch Varchar2,P_Extrnl_Post_Val Number,P_Whr_Mod Varchar2,P_Cncl_So_Rsrvd Number) IS
P_Whr Varchar2(2000):=Null;
P_Ext_Val Number;
If P_Extrnl_Post_Val=85 And Center_Branch='BC' Then
P_Ext_Val := -1;
P_Ext_Val := 0 ;
If Center_Branch = 'CB' And TName like 'ORDER_DETAIL' And P_Cncl_So_Rsrvd=1 Then
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'UPDATE ORDER_DETAIL SET RESERVED=NULL,RES_DATE=NULL WHERE 1=1 '||P_Whr;
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'UPDATE IAS_RESERVE_DTL A SET CP_QTY = 0,RESERVED=0
WHERE DOC_TYPE_REF = 53
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MV_ORDER_DETAIL WHERE ORDER_SER=A.DOC_SER_REF AND ROWNUM<=1)';
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL ;
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'UPDATE '||TName||' SET EXTERNAL_POST='||P_Extrnl_Post_Val||' WHERE NVL(EXTERNAL_POST,0)='||P_Ext_Val||P_Whr||P_Whr_Mod;
Execute Immediate 'COMMIT';

PROCEDURE Ias_Insrt_Data (FtName Varchar2,TtName Varchar2,V_Field_Pk Varchar2,Center_Branch Varchar2,P_Whr_Del Varchar2,P_Whr_Ins Varchar2,P_Use_Del Number,P_Lnk Varchar2,P_Rebuild Number Default 0) IS
Cursor C_Field Is Select Column_Name From User_Tab_Columns A
Where Table_Name=TtName And Exists (Select Column_Name From User_Tab_Columns
Where Table_Name=FtName
And Column_Name=A.Column_Name
Order By Column_Id;
Field Varchar2(2000);
I_Field Varchar2(2000);
Field_Pk Varchar2(200);
V_Usr Varchar2(50);
For I In C_Field Loop
Field := Field||I.Column_Name||',';
Field:=Substr(Field,1,Length(Field)-1);
Field_Pk := V_Field_Pk;
If TtName='ITEM_MOVEMENT' Then
I_Field := Replace(Field,'SERIAL','IAS_SERIAL_SEQ.NEXTVAL');
I_Field := Field;
I_Field := Replace(I_Field,'EXTERNAL_POST','85');
If Nvl(P_Use_Del,0)<>0 And TtName Not Like '%_TMP' Then
If TtName='ITEM_MOVEMENT' And P_Rebuild=1 Then
Execute Immediate 'Delete '||TtName||' Where Doc_Type Not In (1,3,5,7,8)';
Elsif TtName='IAS_POST_MST' And P_Rebuild = 1 Then
Execute Immediate 'Delete IAS_POST_MST Where Doc_Type Not In (1,2,3,4,5,8,11,12)';
Elsif TtName='IAS_POST_DTL' And P_Rebuild = 1 Then
Execute Immediate 'Delete IAS_POST_DTL Where Doc_Type Not In (1,2,3,4,5,8,11,12)';
Elsif TtName='PRIV_ACC' And P_Rebuild = 1 Then
Execute Immediate 'Delete Priv_Acc';
If TtName<>'ITEM_MOVEMENT' Then
Execute Immediate 'Delete '||TtName||' Where ('||Field_Pk||') In (Select '||Field_Pk||' From '||FtName||')'||' '||P_Whr_Del;
ElsIf TtName='ITEM_MOVEMENT' Then
Execute Immediate 'Delete Item_Movement Mov Where Exists ( Select 1 From Mv_Item_Movement
Where Doc_Type =Mov.Doc_Type
And Doc_Ser =Mov.Doc_Ser
And I_Code =Mov.I_Code
And W_Code =Mov.W_Code
And Expire_Date=Mov.Expire_Date
And Batch_No =Mov.Batch_No
And Rcrd_No =Mov.Rcrd_No
And RowNum<=1)';
If P_Lnk Is Not Null Then
V_Usr := '
Execute Immediate 'Insert Into '||TtName||'('||Field||') Select '||I_Field||' From '||V_Usr||FtName||P_Lnk||' '||P_Whr_Ins;
--Raise_Application_Error(-20907,'Insert Into '||TtName||'('||Field||') Select '||I_Field||' From '||FtName) ;
PROCEDURE Ias_Delete_Mv_Br (Mvt_Name Varchar2,Drop_Type Varchar2) Is
PK VARCHAR2(50);
If Drop_Type='
T' Then
Select 1 InTo Cnt From Tab Where TNAME=Mvt_Name And RowNum<=1;
If Nvl(Cnt,0)=1 Then
Execute Immediate 'Drop Table '||Mvt_Name||' Cascade Constraint';
Select 1 InTo Cnt From USER_SNAPSHOTS Where NAME=Mvt_Name And RowNum<=1;

Execute Immediate 'Drop Snapshot '||Mvt_Name;
FUNCTION Ias_Check_Data_Cntr (P_Brn_No Number , T_Name Varchar2,F_Date Varchar2,T_Date Varchar2,P_Field_Date Varchar2,Center_Branch Varchar2) Return Number Is

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION Ys_Get_Blnc_Ac_Dtl_Fnc( P_A_CODE IN ACCOUNT.A_CODE%TYPE DEFAULT NULL,
P_LOC_CUR IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT YS_GEN_PKG.GET_LOCAL_CUR,
P_CUR_CODE IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
P_PJ_CODE IN IAS_PROJECTS.PJ_NO%TYPE DEFAULT NULL,
P_ACTV_CODE IN IAS_ACTVTY.ACTV_NO%TYPE DEFAULT NULL,
P_F_DATE IN DATE DEFAULT YS_GEN_PKG.GET_FRST_DAY,
P_T_DATE IN DATE DEFAULT YS_GEN_PKG.GET_FINAL_DAY,
P_BLNC_TYP IN NUMBER DEFAULT 1,
P_LOC_AMT IN NUMBER DEFAULT 0 ,
P_DOC_POST IN NUMBER DEFAULT 1 )
v_blnc_amt NUMBER:=0;
-- AC_DTL_TYPE : 0 = Account , 1 = Cash , 2 = Bank , 3 = customer , 4 = vendor , 7 = employee
-- P_BLNC_TYP : 0 = Open_bal , 1 = Net Balance ,2 = Period Balance
-- P_LOC_AMT : 0 = By Cur_code , 1 = Local Amt
-- P_DOC_POST : 0 = not posted , 1 = posted , 2 = All
If P_LOC_AMT = 0 Then --(1) -- by cur_code
If P_BLNC_TYP = 0 Then -- Open_bal (2)
Select Decode(P_cur_code,Null,nvl(sum(amt),0),P_Loc_Cur,nvl(sum(amt),0),nvl(sum(amt_f),0))
Into v_blnc_amt
where nvl(A_code,'0') = Decode(P_A_Code,null,nvl(A_Code,'0'),P_A_Code)
and nvl(Ac_Code_Dtl,'0') = Decode(P_Ac_code_Dtl,Null,nvl(Ac_Code_Dtl,'0'),P_Ac_Code_Dtl)
and nvl(Ac_Dtl_Typ,0) = Decode(P_Ac_Dtl_Typ,0,nvl(Ac_Dtl_Typ,0),P_Ac_Dtl_Typ)
and a_cy= Decode(P_cur_code,null,a_cy,P_cur_code)
and (doc_date < P_F_Date Or doc_type = 0)
and nvl(cc_code,'0') = Decode(P_cc_code,null,nvl(cc_code,'0'),P_cc_code)
and nvl(pj_no,'0') = Decode(P_pj_code,null,nvl(pj_no,'0'),P_pj_code)
and nvl(actv_no,'0') = Decode(P_actv_code,null,nvl(actv_no,'0'),P_actv_code)
and nvl(doc_post,0) = Decode(P_DOC_POST,2,nvl(doc_post,0),P_DOC_POST);
Elsif - P_BLNC_TYP = 2 Then -- Period Balance without open balances for this period(2)
Select Decode(P_cur_code,Null,nvl(sum(amt),0),P_LOC_CUR,nvl(sum(amt),0),nvl(sum(amt_f),0))
and doc_date between P_F_Date and P_T_Date
and doc_type<>0
Else -- Balance (2)
and doc_date <= P_T_Date
--#------------------------------------------------------------------------##--
Else -- Local Cur
Select nvl(sum(amt),0)
and nvl(Ac_Code_Dtl,'0') = Decode(P_Ac_code_Dtl,Null,nvl(Ac
_Code_Dtl,'0'),P_Ac_Code_Dtl)
Return(nvl(v_blnc_amt,0));
End Ys_Get_Blnc_Ac_Dtl_Fnc;
Create Or Replace Function Get_Icode_Ordrqty ( P_Icode In Ias_Itm_Mst.I_Code%Type,
P_Psize In Number,
P_Prcss In Number Default 1, --# 0 Open Order 1 Closed Order
P_Wcode In Warehouse_Details.W_Code%Type Default Null,
P_date In Date Default Null,
P_Qry_Typ In Number Default 1)
Return Number Is
V_Ordr_Qty Number:=0;
If Nvl(P_Qry_Typ,1)=1 Then
Select (Nvl(Sum(P_Qty),0) /Nvl( P_Psize,1))+Nvl(Sum(Free_Qty),0)
Into V_Ordr_Qty
From P_Order,P_Order_Detail
Where P_Order.Po_Ser = P_Order_Detail.Po_Ser
And Po_Date <= Nvl( P_date,To_Char(Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Curdate,'DD/MM/YYYY') )
And Nvl(Po_Processed,0) = Nvl(P_Prcss,1)
And Nvl(Canceled,0) = 0
And Nvl(Approved,0) = 1
And P_Order_Detail.W_Code =Nvl(P_Wcode,P_Order_Detail.W_Code) ;
V_Ordr_Qty:=0;
---------------------------------------------------##--
--## Get Sum(Qty) Open Purchase In Road
Select (Nvl(Sum(P_Qty),0)/ Nvl(P_Psize,1))+Nvl(Sum(Free_Qty),0) - (Nvl(Sum(Pi_Qty),0)+Nvl(Sum(Pi_Free_Qty),0))
And P_Order_Detail.I_Code = P_Icode
And Nvl(P_Order.Approved,0) = 1
And P_Order_Detail.W_Code =Nvl(P_Wcode,P_Order_Detail.W_Code)
Group By P_Order_Detail.I_Code ;
V_Ordr_Qty := 0 ;
Return (Nvl(V_Ordr_Qty,0));
End Get_Icode_Ordrqty;
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION Last_Incoming_Price_To_Date ( P_Wtavg_Type In Number,
P_Wcode In WAREHOUSE_DETAILS.W_CODE%TYPE Default Null,
P_Type In Number Default 0 ,
P_Date In Date Default Null )
v_Lst_Inc_Price Number ;
-- P_Type ==> 0 = without pi_type=0 , 1= with pi_type=0
If P_Type = 0 Then --(1)
Select (nvl(stk_cost,0)/nvl(p_size,1))* P_Psize
Into v_Lst_Inc_Price
( SELECT MAX(gr_Detail.gr_date) GDate
, MAX(gr_Detail.Rec_NO) RecNo
From Gr_detail
Where I_code = P_Icode
and W_code = Decode(P_Wtavg_Type,1,W_code,Nvl(P_Wcode,w_code))
and gr_detail.pi_type IN (2,5)
And Gr_Detail.Gr_Date <= Nvl(P_Date,Gr_Detail.Gr_Date)) tb1
and W_code = Decode(P_Wtavg_Type,1,W_code,Nvl(P_Wcode,W_code))
and gr_detail.pi_type In (2,5)
And Gr_Detail.Gr_Date <= Nvl(P_Date,Gr_Detail.Gr_Date)
and Gr_Detail.Rec_No =tb1.RecNo
and rownum=1;
v_Lst_Inc_Price:=0;
Else --(1)
Select (nvl(stk_cost,0)/nvl(p_size,1)) Into v_Lst_Inc_Price
(SELECT
MAX(gr_Detail.gr_date) GDate,
MAX(gr_Detail.Rec_NO) RECNO
and gr_detail.pi_type In (0,2,5)
and gr_detail.pi_type IN (0,2,5)
and Gr_Detail.REC_NO =tb1.RECNO
If P_Wtavg_Type = 1 Then -- By Item
Select nvl(Primary_Cost,0)
where I_Code=P_Icode;
Else -- By Item + w_code
where I_code=P_Icode
and W_code=Nvl(P_Wcode,W_code);
Return v_Lst_Inc_Price ;
END Last_Incoming_Price_To_Date;
CREATE OR REPLACE Function Get_Wcode_Revaluate_Cost (P_Icode In Ias_Itm_Dtl.I_Code%Type ,
P_Cond In Varchar2 Default Null ) Return Number Is
V_Final_Cost Number := 0 ;
V_Wt_Cost Number := 0 ;
V_Wt_Avlqty Number := 0 ;
V_Lst_Date Date ;
V_Wtavg_Type Ias_Para_Inv.Wtavg_Type%Type ;
V_Lst_Date := To_Date(Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Sysdate,'DD/MM/YYYY') ;
If V_Lst_Date = P_Td Then
Select Decode(Sum(Nvl( Ias_Itm_Wcode.Avl_Qty,0)),0,Sum(Nvl(Ias_Itm_Wcode.I_Cwtavg,0)),Sum(Nvl( Ias_Itm_Wcode.Avl_Qty,0)*Nvl(Ias_Itm_Wcode.I_Cwtavg,0)))/
Decode(Sum(Nvl( Ias_Itm_Wcode.Avl_Qty,0)),0,Count(Nvl( Ias_Itm_Wcode.Avl_Qty,0)),Sum(Nvl( Ias_Itm_Wcode.Avl_Qty,0)))
Into V_Final_Cost
||' '|| P_Cond ;
Select Wtavg_Type
Into V_Wtavg_Type
V_Wtavg_Type := 1 ;
Cursor C_Itm Is Select Distinct W_Code ,
Get_Cost( V_Wtavg_Type, 0, P_Icode,W_Code,P_Td,P_Td ) Wtavg ,
Get_Icode_AvlQty(P_Icode,P_Size,W_Code,Null,Null,P_Td ) Avl_Qty
V_Wt_Cost := Nvl(V_Wt_Cost,0) + Nvl(I_Itm.Wtavg,0) ;
V_Wt_Avlqty := Nvl(V_Wt_Avlqty,0) + Nvl(I_Itm.Avl_Qty,0) ;
V_Final_Cost := (Nvl(V_Wt_Cost,0)*Nvl(V_Wt_Avlqty,0))/Nvl(V_Wt_Avlqty,0) ;
Return (Nvl(V_Final_Cost,0));
End Get_Wcode_Revaluate_Cost ;

If P_Type = 1 Then -- Item Group
Select G_Code

V_Post_Code := Null ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION Ias_Get_Sales_Year_Fnc
( P_Type Number,
P_Usr Varchar2,
P_Fld_Name Varchar2,
P_Fld_Value Varchar2,
P_Acy Varchar2,
Local_Rep Number Default 0,
P_Tname Varchar2 Default Null ,
P_Whr Varchar2 Default Null) RETURN NUMBER IS
Local_Cur Varchar2(30);
V_Whr Varchar2(2000);
V_Fld_Name := Replace(P_Fld_Name,'Rt_Bill','Bill');
V_Whr:= Replace(P_Whr,'Rt_Bill','Bill');
Select Cur_Code InTo Local_Cur From Ex_Rate Where L_f=1;
If P_Type In (1,3) Then
Execute Immediate 'Select Sum((Nvl('||P_Usr||'.Ias_Bill_Dtl.I_Qty,0)*(Nvl('||P_Usr||'.Ias_Bill_Dtl.I_Price,0)-Nvl(Ias_Bill_Dtl.Dis_Amt,0)
+Nvl('||P_Usr||'.Ias_Bill_Dtl.Othr_Amt,0)+Nvl('||P_Usr||'.Ias_Bill_Dtl.Vat_Amt,0))) * Decode('||Local_Rep||',0,1,'||P_Usr||'.Ias_Bill_Mst.Bill_Rate))
Where '||P_Usr||'.Ias_Bill_Mst.Bill_Ser='||P_Usr||'.Ias_Bill_Dtl.Bill_Ser '||V_Whr||'
AND Decode('||Local_Rep||',0,'||P_Usr||'.Ias_Bill_Mst.Bill_Currency,'''||Local_Cur||''') =Decode('||Local_Rep||',0,'''||P_Acy||''','''||Local_Cur||''')
AND '||V_Fld_Name||'='''||P_Fld_Value||'''' InTo V_Sale;
If P_Type In (2,3) Then
Execute Immediate 'Select Sum((Nvl('||P_Usr||'.Ias_Rt_Bill_Dtl.I_Qty,0)*(Nvl('||P_Usr||'.Ias_Rt_Bill_Dtl.I_Price,0)-Nvl(Ias_Rt_Bill_Dtl.Dis_Amt,0)
+Nvl('||P_Usr||'.Ias_Rt_Bill_Dtl.Othr_Amt,0)+Nvl('||P_Usr||'.Ias_Rt_Bill_Dtl.Vat_Amt,0))) * Decode('||Local_Rep||',0,1,'||P_Usr||'.Ias_Rt_Bill_Mst.Rt_Bill_Rate))
Where '||P_Usr||'.Ias_Rt_Bill_Mst.Rt_Bill_Ser='||P_Usr||'.Ias_Rt_Bill_Dtl.Rt_Bill_Ser '||Replace(V_Whr,'Bill','Rt_Bill')||'
AND Decode('||Local_Rep||',0,'||P_Usr||'.Ias_Rt_Bill_Mst.Rt_Bill_Currency,'''||Local_Cur||''') =Decode('||Local_Rep||',0,'''||P_Acy||''','''||Local_Cur||''')
AND '||Replace(V_Fld_Name,'Bill','Rt_Bill')||'='''||P_Fld_Value||'''' InTo V_RtSale;
If P_Type =1 Then
RETURN V_Sale;
ElsIf P_Type =2 Then
RETURN V_RtSale;
ElsIf P_Type =3 Then
RETURN Nvl(V_Sale,0)-Nvl(V_RtSale,0);
Raise_application_error(-20443,SqlErrm) ;
END Ias_Get_Sales_Year_Fnc;
Create Or Replace Function IAs_Get_Purchase_Qty(
P_Doc_No In P_Order_Detail.Po_No%Type ,

Select Nvl(Sum(I_Qty),0)
And Pr_Ser = P_Doc_Ser
And Pr_No = P_Doc_No
And Doc_Sequence_Prq = P_Doc_Seq ;
ElsIf P_Type = 2 Then -- Purchase Order
And Po_Ser = P_Doc_Ser
And Po_No = P_Doc_No
And Doc_Sequence_Grn_Po = P_Doc_Seq ;
Return(V_Qty);
End IAs_Get_Purchase_Qty ;
CREATE OR REPLACE Function Get_Itm_Sales_Age ( P_Type In Number ,
P_Sale_Age_Type In Number Default 1 ,
P_I_Code In Ias_Itm_Dtl.I_Code%Type ,
P_Batch_No In Item_Movement.Batch_No%Type Default Null ,
P_Expire_Date In Item_Movement.Expire_Date%Type Default Null ) Return Number Is
V_Itm_Day Number := 0 ;
V_Itm_Date Date ;
V_Itm_Sum_Day Number := 0 ;
V_Last_Date Date ;
V_Income_Date Date ;
V_Tr_Date Ias_Whtrns_Mst.Tr_Date%Type ;
V_Diff_Day Number ;
V_Prev_Date Date ;
V_St_Cp_Qty Number := 0 ;
V_Curdate Date ;
V_Frsdate Date ;
V_Tr_Ser Ias_Whtrns_Mst.Tr_Ser%Type ;
V_Rec_Tr_Ser Ias_Whtrns_Mst.Tr_Ser%Type ;
V_Doc_Date Ias_Whtrns_Mst.Tr_Date%Type ;
V_Rec_Tr_Date Ias_Whtrns_Mst.Tr_Date%Type ;
V_Road_Distance Number ;
If P_Type = 1 Then --Neccessary Warehouse
Cursor C_Itms Is Select G_Ser,I_Code,P_Size,Itm_Unt,I_Qty,P_Qty,Cp_Qty,Doc_Sequence,Rcrd_No,Rec_No,Gr_Date
From Ias_V_Gr_Detail_Yr
And Nvl(W_Code,0) = Decode(P_W_Code,Null,Nvl(W_Code,0),P_W_Code)
And Nvl(Batch_No,'0') = Decode(P_Batch_No,Null,Nvl(Batch_No,'0'),P_Batch_No)
And Nvl(Expire_Date,'01/01/1900') = Decode(P_Expire_Date,Null,Nvl(Expire_Date,'01/01/1900'),P_Expire_Date)
And Gr_Date <= P_T_Date
Order By I_Code ,Gr_Date ,Rec_No ;
For I_Itms In C_Itms Loop
If P_Sale_Age_Type = 1 Then
V_Itm_Day := 0 ;
If V_Prev_Date is Not Null Then
If I_Itms.Gr_Date < V_Prev_Date Then
V_Diff_Day := V_Prev_Date - I_Itms.Gr_Date ;
If Nvl(I_Itms.Cp_Qty,0) > 0 Then
V_Itm_Day := P_T_Date - I_Itms.Gr_Date ;
V_Prev_Date := I_Itms.Gr_Date ;
V_St_Cp_Qty := 1 ;
Select Max(Doc_Date)
Into V_Itm_Date
Where G_Ser = I_Itms.G_Ser
And Rec_no = I_Itms.Rec_no
And Doc_Sequence_Gr = I_Itms.Doc_Sequence
And Doc_Date <= P_T_Date ;
If V_Itm_Date > I_Itms.Gr_Date Then
V_Itm_Day := V_Itm_Date - I_Itms.Gr_Date ;
V_Prev_Date := V_Itm_Date ;
V_Itm_Sum_Day := V_Itm_Sum_Day + V_Itm_Day -Nvl(V_Diff_Day,0) ;
If V_St_Cp_Qty = 1 Then
Exit ;
ElsIf P_Sale_Age_Type = 2 Then
Select Min(Ias_V_Whtrns_Mst_Yr.Tr_Date) Tr_Date
Into V_Rec_Tr_Date
From Ias_V_Whtrns_Mst_Yr,Ias_V_Whtrns_Dtl_Yr
Where Ias_V_Whtrns_Mst_Yr.Tr_Ser = Ias_V_Whtrns_Dtl_Yr.Tr_Ser
And Ias_V_Whtrns_Mst_Yr.Tr_Inout_Type = 2
And Ias_V_Whtrns_Dtl_Yr.I_Code = P_I_Code
And Ias_V_Whtrns_Dtl_Yr.Itm_Unt = P_Itm_Unt
And Ias_V_Whtrns_Dtl_Yr.W_Code = P_W_Code
And Ias_V_Whtrns_Mst_Yr.Tr_Date >= P_F_Date ;
V_Rec_Tr_Date := Null ;
If V_Rec_Tr_Date Is Not Null Then
Select Min(Ias_V_Whtrns_Mst_Yr.F_Tr_Ser) Tr_Ser
Into V_Rec_Tr_Ser
And Ias_V_Whtrns_Mst_Yr.Tr_Date = V_Rec_Tr_Date ;
V_Rec_Tr_Ser := Null ;
Select Max(Ias_Whtrns_Mst.Tr_Date) Tr_Date
Into V_Doc_Date
And Ias_Whtrns_Mst.Tr_InOut_Type = 1
And Ias_Whtrns_Dtl.I_Code = P_I_Code
And Ias_Whtrns_Dtl.Itm_Unt = P_Itm_Unt
And Ias_Whtrns_Dtl.T_W_Code = P_W_Code
And Ias_Whtrns_Mst.Tr_Date <= P_T_Date ;
V_Doc_Date := Null ;
If V_Rec_Tr_Ser Is Not Null Then
Into V_Tr_Date
And Ias_V_Whtrns_Mst_Yr.Tr_Inout_Type = 1
And Ias_V_Whtrns_Mst_Yr.Tr_Ser = V_Rec_Tr_Ser
And Ias_V_Whtrns_Dtl_Yr.T_W_Code = P_W_Code ;
V_Tr_Date := Null ;
If V_Rec_Tr_Date Is Not Null And V_Tr_Date Is Not Null Then
V_Road_Distance := V_Rec_Tr_Date - V_Tr_Date ;
End If ;*/
If P_T_Date Is Not Null And V_Rec_Tr_Date Is Not Null Then
V_Itm_Sum_Day := To_Date(P_T_Date,'Dd/Mm/Yyyy') -To_Date(V_Rec_Tr_Date,'Dd/Mm/Yyyy') ;
ElsIf P_T_Date Is Not Null And V_Doc_Date Is Not Null Then
V_Itm_Sum_Day := To_Date(P_T_Date,'Dd/Mm/Yyyy') -To_Date(V_Doc_Date,'Dd/Mm/Yyyy') ;
V_Itm_Sum_Day := 0 ;
ElsIf P_Sale_Age_Type = 3 Then
Select Min(Ias_V_Gr_Detail_Yr.Gr_Date) Tr_Date
Where Ias_V_Gr_Detail_Yr.I_Code = P_I_Code
And Ias_V_Gr_Detail_Yr.Itm_Unt = P_Itm_Unt
And Ias_V_Gr_Detail_Yr.W_Code = P_W_Code
And Ias_V_Gr_Detail_Yr.Gr_Date >= P_F_Date ;
If P_T_Date Is Not Null And V_Doc_Date Is Not Null Then
V_Itm_Sum_Day := To_Date(P_T_Date,'DD/MM/YYYY') -To_Date(V_Doc_Date,'DD/MM/YYYY');
Return(Nvl(V_Itm_Sum_Day,0)) ;
ElsIf P_Type = 2 Then --All Warehouse
V_Curdate := (To_Date(Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Curdate ,'DD/MM/YYYY'))+1;
V_Frsdate := (To_Date(Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Frst_Day ,'DD/MM/YYYY'))+1;
And Pi_Type = 0
And Nvl(I_qty,0) >0
Select Income_Date
Into V_Income_Date
V_Income_Date := Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Frst_Day ;
Select Min(Gr_Date)
Where I_Code
= P_I_Code
And Pi_Type <> 0 ;
And Nvl(Cp_Qty,0) > 0
V_Last_Date := To_Date(Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_CurDate,'DD/MM/YYYY') ;
V_Last_Date :=To_Date(Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_CurDate,'DD/MM/YYYY') ;
Into V_Last_Date
And Bill_Type In (1,6);
If V_Income_Date Is Not Null And V_Last_Date Is Not Null Then
V_Itm_Sum_Day := (V_Last_Date - V_Income_Date) ;
End Get_Itm_Sales_Age ;

Function Two_digits (Amnt Varchar2)
Sub1 Varchar2 (30) := Null;
Sub2 Varchar2 (30) := Null;
First_digit Varchar2 (1);
Second_digit Varchar2 (1);
First_digit := Substr (Amnt, 1, 1);
Second_digit := Substr (Amnt, 2, 1);
If First_digit = 0 Then
Sub1 := One_digit (Second_digit);
If First_digit = 1 Or Second_digit = 0 Then
Sub1 := Tens (To_number (Amnt));
Sub1 := Ones (To_number (Second_digit));
Sub2 := Tens (To_number (First_digit) * 10);
If Sub2 Is Not Null And Lng_No = 1 Then
Sub1 := Sub1 || ' ' || Wa;
If Lng_No = 1 Then
Return (Sub1 || ' ' || Sub2);
Return (Sub2 || ' ' || Sub1);

Procedure Check_riyals (Amnt Varchar2) Is
If Amnt = '10' Then
Sub1 := Sub1 || ' ' || Curr_name;
Elsif Amnt Between '01' And '09' Then
-- null;
Elsif Ln = 1 Then
If Ln1 > 0 Then

-- main function starts --
Decode(Lang_No,1,Nvl(CUR_FRACTION,Cur_E_FRACTION),Nvl(Cur_E_FRACTION,Cur_FRACTION)),
Decode(Lang_No,1,Nvl(Cur_name,Cur_E_Name),Nvl(Cur_E_name,Cur_Name)),
Nvl(Cur_Frc_No,2)
Frc_name ,
Curr_name ,
V_Cur_Frc_No
Ex_rate
Where Cur_code = A_curr;

Ln1 := Instr (Amnt_char, '.');

Ln2 := Nvl (Nvl (Length (Frac_char), 0), 0);

Sub5 := Three_Digits_H(Rpad(Frac_Char,3,0));
Sub5 := Two_Digits_H(Rpad(Frac_Char,2,0));

Check_riyals (Amnt_char);

Sub1 := Two_digits (Amnt_char);
Elsif Ln = 3 Then
Sub1 := Three_digits (Amnt_char);
Check_riyals (Substr (Amnt_char, 2, 2));
Elsif Ln = 4 Then
Sub1 := Four_digits (Amnt_char);
Check_riyals (Substr (Amnt_char, 3, 2));
Elsif Ln = 5 Then
Sub1 := Five_digits (Amnt_char);
Check_riyals (Substr (Amnt_char, 4, 2));
Elsif Ln = 6 Then
Sub1 := Six_digits (Amnt_char);
Check_riyals (Substr (Amnt_char, 5, 2));
Elsif Ln = 7 Then
Sub1 := Seven_digits (Amnt_char);
Check_riyals (Substr (Amnt_char, 6, 2));
Elsif Ln = 8 Then
Sub1 := Eight_digits (Amnt_char);
Check_riyals (Substr (Amnt_char, 7, 2));
Elsif Ln = 9 Then
Sub1 := Nine_digits (Amnt_char);
Check_riyals (Substr (Amnt_char, 8, 2));
Elsif Ln = 10 Then
Sub1 := Ten_digits (Amnt_char);
Check_riyals (Substr (Amnt_char, 9, 2));
Elsif Ln = 11 Then
Sub1 := Eleven_digits (Amnt_char);
Check_riyals (Substr (Amnt_char, 10, 2));
Elsif Ln = 12 Then
Sub1 := Twelve_digits (Amnt_char);
Check_riyals (Substr (Amnt_char, 11, 2));
Elsif Ln = 0 And Ln2 > 0 Then
Sub1 := Three_Digits_H(Rpad(Frac_Char,3,0));
Sub1 := Two_Digits_H(Rpad(Frac_Char,2,0));
Return (Ias_gen_pkg.Get_prompt (Lang_no, 2600));
End Tafkeet;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION Get_Type_Nm_Fnc( P_lang_no In NUMBER,
P_doc
type In NUMBER,
P_jvtype In NUMBER Default Null) RETURN CHAR Is
v_jvname VARCHAR2(100);
If P_doctype = 40 Then
Select Decode(P_Lang_no,1,PR_A_NAME,nvl(PR_E_NAME,PR_A_NAME))
Into v_jvname From IAS_PREQ_TYPES
Where Pr_TYPE = P_jvtype
ElsIf P_doctype = 42 Then
Select Decode(P_Lang_no,1,PO_A_NAME,nvl(PO_E_NAME,PO_A_NAME))
Into v_jvname From IAS_PORDER_TYPES
Where PO_TYPE = P_jvtype
Return(P_jvtype);
Return(v_jvname);
END Get_Type_Nm_Fnc;
Create Or Replace Function Ias_Ar_Get_V_Name (
P_Type In Number,
P_Code In Varchar2,
P_Code_Loc Number Default 1
V_Name Varchar2 (200);
If P_Type > 1 Then
If P_Type = 2 Then
Select Decode (P_Lang_No,1, Nvl (G_A_Name, G_E_Name),Nvl (G_E_Name, G_A_Name))
From Group_Details
Where G_Code = P_Code And Rownum <= 1;
Elsif P_Type = 3 Then
Select Decode (P_Lang_No,1, Nvl (I_Name, I_E_Name),Nvl (I_E_Name, I_Name))
Where I_Code = P_Code And Rownum <= 1;
Elsif P_Type = 4 Then
Select Decode (P_Lang_No,1, Nvl (C_A_Name, C_E_Name),Nvl (C_E_Name, C_A_Name))
Where C_Code = P_Code And Rownum <= 1;
Elsif P_Type = 5 Then
If P_Code_Loc = 1 Then
Elsif P_Code_Loc = 2 Then
Elsif P_Type = 6 Then
Select Decode (P_Lang_No,1, Nvl (Reprs_A_Name, Reprs_E_Name),Nvl (Reprs_E_Name, Reprs_A_Name))
Where Reprs_Code = P_Code And Rownum <= 1;
Elsif P_Type = 7 Then
Elsif P_Type = 8 Then
Elsif P_Type = 9 Then
Select Decode (P_Lang_No,1, Nvl (R_A_Name, R_A_Name),Nvl (R_E_Name, R_A_Name))
Where R_Code = P_Code And Rownum <= 1;
Elsif P_Type = 10 Then
Where Reprs_Code = P_Code A
nd Rownum <= 1;
Elsif P_Type = 11 Then
Select Decode (P_Lang_No,1, Nvl (W_Name, W_E_Name),Nvl (W_E_Name, W_Name))
Where W_Code = P_Code And Rownum <= 1;
Elsif P_Type = 12 Then
Select Decode (P_Lang_No,1, Nvl (Cc_A_Name, Cc_E_Name),Nvl (Cc_E_Name, Cc_A_Name))
From Cost_Centers
Where Cc_Code = P_Code And Rownum <= 1;
Elsif P_Type = 13 Then
Select Decode (P_Lang_No,1, Nvl (Si_A_Name, Si_E_Name),Nvl (Si_E_Name, Si_A_Name))
From Ias_Sales_Types
Where Si_Type = P_Code And Rownum <= 1;
Elsif P_Type = 15 Then
Select Decode (P_Lang_No,1, Nvl (Cntry_A_Name, Cntry_E_Name),Nvl (Cntry_E_Name, Cntry_A_Name))
From Cntry
Where Cntry_No = P_Code And Rownum <= 1;
Elsif P_Type = 16 Then
Select Decode (P_Lang_No,1, Nvl (Prov_A_Name, Prov_E_Name),Nvl (Prov_E_Name, Prov_A_Name))
From Ias_Provinces
Where Prov_No = P_Code And Rownum <= 1;
Elsif P_Type = 17 Then
Select Decode (P_Lang_No,1, Nvl (City_A_Name, City_E_Name),Nvl (City_E_Name, City_A_Name))
From Cities
Where City_No = P_Code And Rownum <= 1;
Elsif P_Type = 18 Then
Select Decode (P_Lang_No,1, Nvl (Pj_A_Name, Pj_E_Name),Nvl (Pj_E_Name, Pj_A_Name))
Where Pj_No = P_Code And Rownum <= 1;
Elsif P_Type = 19 Then
Select Decode (P_Lang_No,1, Nvl (Brn_Lname, Brn_Fname),Nvl (Brn_Fname, Brn_Lname))
Where Brn_No = P_Code And Rownum <= 1;
Elsif P_Type = 20 Then
Select Decode (P_Lang_No,1, Nvl (Driver_A_Name, Driver_E_Name),Nvl (Driver_E_Name, Driver_A_Name))
From Ias_Drivers
Where Driver_No = P_Code And Rownum <= 1;
Elsif P_Type = 21 Then
Select Decode (P_Lang_No,1, Nvl (Actv_A_Name, Actv_E_Name),Nvl (Actv_E_Name, Actv_A_Name))
From Ias_Actvty
Where Actv_No = P_Code And Rownum <= 1;
Elsif P_Type = 22 Then
Select Decode (P_Lang_No,1, Nvl (Grp_L_Name, Grp_F_Name),Nvl (Grp_F_Name, Grp_L_Name))
From Ias_Grp_Itm_Lvl
Where Grp_Code = P_Code And Rownum <= 1;
Elsif P_Type = 23 Then
Select Decode (P_Lang_No,1, Nvl (Mng_A_Name, Mng_E_Name),Nvl (Mng_E_Name, Mng_A_Name))
From Ias_Mainsub_Grp_Dtl
Where Mng_Code = P_Code And Rownum <= 1;
Elsif P_Type = 24 Then
Select Decode (P_Lang_No,1, Nvl (Subg_A_Name, Subg_E_Name),Nvl (Subg_E_Name, Subg_A_Name))
From Ias_Sub_Grp_Dtl
Where Subg_Code = P_Code And Rownum <= 1;
Elsif P_Type = 25 Then
Select Decode (P_Lang_No,1, Nvl (Assistant_A_Name, Assistant_E_Name),Nvl (Assistant_E_Name, Assistant_A_Name))
From Ias_Assistant_Group
Where Assistant_No = P_Code And Rownum <= 1;
Elsif P_Type = 26 Then
Select Decode (P_Lang_No,1, Nvl (Detail_A_Name, Detail_E_Name),Nvl (Detail_E_Name, Detail_A_Name))
From Ias_Detail_Group
Where Detail_No = P_Code And Rownum <= 1;
Elsif P_Type = 27 Then
Elsif P_Type = 29 Then
Select Decode (P_Lang_No,1, Nvl (P
rm_L_Nm, Prm_F_Nm),Nvl (Prm_F_Nm, Prm_L_Nm))
From Ias_Promoters
Where Prm_Code = P_Code And Rownum <= 1;
Elsif P_Type = 30 Then
Select Decode (P_Lang_No,1, Nvl (C_Class_Name, C_Class_E_Name),Nvl (C_Class_E_Name, C_Class_Name))
From Customer_Class
Where C_Class = P_Code And Rownum <= 1;
Elsif P_Type = 31 Then
Select Decode (P_Lang_No,1, Nvl (C_Group_A_Name, C_Group_E_Name),Nvl (C_Group_E_Name, C_Group_A_Name))
From Customer_Group
Where C_Group_Code = P_Code And Rownum <= 1;
Elsif P_Type = 32 Then
Elsif P_Type = 33 Then
Elsif P_Type = 34 Then
Select Flg_Desc
Where Lang_No = P_Lang_No
And Flg_Code = 'TYPE_NAME_SI'
And Flg_Value = P_Code
Elsif P_Type=35 Then
Select Decode(P_Lang_No,1,Nvl(EMP_L_NM,EMP_F_NM),Nvl(EMP_F_NM,EMP_L_NM))
Where EMP_NO=P_Code
Elsif P_Type=36 Then
Select Decode(P_Lang_No,1,Nvl(PRSON_L_NM, PRSON_F_NM),Nvl(PRSON_F_NM, PRSON_L_NM))
From IAS_INSRNCE_CARD
Where PRSON_CARD_NO=P_Code
End Ias_Ar_Get_V_Name;

CREATE OR REPLACE Function Get_Itm_Age (P_Icode Varchar2 ,
p_td Date ,
P_Wcode Number Default Null ,
p_Batch_No Varchar2 Default Null ,
P_Expire_Date Date Default Null ) Return Number Is
v_age Number := 0 ;
-- lst_date := ias_gen_pkg.get_
sysdate ;
If P_Icode is not null and p_td is not null then
Select sum((p_td- gr_date) * cp_qty ) /sum(cp_qty)
Into v_age
And w_code = Decode(P_Wcode,Null,W_Code,P_Wcode)
And Batch_No = Decode(P_Batch_No,Null,Batch_No,P_Batch_No)
And Expire_Date = Decode(P_Expire_Date,Null,Expire_Date,P_Expire_Date)
And gr_date <= p_td
And nvl(cp_qty,0)>0;
v_age := 0 ;
Return (Nvl(v_age,0));
End Get_Itm_Age;
CREATE OR REPLACE Function Get_Itm_Cost_TnOvr_Ratio (P_Wtavg_Type In NUMBER,
P_V_TP In NUMBER,
p_icode in Varchar2 ,
p_fd in Date ,
d in Date ,
p_wcode in Number Default Null) Return Number Is
v_dev Number := 0 ;
v_op_qty Number := 0 ;
v_fin_amt Number := 0 ;
v_sl_amt Number := 0 ;
v_slrtn_amt Number := 0 ;
v_trovr Number := 0 ;
v_op_cost Number := 0 ;
v_fin_qty Number := 0 ;
v_fin_cost Number := 0 ;
V_CostIng_Type Ias_Para_Inv.Costing_Type%Type ;
Select Costing_Type Into V_CostIng_Type From Ias_Para_Inv ;
If p_icode is not null and p_td is not null then
Select sum(nvl(i_qty,0)+nvl(free_qty,0) * nvl(stk_cost,0) ) Into v_sl_amt
From ias_bill_mst m, ias_bill_dtl d
where m.bill_ser=d.bill_ser
and d.i_code=p_icode
and d.w_code = Decode(p_wcode,null,d.w_code,p_wcode)
and m.bill_date between p_fd and p_td;
v_sl_amt := 0 ;
Select sum(nvl(i_qty,0)+nvl(free_qty,0) * nvl(stk_cost,0) ) Into v_slrtn_amt
From ias_rt_bill_mst m, ias_rt_bill_dtl d
where m.rt_bill_ser=d.rt_bill_ser
and m.rt_bill_date between p_fd and p_td;
v_slrtn_amt := 0 ;
-- get open bal qty
Select nvl(Sum(in_out*(nvl(d.p_qty,0)+nvl(d.pf_Qty,0)) ),0) / nvl(d.p_size,1) into v_op_qty
From item_movement d
where d.i_code=p_icode
and (d.i_date < p_fd or doc_type = 0)
group by d.p_size;
v_op_qty := 0 ;
If V_CostIng_Type = 1 Then -- Fifo
v_op_cost:=Get_Pri_Cost_Fifo( P_icode,
P_fd,
ias_gen_pkg.get_frst_day,
P_Wcode);
v_op_cost := 0 ;
Else -- wtavg
v_op_cost:=Get_Pri_Cost( P_Wtavg_Type,
P_icode,
0 ) * nvl(v_op_qty,0);
v_fin_cost:= get_cost_FIFO ( p_icode,p
_td,p_wcode);
v_fin_cost := 0 ;
If P_Wtavg_Type In (1,2) Then -- By Item Or By Item + W_Code
v_fin_cost:=ias_itm_pkg.Get_Grand_Avlqty(p_icode,p_wcode) * get_cost ( P_Wtavg_Type ,P_V_TP,p_icode,p_wcode,p_td,p_td);
ElsIf P_Wtavg_Type = 3 Then -- Item + Whg_Code
v_fin_cost:=Get_Icode_Whgcode_Avlqty(p_icode,null,Ias_Wcode_Pkg.Get_Whg_Code(p_wcode)) * get_cost ( P_Wtavg_Type ,P_V_TP,p_icode,p_wcode,p_td,p_td);
If v_op_cost > 0 Then
v_dev:=1;
If v_fin_cost > 0 Then
v_dev:= nvl(v_dev,0) + 1;
if v_dev > 0 then
v_trovr:= ((v_sl_amt - v_slrtn_amt ) / v_op_cost + v_fin_cost ) * v_dev;
v_trovr:= 0;
Return (Nvl(v_trovr,0));
End Get_Itm_Cost_TnOvr_Ratio;
CREATE OR REPLACE Function Get_Itm_Qty_TnOvr_Ratio (p_icode Varchar2 ,
p_fd Date ,
p_wcode Number Default Null ,
P_Batch_No Varchar2 Default Null ,
v_sl_qty Number := 0 ;
v_slrtn_qty Number := 0 ;
Select nvl(sum(nvl(i_qty,0)+nvl(free_qty,0)),0) into v_sl_qty
where m.bill_ser = d.bill_ser
and d.i_code = p_icode
and d.Batch_No = Decode(P_Batch_No,null,d.Batch_No,P_Batch_No)
and d.Expire_Date = Decode(P_Expire_Date,null,d.Expire_Date,P_Expire_Date)
and m.bill_date Between p_fd and p_td;
v_sl_qty := 0 ;
Select nvl(sum(nvl(i_qty,0)+nvl(free_qty,0)),0) into v_slrtn_qty
where m.rt_bill_ser = d.rt_bill_ser
and m.rt_bill_date Between p_fd and p_td;
v_slrtn_qty := 0 ;
where d.i_code = p_icode
v_fin_qty := Nvl(Get_Icode_AvlQty ( P_Icod
P_WCode ,
Null ),0) ;
v_fin_qty := 0 ;
If v_op_qty > 0 Then
If v_fin_qty > 0 Then
v_trovr:= ((nvl(v_sl_qty,0)- nvl(v_slrtn_qty,0 )) / (nvl(v_op_qty,0) + nvl(v_fin_qty,0 )) ) * v_dev;
End Get_Itm_Qty_TnOvr_Ratio;
CREATE OR REPLACE Function Get_Itm_Profit_Loss ( p_icode In Varchar2 ,
p_fd In Date ,
p_td In Date ,
p_wcode In Number Default Null) Return Number Is
v_cost Number := 0 ;
v_price Number := 0 ;
v_rtcost Number := 0 ;
v_rtprice Number := 0 ;
v_prls Number := 0 ;
If p_icode is not null and p_fd is not null and p_td is not null Then
Select nvl(sum((nvl(i_qty,0)+nvl(free_qty,0) * nvl(stk_cost,0))*m.bill_rate/m.stock_rate ),0), nvl(sum(nvl(i_qty,0)+nvl(free_qty,0) * (nvl(i_price,0)-nvl(dis_amt,0)) ),0)
Into v_cost,v_price
v_cost := 0 ;
Select nvl(sum((nvl(i_qty,0)+nvl(free_qty,0) * nvl(stk_cost,0))*m.rt_bill_rate/m.stock_rate ),0), nvl(sum(nvl(i_qty,0)+nvl(free_qty,0) * (nvl(i_price,0)-nvl(dis_amt,0)) ),0)
Into v_rtcost,v_rtprice
v_rtcost := 0 ;
v_rtprice := 0 ;
v_prls:= (v_price - v_rtprice) - ( v_cost - v_rtcost);
Return (Nvl(v_prls,0));
End Get_Itm_Profit_Loss;
Create Or Replace Function Get_Icode_Qty ( P_Pcode In Ias_Itm_Mst.I_Code%Type,
P_Cond In Varchar2 Default Null,
P_Fdate In Date Default To_Char(Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Frst_Day,'Dd/Mm/Yyyy') ,
P_Tdate In Date Default To_Char(Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Curdate,'Dd/Mm/Yyyy') )Return Number Is
V_Avlqty Number:=0;
V_Sqlstr Varchar2(2000):='';
V_Frst_Day Date := Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Frst_Day ;
V_Tbl_Nm Varchar2(100) := ' Item_Movement ' ;
If V_Tbl_Nm Is Null Then
V_Tbl_Nm := ' Item_Movement ' ;
If P_Fdate < V_Frst_Day Then
V_Tbl_Nm := ' Ias_V_Item_Movement_Yr ' ;
V_Sqlstr := 'Select Nvl(Sum(In_Out*(Nvl(P_Qty,0)+Nvl(Pf_Qty,0)) ),0
) /Nvl('|| P_Psize||',1)
From '||V_Tbl_Nm||'
Where I_Code ='||''''||P_Pcode||''''
||' And I_Date Between '||''''||P_Fdate ||''''||' And '||''''||P_Tdate||''''
V_Sqlstr:= V_Sqlstr ||' And W_Code ='||P_Wcode;
Execute Immediate V_Sqlstr Into V_Avlqty ;
Return (Abs(Nvl(V_Avlqty,0)));
End Get_Icode_Qty ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION GET_AC_TYPE(P_a_code In ACCOUNT.A_CODE%TYPE) RETURN NUMBER IS
r_bs NUMBER;

Into r_bs
From account_report_type,account

End GET_AC_TYPE;
CREATE OR REPLACE Function Get_Bl_Main_Ac_Fnc( P_cc_code In COST_CENTERS.CC_CODE%TYPE Default Null ,
P_fd In Date Default Null ,
P_td In Date Default Null ,
P_bal_type In Number Default 0 ) Return Number Is
bl_amt Number:=0;
If p_bal_type = 0 Then -- Open_bal
Select Nvl(Sum(amt),0)
Into bl_amt
From ias_post_dtl , ias_acc_tree
Where ias_post_dtl.a_code = ias_acc_tree.a_code
And Nvl(mn_sub,0) = 0
And ias_acc_tree.ac_tree = p_a_code
And Nvl(ias_post_dtl.cc_code,'0') = Decode(p_cc_code,Null,Nvl(ias_post_dtl.cc_code,'0'),p_cc_code)
And Nvl(doc_type ,0) = 0 ;
Else -- Balance
If p_fd Is Not Null And p_td Is Not Null Then
And ias_post_dtl.doc_date Between p_fd And p_td
And Nvl(ias_post_dtl.cc_code,'0') = Decode(p_cc_code,Null,Nvl(ias_post_dtl.cc_code,'0'),p_cc_code);
ElsIf p_fd Is Not Null And p_td Is Null Then
And ias_post_dtl.doc_date < p_fd
ElsIf p_fd Is Null And
p_td Is Not Null Then
And ias_post_dtl.doc_date <= p_td
Else --(4)
End if; --(2)
Return(nvl(bl_amt,0));
End Get_Bl_Main_Ac_Fnc;

function is_zero(amnt VARCHAR2, l number) return boolean is
stat boolean := true;
m number := 1;
begin
while m <= l loop
if substr(amnt,m,1) != 0 then
stat := false;
exit;
m := m + 1;
end loop;
return(stat);

sub1 := two_digits_h(frac_char);
return(' Merci plus de 12 nbrs incapable de lire. ' );
END Tafkeet_F;
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION GET_COST( P_Wtavg_Type In NUMBER,
P_Wcode In WAREHOUSE_DETAILS.W_CODE%TYPE DEFAULT NULL,
P_Date In DATE,
P_T_date In DATE ) RETURN NUMBER IS
V_wt_avg_after NUMBER ;
Select nvl(Wt_avg_after,0)
Into V_wt_avg_after
and Decode(P_V_Tp , 0 , pi_type , 0 ) = 0
and Decode(P_V_Tp , 0 , gr_date , P_Date) = P_Date
and Decode(P_V_Tp , 1 , gr_date , P_Date-1) < P_Date
and Decode(P_V_Tp , 2 , gr_date , P_T_date-1
) <= P_T_date
and Rec_No = ( Select Max(rec_no)
and Decode(P_V_Tp , 2 , gr_date , P_T_date-1)<= P_T_date) ;
ElsIf P_Wtavg_Type = 2 Then -- By Item + W_Code
and W_code = Decode(P_Wtavg_Type,1,W_code,P_Wcode)
and Decode(P_V_Tp , 2 , gr_date , P_T_date-1) <= P_T_date
and Whg_Code = Decode(P_Wtavg_Type,3,Ias_Wcode_Pkg.Get_Whg_Code(P_Wcode),Whg_Code)
RETURN (V_wt_avg_after);
END GET_COST;
CREATE OR REPLACE Function Get_Cost_Fifo (pcode Ias_Itm_Mst.I_CODE%TYPE ,
td Date ,
wcode WAREHOUSE_DETAILS.W_CODE%TYPE Default Null) Return Number Is
final_cost Number := 0 ;
lst_date date ;
lst_date := ias_gen_pkg.get_sysdate ;
If lst_date = td Then
If wcode Is Null Then
Select Sum(((Nvl(cp_qty,0)*Nvl(stk_cost,0))/Nvl(p_size,1)))/Sum(Nvl(cp_qty,0))
Into final_cost
Where I_Code = pcode
And gr_date <= td
And cp_qty <> 0;
final_cost := 0 ;
And w_code = wcode
Select Sum(((((Nvl(p_qty,0)+Nvl(pf_qty,0))*in_out)*Nvl(stk_cost,0))/Nvl(p_size,1)))/Sum((Nvl(p_qty,0)+Nvl(pf_qty,0))*in_out)
And i_date <= td ;
Return (Nvl(final_cost,0));
End get_cost_fifo ;

CREATE OR REPLACE Function Open_Stock ( P_I_code In Ias_Itm_Mst.I_Code%Type,
P_Date In Date Default Null,
P_Whr In Varchar2 Default Null) Return Number Is
V_Op_Qty Number :=0 ;
V_Sqlstr Varchar2(4000) ;
--##--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------###--
V_Sqlstr:=' Select Nvl(Sum(In_Out*(Nvl(P_Qty,0)+Nvl(Pf_Qty,0)) ),0)
From Item_Movement Itm_Mov
Where I_Code = '||''''||P_I_Code||''''||' ' ;
V_Sqlstr:= V_Sqlstr|| ' And Itm_Mov.W_Code = '|| P_W_Code ;
If P_Date Is Not Null Then
V_Sqlstr:= V_Sqlstr|| ' And ( Itm_Mov.I_Date< To_Date( '||''''||P_Date||''''||',''DD/MM/YYYY'') Or Itm_Mov.Doc_Type=0 ) ' ;
If P_Whr Is Not Null Then
V_Sqlstr:= V_Sqlstr||' '|| P_Whr ;
Execute Immediate V_Sqlstr Into V_Op_Qty ;
Return (Nvl(V_Op_Qty,0));
End Open_Stock ;

l(P_Qty,0)+Nvl(Pf_Qty,0)) ),0)
If P_Bat Is Not Null Then

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION Get_Pri_Cost ( P_Wtavg_Type In NUMBER,
P_Date In DATE DEFAULT NUL
P_isfd In NUMBER DEFAULT 0 )
v_pricost NUMBER;
v_fd DATE;
If P_Date Is Null Then -- to_date parameter is not sent ,so return i_cwtavg
Into v_pricost
Where I_Code = P_Icode;
ElsIf P_Wtavg_Type In (2,3) Then -- By Item + Wcode Or By Item + Whgcode
and W_code = P_Wcode
Raise_Application_Error(-20002,'Error When Updating i_cwtavg For i_code = '||P_Icode||chr(13)||SqlErrm) ;
--=========================== to_date Is Sent so check parameter is_fd
Elsif P_isfd = 1 Then -- select first date of periods
Select Min (f_date)
Into v_fd
If P_Date = v_fd Then -- P_Date=first date ,so operator is (<=)
Select nvl(gd.wt_avg_after,0)
From gr_detail gd
Where gd.I_Code = P_Icode
and gd.gr_date = P_Date
and gd.rec_no =
(Select Max (rec_no)
and gd.pi_type = 0);
and gd.w_code = Decode(P_Wtavg_Type,1,gd.w_code,P_Wcode)
--and gd.w_code = Decode(P_Wtavg_Type,1,gd.w_code,P_Wcode)
and gd.whg_code = Decode(P_Wtavg_Type,3,Ias_Wcode_Pkg.Get_Whg_Code(P_Wcode),gd.whg_code)
-- P_Date=first date ,so operator is (<)
INTO v_pricost
and gd.gr_date < P_Date
(Select MAX (rec_no)
and gd.gr_date < P_Date);
Elsif P_isfd = 0 Then
and gd.gr_date <= P_Date
and gd.rec_no
and gd.gr_date <= P_Date);
RETURN (v_pricost);
RETURN (SQLCODE);
END Get_Pri_Cost;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION Doc_Type_Name( P_lang In NUMBER,
P_doctype In NUMBER,
v_dvname VARCHAR2(50);
If P_doctype = 0 Then
Return (Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Prompt (P_lang,1647));
ElsIf P_jvtype Is Null Then
Into v_jvname
From Ias_Sys.IAS_DOCJV_TYPE_SYSTEMS_MST
Where Lang_no = P_lang
and DOC_TYPE = P_Doctype;
Return(P_doctype);
Elsif P_Doctype = 1 Then
Select Decode(P_Lang,1,jv_name,jv_e_name)
where jv_type=P_jvtype;
Elsif P_Doctype = 8 then
Select Decode(P_Lang,1,incom_name,incom_e_name)
From Incom_Types
where Incom_Type=P_jvtype;
return(P_doctype);
Elsif P_Doctype=9 then
Select Decode(P_Lang,1,out_name,out_e_name)
From out_Types
where out_Type=P_jvtype;
Elsif P_Doctype IN( 11,12) then
Select Decode(P_Lang,1,Tr_name,Tr_e_name)
Into v_j
vname
From transfer_Types
where Tr_Type=P_jvtype;
Return(P_Doctype);
ElsIf P_jvtype Is Not Null Then
Into v_dvname
and Flg_Code ='POST_DOC_TYPE'
and Flg_Value= P_doctype;
v_dvname:=Null;
If P_Doctype In (2,3) Then
and Flg_Code ='CASH_CHQ'
and Flg_Value= P_jvtype;
v_jvname:=Null;
ElsIf P_Doctype In (4,5,6,7) Then
and Flg_Code ='TYPE_NAME_SI'
ElsIf P_Doctype = 10 Then
and Flg_Code ='STK_ADJ_TYPE'
ElsIf P_Doctype >=60 Then
Select Jv_NAME
From Ias_Sys.IAS_DOCJV_TYPE_SYSTEMS
and DOC_TYPE = P_Doctype
and JV_TYPE = P_jvtype;
Select Doc_Type_Name
Return(v_dvname||' '||v_jvname);
END Doc_Type_Name;

and Flg_Code ='
TYPE_NAME_SI'
