CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION Get_Pri_Cost_Fifo (pcode Ias_Itm_Mst.I_CODE%TYPE ,
fd Date ,
frst_fd Date ,
wcode WAREHOUSE_DETAILS.W_CODE%TYPE Default Null )Return Number Is
pricost Number :=0;
opcost Number :=0 ;
wh Number ;
IF fd =frst_fd Then
IF wcode Is Null Then
Select Sum((((Nvl(p_qty,0)+Nvl(pf_qty,0))*Nvl(stk_cost,0))/Nvl(p_size,1))*in_out)/sum((Nvl(p_qty,0)+Nvl(pf_qty,0))*in_out)
Into opcost
And item_movement.doc_type =0 ;
And item_movement.doc_type =0
And w_code=wcode;
End IF ;
IF fd <> frst_fd Then
Into pricost
And i_date <fd ;
And i_date <fd
And w_code = wcode;
Return (NVl(pricost,0)+Nvl(opcost,0));
Return (SqlCode);
End Get_Pri_Cost_Fifo;
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION Get_Icode_AvlQty_Priv ( P_Icode In Ias_Itm_Mst.I_Code%Type,
P_UserNo In Number )
If P_Wcode Is Not Null Then --(1)
Select nvl(Sum(distinct avl_qty),0)/P_Psize
From Ias_Itm_Wcode,Privilege_wh
and U_id = P_UserNo
and Ias_Itm_Wcode.w_code=Privilege_wh.w_code
and Ias_Itm_Wcode.W_code=P_Wcode
and nvl(add_flag,0)=1;
avlq:=0;
WHEN Others THEN
Select Sum(avlq)/P_Psize Into avlq From (
Select Sum(distinct Avl_qty) avlq,Ias_Itm_Wcode.w_code
and U_id=P_UserNo
and nvl(add_flag,0)=1
Group By Ias_Itm_Wcode.w_code );
END Get_Icode_AvlQty_Priv;
Create Or Replace Function Get_Icode_Avlqty ( P_Icode In Ias_Itm_Mst.I_Code%Type,
P_Expdate In Date Default Null,
P_Batchno In Varchar2 Default Null,
P_Idate In Date Default Null)
Return Number
Avlq Number:=0;
If P_Idate Is Not Null Then --(1)
Select Nvl(Sum(In_Out*(Nvl(P_Qty,0)+Nvl(Pf_Qty,0)) ),0) /Nvl( P_Psize,1)
Into Avlq
And W_Code = Decode(P_Wcode,Null,W_Code,P_Wcode)
And Expire_Date=Decode(P_Expdate,Null,Expire_Date,Nvl(P_Expdate,'01/01/1900'))
And Batch_No = Decode(P_Batchno,Null,Batch_No,Nvl(P_Batchno,'0'))
And I_Date <= P_Idate;
Avlq:=0;
If P_Wcode Is Not Null Then --(2)
--If p_ExpDate Is Null and p_BatchNo Is Null Then --(3)
If (P_Expdate Is Null Or P_Expdate ='01/01/1900' ) And ( P_Batchno Is Null Or P_Batchno = '0' ) Then --(3)
Select Nvl(Sum(Distinct Avl_Qty),0)/P_Psize
Where I_Code=P_Icode
And Ias_Itm_Wcode.W_Code=P_Wcode;
And Batch_No = Decode(P_Batchno,Null,Batch_No,Nvl(P_Batchno,'0'));
Select Sum(Avlq) Into Avlq From (
Select (Sum(Distinct Avl_Qty)/Nvl( P_Psize,1)) Avlq,W_Code
Group By W_Code );
Return (Nvl(Avlq,0));
End Get_Icode_Avlqty;
CREATE OR REPLACE Function Check_Item_Move( P_Csttype In Number ,
P_Wtavg_Type In Number ,
P_Trns_St In Varchar2 ,
P_Trns_Type In Number ,
P_Doctype In Number ,
P_Docser In Number ,
P_Rcrd_No In Number ,
P_Chk_Doc_Dplct_Itm In Number Default 0) Return Number Is
V_Use_Wcode Number:=0;
If P_Wtavg_Type = 2 Or P_Csttype = 1 Then
V_Use_Wcode:= 1 ;
Elsif P_Wtavg_Type = 3 And P_Csttype = 2 Then
V_Use_Wcode:= 2 ;
If P_Icode Is Not Null And P_Tdate Is Not Null Then --(1)
If P_Trns_St='I' Then --(2) (Insert)
If P_Trns_Type = 1 Then --(Income)
If V_Use_Wcode = 2 Then
Select 1 Into V_Cnt From Item_Movement
And Whg_Code = Ias_Wcode_Pkg.Get_Whg_Code(P_Wcode)
And To_Date(I_Date,'DD/MM/YYYY') > To_Date(P_Tdate,'DD/MM/YYYY')
And W_Code = Decode(V_Use_Wcode,1,P_Wcode,W_Code)
Else --(Out)
And Item_Movement.In_Out = 1
And W_Code = Decode(V_Use_Wcode,1,P_W
code,W_Code)
Else --(2) (Query,Update,Delete)
If P_Trns_Type=1 Then --(income)
If P_Csttype = 2 Then --watAvg
If Nvl(P_Chk_Doc_Dplct_Itm,0)=0 Then
And Serial >( Select Min(Serial) From Item_Movement
Where Doc_Type = P_Doctype
And Doc_Sequence = P_Doc_Seq )
And W_Code = Decode(P_Wtavg_Type,1,W_Code,P_Wcode)
And Doc_Ser <> P_Docser
And Doc_Ser = P_Docser )
Else -- FIFO
Select 1 Into V_Cnt From Gr_Detail
Where Pi_Type = P_Doctype
And Decode(P_Doctype,2,Doc_Ser,G_Ser)= P_Docser
And Nvl(Cp_Qty,0)<>(Nvl(P_Qty,0)+(Nvl(Free_Qty,0)*Nvl(P_Size,1)))
Else --(out)
And Serial >( Select Max(Serial) From Item_Movement
And Doc_Sequence = P_Doc_Seq)
And Item_Movement.In_Out=1
Return(V_Cnt);
End Check_Item_Move;
CREATE OR REPLACE Function Calc_Wtavg_Cost ( P_Cost_Type In Number,
P_Wtavg_Type In Number,
P_Frqty In Number Default 0,
P_Icost In Number,
P_Frc_No In Number,
P_Brn_no In Number Default Null,
P_Brn_Year In Number Default Null,
P_Cmp_no In Number Default Null,
P_Brn_Usr In Number Default Null) Return Number Is
v_Avlqty Number:=0;
v_Wtavg Number:=0;
v_Nwtavg Number:=0;
-- P_Cost_Type ==> 1 = FIFO , 2 = WtAvg
-- P_Wtavg_Type ==> 1 = Item , 2 = Item + W_code , 3 = Item + Whg_code
If P_Cost_Type = 2 Then -- Wt_Avg Item
v_Avlqty:= Get_Icode_AvlQty(P_Icode=>P_Icode,P_Psize=>1) ;
ElsIf P_Wtavg_Type = 2 Then -- By Item + W_code
v_Avlqty:= Get_Icode_AvlQty(P_Icode=>P_Icode,P_Psize=>1,P_Wcode=>P_Wcode) ;
ElsIf P_Wtavg_Type = 3 Then -- By Item + Whg_code
v_Avlqty:= Get_Icode_Whgcode_Avlqty(P_Icode=>P_Icode,P_Psize=>1,P_Whgcode=>Ias_Wcode_Pkg.Get_Whg_Code(P_Wcode)) ;
If P_Wtavg_Type = 1 Then -- WtAvg Item
Select Nvl(I_cwtavg,0)
Where I_code=P_Icode
ElsIf P_Wtavg_Type = 2 Then -- WtAvg I_Code + W_Code
And W_code = P_Wcode
V_Wtavg := 0 ;
Raise_Application_Error(-20001,'Error In Get Wtavg For I_Code '||P_Icode||SqlErrm);
ElsIf P_Wtavg_Type = 3 Then -- WtAvg I_Code + Whg_Code
Raise_Application_Error(-20002,'Error In Get Wtavg For I_Code '||P_Icode||SqlErrm);
End If; -- Wt_Avg Item
Raise_Application_Error(-20003,'Error When Select WatAvg, '||SqlErrm) ;
v_Wtavg:=0;
If v_Avlqty < 0 Then
v_Nwtavg :=Nvl(p_Icost,0)/nvl(p_psize,1);
v_Nwtavg := ((Nvl(v_Wtavg,0) * nvl(v_Avlqty,0)) + (Nvl(p_Icost,0)* (nvl(p_IQty,0) + nvl(P_Frqty,0) )))/(((nvl(p_IQty,0) + nvl(P_Frqty,0) )*nvl(p_psize,1))+ nvl(v_Avlqty,0)) ;
When ZERO_DIVIDE then
v_Nwtavg:=v_Wtavg;
If P_Cost_Type = 2 Then -- WtAvg
Update Ias_Itm_Mst Set I_cwtavg = Round(nvl(v_Nwtavg,0) ,P_Frc_No)
Raise_Application_Error(-20004,'Error When Updating i_cwtavg For i_code = '||P_Icode||chr(13)||SqlErrm) ;
ElsIf P_Wtavg_Type = 2 Then --By Item_Wcode
Update Ias_Itm_Wcode Set I_cwtavg = Round(nvl(v_Nwtavg,0) * nvl(p_size,1),P_Frc_No)
and W_code = P_Wcode;
Raise_Application_Error(-20005,'Error When Updating i_cwtavg In Ias_Itm_Wcode For i_code = '||P_Icode||chr(13)||SqlErrm) ;
ElsIf P_Wtavg_Type = 3 Then --By Item_Whgcode
and Whg_code = Ias_Wcode_Pkg.Get_Whg_Code (P_Wcode);
Raise_Application_Error(-20006,'Error When Updating
i_cwtavg In Ias_Itm_Wcode For i_code = '||P_Icode||chr(13)||SqlErrm) ;
Return(v_Nwtavg);
End Calc_Wtavg_Cost;
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION Get_Items_ACtivity( P_Activity_No In Ias_Items_Activity_Priv.Activity_No%TYPE ,
P_Conn_Itm_Act In Ias_Para_Inv.Conn_Itm_Act_By_Usr_Priv%Type,
P_Op_type In Number Default 1) RETURN NUMBER IS

Where Ias_Items_Activity_Priv.Activity_No = P_Activity_No
And U_Id = P_User_No
And Decode(P_Op_type,1,Add_Flag,View_Flag) = 1
Cnt := 0 ;
Cnt := 1 ;
End Get_Items_ACtivity;
CREATE OR REPLACE Function GET_NEW_SEQ( S_TAB VarChar2,
S_COL VarChar2,
S_TYP VarChar2,
val1 Number,
val2 Number ,
val3 NUMBER ,
val4 NUMBER,
val5 NUMBER,
val6 NUMBER,
init_val NUMBER,
incr_by NUMBER,
seq_conc NUMBER,
v_cmp_no NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
v_Brn_no NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
v_Brn_Usr NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
v_Brn_Year NUMBER DEFAULT NULL ) Return Number is
VSeq Number;
---------------------------------------------------
-- type = 0 Direct sequence
IF s_typ = 0 Then
Select nvl(S_SEQ_VAL,0) + nvl( S_INCRBY_VAL,0)
Into VSeq
From S_SEQ_VALUES
Where UPPER(S_TAB_NAME) = UPPER(S_TAB)
AND UPPER(S_COL_NAME) = UPPER(S_COL)
AND S_SEQ_TYP = S_TYP
For Update;
Update S_SEQ_VALUES
Set S_SEQ_VAL = nvl(S_SEQ_VAL ,0)+ nvl(S_INCRBY_VAL,0)
AND S_SEQ_TYP = S_TYP;
if seq_conc <> 0 then
Return seq_conc||VSeq;
Return VSeq;
end if ;
--Raise_Application_Error(-20002,''Error In Generating Sequence, Record(s) Not Saved'');
VSeq:=init_val;
S_SEQ_VALUES(S_TAB_NAME
,S_COL_NAME
,S_VAL1
,S_VAL2
,S_VAL3
,S_VAL4
,S_VAL5
,S_VAL6
,S_INCRBY_VAL
,S_INIT_VAL
,S_SEQ_VAL
,S_SEQ_TYP
,BRN_YEAR)
VALUES(S_TAB
,S_COL
,incr_by
,init_val
,S_TYP
,v_cmp_no
,v_Brn_no
,v_Brn_Usr
,v_Brn_Year);
-- type = 1 field
ELSIF s_typ = 1 THEN
Select S_SEQ_VAL + S_INCRBY_VAL
UPPER(S_COL_NAME) = UPPER(S_COL)
AND S_
SEQ_TYP = S_TYP
AND S_VAL1=VAL1
Set S_SEQ_VAL = S_SEQ_VAL + S_INCRBY_VAL
AND S_VAL1=VAL1;
DBMS_OUTPUT.Put_Line(VSeq);
--Return 1;
,VAL1
ELSIF s_typ = 2 THEN
AND S_VAL2=VAL2
et S_SEQ_VAL = S_SEQ_VAL + S_INCRBY_VAL
AND S_VAL2=VAL2 ;
,VAL2
ELSIF s_typ = 3 THEN
AND S_VAL3=VAL3
AND S_VAL3=VAL3 ;
,VAL3
ELSIF s_typ = 4 THEN
AND S_VAL4=VAL4
AND S_VAL4=VAL4 ;
,VAL4
,v_Brn_Year
ELSIF s_typ = 5 THEN
AND S_VAL1
= VAL1
AND S_VAL2 = VAL2
AND S_VAL3 = VAL3
AND S_VAL4 = VAL4
AND S_VAL5 = VAL5
AND S_VAL1 = VAL1
AND S_VAL5=VAL5 ;
,VAL5
ELSIF s_typ = 6 THEN
AND S_VAL6 = VAL6
AND S_VAL6 = VAL6 ;
,VAL6

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION Get_Net_Pur_Prev_Year(P_Usr In VARCHAR2,
P_Fld_Name In VARCHAR2,
P_Fld_Value In VARCHAR2,
P_Fdate In DATE,
P_Tdate In DATE,
P_Tname In VARCHAR2 Default Null ,
P_Sign In VARCHAR2 Default Null ,
P_Per In NUMBER Default Null ,
V_Pur Number:=0;
V_RtPur Number:=0;
V_NetPur Number:=0;
--V_whr Varchar2(8000);
--V_Fld_Name Varchar2(50);
From '||P_Usr||'.Ias_Pi_Bill_Mst,'||P_Usr||'.Ias_Pi_Bill_Dtl '||V_Tname||'
Where '||P_Usr||'.Ias_Pi_Bill_Mst.Bill_Ser='||P_Usr||'.Ias_Pi_Bill_Dtl.Bill_Ser'||P_Whr||'
AND '||P_Usr||'.Ias_Pi_Bill_Mst.Bill_Date Between '''||To_Char(P_Fdate,'DD/MM/YYYY')||''' And '''||To_Char(P_Tdate,'DD/MM/YYYY')||'''
AND '||Replace(P_Fld_Name,'V_Code','Ias_Pi_Bill_Mst.v_code')||'='||''''||P_Fld_Value||'''' InTo V_Pur;
From '||P_Usr||'.Ias_Pr_Bill_Mst,'||P_Usr||'.Ias_Pr_Bill_Dtl'||V_Tname||'
Where '||P_Usr||'.Ias_Pr_Bill_Mst.Rt_Bill_Ser='||P_Usr||'.Ias_Pr_Bill_Dtl.Rt_Bill_Ser'||Replace(P_Whr,'Pi_Bill','Pr_Bill')||'
AND '||P_Usr||'.Ias_Pr_Bill_Mst.Rt_Bill_Date Between '''||To_Char(P_Fdate,'DD/MM/YYYY')||''' And '''||To_Char(P_Tdate,'DD/MM/YYYY')||'''
AND '||Replace(Replace(P_Fld_Name,'V_Code','Ias_Pr_Bill_Mst.v_code'),'Pi_Bill','Pr_Bill')||'='||''''||P_Fld_Value||'''' InTo V_RtPur;
V_NetPur := Nvl(V_Pur,0)-Nvl(V_RtPur,0);
If Nvl(V_NetPur,0) >= 0 Then
V_NetPur := V_NetPur + (V_NetPur*P_Per/100);
V_NetPur := V_NetPur - (V_NetPur*P_Per/100);
V_NetPur := V_NetPur * (V_NetPur*P_Per/100);
V_NetPur := V_NetPur / (V_NetPur*P_Per/100);
RETURN V_NetPur;
END Get_Net_Pur_Prev_Year;
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION Ias_Get_Doc_Del_Fnc ( P_Brn_No In S_Brn.Brn_No%Type ,
P_Serial_Type In Number ,
P_doc_jv_type In Number Default Null ,
P_Pur_Type In Number Default Null ,
P_Cc_Code In Varchar2 Default Null ,
P_w_code In Number Default Null ,
P_Cash_No In Number Default Null ) RETURN NUMBER IS
V_Doc_No Number:= Null;
V_Cnt Number:= 0;
P_Whr Varchar2(2000);
----------------------------------------------------
------------------------------------
-- 1- accumulated
-- 2- doc_jv_type
-- 3- by cost_center
-- 4- warehouse
-- 5- warehouse + doc_jv_type
-- 6- by cost_center + doc_jv_type
-- 7- by cash
-- 8- by bank
-- 9- By Journal
V_Cnt := Ias_gen_Pkg.Get_Cnt('Select 1 From Ias_Doc_Del
Where Brn_No = '||P_Brn_No||'
And Doc_Type = '||P_Doc_Type||'
And Doc_Ser = '||P_Doc_Ser ||'
If P_Serial_Type=2 Then
P_Whr := ' And doc_jv_type='||P_doc_jv_type;
ElsIf P_Serial_Type=3 Then
P_Whr := ' And Cc_Code In ( Select Cc_Code From Cost_Centers
Where Nvl(C_Sr,0)=(Select Nvl(C_Sr,0)
where Cc_Code='''||P_Cc_code||'''))';
ElsIf P_Serial_Type = 4 Then
P_Whr := ' And W_Code In ( Select W_Code From Warehouse_Details
Where Nvl(W_Ser,0)=(Select Nvl(W_Ser,0)
where W_Code='||P_w_code||'))';
ElsIf P_Serial_Type=5 Then
P_Whr := ' And w_code='||P_w_code||
' And doc_jv_type='||P_doc_jv_type;
ElsIf P_Serial_Type=6 Then
P_Whr := ' And cc_code='''||P_cc_code||'''
And doc_jv_type='||P_doc_jv_type;
ElsIf P_Serial_Type=7 Then
P_Whr := ' And doc_jv_type='||P_doc_jv_type||'
And Cash_no In ( Select Cash_no From cash_i
n_hand
Where Nvl(cash_sr,0)=(Select Nvl(cash_sr,0)
where Cash_no='||P_Cash_no||'))';
ElsIf P_Serial_Type=8 Then
And Cash_no In ( Select bank_no From cash_at_bank
Where Nvl(bank_sr,0)=(Select Nvl(bank_sr,0)
where bank_no='||P_Cash_no||'))';
ElsIf P_Serial_Type=9 Then
P_Whr := ' And Doc_Jv_Type In ( Select Jv_type From Jv_Types
Where Nvl(Sequenced,0)=(Select Nvl(Sequenced,0)
From jv_Types
where Jv_Type='||P_doc_jv_type||'))';
ElsIf P_Serial_Type= 10 Then
P_Whr := ' And pur_type= '||P_Pur_Type;
V_Doc_No := Ias_gen_Pkg.Get_Cnt('Select Nvl(Max(Doc_No),0)+1 From Ias_Doc_Del
And Doc_Type ='||P_Doc_Type||P_Whr);
END Ias_Get_Doc_Del_Fnc;
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION Get_Ac_Bal_Fnc( P_a_code In ACCOUNT.A_CODE%TYPE ,
P_post In Number Default 1) RETURN NUMBER IS
v_bl_amt NUMBER:=0;
Select Round(nvl(sum(nvl(amt,0)),0) ,2)
Into v_bl_amt
From ias_post_dtl d
where nvl(Doc_Post,0) = Decode (P_post ,2,nvl(Doc_Post,0),1)
and (d.a_code In (Select a_code from ias_Acc_tree where AC_TREE = P_a_code ) Or d.a_code = p_a_code)
and nvl(doc_post,0) = Decode(P_post,2,nvl(doc_post,0),P_post);
Return(nvl(v_bl_amt,0));
End Get_Ac_Bal_Fnc;
Create Or Replace Function Get_Cost_Exp_Batch (P_Icode Ias_Itm_Mst.I_Code%Type ,
P_Td Date ,
P_Wcode Warehouse_Details.W_Code%Type Default Null ,
P_Batch_No Item_Movement.Batch_No%Type Default Null ,
P_Expire_Date Item_Movement.Expire_Date%Type Default Null ) Return Number Is
Select Sum(((((Nvl(P_Qty,0)+Nvl(Pf_Qty,0))*In_Out)*Nvl(Stk_Cost,0))/Nvl(P_Size,1)))/Sum((Nvl(P_Qty,0)+Nvl(Pf_Qty,0))*In_Out)
And I_Date <= P_Td ;
End Get_Cost_Exp_Batch ;
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION Get_Per_Sales_Inc_Icode_Pr
c ( P_Icode Varchar2 ,
P_FDate Date ,
P_TDate Date ,
P_Whr_Batch Varchar2 ,
P_Pos_Sys NUMBER ) RETURN NUMBER IS
---------------------------------------------------------------
V_Qty Number:=0 ;
V_Rt_Qty Number:=0 ;
V_Pos_Qty Number:=0 ;
V_Pos_Rt_Qty Number:=0 ;
V_Inc_Qty Number:=0 ;
V_Per_Qty Number:=0 ;
V_Sql Varchar2(5000):=Null;
V_Sql_Pos Varchar2(5000):=Null;
b Boolean;
V_Whr_Conn Varchar2(1000);
V_Sql := 'Select Nvl(Sum(Nvl(Ias_Bill_Dtl.P_Qty,0)+(Nvl(Ias_Bill_Dtl.Free_Qty,0)*Nvl(P_Size,1))),0)
And Ias_Bill_Dtl.I_Code = '''||P_Icode||'''
And Bill_Date Between '''||P_FDate||''' And '''||P_TDate||''''||P_Whr_Batch;
V_Sql_Pos := 'Select Nvl(Sum(Nvl(Ias_Pos_Bill_Dtl.P_Qty,0)),0)
From Ias_Pos_Bill_Mst,Ias_Pos_Bill_Dtl
Where Ias_Pos_Bill_Mst.Bill_No = Ias_Pos_Bill_Dtl.Bill_No
And Ias_Pos_Bill_Dtl.I_Code = '''||P_Icode||'''
And Bill_Date Between '''||P_FDate||''' And '''||P_TDate||'''
And Nvl(Ias_Pos_Bill_Mst.Posted,0)= 0 '||P_Whr_Batch;
V_Qty := Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Cnt(V_Sql);
V_Rt_Qty := Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Cnt(Replace(V_Sql,'Bill','Rt_Bill'));
If P_Pos_Sys =1 Then
V_Pos_Qty := Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Cnt(V_Sql_Pos);
V_Pos_Rt_Qty := Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Cnt(Replace(V_Sql_Pos,'Bill','Rt_Bill'));
V_Inc_Qty := Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Cnt('Select Nvl(Sum((Nvl(P_Qty,0)+Nvl(Pf_Qty,0))*In_Out),0)
And I_Date Between '''||P_FDate||''' And '''||P_TDate||'''
And Doc_Type Not In (1,3,7,8)'||P_Whr_Batch);
If Nvl(V_Inc_Qty,0)>0 Then
V_Per_Qty := Round((((Nvl(V_Qty,0)+Nvl(V_Pos_Qty,0))-(Nvl(V_Rt_Qty,0)+Nvl(V_Pos_Rt_Qty,0)))/Nvl(V_Inc_Qty,0))*100,2);
V_Per_Qty := 0;
Return (V_Per_Qty);
END Get_Per_Sales_Inc_Icode_Prc;

CREATE OR REPLACE Function Ias_Get_Sale_Age ( P_I_Code In Ias_Itm_Mst.I_Code%Type ,
P_W_Code In Warehouse_Details.W_Code%Type ,
P_Age_Type In Number ,
P_Use_Min_Lmt In Number Default 0 ) Return Number Is
V_Age Number ;
V_F_Avl_Qty Number ;
V_T_Avl_Qty Number ;
V_Doc_Date Date ;
V_Max_Doc_Date Date ;
V_Min_Doc_Date Date ;
V_Tr_Date Date ;
V_Rec_Tr_Date Date ;
V_Lost_Day Number ;
P_Cmp_Value Number ;
If P_Type = 1 Then -- General Age For Item
If P_Age_Type = 1 Then -- Default Option
Select Sum(First_Inc_Date-Last_Out_Date)
Into V_Lost_Day
From Ias_Itm_Sales_Age
And Last_Out_Date >= P_F_Date
And Last_Out_Date <= P_T_Date
And First_Inc_Date > Last_Out_Date
And First_Inc_Date Is Not Null
And Last_Out_Date Is Not Null ;
V_Lost_Day := 0 ;
End ;*/
--##-----------------------------------------------------------------##-
If Nvl(P_Use_Min_Lmt,0) = 1 Then
P_Cmp_Value := Ias_Itm_Pkg.Get_Itm_Min_Qty( P_I_Code => P_I_Code , P_W_Code => P_W_Code ) ;
P_Cmp_Value := 0 ;
--## Get Avl Qty
V_F_Avl_Qty := Yr_Get_Icode_Avlqty_Fnc ( P_Icode => P_I_Code ,
P_Psize => 1 ,
P_Wcode => Null ,
P_Expdate => Null ,
P_Batchno => Null ,
P_Idate => P_F_Date ) ;
V_F_Avl_Qty := 0 ;
V_T_Avl_Qty := Yr_Get_Icode_Avlqty_Fnc ( P_Icode => P_I_Code ,
P_Idate => P_T_Date ) ;
V_T_Avl_Qty := 0 ;
If Nvl(V_F_Avl_Qty,0) > P_Cmp_Value And Nvl(V_T_Avl_Qty,0) > P_Cmp_Value Then
V_Age := To_Date(P_T_Date,'DD/MM/YYYY') - To_Date(P_F_Date,'DD/MM/YYYY') ;
V_Age := Nvl(V_Age,0) - Nvl(V_Lost_Day,0);
ElsIf Nvl(V_F_Avl_Qty,0) > P_Cmp_Value And Nvl(V_T_Avl_Qty,0) = P_Cmp_Value Then
Select Max(I_Date) Into V_Doc_Date
Where I_C
ode = P_I_Code
And I_Date <= P_T_Date
And In_Out = -1 ;
If V_Doc_Date Is Not Null Then
V_Age := To_Date(V_Doc_Date,'DD/MM/YYYY') - To_Date(P_F_Date,'DD/MM/YYYY') ;
ElsIf Nvl(V_F_Avl_Qty,0) = P_Cmp_Value And Nvl(V_T_Avl_Qty,0) > P_Cmp_Value Then
Select Min(Gr_Date) Into V_Min_Doc_Date
And Gr_Date Between P_F_Date And P_T_Date ;
V_Min_Doc_Date := Null ;
If V_Min_Doc_Date Is Not Null Then
V_Age := To_Date(P_T_Date,'DD/MM/YYYY') - To_Date(V_Min_Doc_Date,'DD/MM/YYYY') ;
ElsIf Nvl(V_T_Avl_Qty,0) = P_Cmp_Value And Nvl(V_F_Avl_Qty,0) = P_Cmp_Value Then
If V_Doc_Date Is Not Null And V_Min_Doc_Date Is Not Null Then
V_Age := To_Date(V_Doc_Date,'DD/MM/YYYY') - To_Date(V_Min_Doc_Date,'DD/MM/YYYY') ;
ElsIf P_Age_Type = 2 Then -- Min Transfer
If V_Tr_Date Is Not Null Then
Select Min(Ias_V_Whtrns_Mst_Yr.Tr_Ser) Tr_Ser
Into V_Tr_Ser
And Ias_V_Whtrns_Mst_Yr.Tr_InOut_Type = 1
And Ias_V_Whtrns_Mst_Yr.Tr_Date = V_Tr_Date ;
V_Tr_Ser := Null ;
If V_Tr_Ser Is Not Null Then
Select Min(Ias_V_Whtrns_Mst_Yr.Tr_Date) Rec_Tr_Date
And Ias_V_Whtrns_Mst_Yr.Tr_InOut_Type = 2
And Ias_V_Whtrns_Mst_Yr.F_Tr_Ser = V_Tr_Ser
And Ias_V_Whtrns_Mst_Yr.Tr_Date <= P_T_Date ;
If V_Tr_Date Is Not Null And V_Rec_Tr_Date Is Not Null Then
If P_T_Date Is Not Null And V_Tr_Date Is Not Null Then
V_Age := To_Date(P_T_Date,'DD/MM/YYYY') -To_Date(V_Tr_Date,'DD/MM/YYYY') - Nvl(V_Road_Distance,0);
ElsIf P_Age_Type = 3 Then -- Min Incoming
Select Min(Ias_V_Gr_Detail_Yr.Gr_Date) Gr_Date
Into V_Min_Doc_Date
Where Ias_V_Gr_Detail_Yr.Pi_Type Not In (3,15,17)
And Ias_V_Gr_Detail_Yr.I_Code = P_I_Code
If P_T_Date
Is Not Null And V_Min_Doc_Date Is Not Null Then
V_Age := To_Date(P_T_Date,'DD/MM/YYYY') -To_Date(V_Min_Doc_Date,'DD/MM/YYYY');
ElsIf P_Age_Type = 4 Then -- Max Transfer
Select Max(Ias_V_Whtrns_Mst_Yr.Tr_Date) Tr_Date
Select Max(Ias_V_Whtrns_Mst_Yr.Tr_Ser) Tr_Ser
Select Max(Ias_V_Whtrns_Mst_Yr.Tr_Date) Rec_Tr_Date
ElsIf P_Age_Type = 5 Then -- Max Incoming
Select Max(Ias_V_Gr_Detail_Yr.Gr_Date) Gr_Date
If P_T_Date Is Not Null And V_Min_Doc_Date Is Not Null Then
ElsIf P_Type = 2 Then -- General Age For Item And Wcode
P_Wcode => P_W_Code ,
ElsIf Nvl(V_F_Avl_Qty,0) > P_Cmp_Value And Nvl(V_T_Avl_Qty,0) <= P_Cmp_Value Then
ElsIf Nvl(V_F_Avl_Qty,0) <= P_Cmp_Value And Nvl(V_T_Avl_Qty,0) > P_Cmp_Value Then
V_Age := To_Date(
P_T_Date,'DD/MM/YYYY') - To_Date(V_Min_Doc_Date,'DD/MM/YYYY') ;
ElsIf Nvl(V_T_Avl_Qty,0) <= P_Cmp_Value And Nvl(V_F_Avl_Qty,0) <= P_Cmp_Value Then
And Ias_V_Whtrns_Dtl_Yr.T_W_Code = P_W_Code
If P_T_Date Is Not Null And V_Tr_Date Is Not Nul
l Then
If Nvl(V_Age,0) > 0 Then
V_Age := Nvl(V_Age,0) + 1 ;
End Ias_Get_Sale_Age ;
CREATE OR REPLACE Function Ias_Get_Sale_Age_Batch ( P_I_Code In Ias_Itm_Mst.I_Code%Type Default Null ,
P_Batch_No In Item_Movement.Batch_No%Type Default Null,
P_Age_Type In Number ) Return Number Is
V_Tr_Ser Ias_Whtrns_Mst.Tr_Ser%Ty
pe ;
If P_I_Code Is Null Then
Into V_F_Avl_Qty
Where W_Code = Decode(P_W_Code,Null,W_Code,P_W_Code)
And Batch_No = Decode(P_Batch_No,Null,Batch_No,Nvl(P_Batch_No,'0'))
Into V_T_Avl_Qty
And Batch_No = Decode(P_Ba
tch_No,Null,Batch_No,Nvl(P_Batch_No,'0'))
And I_Date <= P_T_Date ;
V_F_Avl_Qty := Get_Icode_Avlqty ( P_Icode => P_I_Code ,
P_Batchno => P_Batch_No ,
V_T_Avl_Qty := Get_Icode_Avlqty ( P_Icode => P_I_Code ,
If Nvl(V_F_Avl_Qty,0) > 0 And Nvl(V_T_Avl_Qty,0) > 0 Then
ElsIf Nvl(V_F_Avl_Qty,0) > 0 And Nvl(V_T_Avl_Qty,0) = 0 Then
Where I_Code = Decode(P_I_Code,Null,I_Code,P_I_Code)
And W_Code = Decode(P_W_Code,Null,W_Code,P_W_Code)
ElsIf Nvl(V_F_Avl_Qty,0) = 0 And Nvl(V_T_Avl_Qty,0) > 0 Then
ElsIf Nvl(V_T_Avl_Qty,0) = 0 And Nvl(V_F_Avl_Qty,0) = 0 Then
Batch_No = Decode(P_Batch_No,Null,Batch_No,P_Batch_No)
And Ias_V_Whtrns_Dtl_Yr.I_Code = Decode(P_I_Code,Null,Ias_V_Whtrns_Dtl_Yr.I_Code,P_I_Code)
And Ias_V_Whtrns_Dtl_Yr.T_W_Code = Decode(P_W_Code,Null,Ias_V_Whtrns_Dtl_Yr.T_W_Code,P_W_Code)
And Ias_V_Whtrns_Dtl_Yr.Batch_No = Decode(P_Batch_No,Null,Ias_V_Whtrns_Dtl_Yr.Batch_No,P_Batch_No)
And Ias_V_Whtrns_Dtl_Yr.W_Code = Decode(P_W_Code,Null,Ias_V_Whtrns_Dtl_Yr.W_Code,P_W_Code)
And Ias_V_Gr_Detail_Yr.I_Code = Decode(P_I_Code,Null,Ias_V_Gr_Detail_Yr.I_Code,P_I_Code)
And Ias_V_Gr_Detail_Yr.W_Code = Decode(P_W_Code,Null,Ias_V_Gr_Detail_Yr.W_Code,P_W_Code)
And Ias_V_Gr_Detail_Yr.Batch_No = Decode(P_Batch_No,Null,Ias_V_Gr_Detail_Yr.Batch_No,P_Batch_No)
And Ias_V_Whtrns_Dtl
_Yr.I_Code = Decode(P_I_Code,Null,Ias_V_Whtrns_Dtl_Yr.I_Code,P_I_Code)
End Ias_Get_Sale_Age_Batch ;

V_Barcode Ias_Itm_Unt_Barcode.Barcode%Type;
V_Icode Ias_Itm_Unt_Barcode.I_Code%Type;
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
If P_Barcode_Type=1 Then -- Barcode Same Item
V_Icode := P_Icode;
If V_Icode Is Not Null Then
If P_Barcode_Type=1 And Nvl(P_Barcode,'0')<>'0' Then
V_Barcode := P_Barcode ;
Select Barcode InTo V_Barcode From Ias_Itm_Unt_Barcode Where I_Code=V_Icode And RowNum<=1;
V_Barcode := Null;
Return(V_Barcode);
eturn(Null);
END Ias_Get_Itm_Barcode_Fnc;

nd RowNum<=1;

Create Or Replace Function Get_Out_Bill_Qty ( P_Icode In Ias_Itm_Mst.I_Code%Type,
P_Use_Out_Bills In Number,
P_Typ In Number) Return Number Is
-- P_Typ = 1= Out Bill , 2= Return Bill
If P_Use_Out_Bills=1 Then
If P_Typ = 1 Then -- out_bills
Select Sum(((Nvl(I_Qty,0)-Nvl(Out_Qty,0))+(Nvl(Free_Qty,0)-Nvl(Out_Free_Qty,0)))*Nvl(P_Size,1))
And Ias_Bill_Dtl.W_Code=P_Wcode
And Expire_Date=Nvl(P_Expdate,Expire_Date)
And Batch_No=Nvl(P_Batchno,Batch_No);
V_Qty:=0;
Elsif P_Typ=2 Then
Select Sum(((Nvl(I_Qty,0)-Nvl(Ret_Qty,0))+(Nvl(Free_Qty,0)-Nvl(Ret_Free_Qty,0)))*Nvl(P_Size,1))
And Ias_Rt_Bill_Dtl.W_Code = P_Wcode
Return( V_Qty);
Create Or Replace Function Get_Tr_Not_Rec_Qty ( P_Icode In Ias_Itm_Mst.I_Code%Type,
P_Doc_Date In Date Default Null) Return Number Is
Select Sum(Round ((Nvl(Ias_Whtrns_Dtl.P_Qty,0)/Nvl(P_Psize,1)),4)) Into V_Qty
And Ias_Whtrns_Mst.Tr_Date <= P_Doc_Date
And Ias_Whtrns_Dtl.I_Code = P_Icode
And Nvl(Ias_Whtrns_Mst.Processed,0)= 0;
CREATE OR REPLACE Function Get_Itm_Sales_Tnovr_Ratio ( P_Costing_Type In Ias_Para_Inv.Costing_Type%Type
P_V_Tp In Number ,
P_I_Size In Varchar2 Default 1 ,
P_Tnovr_Type In Number ,
P_Retrn_Type In Number default 3) Return Number Is
V_Dev Number := 0 ;
V_Op_Qty Number := 0 ;
V_Fin_Qty Number := 0 ;
V_Sl_Cost Number := 0 ;
V_Slrtn_Cost Number := 0 ;
V_Op_Cost Number := 0 ;
V_Fin_Cost Number := 0 ;
V_Trovr Number := 0 ;
V_Tnovr_Type Number(1) := 1 ; --- Ratio Type 1=Cost 2=Qty ---
V_sale_cost Number := 0 ;
V_Stock_Cost Number := 1 ;
If P_I_Code Is Not Null And P_Td Is Not Null Then
---##----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------##---
--## To Get Sales Qty
Select Nvl((Sum((((Nvl(I_Qty,0)+Nvl(Free_Qty,0))*Nvl(P_Size,0))*Decode(P_Tnovr_Type,1,Nvl(Stk_Cost,0),1))/Nvl(P_I_Size,1))),0)
Into V_Sl_Cost
From Ias_Bill_Mst M , Ias_Bill_Dtl C
Where M.Bill_Ser = C.Bill_Ser
And C.I_Code = P_I_Code
And C.W_Code = Decode(P_W_Code,Null,C.W_Code,P_W_Code)
And M.Bill_Date Between P_Fd And P_Td
GROUP BY Decode(P_W_CODE,Null,C.W_Code,P_W_CODE),C.I_Code ;
--- raise_application_error(-20001 , ' Err in Bills V_Sl_Cost ' ||SqlErrm);
V_Sl_Cost := 0 ;
--- To Get Return Sales Qty
Select Nvl((Sum((((Nvl(I_Qty,0)+Nvl(Free_Qty,0))*Nvl(P_Size,0))*Decode(P_Tnovr_Type,1,Nvl(Stk_Cost,0),1))/N
vl(P_I_Size,1))),0) Into V_Slrtn_Cost
From Ias_Rt_Bill_Mst M, Ias_Rt_Bill_Dtl C
Where M.Rt_Bill_Ser = C.Rt_Bill_Ser
And M.Rt_Bill_Date Between P_Fd And P_Td
-- raise_application_error(-20001 ,' Err in Rt Bills V_Slrtn_Cost ' || SqlErrm);
V_Slrtn_Cost := 0 ;
-- To Get Open Stock Qty
Select Nvl(Sum((Nvl(In_Out*(Nvl(C.P_Qty,0)+Nvl(C.Pf_Qty,0)) ,0) / Nvl(P_I_Size,1))* Decode(P_Tnovr_Type,1,Nvl(Stk_Cost,0),1))
,0) Into V_Op_Qty
From Item_Movement C
Where C.I_Code = P_I_Code
And (C.I_Date < P_Fd Or Doc_Type = 0)
-- raise_application_error(-20001 ,' Err in Bills V_Sl_Cost ' || SqlErrm);
Select Nvl((Sum((((Nvl(I_Qty,0)+Nvl(Free_Qty,0))*Nvl(P_Size,0))*Decode(P_Tnovr_Type,1,Nvl(Stk_Cost,0),1
))/Nvl(P_I_Size,1))),0)
GROUP BY C.I_Code ;
Select Nvl((Sum((((Nvl(I_Qty,0)+Nvl(Free_Qty,0))*Nvl(P_Size,0))*Decode(P_Tnovr_Type,1,Nvl(Stk_Cost,0),1))/Nvl(P_I_Size,1))),0) Into V_Slrtn_Cost
-- To Get Balance Qty
Select Nvl(((Nvl(Get_Icode_Avlqty ( P_I_Code , 1 , P_W_Code , Null , Null , Null ),0))/Nvl(P_I_Size,1)),0)
Into V_Fin_Qty From Dual;
-- raise_application_error(-20001 ,' Err in Get_Icode_Avlqty V_Fin_Qty ' || SqlErrm);
V_Fin_Qty := 0 ;
--- To Get Open Stock Cost
If P_Costing_Type = 1 Then -- Fifo
V_Op_Cost:=Get_Pri_Cost_Fifo( P_I_Code,
P_Fd,
Ias_Gen_Pkg.Get_Frst_Day,
P_W_Code) * Nvl(V_Op_Qty,0);
-- raise_application_error(-20001 ,' Err in Get_Pri_Cost_Fifo V_Op_Cost ' || SqlErrm);
V_Op_Cost:=Get_Pri_Cost( P_Wtavg_Type,
0 ) * Nvl(V_Op_Qty,0);
-- raise_application_error(-20001 ,' Err in Get_Pri_Cost V_Op_Cost ' || SqlErrm);
--- To Get Balance Cost
V_Fin_Cost:= Get_Cost_Fifo ( P_I_Code,P_Td,P_W_Code) * Nvl(V_Fin_Qty,0);
V_Fin_Cost := 0 ;
---raise_application_error(-20001 ,' Err in Fifo By To Get Balance Cost ' || SqlErrm);
Select Nvl((( Ias_Itm_Pkg.Get_Grand_Avlqty( P_I_Code,P_W_Code) )/Nvl(P_I_Size,1)),0)*
Get_Cost ( P_Wtavg_Type ,P_V_Tp,P_I_Code,P_W_Code,P_Td,P_Td)
Into V_Fin_Cost From Dual;
--- raise_application_error(-20001 ,' Err in Wtavg By Item Or By Item + W_Code ' || SqlErrm);
Elsif P_Wtavg_Type = 3 Then -- Item + Whg_Code
Select Nvl((( Get_Icode_Whgcode_Avlqty( P_I_Code,Null,Ias_Wcode_Pkg.Get_Whg_Code(P_W_Code)))/Nvl(P_I_Size,1)),0)
* Get_Cost ( P_Wtavg_Type ,P_V_Tp,P_I_Code,P_W_Code,P_Td,P_Td)
--- raise_application_error(-20001 ,' Err in Wtavg By Item + Whg_Code ' || SqlErrm);
--- To Calculate Ratio
If V_Op_Cost > 0 Then
V_Dev:=1;
If V_Fin_Cost > 0 Then
V_Dev:= Nvl(V_Dev,0) + 1;
If V_Dev > 0 Then
V_Trovr:= ((V_Sl_Cost - V_Slrtn_Cost ) / V_Op_Cost + V_Fin_Cost ) * V_Dev;
V_Trovr:= 0;
--##-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------##------
If P_Retrn_Type =1 then
V_Sale_Cost :=nvl((V_Sl_Cost - V_Slrtn_Cost ),0) ;
Return (V_Sale_Cost);
Elsif P_Retrn_Type =2 then
V_Stock_Cost :=nvl((V_Op_Cost + V_Fin_Cost ),1);
Return (V_Stock_Cost);
Elsif P_Retrn_Type =3 then
Return (Nvl(V_Trovr,1));
End Get_Itm_Sales_Tnovr_Ratio;
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION CHK_TLGRM_PRMTRS( P_USR_TYP IN VARCHAR2, P_USR_CODE IN VARCHAR2 , P_PSSWRD IN VARCHAR2 , P_MOBILE_NO IN VARCHAR2 ) RETURN NUMBER IS
V_RSLT NUMBER := 0;
V_USR_CODE VARCHAR2(100);
V_PWD VARCHAR2(100);
V_MOBILE_NO VARCHAR2(100);
CURSOR USR_CV IS SELECT USERNAME FROM ALL_USERS WHERE USERNAME LIKE 'IAS%' AND USERNAME <> 'IAS_SYS'
AND SUBSTR(USERNAME,4,4) = (SELECT MAX(SUBSTR(USERNAME,4,4)) FROM ALL_USERS WHERE USERNAME LIKE 'IAS%' AND USERNAME <> 'IAS_SYS' );
FOR I IN USR_CV LOOP
IF P_USR_TYP = 1 THEN -- CUSTOMER
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE ('SELECT C_MOBILE,C_PWD FROM CUSTOMER WHERE C_CODE = '||''''||P_USR_CODE||''''||' AND ROWNUM<=1 ') INTO V_MOBILE_NO,V_PWD ;
IF V_PWD <> P_PSSWRD THEN
V_RSLT := 2 ;
ELSIF V_MOBILE_NO <> P_MOBILE_NO THEN
V_RSLT := 3 ;
ELSIF P_USR_TYP = 2 THEN -- EMPLOYEE
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE ('SELECT MOBILE_NO,EMP_PSWRD FROM S_EMP WHERE EMP_NO = '||''''||P_USR_CODE||''''||' AND ROWNUM<=1') INTO V_MOBILE_NO,V_PWD ;
RETURN(V_RSLT);
RETURN(1);
END CHK_TLGRM_PRMTRS;
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION Get_Tr_Qty_Fnc (P_Bill_Ser In Number,P_I_Code In Ias_Itm_Mst.I_Code%Type,P_W_Code In Warehouse_Details.W_Code%Type,P_Batch_No In Gr_Detail.Batch_No%Type,P_Expire_Date In Gr_Detail.Expire_Date%Type) RETURN NUMBER IS
V_Tr_Qty Number;
Select Nvl(Sum(I_Qty),0) InTo V_Tr_Qty
And Batch_No
= P_Batch_No
And Expire_Date = P_Expire_Date

And Doc_Ser_Ref<>P_Bill_Ser
And (Doc_Ser_Ref,I_Code,T_W_Code) Not In (Select Bill_Ser,I_Code,W_Code from Detail_Out_Bills));
Return(V_Tr_Qty);
